3d.an_autonomous_agent_building_a_game_a: Agent yigenga ikora umukino, ishusho, NFT, cyangwa umutungo wo ku isoko ikeneye 3D — kandi ikeneye kwizera ibyo ibona. Iyi API isubiza ibibazo byombi mu gihe cy'akazi: nkoreye model ikomoka kuri iyi nyandiko, na iyi model irakora neza, kandi nayigabanya nte? Nta yindi platform y'ubwishyu bwa agent itanga gukora no kugenzura 3D ku buntu.

3d.give_your_ai_agent_a_3d_toolchain: Ha umukozi wa AI wawe ibikoresho bya 3D. Hindura amagambo yanditsemo GLB nyayo ifite imiterere, genzura kandi unonosore glTF/GLB iyo ari yo yose — ubuntu, nta rufunguzo, nta konti. Iyo inyandiko y'ibanze idahagije, API imwe igera ku byiciro bya Forge Pro bikoreshwa mu gukora no ku ma-Avatar yateguwe gukoreshwa mu gukina amashusho.

Gukora inyandiko mbanziriza no kuyisuzuma ku buntu bigera ku rwego rwa Forge Pro rwishyurwa n'ama-avatar yateguwe yiteguye gukoreshwa mu ma-animation. Nta rufunguzo, nta konti.

3d.real_glb_not_a_screenshot: GLB nyayo, si ifoto yafashwe kuri ecran
3d.start_free_upgrade_only_when_a_draft: Tangira ku buntu. Uzamure urwego gusa igihe inyandiko mbanziriza idahagije. Urwego rwishyurwa rwishyurwa buri koreshwa muri USDC binyuze kuri x402 — nta konti, nta n'urufunguzo.
3d.text_3d_and_image_3d_pipelines: Imikorere ihindura amagambo akaba 3D n'amashusho akaba 3D

3d.this_is_a_live_gltf_binary_rendered: Iyi ni binary ya glTF ikora igaragara muri mushakisha yawe. Endpoint y'ubuntu /api/3d/inspect itanga amakuru y'ukuri ku byiri muri ibi — vertices, triangles, ibikoresho, textures, animations, extensions — n'igishushanyo mbonera cyihutirwa cyo kuyigira nto kandi yihuta.
3d.yes_no_account_no_api_key_no: Yego. Nta konti, nta API key, nta wallet. Endpoints z'ubuntu zifite urugero ntarengwa rwo gukoresha kuri buri IP rurinda gusa gukoresha nabi. Urwego rw'ubuntu rwo gukora inyandiko mbanziriza rukoresha umuhanda wa GPU usangiwe — rwerekana neza ko ari urwego rwo kugerageza (draft geometry, GLB gusa, nta gutegura).

agenc_embodied.h1_v2: AgenC embodied: a Solana umuhare ufite umubiri live · solana
agenc_embodied.lede_v2: Gura umuhare utagukira aha, cyangusa paste any AgenC task PDA. Avatar yakoreshwa ikunjwe n'ikirere cy'umuhare on-chain through the <three-ws-agent> web component, which polls /api/agenc/get-task na recolors the scene as the task moves from Open to In Progress to Pending Validation to Completed. Halo hagati ya avatar ni icyo kibazo cy'ubuzima; with the optional agenc-clips attribute, a GLB that carries animation clips switches clip per state. Every transition is a real Solana transaction. agenc.tech

artifact_index.glbs_over_6_mb_are_rejected_because: GLBs over 6 MB ntabwo bafungurwa, kubera Claude's artifact panel ikora cyane ku payloads zinkomeje zikorerwamo. Viewer ikeraho 565 KB flat ku model.
artifact_index.glbs_over_6_mb_are_rejected_claude: GLB zirenga 6 MB ntizemerwa — panel ya artifact ya Claude ishobora guhagarara kubera ibintu binini byinjijwemo. Umureba yongeraho 565 KB hejuru ya model.
artifact_index.meta_description: Injizamo agent ya three.ws ikorana muri artifact ya Claude.ai. HTML yuzuye, nta bindi bishingirwaho byo hanze.
artifact_index.meta_og_description: Yerekana bundles za artifact za Claude nk'application zishobora kwinjizwamo zihagaze ku giti cyazo.
artifact_index.meta_twitter_description: Yerekana bundles za artifact za Claude nk'application zishobora kwinjizwamo zihagaze ku giti cyazo.
artifact_index.models_over_6_mb_are_rejected_because: Models over 6 MB ntabwo bafungurwa, kubera Claude's artifact panel ikora cyane ku payloads zikorerwamo inlining. Inlining base64-encodes model, which costs four bytes per three, ku top ya 565 KB viewer flat: model 6 MB ikajya kuba roughly 8.6 MB ya HTML. That total, not model, ni icyo size stat igukorera.
artifact_index.paste_a_single_url_into_a_claude: Andika URL imwe gusa muri chat ya Claude. Igisubizo kiba inyandiko imwe ya HTML yuzuye — three.js, GLTFLoader, na GLB ya agent yawe byose biba birimo. Nta script ihagarikwa na CSP ya sandbox ya Claude, nta kintu gifetching kigera gisohoka kuri page.
artifact_index.the_response_sets_a_csp_mirroring_claude: Igisubizo gishyiraho CSP isa n'iya Claude. Imyitwarire muri preview ibaho isa n'imyitwarire muri Claude.ai — nta bitunguranye hagati ya staging na prod.
artifact_index.three_js_gltfloader_and_the_glb_are: three.js, GLTFLoader, na GLB byose biba birimo. Page yerekana nta network calls zibayeho — ihuye neza na CSP ya sandbox ya Claude ibuzanya fetch na scripts zo hanze.

asl-alphabet.atoz_p: Buri nyuguti ishyirwa ku murongo umwe n'uburyo agent ikoresha mu gusinya igisubizo cy'ikiganiro, bityo ibyo wiga hano ni byo uzasoma hariya. Kanda ku nyuguti kugira ngo uyisobanukirwe; kanda cyangwa uyikande, uyirebe.
asl-alphabet.h1: Buri nyuguti ya ASL, ku kiganza ushobora guhindura.
asl-alphabet.keys_hint: Inama: kanda kuri <kbd>inyuguti</kbd> cyangwa <kbd>umubare</kbd> uwo ari wo wose kugira ngo usinye ako kanya.
asl-alphabet.lede: Ifoto y'ikiganza igaragaza igipimo kimwe. Ibi ni ukuri: avatar ifite rig ikora buri nyuguti y'icyanditswe cy'intoki cy'Amerika, ku muvuduko uhitamo, ku kiganza icyo ari cyo cyose. Kanda ku nyuguti, cyangwa uyikande ku kibaho cyawe.
asl-alphabet.meta_desc: Icyanditswe cy'intoki cy'Amerika ku avatar ibarizwa mu 3D. Kanda cyangwa andika inyuguti iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo ubone ikiganza, usome ibyo ugomba kureba, wige ibisa, ushyire mu nyuguti ijambo icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi witoze kugeza ushoboye gusoma fingerspelling.
asl-alphabet.note: Fingerspelling ni igice kimwe cy'ururimi rw'ikimenyetso cy'Amerika: gisinya amazina, amagambo y'inguzanyo, n'ibintu byose bidafite ikimenyetso cyabyo. Amagambo afite ibimenyetso asinywa guhabwa, kandi ushobora kubireba, ukabona ibisubizo by'ikiganiro byasinywe na AI, kandi ugasinyira hamwe na webcam yawe kuri /sign-language. Icyerekezo cyuzuye kiri muri inyandiko, kandi moteri inyuma y'impapuro zombi itangwa nk'igipaki @three-ws/sign-language, gishobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa kuva ku ishusho kugeza igihe urutonde rwayo ruzaba rwamaze gushyirwa ahagaragara.
asl-alphabet.page_title: Icyanditswe cya ASL: buri nyuguti ku kiganza cy'ibihangano mu 3D · three.ws
asl-alphabet.practice_p: Gusoma fingerspelling ni igice gikomeye, kandi biza gusa mu gusubiramo. Avatar isinya ikintu; wandika ibyo usoma. Igihe cyawe kirabikwa kuri iki gikoresho.
asl-alphabet.share_desc: Kanda cyangwa andika inyuguti iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo urebe avatar ibarizwa mu 3D isinya, usome ikiganza, wige ibisa, kandi witoze gusoma fingerspelling.
asl-alphabet.share_title: Icyanditswe cya ASL: buri nyuguti ku kiganza cy'ibihangano mu 3D · three.ws
asl-alphabet.spell_h: Sinyira ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose
asl-alphabet.spell_p: Andika ijambo urebe uko risinywa inyuguti ku nyuguti, buri nyuguti ikaka umucyo uko ikiganza kigera kuri yo. Amazina, ahantu, n'ibintu byose bidafite ikimenyetso cyabyo ni byo fingerspelling igenewe.

assembly.canvas_aria: Icyerekezo cy'imashini. Komeza cyangwa ukoreshe imfunguzo z'ibumoso n'iburyo kugira ngo ugenzure camera.
assembly.explain1_body: Imashini zombi zubakwa igihe urupapuro rwikora. Ibipimo bihinduka imiterere, imiterere ikazenguruka cyangwa ikazenguruka, kandi ibisubizo bigahurizwa hamwe mu bice ushobora kubona. Umuyoboro w'icyuma ni umwe mu bisekuru byazengurutse, umuyoboro ni umwe mu gice cyafunzwe cyakwirakwijwe ku murongo, kandi urukuta rw'igikoresho ni urutonde rw'ibice bya NACA byazengurutse bifite umunuko.
assembly.explain1_title: Nta kintu na kimwe cyakiriwe hano
assembly.explain2_body: Pistons ziva ku slider-crank y'ibipimo. Icyuma cy'ibikoni gifunga urukiramende rw'ibice bine binyuze mu guhuza imirongo buri gihe. Ni yo mpamvu urukuta rurerure rugaragara ruba ku murongo w'ibyo, kandi ni yo mpamvu urukuta rurerure rudashobora kugera ku murongo w'ibyo rudakora ahubwo rukanga kugenda.
assembly.explain2_title: Imyitwarire irakemurwa, ntabwo ikozwe mu byiciro
assembly.explain3_body: Buri mashini ni ikintu gito cya JSON cy'imibare. Kopira ibisobanuro, ubishyire ku muyoboro, ubone indi mashini. Ohereza umusaruro nka GLB kandi uhita ujya mu ishusho y'avatar, urupapuro rw'igicuruzwa, cyangwa mu glTF umureba.
assembly.hint: Kurambura kugirango uhindure · kumanuka kugirango ugaragaze · kora ku gice kugirango ugitange izina · ahantu, E na S
assembly.meta_desc: Imashini ebyiri zikora nta mafaili ya 3D ziri inyuma yazo. Moteri ya radial aero na locomotive ya steam, ikorwa mu rubuga rwawe rw'ibikoresho uhereye ku bipimo bike, hamwe n'imyitwarire ikemuwe, kureba byagutse, ibiparameter bigenzurwa n'ibyo GLB byoherejwe.
assembly.next1_body: Sobanura ikintu mu magambo kandi ubone GLB ifite texture.
assembly.next2_body: Shyira mu bikorwa ibyo wohereje urebe ibikoresho, meshes n'imyitwarire.
assembly.next3_body: Ibindi bipimo byose biri gukora ku three.ws.
assembly.og_desc: Nta mafaili y'ibimenyetso. Moteri ya radial aero na locomotive ya steam byubatswe mu gihe cyo gukora uhereye ku bipimo, imiterere n'imikorere ya geometrie, hamwe n'ibikurikirana byakemuwe ushobora kubikuramo.
assembly.page_title: Machine Atlas · Imashini zikorwa uhereye ku murongo, ntabwo ku mafaili y'ibimenyetso · three.ws
assembly.source_note: Ikorwa uhereye ku gaciro kari iburyo, bityo ihora ihuye n'ibiri ku ishusho.
assembly.tw_desc: Moteri ya radial na locomotive ya steam, ikorwa mu gihe cyo gukora uhereye ku bipimo n'imiterere. Kora ku isaha kandi geometrie irongera kubakwa.

assistant.a_3d_avatar_assistant_on_any_website:
Umufasha w'avatar ya 3D
kuri website iyo ari yo yose.
assistant.a_real_animated_3d_character_with_idle: Imyitwarire nyayo ya 3D ikora ifite animations zo gutuza, gukoma, no kuvuga — ihagaze neza kuri page yawe iyo background ibonerana.
assistant.custom_avatar_glb_url_arialabel: Custom avatar GLB URL cyangwa three.ws avatar id
assistant.docs_developer_docs_related_3d_embeds_wa: Docs: inyandiko z'abashinzwe iterambere · Bifitanye isano: 3D embeds · walking avatar embed · creator widgets
assistant.free_lane_needs_no_key_and_no: Uburyo bw'ubuntu ntibusaba urufunguzo cyangwa konti. Cyangwa abashyitsi bazana urufunguzo rwabo rwa Groq / OpenRouter — ntirigera isohoka muri browser yabo kandi ntirigera ikora ku code ya site yawe.
assistant.launcher_button_send_button_focus_rings: Buto yo gutangiza, buto yo kohereza, focus rings.
assistant.live_preview_running_in_the_corner_every: Live preview ikora mu corner. Every change above iremount.
assistant.meta_description: Shyira umufasha w'avatar ya 3D kuri website iyo ari yo yose ukoresheje script tag imwe. Uburyo bwa chatbot (models z'ubuntu cyangwa urufunguzo rwawe rwa Groq/OpenRouter) n'uburyo bwo kuvuga — avatar ivuga icyo wanditse cyose, mu ijwi riranguruye, ifite speech bubble.
assistant.meta_og_description: Shyira umufasha w'avatar ya 3D kuri website iyo ari yo yose ukoresheje script tag imwe. Uburyo bwa chat n'uburyo bwo kuvuga, background ibonerana cyangwa gradient, models z'ubuntu cyangwa uzane urufunguzo rwawe.
assistant.meta_twitter_description: Shyira umufasha w'avatar ya 3D kuri website iyo ari yo yose ukoresheje script tag imwe. Uburyo bwa chat n'uburyo bwo kuvuga, background ibonerana cyangwa gradient, models z'ubuntu cyangwa uzane urufunguzo rwawe.
assistant.not_a_render_not_a_video: Ntabwo ari render. Ntabwo ari video.
assistant.one_script_tag_adds_a_floating_launcher: Script tag imwe yongeraho launcher igenda kuri site yawe. Kanda kuri yo maze avatar ya 3D nyayo, ikora, iragaragara — kuri page yawe, ibara, cyangwa gradient — ifite uburyo bubiri: chatbot isubiza ibibazo (models z'ubuntu, cyangwa uzane urufunguzo rwawe rwa Groq / OpenRouter), n'uburyo bwo kuvuga aho avatar ivuga neza icyo wanditse, mu ijwi riranguruye, muri speech bubble.
assistant.paste_it_before_on_any_site_chat: Andika iyi mbere ya </body> kuri site iyo ari yo yose. Ibisubizo bya chat bituruka kuri free model chain (Groq → OpenRouter → NVIDIA) mu buryo busanzwe; abashyitsi bashobora guhindurira ku rufunguzo rwabo rwa Groq cyangwa OpenRouter mu igenamiterere rya widget — urufunguzo ruguma muri browser yabo. Uburyo bwo kuvuga bukoresha amajwi yubatswe muri browser. Inyandiko zuzuye: /docs.
assistant.the_live_preview_could_not_start_the: Live preview ntabwo bwite gushika (widget script ntabwo bwite kongera). Snippet yako hafi yose yemeze, na widget ikora ku site yako.
assistant.the_preview_mounted_but_its_3d_avatar: Preview yamunte, ariko 3D avatar yayo ntabwo bwite kongera. Snippet yako hafi yose yemeze.
assistant.transparent_avatar_floats_on_title: Ibereye — avatar igaragara hejuru y'urubuga rwawe
assistant.type_anything_and_the_avatar_says_it: Andika ikintu cyose maze avatar ikivuge n'ijwi riranguruye mu kantu k'amagambo — ijwi ry'urubuga, amajwi ahitamo, nta kiguzi.
assistant.use_a_built_in_body_any_three: Koresha umubiri wubatswe, id ya avatar iyo ari yo yose ya three.ws (iyikore muri Forge), URL ya GLB, cyangwa umubiri wa agent binyuze muri data-agent.
assistant.what_should_the_chatbot_know_about_your: Chatbot igomba kumenya iki ku rubuga rwawe?

assistant_frame.meta_description: Umufasha wa avatar ya 3D ushobora gushyirwa ahantu hose — kuganira n'ijwi ry'inyandiko mu iframe imwe.
assistant_frame.speech_uses_your_browser_s_built_in: Kuvuga bikoresha amajwi yubatswe mu mushakisha wawe — nta kintu na kimwe kizamurwa.
assistant_frame.which_model_lane_answers_you_title: Umuhanda wa model ugasubiza ubutumwa bwawe
assistant_frame.your_key_is_stored_only_in_this: Funguzo yawe ibikwa muri uyu mushakisha gusa (localStorage kuri three.ws) kandi yoherezwa itaziguye kuri provider — ntabwo igera kuri seriveri za three.ws cyangwa urupapuro rushyiramo aka widget.

atlas.intents_desc: Buri kimwe muri ibi gisubiza hamwe n'intambwe zateguwe, ntabwo ari umurongo gusa. Ni izo shortcuts zisa n'izo palette ya ⌘K igaragaza igihe usobanura akazi.
atlas.lede: Urubuga rwose ku ipaji imwe, rujyanye n'icyo buri kintu gikoreshwa. Tangira ufite intego hasi, cyangwa ushake. Kanda <kbd>⌘ K</kbd> ahantu hose kuri three.ws kugirango ufungure gushakisha kimwe utavuye ku ipaji uriho.
atlas.meta_desc: Urubuga rwose three.ws nk'ikarita ishakishwa: ipaji yose yateguwe n'icyo igamije, hamwe na shortcuts z'akazi zisubiza n'intambwe. Kanda Cmd+K ahantu hose ku rubuga kugirango ushake.
atlas.search_placeholder: Shakisha ipaji zose, cyangwa usobanure icyo ushaka gukora
atlas.share_desc: Ipaji zose kuri three.ws, zateguwe kandi zishakishwa, hamwe na shortcuts z'akazi ziri inyuma ya Cmd+K.
atlas.title: Atlas
atlas.twitter_desc: Urubuga rwose nk'ikarita ishakishwa: ipaji yose yateguwe n'icyo igamije, hamwe na shortcuts z'akazi palette ya Cmd+K isubiza. Kanda Cmd+K ahantu hose ku rubuga kugirango ushake utavuye ku ipaji.

atomic.feat1_body: Ibisabwa bya Atomic bisaba version 1 y'igikorwa, bityo umuvuduko wa V1 ntushobora kwangirika cyangwa kubura mu nzira yo gusoma.
atomic.feat2_body: V1 ikora mu transactionConfig. Atomic ntishaka ko isuzuma ry'ibikoresho by'ubukungu rihora ribikurikirana.
atomic.feat3_body: Icyuma gipima ibyuma byanditswe, ntabwo ari igipimo. Imigabane irenze urukuta rwa MTU ishobora kugaragara ako kanya.
atomic.hint: Yafashwe binyuze mu three.ws guhindagurika Solana RPC rail hamwe na V1 reads byemewe.
atomic.lede: Urwego rw'imigabane ubu ni 4 KiB. Atomic igaragaza aho buri byte ijya, isoma imipaka y'ibikoresho bya V1 ahantu hakwiriye, kandi ikabwira umufatanyabikorwa icyo byakora mu by'ukuri.
atomic.meta_desc: Reba icyo ari cyo cyose Solana imigabane cyangwa guhererekanya bitanditswe mbere yo gusinya. Reba ingano nyayo y'icyuma, imipaka y'imigabane ya V1, ikoreshwa ry'ibikoresho, n'umutekano w'umufatanyabikorwa.
atomic.og_desc: Icyuma kiriho V1 observatory na microscope y'umutekano mbere yo gusinya ku migabane mishya ya Solana 4,096-byte.
atomic.page_title: Atomic · Solana V1 Umugenzuzi w'Imigabane · three.ws
atomic.tw_desc: Icyuma kiriho Solana Umugenzuzi w'Imigabane V1 na pre-sign inspector. Shyiramo umukono wa mainnet cyangwa imigabane y'icyuma ya base64 kugira ngo ubone ibyuma nyayo, imipaka y'ibikoresho, ikoreshwa ry'ibikoresho, n'umutekano w'umufatanyabikorwa.
atomic.tw_title: Atomic - Solana Umugenzuzi wa V1 · three.ws

autopilot.meta_description: Shyira igiceri cyawe cya pump.fun kuri autopilot. Agent yawe ikora buybacks ikanatanga amafaranga y'abaremye ku bafite igiceri hashingiwe ku mategeko washyizeho — kandi igasobanura buri gikorwa cyose kuri chain mu gihe nyacyo.
autopilot.meta_og_description: Agent y'igiceri yigenga ikora buybacks ikanatanga amafaranga hashingiwe ku mategeko yawe, isobanurwa mu buryo bwa live na avatar yayo.
autopilot.meta_twitter_description: Akabati k'ibimenyetso kadakoreshwa intoki: shyiraho amategeko — kugura, kugurisha, n'ibiziririza — maze ureke agent yawe ikore igiceri yigenga.
autopilot.your_agent_runs_the_whole_coin_lifecycle: Agent yawe ikora ubuzima bwose bw'igiceri yonyine: igura kandi igatwika amafaranga y'abaremye ikanatanga ibyishyurwa ku bafite igiceri — hashingiwe ku mategeko washyizeho. Buri gikorwa cyose kuri chain gisobanurwa mu buryo bwa live na avatar ya agent yawe.

autopilot_activity.every_action_your_agent_took_on_your: Buri gikorwa umu-agent wawe yakoze mu izina ryawe — buri kimwe gishingiye ku bwenge bwacyo cyagiteye, cyashyizweho umukono, kandi gishobora gusubizwa inyuma aho bishoboka. Uku ni ukwigenga ushobora kugenzura.
autopilot_activity.meta_description: Buri gikorwa cyigenga umu-agent wawe three.ws yakoze — buri kimwe gifite ubwenge bwacyo cyagiteye, inyemezabuguzi yashyizweho umukono, n'uburyo bwo gusubiza inyuma ukoresheje gukanda rimwe. Ukwigenga ushobora gusobanura kandi ukwizera.
autopilot_activity.meta_og_description: Ukwigenga ushobora gusobanura: buri gikorwa umu-agent wawe yakoze, gifite ubwenge bwacyo cyagiteye n'inyemezabuguzi yashyizweho umukono.

avatar-cli.ci_gate1_note: Icyuma gishakisha re-export nta muntu wavuze, igipimo cy'igihombo, umufatanyabikorwa wahinduye model akagumana izina ry'inyandiko, n'icyuma cya CDN cyatangiye gutanga ipaji y'ikosa hamwe na 200.
avatar-cli.ci_gate2_note: xargs isohoka itari zero niba igikorwa cyose kimwe cyaratsinzwe, bityo igitabo kibi gitsindwa mu cyiciro cyose. Gishyiremo icyo cyose gikoreshwa mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa.
avatar-cli.ci_gate2_title: 02 Ese buri gitabo kiracyari nyacyo?
avatar-cli.ci_lede: Igitabo cyonyine cyemewe ku munsi w'uko wacyanditse ni inyandiko, ntabwo ari garanti. Igenzura ebyiri bigihindura kimwe. Nta na kimwe gikeneye kugera ku murongo.
avatar-cli.ci_title: Gutsindwa mu kubaka, ntabwo ku ipaji
avatar-cli.cmd_hash_desc: Icyuma cy'inyuguti ntoya SHA-256 y'inyandiko, yonyine kuri stdout kugira ngo igire umubano. Icyuma kimwe init yandika mu mesh.sha256, ari nayo ituma kugenzura impinduka biba ugukora ugereranya ku murongo umwe.
avatar-cli.cmd_init_desc: Ihindura igitabo cyemewe na schema kuva ku mufuka, izina, na dosiye ya mesh. Isoma mesh rimwe kugira ngo ibare SHA-256 n'ubunini bwayo, bityo inyandiko ntishobora kwangana n'ibyuma byubatsweho.
avatar-cli.cmd_lede: Nta dosiye y'ibikurikiranwa, nta shushanyo ry'umushinga, nta directory y'ibikurikiranwa. Buri itegeko rikora ikintu kimwe ku nyandiko imwe kandi rikakubwira ibyo byabaye.
avatar-cli.cmd_preview_desc: Igenzura, hanyuma ikandika URL y'umusubirizo, igice cya <agent-3d> gihuza n'uwanditse uyandikisha, n'iframe idakenera kwishyiramo. Itanga ikimenyetso igihe mesh.uri ikiri inzira y'aho.
avatar-cli.cmd_validate_desc: Igenzura igitabo ku @three-ws/avatar-schema kandi ikandika ikosa ryose ku murongo w'ahabereye. Ibisohoka bitari zero bituma biba urukuta rwo kubaka aho kuba raporo.
avatar-cli.copy_snippet_aria: Siga snippet yo gushyira mu mwanya
avatar-cli.cta_docs: Soma inyandiko <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 7h8M7 3l4 4-4 4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg>
avatar-cli.hero_sub: Shiraho manifest y'avatar ifitanye isano na hash iva muri wallet na GLB, uyemeze uhuye n'icyitegererezo cyatanzwe, hanyuma usohore snippet yo gushyira mu mwanya ikora neza. Ihagarara, iteganyijwe, kandi ni byiza kuyishyira mu script yo release.
avatar-cli.live_fallback_body: Umukoresha w'ibice ntiyanditswe. Snippet iracyari nziza; reba web component reference.
avatar-cli.live_lede: Ibi si ifoto. Ibyanditswe hasi ni byo preview isohora, byanditswe kuri iyi paji nta mpinduka. Niba byaba byarahagaze gukora, iyi ngingo yazahazaga mu ruhame.
avatar-cli.live_note: Imirongo yombi ifite agaciro. <agent-3d> ni ikintu kitazwi kugeza umukoresha akiyandikisha, bityo gushyira gusa tag biguha akaboko katuzuye nta warning. Ni yo mpamvu preview italways isohora hamwe. Umukoresha uri imbere ni iyi markup nyayo; gusa amategeko ya stylesheet ni yo agena uburebure bwayo ku mbuga ngufi, ibyo ikintu gikemura binyuze mu guhindura imiterere.
avatar-cli.live_title: Snippet iri ibumoso irimo gukora iburyo
avatar-cli.manifest_field_id_note: Konti ya CAIP-10, cyangwa izina ry'ikigo risoza muri .eth, .ws, cyangwa .sol.
avatar-cli.manifest_field_mesh_note: Aderesi y'ibikubiye mu model. Ikibuga gifata re-export itagaragara.
avatar-cli.manifest_field_owner_note: Konti ifitanye isano na chain, bityo uburenganzira burumvikana hanze ya platform.
avatar-cli.manifest_field_skeleton_note: Kimwe mu avaturn, mixamo, rpm, vrm-humanoid, custom. Igena urutonde rw'ibikorwa by'ubugeni bigaragara ku rig.
avatar-cli.manifest_lede: Ibice birindwi bisabwa. uri ivuga aho mesh iherereye, sha256 ivuga icyo igomba kuba. Ibyo ni ibisezerano bitandukanye, kandi gusa icya kabiri ni cyo kibasha kubaho umuntu asubiyemo model itandukanye ku nzira imwe.
avatar-cli.manifest_more: Ibice bitanu by'inyongera schema nayo yemera: animations, accessories, traits, creator, na signature. Icya nyuma ni cyo cy'ingenzi: ibindi byose ni ibirego urimo gukora, mu gihe signature ari ikirego undi muntu ashobora kwemeza adategereje server yawe.
avatar-cli.meta_desc: Ibikoresho by'ibanze ku terminal ku avatars ziri ku murongo. Shira manifest y'avatar ifitanye isano na hash iva muri wallet na GLB, uyemeze uhuye n'icyitegererezo, hanyuma usohore snippet yo gushyira mu mwanya. Ihagarara, iteganyijwe, CI-safe.
avatar-cli.next_card1_desc: Icyapa cyose, ikimenyetso cy'iherezo, na --json imiterere, itegeko ku itegeko.

avatar_artifact.avatar_artifact_a_live_three_js_portrait: Avatar Artifact — ishusho ya Three.js iriho
avatar_artifact.back_to_three_ws_home_arialabel: Subira ku rupapuro rwa mbere rwa three.ws
avatar_artifact.canvas_label: Avatar 3D interactive ufollow cursor yako, touch, cyangwa arrow keys
avatar_artifact.err_agent_fetch: Agent lookup ntabwo bwite kongera. Ni hagati network hiccup, kandi retry irakomeza.
avatar_artifact.err_avatar_private: Avatar y'agent this yisabye, kandi ntiyakozwe hanze three.ws. Profile yayo ni yo hano.
avatar_artifact.err_both: Pass agent id cyangwa model URL, ntibyombi. Drop umwe mu link kandi uload ubushe.
avatar_artifact.err_model_blocked: Model link that ntiyo https URL ku host this viewer akira. Models bisaba kwerekwa from three.ws cyangwa known asset host.
avatar_artifact.err_model_failed: Model file ntabwo bwite kongera. Yagombaga kugenda, cyangwa ikora compression format this viewer ntibyerekere.
avatar_artifact.err_no_avatar: Agent this ntiyagenwe avatar yet, kandi hafiga nothing kugira ngo urender. Profile yayo ifite rest y'identity yayo.
avatar_artifact.err_no_webgl: Browser this ntabwo bwite gushika WebGL, kandi 3D portrait ntibishoboka kugera aha. Ekeka browser nyingwe cyangusa enable hardware acceleration.
avatar_artifact.err_not_found: Nta agent ku three.ws bishoboka that id. Link yagombaga kuba old, cyangwa agent yagombaga kumenyekana.
avatar_artifact.meta_description: Umurebyi wa Three.js wigenga w'ama-avatar artifacts — ushobora gushyirwa ahandi no gusangizwa nta rupapuro rwo kuwugota.
avatar_artifact.meta_og_description: Umurebyi wa Three.js wigenga w'ama-avatar artifacts — ushobora gushyirwa ahandi no gusangizwa nta rupapuro rwo kuwugota.
avatar_artifact.meta_twitter_description: Umurebyi wa Three.js wigenga w'ama-avatar artifacts — ushobora gushyirwa ahandi no gusangizwa nta rupapuro rwo kuwugota.
avatar_artifact.move_your_cursor_drag_on_touch_arrow: Koresha umusego · kurura ukoresheje gukora · imyambi y'ibibaho ngororamajwi
avatar_artifact.the_graphics_runtime_failed_to_load_this: Porogaramu y'amashusho yaranze gushyirwaho — ibi bisobanura ko habaye ikibazo cy'umurongo wa interineti cyangwa urubuga rutagira WebGL.

avatar_engines.a_factual_map_of_the_open_source: Ikarita y'ukuri y'imikorere ya open-source n'iy'ubucuruzi ikora ama-avatar ya 3D agaragara neza kandi afite ireme ryiza — Gaussian-splat heads, abantu bakozwe n'ifoto imwe, ibikora avatar biva mu nyandiko, n'ibikoresho three.ws isanzwe ikoresha mu gukora amashusho yimuka. Kuri buri kimwe: icyo gikora, aho gikora, icyo uruhushya rwacyo rwemerera, n'uburyo three.ws ikoresha.
avatar_engines.commercial_use_only: Gukoresha mu bucuruzi gusa
avatar_engines.every_engine_for_a_high_quality_human: Buri mashini ikora avatar y'umuntu ifite ireme ryiza.
avatar_engines.listings_are_reference_material_compiled: Urutonde ni ibikoresho by'ireferansi byakusanyijwe mu bubiko n'impapuro za buri mushinga, bigezweho kugeza muri Kamena 2026. Incamake z'amasezerano y'uruhushya ni ubuyobozi, ntabwo ari inama z'amategeko — emeranya n'umushinga w'ibanze mbere yo gukoresha mu bucuruzi ubwo aribwo bwose. Imashini z'ubushakashatsi zidafite inyungu z'ubucuruzi zashyizweho kugira ngo zikoreshwe ku giti cyazo no mu mashuri kandi zidasanzwe zihuza n'uburyo bwo gukora bwishyurwa bwa three.ws. Ikimenyetso kimwe gusa three.ws yerekeza ni $THREE.
avatar_engines.meta_description: Igitabo cyuzuye, cyizewe cy'imashini (engines) zifunguye n'iz'ubucuruzi zikora avatar z'abantu za 3D zifite ireme ryiza kandi zisa n'ukuri — uburyo zikora, uruhushya, imbaraga z'imashini, n'ukuntu three.ws ikoresha buri imwe.
avatar_engines.meta_og_description: Buri mashini ikomeye ikora avatar z'abantu za 3D zifite ireme ryiza kandi zisa n'ukuri — imitwe ya Gaussian-splat, ifoto-umuntu, inyandiko-avatar, n'imikoreshereze three.ws isanzwe ikoresha mu kuzihindura. Uburyo zikora, uruhushya, n'uko zinjijwe muri sisitemu kuri buri imwe.

bnb.we_never_claim_bnb_s_roadmap_targets: Ntabwo twigera tuvuga ko intego za roadmap ya BNB — 20,000 TPS, 250ms finality (BEP-670), cyangwa 'AI agent framework' ku rwego rwa chain — zagezweho. Gusa ibyo twipimiye ubwacu.

bnb_latency.a_chain_s_rpc_going_quiet_shows: RPC ya chain iyo yacecetse igaragaza 'reconnecting' kuri iyo nzira gusa; irushanwa risigaye rikomeza gukora. Zose uko ari enye zihagaritse icyarimwe bigaragaza ikosa ryateguwe rifite uburyo bwo kongera kugerageza, ntabwo ari page y'ubusa.
bnb_latency.each_card_samples_real_blocks_or_slots: Buri karita ipima blocks nyayo (cyangwa slots, kuri Solana) kuva kuri RPC rusange kandi igatanga raporo y'igihe cy'ikigereranyo cyapimwe — sparkline ni ibipimo 24 bya nyuma biriho, akabari karekare = igipimo cyihuta cyane.
bnb_latency.every_chain_s_public_rpc_is_unreachable: RPC rusange ya buri chain ntishobora kugerwaho ubu — uku ni uguhagarara nyako, ntabwo ari ikosa. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa uzongere ugenzure vuba.
bnb_latency.every_number_comes_from_which_samples_re: Buri mubare ukomoka kuri /api/bnb/latency, ipima blocks nyayo (BNB binyuze muri probeBlockTime, umurimo umwe ushyigikira proof strip ya /bnb hub) kuva kuri RPCs rusange buri uko igenzuwe — nta na kimwe kibarwa mbere cyangwa ngo gishyirwemo mbere.
bnb_latency.four_lanes_one_honest_race_bnb_chain: Inzira enye, irushanwa rimwe ry'ukuri: BNB Chain, Base, Ethereum, na Solana, buri imwe ipimwa ako kanya kuva kuri RPC rusange buri masegonda make — ntabwo ari '0.45s' yashyizwemo mbere. Inzira yacecetse igaragaza 'reconnecting,' atari umubare w'ikinyoma wahagaze, mu gihe izindi zikomeza kwiruka.

brownout.hero_p: Fallback ni kode ikora gusa igihe hari ikintu kibaye nabi, bityo ikaba ari yo kode ifite ikizamini gito mu buryo bwose bwa kode. Uyu murongo ukora ibintu bibiri kuri byo. Igisubizo cyose kivuga aho amakuru yacyo yaturutse n'igihe agezweho, mu mutwe ushobora gusoma. Kandi buri fallback hasi yakozwe koko, hamwe n'umukoresha ikingira mu buryo bw'ukuri, mu nzira imwe umukozi akoresha. Ibyemezo biri munsi. Soma reference ku bijyanye n'imiterere y'umutwe n'ukuntu wakora probe ubwawe.
brownout.live_h2: Ihamagarwa ririho, uhereye ku rubuga rwawe, ubu
brownout.meta_desc: Igisubizo cyose iki API gitanga kivuga aho amakuru yacyo yaturutse n'igihe agezweho, kandi buri fallback yemejwe no gukuramo umuyoboro ikingira. Soma ibyemezo: ni nde wanga, ni nde wakiriye icyifuzo, n'igihe igisubizo cyari cyashizweho.
brownout.og_desc: Fallbacks ni kode ifite ikizamini gito mu buryo bwose bwa kode, kuko ikintu ikingira kidakorwa ku bushake. Bityo turagikora ku mpamvu, kandi tukandika ibyemezo.
brownout.proven_p: Buri karita ivuga umuyoboro, ikosa ryinjijwe muri yo, n'icyo icyerekezo cyakoze. Icyemezo cya not exercised kigaragazwa mu buryo busobanutse nk'ikosa: bisobanura ko ikosa ryakiriwe ariko cache ishyushye yatanze igisubizo mbere y'uko ikiganiro cy'umuyoboro kiba, bityo nta kintu cyari cyemejwe. Icyemezo kitakozwe ntabwo ari ikizamini.
brownout.reading_p1: Buri cyerekezo gisubiza hamwe na x-brownout, kandi kongeramo x-brownout-trace igihe ikintu cyagabanutse. Uburyo bushya ni uruziga aho kuba ikimenyetso, kandi igisubizo kigaragaza urwego rwa worst rwagize uruhare mu kugikora: live yavuye ku murongo mu gihe cy'icyifuzo cyawe, cache ni ikintu cyakiriwe mu gihe cyagenewe, stale ni ikirenzeho kuko umuyoboro utashoboye gusubiza, kandi fallback bisobanura ko umukozi wundi cyangwa uburyo butandukanye bwatanze igisubizo ku kibazo. Urupapuro rukozwe mu gusoma kumwe no mu gusoma kw'amasaha atatu ntabwo ari ruriho, bityo ntirugomba kuvuga ko ruriho.
brownout.reading_p2: Icyiciro @three-ws/brownout gisesengura izi headers, kandi gitanga ibizamini byawe bimwe n'ikosa ryinjijwe kuri uru rupapuro, bityo ushobora kwemeza ko ihuriro ryawe rigabanuka uko ubitekereza.
brownout.twitter_desc: Dukora ku bushake abatanga serivisi bacu, mu nzira nyayo y'icyifuzo, kandi tukandika ibyo twakiriye.

bundles.desc_placeholder: Icyo umuguzi abona, mu murongo umwe.
bundles.hero_lede: Gurisha ibikoresho byinshi by'umukozi nk'igura rimwe. Ikibazo gikomeye ntabwo cyari igikoresho, ahubwo cyari igiciro, bityo three.ws igiciro gituruka ku bucuruzi bwawe bwite: gishaka abaguzi bamaze kugura bibiri cyangwa byinshi muri ibi bikoresho byihariye kandi kikerekana icyo igikoresho cyari kuzana ku bantu b'abo. Reba inyandiko ku bijyanye na API.
bundles.live_p: Ruriho kuri uyu mukozi ubu, rutangwa mu buryo rusange kuri /api/agents/<id>/bundles kandi rugurwa mu giciro kimwe rufungura buri gikorwa imbere. Guhagarika kimwe biragihisha ku baguzi kandi bikagihisha hano, bigabanyijwe, bityo ushobora kucyongera. Uko kugura bikorwa.
bundles.meta_desc: Shyira ibikoresho by'umukozi mu gura rimwe kandi ugiprice uhereye ku bucuruzi bwawe. three.ws isuzuma igiciro icyo aricyo cyose ku baguzi bamaze kugura bibiri cyangwa byinshi muri ibyo bikoresho byihariye, bityo ushobora kubona icyo igikoresho cyari kuzana mbere yo kukitangaza.
bundles.og_desc: Shyira ibikoresho by'umukozi mu gura rimwe, bigizwe n'igiciro gituruka ku bucuruzi bwawe aho kuba ku mategeko y'ubwenge.
bundles.pick_sub: Ibikoresho gusa bifite igiciro cy'akazi gashobora gushyirwa hamwe, kuko igikoresho kigomba kuba gifite agaciro gato kurusha ibice byacyo kugira ngo kibe gifite icyo kivuze.
bundles.price_idle: Hitamo nibura ibikoresho bibiri kugira ngo ubone igiciro.
bundles.price_sub: Icyo umubare wose uri hano uva ku byaguzwe n'uyu mwanya byemejwe, byishyuwe. Ibyo kugerageza no kubona byatanzwe n'ikindi gice biraburirwa, bityo nta kintu na kimwe cyiyongera ku byo ubona.
bundles.step1_body: Hitamo ubumenyi bubiri cyangwa bwinshi bufite igiciro. Igiteranyo cy'ibiciro byabo ni cyo kigereranyo cyawe.
bundles.step2_body: Hindura igiciro urebe uko byakiriwe n'abaguzi b'ukuri bishyuye.
bundles.step3_body: Igice kiza ku mwanya. Kwishyura rimwe gufungura buri bumenyi buri muri cyo.

capture.files_stay_on_your_device_decoding_and: Dosye ziguma ku gikoresho cyawe — decoding na rendering bikorera muri browser yawe.
capture.film_a_room_a_street_an_object: Fata amashusho y'icyumba, umuhanda, cyangwa ikintu — hanyuma ubonereho igishushanyo cya 3D cy'ingingo ushobora kugenzura. Geometric Context Transformer ya feed-forward yubaka imiterere yuzuye y'isi ikuye mu mashusho, hanyuma igatambutsa .ply ifite amabara ushobora kuzenguruka hano ako kanya. Usanzwe ufite igishushanyo cya 3D cy'ingingo? Kinjiza cyangwa wandike URL.
capture.frames_stream_through_a_feed_forward_tra: Amashusho atambuka muri feed-forward transformer ihamya coordinates, isoma geometry ifashe, kandi ikosora kwihinduranya muri clip yose — nta optimisation kuri buri shusho. Ibyavuyemo ni point cloud ifite amabara y'isi yose. Ibyo itanga bigaragara na WebGL THREE.Points; iyi ni point cloud, ntabwo ari Gaussian splat.
capture.meta_description: Hindura videwo ya telefoni y'ahantu hose 3D point cloud ishobora kugenzurwa muri browser. Streaming feed-forward reconstruction (LingBot-Map) → .ply ifite amabara, igaragara ako kanya na WebGL.

choreograph.footnote: Uburyo ni urutonde rw'ibice n'ibihagarara, si urutonde rw'inyandiko z'ibikorwa: uburyo bumwe bugaragara butandukanye ku mwanya ufite uburyo bwihariye ku urupapuro rw'ijambo, ari na yo ntego. Uburyo bw'ikwire, isura y'ububiko n'API yo gukina byanditswe mu docs/choreography.
choreograph.hero_lede: Icyo gikorwa ni umwanya. uburyo ni igikorwa: shyira hejuru, hanyuma utekereze, hanyuma ushyire ahagaragara ikintu waremye. Kubaka kimwe ku murongo, urebe byose ku mwanya w'ukuri, hanyuma ubike ku mwanya wawe kandi ubikine ku izina mu gice icyo ari cyo cyose.
choreograph.meta_desc: Gushyira hamwe urutonde rw'ibikorwa by'umwanya ku murongo, urebe igikorwa cyose ku mwanya wa 3D, hanyuma ubike ku mwanya wawe kandi ubikine ku izina mu gice icyo ari cyo cyose.
choreograph.og_desc: Gushyira hamwe ibikorwa by'umwanya mu buryo bw'igihe, urebe mu buryo bwa 3D, ubike ku mwanya wawe, kandi ubikine ku izina mu gice icyo ari cyo cyose.
choreograph.palette_p: Ijambo ry'ibanze ry'ibikorwa. Intambwe yitwa slot, bityo gahunda yateguwe hamwe n'undi murongo ikomeza gukina uburyo bw'uwundi mu gikorwa cyose.
choreograph.routine_p: Umurongo wose ni umudiho umwe. Kanda kugirango uhindure, shyiramo igihe ikomeza, kandi uhamagare intambwe iyo ari yo yose ku gice gitandukanye. Urubuga rukurikira buri guhindura.
choreograph.save_lede: Injira kugirango ubike iyi gahunda ku agent. Ibindi byose kuri iyi paji bikora nta konti, kandi gahunda yawe imaze kuba muri URL.
choreograph.ship_p: Bika gahunda ku agent ufite kandi izagendana n'uwo agent: urutonde rusange ruruyobora, kandi ikintu cyose gishobora kukina ku izina.
choreograph.stage_empty_body: Tangirira kuri gahunda iri hasi, cyangwa ongeramo igikorwa. Nta 3D izakora kugeza ubwo ubikoze.
choreograph.stage_error_body: Icyiciro ni cyiza: uburyo bwo gusangira bwabashije kubihuza. Hindura icyiciro cy'intambwe, cyangwa ubirebe ku giti cyacyo muri galeri.
choreograph.stage_error_title: Iyi ntambwe ntiyajyanye n'avatar yo gusangira.
choreograph.start_p: Imyiyerekano itanu yubatswe kuva ku ijambo ry'ibanze ry'ibikorwa. Shyiramo imwe, hanyuma uhindure ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose: ni intangiriro, si imiterere ugomba gukomeza.
choreograph.steps_empty_body: Hitamo igikorwa hasi kugirango wongere umudiho wa mbere, cyangwa shyiramo imwe muri gahunda ziri hejuru.
choreograph.timeline_empty: Umukino utarimo ikintu. Ongeramo igikorwa kandi kigaragare hano.
choreograph.tw_desc: Umukino w'ururimi rw'umubiri w'agent. Tegura, reba mu 3D, bika ku agent yawe, ukine ku izina.

Gusaba k'umwimerere cyangwa bundle yatewe inkunga? Ni bande bari kugura by'ukuri? Moteri yiga ibimenyetso byerekana abatsinze, n'aba agents bawe ba 3D basoma ubwo bwenge kugira ngo bakore.

Win-rate ni ijanisha ry'amafaranga yaguzwe yinjira mu cyiciro gikurikira cyangwa akazamuka cyane — ribarwa iyo wallet ifite nibura amafaranga 3 yashyizweho ikimenyetso. Iki ni igitabo cy'ubucuruzi inyuma y'igitabo cy'ubucuruzi.

community.web_three_ws_every_product_surface_lives: Web three.ws Urugo rwose rw'ibicuruzwa riri aha ku rubuga ruhu n'undi rwose.

companion.contacts_sub: Tanga umuntu avatar kandi ubutumwa bwabo buza muri uwo mubiri, mu ijwi ryabo. Abandi bose batangwa n'umufasha wawe usanzwe.
companion.default_avatar_hint: Bikoreshwa kuri bose badafite ikarita yabo y'itumanaho.
companion.default_voice_hint: Ijwi nyakuri rituruka mu Voice Lab imirongo, rivugwa muri browser.
companion.feed_sub: Buri butumwa bwaje, icyo bwagize, n'impamvu. Ibihangayikishije birabikwa hano aho kutavugwa.
companion.hero_sub: Umugabo wa 3D ugenda akakubwira ibintu by'ingenzi byo kukurangaza. Huza ibyo usanzwe ukoresha, tanga abantu b'ingenzi isura n'ijwi byabo, kandi reka ibindi byose bigumane umutekano.
companion.meta_desc: Umufasha wa 3D utanga ubutumwa bwawe bw'ingenzi mu buryo bwihariye. Huza Telegram, kalendari yawe, inbox yawe, cyangwa telefone yawe, tanga buri muntu avatar yabo, kandi wumve ibikomeye mu ijwi.
companion.og_desc: Umufasha wa 3D utanga ubutumwa bwawe bw'ingenzi mu buryo bwihariye. Bring your own keys, give your contacts a face, and hear what matters out loud.
companion.pitch_card1: 📱 Telefoni yawe, Mac yawe, ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose Ikimenyetso kimwe, ahantu hamwe. Umwirondoro wa Android, Shortcut, amategeko ya Mail, script yo kubaka, cyangwa agent yemeje ko ugomba kumenya.
companion.pitch_card2: ✈️ Telegram Umutwe w'ikoranabuhanga wihariye uhuza gusa ibiganiro wongeramo. Guhagarika no guhuza birahari, nta kintu gisigaye hano.
companion.pitch_card3: 📅 Kalendari Ihuza ryihariye rya iCal Google, Apple, Outlook na CalDAV byose bitanga. Ibiguhamagarira inama itangira mu gihe ushobora kuyikora.
companion.pitch_card4: ✉️ Email IMAP hamwe n'ijambo ry'ibanga ry'igikoresho. Gusoma gusa, umutwe n'icyitegererezo, kandi uko utarabonye ubutumwa ntibuhindurwa. Cyangwa ukabikora ku mashini yawe kandi ukohereza gusa interuro.
companion.pitch_foot: Igerera hano, nk'ikimenyetso ku telefone yawe, no ku desktop yawe nk'ikimenyetso ginyura ku ishusho yawe. Abatekinisiye babona byose nka SDK, CLI, na MCPseriver.
companion.pitch_h: Telefone yawe irakubita incuro mirongo ine ku munsi. Zimwe muri izo zifite agaciro.
companion.pitch_lead: Umufasha asoma ibyo binjira mu makuru ukoresha, akagena icyo umuntu ashaka ko abona, hanyuma akaza akabivuga. Ibindi byose birahora bisanzwe, mu isoko, hamwe n'impamvu yabyo yo kutavuga.
companion.pitch_step1: 1 Huza ibyo usanzwe ukoresha. Buri cyangombwa ni icyawe, kandi cyarinzwe hano.
companion.pitch_step2: 2 Tanga abantu bafite agaciro isura n'ijwi. Ubutumwa bwabo buza nkabo.
companion.pitch_step3: 3 Shyiraho urwego, n'amasaha utazahungabanywa. Ibyo nibyo byose by'igicuruzwa.
companion.quiet_hint: Muri iyi ndorerwamo ubutumwa burabikwa, ntibuvugwa.
companion.settings_sub: Urwego ubutumwa bugomba kugeraho mbere y'uko umuntu yinjira ku rubyiniro.
companion.sources_sub: Bring your own keys. Nta kintu kibikwa kitari icyo ushobora gukuraho ku rundi ruhande mu kanda rimwe, kandi buri cyangombwa kirinzwe mbere yo kugera kuri database.
companion.stage_empty: Nta kintu cyageze hano. Huza isoko hasi, cyangwa ohereza ubutumwa bw'igerageza kuri telefone yawe, kandi uwo ari we wese azagaragara hano.
companion.stage_line_default: Utegereje ikintu gifite agaciro ko kuvugwa.
companion.stage_sub: Icyoherejwe gishya, nk'uko umufasha wawe abikora.
companion.threshold_hint: Guhindura hasi byumva byinshi. Guhindura hejuru bigumana ibikwiye ko ubona ikimenyetso ku rutugu.
companion.timezone_hint: Yamenyekanye muri uyu murongo w'ibikoresho kandi ikakoreshwa mu masaha y'ituze.
companion.tw_desc: Umufasha wa 3D ugeza ubutumwa bwawe bw'ingenzi mu buryo bw'umuntu.

concierge.an_ai_concierge_with_a_face_for: Concierge ya AI ifite isura, kuri buri rubuga.
concierge.answers_stream_in_over_sse_and_the: Ibisubizo bitangira kuza binyuze kuri SSE kandi avatar itangira kuvuga interuro ya mbere mu gihe ibindi bikiza.
concierge.at_ask_time_it_reads_the_live: Iyo ubajije, isoma urupapuro ruriho (umutwe, imitwe minini, navigation, ibirimo) hamwe n'ubumenyi bwawe bwatoranyijwe, kandi yanze guhimba ibiciro cyangwa amabwiriza itabona.
concierge.completed_sentences_are_handed_to_the_br: Interuro zose zujuje zihabwa moteri y'ijwi ya browser uko zigezeho, kandi igihe cy'inyandiko-kuri-viseme gituma iminwa ya avatar ihinduka mu buryo buhuje. Yacecekeshejwe? Amagambo n'iminwa iracyakina, bityo igisubizo ntikigera gihagarara.
concierge.docs_every_attribute_and_event: Inyandiko: buri kintu na buri gikorwa
concierge.install_in_under_a_minute: Shyiraho mu gihe kitageze ku munota
concierge.meta_description: Shyira concierge ya AI kuri buri rubuga ukoresheje tag imwe: avatar ya 3D yateguwe, itwenga kandi ikavuga ijwi rihuje n'iminwa, itambutsa ibisubizo bishingiye ku rupapuro rwawe ruriho, n'ijwi rya browser ryinjira rikanasohoka. Embed y'ubuntu, ifunguye na three.ws.
concierge.meta_og_description: Tag imwe iha urubuga rwawe concierge ya AI ifite avatar ya 3D ivuga: itambutsa ibisubizo bishingiye ku rupapuro rwawe, ijwi ryinjira rikanasohoka, insanganyamatsiko, n'ugutoranya avatar.

concierge.most_site_chatbots_are_a_text_box: Chatbot nyinshi zo ku mbuga ni agasanduku k'inyandiko gafite ikirango. Iyi yo ni ubuhari: moteri imwe y'avatar yateguwe ikoresha Walk n'ubuyobozi bw'urupapuro, yagenewe ubufasha.
concierge.no_crawler_no_vector_database_no_onboard: Nta crawler, nta database ya vector, nta guhamagara kwa onboarding. Ibice bitatu bigenda.
concierge.one_accent_color_restyles_the_whole_widg: Ibara rimwe ry'ingenzi rihindura imiterere ya widget yose. Amabara yoroheje n'ayijimye akurikira sisitemu y'umusura, cyangwa ugashyiraho rimwe. Munsi ibumoso cyangwa munsi iburyo.
concierge.one_tag_gives_your_site_a_support: Tag imwe iha urubuga rwawe chat y'ubufasha abashyitsi bakunda by'ukuri: avatar ya 3D yateguwe ikabiza, ikavuga, ikanahuza iminwa n'ijwi; ibisubizo bitambuka bishingiye ku rupapuro rwawe ruriho; n'ijwi ryinjira n'irisohoka, biturutse muri browser. Nta konti, nta gushyiraho crawler, nta giciro kuri buri mwanya.
concierge.pick_your_flavor_every_option_ships_the: Hitamo uburyo ukunda. Buri buryo butanga widget imwe.
concierge.push_to_talk_speech_input_and_browser: Kanda uvuge (Push-to-talk) ijwi ryinjira n'ijwi risohoka ry'umwimerere wa browser, nta audio backend na nta API key. Gucecekesha ni ugukanda rimwe kandi biribukwa.
concierge.skeleton_rigged_blinking_idling_viseme_l: Yateguwe na skeleton, ibiza, yicaye, ihuzagurana iminwa n'ijwi mu gihe ivuga. Abashyitsi bahitamo concierge yabo muri kataloge nini, cyangwa ugatanga iyawe bwite GLB.
concierge.the_snapshot_the_running_conversation_an: Ifoto, ikiganiro kiriho, n'ikibazo bijya kuri /api/concierge, ikubaka system prompt ishingiyeho ikanohereza igisubizo binyuze kuri SSE giturutse kuri three.ws free-first inference chain, ifite automatic failover hagati ya providers, kugira ngo widget ikomeze gukora iyo umuhanda umwe ufunzwe.
concierge.the_widget_is_open_source_and_the: Widget ni open source kandi moteri y'ibisubizo iri kuri server ikoresha three.ws free inference chain. Zana endpoint yawe igihe icyo aricyo cyose, format imwe ya wire.
concierge.this_page_runs_it_live_try_the: Uru rupapuro ruyikoresha live, gerageza agapfundikiye kari mu mfuruka ↘
concierge.when_a_visitor_asks_something_the_widget: Iyo umusura abajije ikintu, widget ifata ifoto ya live DOM, umutwe, meta description, imyandikire y'ingenzi, ibirango bya navigation, n'ibiriho by'ingenzi, bigabanyijwe ku ngengo y'imari ikomeye, ikanahuriza hamwe ubumenyi wateguye. Icyo urupapuro rwawe ruvuga uyu munsi nicyo concierge izi uyu munsi.
concierge.why_it_beats_a_faceless_chat_bubble: Impamvu irusha agapfundikiye ka chat kadahagarariye umuntu

connect.add_three_ws_to_claude_chatgpt_cursor: Ongeramo three.ws kuri Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code cyangwa Claude Code kandi umufasha wawe ashobora gukora ibishushanyo bya 3D n'ibishushanyo, gukora abakozi bawe, gusoma umutungo wabo no kwishyura serivisi kuri x402. Injira rimwe mu rubuga rwawe: nta rufunguzo rwa API rwo kopi. Buri gikoresho kiri mu MCP urutonde rw'ibikoresho.
connect.any_client_that_speaks_streamable_http_m: Umutekano uwo ari wo wose uvuga Streamable HTTP MCP ushobora guhuza. Abakiriya bafite ubufasha bwa OAuth bakwinjiza byikora kuva ku mutwe wa WWW-Authenticate w'iserver. Abakiriya badafite ibyo bashobora kohereza urufunguzo rwa API kuva Dashboard → API nka Uburenganzira: Bearer.
connect.back_in_apps_connectors_click_create_nam: Subira mu Apps & Connectors, kanda Gira. Iyihe izina three.ws, shyira URL, hitamo OAuth, kandi uyikore.
connect.chatgpt_adds_custom_mcp_servers_through_: ChatGPT yongeyeho seriveri zihariye za MCP binyuze mu Imiterere y'Abakora, ku ngengo z'ibiciro aho OpenAI ibitanga. Nta murongo wuzuye, bityo kopiya URL mbere.
connect.click_connect_and_sign_in_to_three: Kanda Hindura hanyuma winjire muri three.ws. Saba uruhushya mbere yo kubyemeza.
connect.click_the_button_above_check_the_name: Kanda ku gashya kari hejuru, reba izina na URL, hanyuma kanda Ongeramo. Gushyiramo intoki: Hindura → Abahuza (Igenamiterere → Abahuza ku makonti amwe), Ongeramo umuhuza wihariye, shyiramo URL.
connect.each_tool_declares_whether_it_only_reads: Buri gikoresho cyerekana niba gusa gisoma, kwandika, cyangwa gikora ikintu kidashobora kugarurwa, bityo umukiriya wawe akamenya icyo agomba kukubaza. urupapuro rw'ibikoresho rufite politiki y'icyizere yiteguye gushyiramo.
connect.every_client_you_connect_appears_under_d: Buri mukiriya uhuza agaragara munsi ya Dashboard → Igenamiterere → Porogaramu zihuza. Guhagarika imwe bihagarika uwo mukiriya mu isaha, igihe ikimenyetso cy'uburenganzira cyayo gishira. Abakozi bawe n'ibikenewe ntibihinduka.
connect.every_hosted_server_with_its_auth_and: Buri seriveri ishyizweho, hamwe n'uburenganzira bwayo n'ibikoresho, yanditswe mu buryo bworoshye gusoma kuri /.well-known/mcp.json.
connect.for_github_copilot_agent_mode_in_vs: Ku buryo bwa GitHub Copilot mu VS Code. Agashya gafungura ikibanza cyo gushyiramo VS Code; seriveri ikwinjiza ku nshuro ya mbere ukoresheje.
connect.in_a_chat_open_the_menu_then: Mu biganiro, fungura + menu, hanyuma Abahuza, kandi uhindure three.ws kuri icyo kiganiro.
connect.in_a_new_chat_open_the_menu: Mu biganiro bishya, fungura + menu, hitamo Imiterere y'Abakora, kandi ushyireho three.ws.
connect.in_claude_code_type_pick_the_server: Muri Claude Code, andika /mcp, hitamo seriveri umaze kongeramo hanyuma uhitemo Kwemeza.
connect.in_settings_apps_connectors_advanced_set: Muri Igenamiterere → Porogaramu & Abahuza → Igenamiterere rihanitse, shyira kuri Imiterere y'Abakora.
connect.link_format_from_cursor_s_install_link: Imiterere y'ihuriro iva mu Ibyanditswe by'ihuriro rya Cursor.
connect.link_format_from_vs_code_s_mcp: Imiterere y'ihuriro iva mu Igitabo cy'Abakora cya VS CodeMCP.
connect.links_open_your_client_with_the_server: Ihuriro rifungura umukiriya wawe hamwe na seriveri yuzuye. Uracyagenzura no kwemeza.
connect.meta_description: Ongeramo three.ws ku mukiriya wawe wa AI mu byiciro bibiri. URL imwe y'umuhuza itanga Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code cyangwa Claude Code ibikoresho bya three.ws MCP: 3D ikorwa, abakozi, ibikenewe na x402 kwishyura. Winjire rimwe, nta murongo wa API wo gukopiya.

connect.one_command_adds_the_server_the_first: Itegeko rimwe ryongera seriveri. Igihe cya mbere igikoresho gikeneye konti yawe, Claude Code ifungura three.ws kwinjira mu rubuga rwawe.
connect.one_url_your_ai_gets_three_ws: URL imwe. AI yawe ibona three.ws.
connect.run_the_command_add_to_share_it: Kora itegeko. Ongeramo --scope umushinga kugirango uyisangize itsinda ryawe binyuze muri .mcp.json.
connect.sign_in_to_three_ws_when_chatgpt: Injira kuri three.ws igihe ChatGPT ibisabye, kandi wemere uburenganzira.
connect.signing_in_gives_your_client_its_own: Injira itanga umukiriya wawe token yayo ku rubuga rwawe rwa three.ws, hamwe n'uburenganzira wemeye ku ishusho y'ubwumvikane. Ibikoresho bikora ku bagize n'ibikapu by'uru rubuga winjiyemo.
connect.start_with_three_ws_add_others_later: Tangirira kuri three.ws. Ongeramo abandi nyuma; buri umwe ni connector yihariye.
connect.steps_follow_claude_s_own_guide_its: Intambwe zikurikira Igitabo cya Claude. Menyu zayo zigenda: niba izi zivanze, tubwire.
connect.steps_follow_openai_s_developer_mode_gui: Intambwe zikurikira Igitabo cy'uburyo bwo gukora cya OpenAI. Amakuru yayo ahinduka kenshi: niba izi zivanze, tubwire.
connect.the_3d_studio_free_server_needs_no: Seriveri ya 3D Studio (ubuntu) ntikeneye kwinjira: andika mu 3D, ifoto mu 3D no mu mashusho yateguwe. Hitamo hejuru kandi uhuze mu masegonda.
connect.the_button_opens_cursor_s_install_prompt: Buto ifungura igisubizo cyo gushyiramo Cursor hamwe na seriveri yuzuye. Cursor nyuma ikora three.ws kwinjira.
connect.works_on_claude_ai_and_the_claude: Ikora kuri claude.ai na porogaramu ya Claude, ku mugambi wose. Konti z'ubuntu zishobora kongeramo connector imwe yihariye. Ku itsinda na Enterprise, abashinzwe gusa ni bo bashobora kongeramo imwe.

constellation.generated_by_an_ai_model_from_public: Byakozwe na AI model bivuye kuri metadata ya token rusange. Amakuru gusa — ntabwo ari inama z'imari. Tokens zigaragazwa ni data ya pump.fun / Solana trending iriho kandi ntabwo ari ubuhamya.
constellation.live_solana_tokens_positioned_in_3d_by: Tokens za Solana ziriho, zashyizwe muri 3D na IBM Granite embeddings kuri watsonx.ai. Inyenyeri ziri hafi zifite ubusobanuro bumwe.
constellation.meta_description: Galaxy ya 3D iriho ya tokens za Solana zigezweho, zashyizweho na IBM Granite embeddings kuri watsonx.ai. Kanda ku nyenyeri iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo ubone isesengura rya Granite ririho. 3D + AI + crypto, byose ni ukuri.
constellation.meta_og_description: Tokens za Solana zigezweho zashyizwe mu mwanya wa 3D semantic na IBM Granite embeddings. Kanda ku nyenyeri kugira ngo ubone isesengura rya Granite ririho.

conversions.intro: Igerageza ry'ubuntu rigenzurwa gusa ryinjiza ikintu igihe rishize. Ibi ni impande zombi z'icyo gihe: ibigeragezo ufite, n'ibigeragezo bikora ku bumenyi ugurisha.
conversions.meta_desc: Buri gerageza ry'ubuntu ufite n'ibigeragezo bikora ku bumenyi ugurisha, hamwe n'ibyo usigaje, igiciro cyo guhindura, n'inyungu ziri mu murongo.
conversions.note: Ibiciro ni urutonde rw'ibiciro by'ukuri by'umugurisha mu mint yahisemo. Kugura bikorwa ku ipaji y'umukozi, aho ingano n'ahantu bigaragara mbere y'uko ikintu cyose signed. Soma ukuntu igerageza rihinduka cyangwa urebe funnel y'igerageza ku rubuga.
conversions.share_desc: Impande zombi z'igihe igerageza ry'ubuntu rigenzurwa: ibigeragezo ufite hamwe n'ibyo usigaje n'igiciro cyo kubigumana, n'ibigeragezo bikora ku bumenyi ugurisha hamwe n'inyungu zitegereje mu murongo.

cookbook.empty_p: Igitabo cy'amasoko ni gito kandi kiriyongera. Siba ifatizo kugira ngo ubone byose, cyangwa fungura ikibazo ku resipe ushaka ko ibaho.
cookbook.hero_p: Ntabwo ari inzira. Buri resipe hano ni ifishi nyayo yakozwe ku API ikora mbere yo gushyirwa hanze: igikoresho cy'umurongo wa komandi, pipeline y'ibikorwa byinshi, seriveri ya MCP, umuryango wa CI, uruziga rw'agent rwikora. Kopi imwe, uyikore, uyihindure.
cookbook.meta_desc: Resipe zishobora gukorwa zo kubaka na three.ws: inyandiko ku 3D uhereye ku murongo wa komandi, ibipaki by'ibikoresho byinshi, igikoresho cya MCP ku mufasha wawe wa AI, umuryango wa CI, n'uruziga rw'ikora rwikora. Buri resipe itanga ifishi ushobora gukoresha.
cookbook.outro_p: Resipe ni ifishi ikora, hamwe n'inyandiko isobanura impamvu ifite uko imeze. Niba wakoze ikintu kuri API ya 3D gifite agaciro ko gukopiwa, kigeza kuri twe.
cookbook.share_desc: Resipe zishobora gukorwa zo kubaka na three.ws. Buri resipe itanga ifishi ushobora gukoresha, ku API ya 3D idahenze kandi idakeneye urufunguzo.

Ikoresha icyitegererezo cya text-to-3D cyashyizwe ahagaragara (Microsoft TRELLIS kuri NVIDIA NIM) kandi igarura glTF 2.0 .glb isanzwe. Intambwe ya QA ikoresha indi endpoint idasaba urufunguzo, ituruka kuri API imwe, ihindura GLB yose ikayigira PNG. Nta na kimwe gisaba konti cyangwa API key, bityo byombi birakorana ubuntu.

cookbook_index.the_critic_is_calibrated_to_the_tier: Umunenga ahuzwa n'urwego. Umurongo w'inyandiko ngufi ugenzurwa hakurikijwe ubuziranenge bwo gukora ibintu byose uratsindwa, kandi umunenga ushishikaye cyane yandika "amabwiriza yakosowe" y'inyuguti 1,000 adashobora gukoreshwa n'ikora ry'ikintu kimwe. Amabwiriza ya sisitemu abwira umunenga uko bisanzwe bigaragara kuri uru rwego, kugira ngo atsinde gusa ku kimenyetso (ese umunyamahanga yashobora kuvuga izina ry'ikintu?), no kugira ngo ibyanditswe byose bikosowe bibe bigufi kandi bifatika.
cookbook_index.the_draft_lane_is_single_subject_and: umurongo w'inyandiko ngufi ni uw'ikintu kimwe kandi ntushyizweho imigozi ku bushake; three.ws itanga PBR ifite poly nyinshi n'imirongo ifite imigozi ifite imiterere imwe y'igikoresho iyo ubuziranenge ari ingenzi
cookbook_index.the_free_draft_lane_is_per_ip: umurongo w'ubuntu w'inyandiko ngufi ufite umuvuduko ugabanyijwe kuri buri IP; shyira max_workers ku rugero ruciriritse (bane hano) cyangwa ujye ku murongo usaba urufunguzo
cookbook_index.the_free_lane_is_the_draft_tier: Umurongo w'ubuntu ni urwego rwa draft: ikintu kimwe, geometrie y'inyandiko ngufi, nta migozi. Ifite umuvuduko munini ugabanyijwe kuri buri IP urinda igabana rya GPU rusange; iyo urenze urugero, igarura 429 hamwe na header ya Retry-After.

cookbook_index.the_loop_is_the_standard_responses_api: Uruzunguruko ni uburyo busanzwe bwo guhamagara ibikoresho bya Responses API, bufite impinduka imwe: icyitegererezo gitanga ibintu byinshi bya function_call mu nshuro imwe (kimwe kuri buri gikoresho), bityo tukabikoresha icyarimwe.
cookbook_index.the_model_looks_like_a_dense_feathery: Icyitegererezo kimeze nk'igihuru kinini, gifite amababa mu nkono y'umukara izengurutse aho kuba pothos igenda ikururuka: amababi yayo aratandukanye/afite amenyo aho kuba afite ishusho y'umutima, nta mabara y'umuhondo ahari, kandi inkono ya coral y'ukwezi gucye n'imiterere y'icyegeranyo y'izuba ntibihari.
cookbook_index.the_notebook_ships_fully_executed_and_li: Igitabo cy'akazi cyoherezwa cyakozwe neza, kandi guhamagara mu buryo bwa live birashoboka.
cookbook_index.the_pattern_generalizes_twice_over_any_c: Iyi mikorere yagutse kabiri: ubushobozi ubwo aribwo bwose model ibura bugerwaho ako kanya iyo API yayo uyihinduye igikoresho cy'umurimo, kandi igikoresho icyo aricyo cyose cy'uburyo bwa generative kiba cyizewe ako kanya iyo ugaragaje ibyo cyasohoye ahantu model ishobora kubibona ikabyigenzurira.

cookbook_index.the_render_clearly_depicts_a_handheld_br: Iyo render yerekana neza itara ry'umuringa rifatwa mu ntoki rifite umubiri uzengurutse, impeta y'imbere ifunguka n'umukondo wo hejuru, rifite umuringa warangiritse n'ikirahure cy'ubururu cyacuzwe umwotsi—ryisomeka nk'itara ryo ku nyanja ryijimye. Ryemewe kuko ikintu cyerekanwa n'imiterere ya carnival yo ku nyanja yo mu gihe cya Victorian biragaragara, nubwo umuriro w'icyatsi kibisi usa n'umuzimu n'ibimenyetso byinshi by'umunyu/ubururu bwijimye byagabanutseho gato.
cookbook_index.the_render_clearly_presents_a_warped_dri: Iyo render yerekana neza ikimenyetso cy'amatike cyakozwe mu giti cyatwawe n'amazi cyarandaguritse, gifite inyuguti z'umutuku zikozwe muri stencil zishira, ibikoresho by'ibyuma byarushywe, ibirahure by'inyanja by'icyatsi kibisi/ubururu byashyizwemo, n'itara ryangiritse—risomeka nk'ikimenyetso cy'amatike cyo ku nyanja cyasabwe cy'ibiteye ubwoba kandi gihuye n'umwuka uteye ubwoba, wangiritse.
cookbook_index.the_render_clearly_reads_as_a_small: Iyo render isomeka neza nk'agakarito gato k'igiti kashaje, gafite umupfundikizo uzengurutse n'ibimenyetso byinshi by'uburwayi ku buso, ku buryo uyireba ashobora kukamenya nk'agakarito k'ibihembo kashyizwemo ibyatsi byo mu nyanja (Kelp-Tangled Prize Chest). Ryemewe ku rwego rw'umushinga nubwo nta bihembo byiza byo imbere n'ibyatsi byo mu nyanja bifite, ibyo bikaba ari ibintu byemewe kutagaragara kuri uru rwego.
cookbook_index.the_render_clearly_shows_a_single_styliz: Iyo render yerekana neza igihingwa kimwe cya snake plant cyakozwe mu buryo bwihariye, gifite amababi menshi ahagaze, y'amabara atandukanye, cyatewe mu giseke kigufi cyaboshywe gifite igitambaro imbere — ikintu cyerekanwa kiragaragara kandi gihuye n'insanganyamatsiko y'ibintu byiza, byakozwe n'intoki byegeranywa, nubwo gifite uburyo bworoshye n'imiterere yoroshye.
cookbook_index.the_render_depicts_a_single_triangular_r: Iyo render yerekana ibendera rimwe ry'umutuku rifite ishusho ya mpandeshatu riri ku giti cy'igiti cyashaje gifite imigozi miremire yashaje n'igitambaro cyashaje; nubwo gifite ibimenyetso byoroshye, risomeka neza nk'ibendera rya carnival yo ku nyanja ryashaje kandi rihuye n'insanganyamatsiko ya vintage iteye ubwoba.
cookbook_index.the_render_is_an_indistinct_white_blob: Iyo render ni ikintu cyera kitagaragara neza, nta shusho y'igipupe igaragara, nta masura, nta myenda, cyangwa ikirenge—nta kimenyetso na kimwe cy'umupfumu w'imashini (igitambaro, ijisho, umukondo w'umuringa, ikarita ya tarot) kigaragara, ku buryo ikintu cyerekanwa kidashobora kumenyekana kandi ntigihuye n'insanganyamatsiko.
cookbook_index.the_render_looks_like_a_dark_multi: Iyo render isa n'igiti cy'imikindo/igihingwa cya fern cyijimye, gifite amababi menshi, kiri mu nkono y'ibumba y'igikara ifite imirongo, aho kuba igiti gito cya Monstera: amababi asa n'umutaka afite imikoresho ya radial aho kuba amababi atatu manini, yaka, ya Monstera afite imyenge yoroshye, kandi inkono isomeka nk'igiti cyijimye aho kuba enamel y'umuhondo wa mustard, ku buryo ikintu cyerekanwa kidafite ireme.
cookbook_index.the_render_shows_a_chunky_golden_barrel: Iyo render yerekana umubiri w'igihingwa cya cactus cya golden barrel kinini, ariko inkono ya sima, isahani, n'amabuye yo hejuru birabura—ku buryo kidahuye n'ibisabwa by'igihingwa cyatewe mu nkono kandi ntigihuye n'insanganyamatsiko yashyizweho. cookbook_index.the_render_shows_a_small_ornate_carousel: Iyo render yerekana urubaho ruto rwa carousel rwiza n'igicucu ariko nta farashi yonyine — ikintu cyerekanwa ni imiterere ya carousel aho kuba ifarashi imwe ya carousel yuzuyeho ibikoko byo mu nyanja, ku buryo uyireba atashobora kumenya ikintu cyagenewe. crews.meta_desc: Wabonye itsinda, invita abantu bawe, kandi urebe urutonde rwose ruhagarara mu cyicaro kimwe cya 3D. Umwe wese agaragara nk'agent we, yaka igihe ari mu isi.

data_desk.empty_body: Abakozi b'ikopo rishya bagura dataset imwe nk'igihe kigera ku minota na 3D prop imwe nk'igihe kigera ku minota. Kugurisha kwa mbere kuzaboneka hano n'ibyemezo byabo nk'uko bisuzumye ku Solana.
data_desk.error_body: Hari ikibazo cyabaye mu kwongera ibikoresho byaguriwe.
data_desk.how_1: Keypair rishya ruvugururwa no gushyirwa mu myigire. Ntiribonye ku chain.
data_desk.how_2: Gushyizemo amafaranga gusa kigira ngo kigire igiciro cya USDC cy'umurimo wayo kandi kugira SOL zizaza kugira ngo zibereye kugaburira ibikoresho no gushyiraho amafaranga y'ibikorwa byabiri bya netiworki.
data_desk.how_3: Ikopo rigira endpoint yishyuwe, rigira 402 challenge, rishyiraho gushyiraho USDC imwe kandi rigira data inyuma. Kwishyura ni transaction ya Solana yiteye imbere yose yemera gukoresha.
data_desk.how_4: Ikopo rigira USDC zishize ku treasury, fungura konti y'ibikoresho kugira ngo amafaranga y'ikodere yisubire kuwashyizeho, kandi rigira buri lamport irasigaye iwabo. Rigira hejuru gusa kandi ntirigenzura gukoreshwa.
data_desk.how_more: Ibiro by'umurenge n'ibimenyetso bya buri wallet byabiri bitatu birimo mu
data_desk.lede: Burigihe platform yuvugurura Solana wallets muto yitwa agenti zidashobora kuba ziboneka, zigira imwe imwe igiciro cya USDC cy'umurimo umwe, kandi zirekura gukura dataset y'ukuri ku storefront y'ibicuruzwa by'amakuru ya three.ws ku ruhande rwo kwishyura rwa x402. Igisubizo giranuka hano n'igice cya kwemeza: wallet yashyizeho, igiciro, n'transaction y'kwishyura. Inyuma y'aho wallet ifunguriwe na kugabanuka. Nta kuranga, nta mocks: ni ekonomiya y'agenti ikora umurimo w'ukuri, umwanya umwe w'kwishyura ubu.
data_desk.ledger_lede: Buriri muri mudasobwa ni gukura kwa wallet imwe. Wallet ntiyabaye imbere y'igihe yashyizeho kandi yafunguye inyuma y'aho; link ya receipt ifungura kwishyura ku Solscan.
data_desk.meta_description: Amakuru y'ubutaka bugurishwa minota buri minota n'agenti wallets nkuru ku x402. Buri dataset ifite receipt yayo: wallet yashyizeho, igiciro, n'transaction y'kwishyura ya Solana.

demo_avatar_os_index.mediapipe_tasks_vision_pulled_via_npm_wa: MediaPipe Tasks Vision ikururwa binyuze kuri npm (@mediapipe/tasks-vision]). WASM + dosiye za model zikurwa kuri CDN ya Google igihe ikora.

demo_avatar_os_index.the_avatar_studio_is_the_existing_worksp: Avatar Studio ni aho gukorera hasanzwe character-studio/ (M3-org, AGPL — irasuzumwa), ikorerwa kuva ku isoko rimwe kuri /avatar-studio mu iterambere no mu gukoreshwa. Yubake rimwe ukoresheje npm --prefix character-studio run build, cyangwa werekeze VITE_CHARACTER_STUDIO_URL kuri seriveri ya studio yigenga.
demo_avatar_os_index.three_parallel_paths_replace_what_we_cur: Inzira eshatu zikora icyarimwe zisimbura ibyo twabonaga muri Avaturn. Buri demo irakora neza kuva itangira kugeza irangiye — fata, byara, reba mbere, wohereze GLB. Nta mocks, nta makuru y'ibihimbano.

demo_avatar_os_selfie.runs_the_mediapipe_face_landmarker_on_th: Ikoresha MediaPipe Face Landmarker ku ifoto y'imbere. Yubaka BufferGeometry ya three.js: imyanya ya vertex 478 ivuye kuri landmarks, UVs zivuye kuri image coords, indices zivuye kuri triangulation ya tfjs-models (Apache-2.0, ziriho).

demos_audio2face.audio2face_3d_facial_animation: Audio2Face-3D · guhindura isura mu buryo bwa 3D
demos_audio2face.meta_description: Andika inyandiko, uyumve mu ijwi rya NVIDIA Magpie, maze urebe isura ya avatar ya 3D ihinduka ako kanya — ikorwa intambwe ku yindi na NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D. Blendshapes za ARKit nyazo, zikoreshwa kuri rig iyo ari yo yose.
demos_audio2face.meta_og_description: Ijwi rya NVIDIA Magpie + guhindura isura na NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, bihuje, mu mushakisha. Imyanya y'iminwa ya avatar ikurikira amajwi nyayo.
demos_audio2face.meta_og_title: Audio2Face · imiterere ibiri ya NVIDIA ku isura imwe · three.ws
demos_audio2face.meta_title: Audio2Face · imiterere ibiri ya NVIDIA ku isura imwe · three.ws
demos_audio2face.meta_twitter_description: Ijwi rya NVIDIA Magpie + guhindura isura na NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, bihuje, mu mushakisha.
demos_audio2face.meta_twitter_title: Audio2Face · imiterere ibiri ya NVIDIA ku isura imwe · three.ws
demos_audio2face.powered_by_nvidia_audio2face_3d_over_nvc: Ikoreshwa na /api/a2f (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D binyuze kuri NVCF gRPC) na /api/tts/speak (NVIDIA Magpie). Ihuza rya blendshape na morph riherereye muri src/voice/a2f-player.js — rikoresha amagambo ya ARKit/VRM/Oculus muri src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js, bityo rig iyo ari yo yose y'umuntu ishobora gukora lip-sync nta rutonde rwihariye rwa buri rig. Reba demo ya lipsync ikoresha amplitude gusa kugira ngo ubone uburyo bwo gusimbura.
demos_audio2face.two_nvidia_models_on_one_face: Imiterere ibiri ya NVIDIA ku isura imwe
demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Andika interuro. Ivugwa mu ijwi rya NVIDIA Magpie, kandi iryo jwi ryoherezwa kuri NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, igarura ARKit blendshape track kuri buri frame. Umunwa n'isura bya avatar bigenda frame kuri frame n'ijwi nyaryo — bihuye n'uburyo bwa morph-target bwose GLB ikoresha (ARKit, common avatar-platform, VRM, Oculus visemes). Niba Audio2Face idahari, avatar iracyavuga kandi igakoresha amplitude lipsync — ntabwo isura ihagarara.

demos_avatar_sdk.the_npm_sdk_bundle_loaded_from_what: npm SDK bundle yashyizwemo ivuye kuri /avatar-sdk/dist/index.mjs (ibyo abakoresha babona bakoze npm install @three-ws/avatar nimara gusohoka). Iyo yashyizweho, yandika <agent-3d> nka custom element. Igice cya Creator gifungura iframe modal igarura GLB Blob — uburyo bumwe n'ubwo imbuga z'abandi zakoresha.
demos_avatar_sdk.the_sdk_resolves_against_on_the_same: SDK ikemura avatar-id ikoresheje GET /api/avatars/:id kuva aho SDK yashyizwemo (bishobora guhindurwa na api-base="https://other.host"]). Uku ni ugutanga gukomeye gallery picker itanga, kandi bikomeza gukora kabone n'iyo URL ya GLB y'ibanze ihindutse.

demos_bonding_curve.interactive_bancor_v1_simulator_the_same: Simulator ya Bancor V1 ikorana (formula imwe pump.fun ikoresha). Byose bikorera muri browser — nta wallet, nta kwandika kuri blockchain, nta RPC. Koresha sliders, simula kugura no kugurisha ukoresheje ububiko bwa virtual, urebe uko igiciro cy'ako kanya kigenda. Bifasha kumenya ingano ya reserve ratio na graduation threshold mbere yo gushyira hanze agent tokens nyazo.
demos_bonding_curve.same_starting_state_same_cumulative_eth_: Uburyo bumwe bwo gutangira, ETH imwe yose yashyizwemo — ibipimo bitatu bitandukanye by'ububiko. Igipimo gito = curve ikomeye = kumenya igiciro vuba + inyungu nyinshi ku bafata iya mbere. Pump.fun itanga ~25% by default.

demos_brain.meta_description: Ahantu ho gukina na AI ifite models nyinshi. Ganira na Claude, GPT, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek — hindura models hagati y'ikiganiro, gereranya ukurikiranya, unamenye umuvuduko n'ibipimo bya tokens.
demos_brain.meta_og_description: Ahantu ho gukina na AI ifite models nyinshi. Ganira, gereranya, unagerageze models 10 ukurikiranya hamwe n'ibipimo nyabyo bya streaming na tokens.

demos_checkout.hand_tuned_reactive_lighting_baked_into_: Amatara y'imikorere yihariye yateguwe n'intoki, yinjijwe mu gipira gito kigendanwa. Kimwe kuri buri agent.

demos_create_v2.choose_a_ready_made_character_and_custom: Hitamo umuntu wateguwe unahindure uruhu, umusatsi, imyenda, n'ibindi mu mushakisha. Nta kintu ukeneye gukuramo.
demos_create_v2.drop_any_gltf_2_0_file_works: Shyiramo dosiye iyo ari yo yose ya glTF 2.0 .glb. Ikora na Blender, Unity, cyangwa ibyo byose byoherejwe na software ya 3D.

demos_create_v2.pick_a_path_you_ll_have_a: Hitamo inzira — uzagira avatar ya 3D yateguwe, ivuga, yiteguye gushyirwa ahantu, kuvuga, cyangwa gukoreshwa nka AI agent.

Nta backend, nta makiyi abitswe — usinya buri kwandika wenyine.

demos_halfbody_xr.side_by_side_preview_of_full_body: Kureba iruhande n'uruhande umubiri wose ugereranije n'igice cy'umubiri. Kureba igice cy'umubiri bigerwaho mu gihe bikoreshwa hagenzurwa amagufwa yo hasi mu gishushanyo mbonera cya GLB (ukuguru, ikibero, ikirenge, ino, n'ibindi) no kubigabanya kugeza kuri zeru — mesh imwe yambaye uruhu, amagufwa yagabanutse kugera ku mwanya wo kuruhuka. Gusubiza mu buryo busanzwe ni ugukora scale write imwe. Injira muri WebXR unyuze kuri iyi page kugira ngo urebe uburyo bwa half-body muri headset.

demos_index.a_3d_avatar_runs_up_and_leaps: Avatar ya 3D irahaguruka ikasimbukira kuri buto nyayo. Imbaraga za spring zikanda kandi zigatuma buto isimbuka iyo ikozweho, hanyuma uruhererekane rugasubiramo.

demos_index.browsable_grid_of_available_avatars_with: Urutonde rw'amashusho (avatars) aboneka ushobora kureba, hamwe n'akadirishya kerekana ishusho ya 3D mu buryo bwa live. Kanda kuri kimwe muri byo kugira ngo upakishe GLB, unyure mu duce twa videwo, wandukure agace k'icyo ushaka gushyiramo.
demos_index.buy_and_sell_along_a_constant_product: Gura no kugurisha ukurikije igishushanyo mbonera cy'igicuruzwa gihoraho. Igiciro, ububiko, n'itandukaniro ry'igiciro bihinduka ako kanya uko ugerageza gukora ubucuruzi.
demos_index.checkout_agent_runs_the_cart: Kwishyura — agent ni yo icunga igikoresho cyo kugura.
demos_index.clone_your_voice_in_seconds_professional: Kora kopi y'ijwi ryawe mu isegonda. Uburambe bw'umwuga mu gufata amajwi hamwe n'ishusho y'ijwi igaragara ako kanya, amabwiriza ayobora, ububiko bw'amajwi, n'ahantu ho kugeragereza TTS.
demos_index.drop_in_web_component_loaded_from_the: Igice cya web <agent-3d> cyinjizwa byoroshye cyapakiwe muri npm SDK bundle, hamwe na iframe ya AvatarCreator ikorana na porogaramu.
demos_index.feed_live_mic_audio_through_the_viseme: Injiza amajwi ya mikoro mu buryo bwa live unyuze mu kisesengura cya viseme, urebe uko akanwa k'ishusho gakurikira ijwi ryawe ako kanya.
demos_index.fourteen_prototypes_for_how_a_3d_agent: Prototypes cumi n'enye zerekana uburyo agent ya 3D ishobora kugaragara ku rupapuro: ikurikira umukono, buto ya trampoline, umupira usenya, kuzamuka umutwe, n'ibindi.
demos_index.full_first_class_ar_experience_webxr_imm: Uburambe bwuzuye bwa AR bw'ibanze: WebXR immersive-ar hamwe no gushyira ahantu hakozwe hit-test, guhinduranya hagati y'umubiri wose/igice, n'uburyo bwo gukoresha kamera mu gihe ibindi byanze.
demos_index.hero_with_the_avatar_perched_on_the: Hero ifite ishusho yicaye kuri H1, isimbukira kuri CTA iyo ikanditswe. Utuce twa videwo duhinduranya neza, igicucu cy'inyandiko cyegereye, gutemba iyo ikozweho, kongera gushyira ahantu hagenwe na ResizeObserver, n'imikorere itangizwa na chip.
demos_index.issue_query_and_revoke_eas_attestations_: Tanga, baza, kandi wambure ibyemezo bya EAS bigamije izina rya agent. Soma ako kanya kuri Base mainnet binyuze muri agent0-sdk.
demos_index.live_read_of_on_chain_agent_identities: Soma ako kanya indangamuntu za agent ziri kuri blockchain kuri Base, Ethereum, Polygon, na testnets binyuze muri agent0-sdk. Nta funguzo, nta musinya.
demos_index.load_an_avatar_generate_a_usdz_companion: Pakira ishusho, kora USDZ yayo muri mushakisha, yohereze kuri R2, wemeze ko iOS Quick Look ifungura ibyavuyemo.

demos_index.paste_a_chat_log_or_social_bio: Shyiramo amakuru y'ibiganiro cyangwa bio yo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Uwakuramo ayahinduramo imiterere y'umuntu agent ishobora gukoresha nk'amakuru shingiro mu biganiro bizaza.

Buri kintu kuri aya mapaji gikoresha APIs nyazo n'ububiko nyabwo — nta by'ikigereranyo.
demos_index.react_wrapper_around_the_avatar_sdk_drop: React wrapper ikikije avatar SDK. Injiza <Agent3D /> muri JSX tree iyo ari yo yose maze ushyiremo props za clip, persona, na camera.
demos_index.real_time_468_point_face_mesh_with: Real-time 468-point face mesh ifite quality gates (yaw, blur, lighting, centering), ifata amashusho mu mpande eshatu, no kumenya aho umutwe uhagaze. Ubu yashyizwe muri /create/selfie, dashboard, n'amapaji y'abakozi nk'ikintu gikoreshwa mu musaruro.
demos_index.redesigned_create_chooser_featured_recom: /create chooser yongereweho imiterere: ikarita yatoranyijwe kandi isabwa, 3D previews zitandukanye, time badges, ibimenyetso by'aho ujya, imibare y'igihe nyacyo ituruka kuri /api/explore, n'umurongo wo guhuza.
demos_index.selfie_fit_avatar_from_your_face: Selfie Fit — avatar ikozwe mu maso hawe
demos_index.send_the_same_prompt_to_claude_gpt: Ohereza prompt imwe kuri Claude, GPT, Qwen kuri Alibaba DashScope, Qwen3-Coder kuri ModelScope, na Llama kuri Groq. Streaming yegeranye, latency, n'ikoreshwa rya token.
demos_index.side_by_side_preview_full_vs_half: Kureba yegeranye: umubiri wose vs igice cy'umubiri, zombi WebXR sessions zihuza neza binyuze muri WebXRSession.
demos_index.sign_in_form_wired_with_declarative_attr: Ifishi yo kwinjira ihujwe na declarative data-agent-* attributes. Igenda ijya ku kintu cyibandwaho, ikurikirana aho wandika binyuze mu ndorerwamo yihishe, ipfuka amaso ku gice cy'ijambo ry'ibanga, inyeganyeza umutwe iyo yoherejwe irimo ubusa.
demos_index.standalone_copy_of_the_mic_driven_lipsyn: Kopi yigenga ya demo ya lipsync ikoresha mikoro — amajwi y'igihe nyacyo yinjira, visemes zisohoka, nta TTS step mu ikorana.
demos_index.standalone_copy_of_the_multi_llm_brain: Kopi yigenga ya demo ya multi-LLM brain — Claude / GPT / Qwen / Llama yegeranye, itandukanyijwe n'inzira y'umusaruro.
demos_index.standalone_copy_of_the_tts_driven_lipsyn: Kopi yigenga ya demo ya lipsync ikoresha TTS — andika inyandiko, uyumve, urebe visemes zikoresha umunwa wa avatar.
demos_index.stream_an_llm_completion_through_livepee: Kwirakwiza LLM completion binyuze mu muyoboro wa Livepeer w'ubwenge bukoranwa aho gukoresha umutanga serivisi wo hagati. Yerekana guhitamo orchestrator + igiciro.
demos_index.stripped_down_version_of_the_button_jump: Verisiyo yoroheje ya demo yo gusimbuka ku buto — gusa avatar, buto, n'igikanyizo. Bifasha mu guhindura physics yonyine.
demos_index.the_app_surface_rebuilt_around_the_avata: Ubuso bwa /app, bwongeye kubakwa buzunguruka avatar. Ask-the-agent chat dock ifite prompts zihinduranya zikoresha LLM n'amashusho yimuka · camera presets (Face/Body/Wide/Hero) · share & embed snippet · fullscreen · push-to-talk · auto-hide chrome · floor glow + camera drift. demos_livepeer_inference.meta_description: Prompt imwe, abatanga serivisi babiri. Gereranya three.ws inference isanzwe n'inzira ya AI idafite umuyobozi umwe, ku ruhande: igihe cyo gutinda, umubare wa tokens, n'igisubizo cyuzuye cya buri kimwe.
demos_livepeer_inference.meta_title: Inference idafite umuyobozi umwe · three.ws laboratwari
demos_livepeer_inference.powered_by_livepeer_ai_gateway_decentral: Ibyo byakozwe na Livepeer AI Gateway mu buryo bwo kugabanya. Icyo kibazo gikurira ku three.ws provider chain, n'ikadi rimwe ririzina provider n'umodi w'ibintu by'imbere. Public decentralized gateway ntiyagomba kubona umufunguzo, kandi itagaragaza ko ari yo iteganijwe kandi ntishobora kubona orchestrator online kuri mododi yose.
demos_livepeer_inference.same_prompt_two_providers_real_responses: Prompt yose, aba babiri, ibintu by'imbere. Ikadi left gikora three.ws inference chain, ikibazo gikurira ku provider wose w'imbere. Ikadi right ikora umubano umwe mu buryo bwo kugabanya decentralized AI gateway aho orchestrators bakoresha open-weight models kuri commodity GPUs. Phase 4 y'icyo gice: decoupling inference mu vendor yose kugira ngo agent zikomeze kugenda iyo provider imwe ntishobora.

diff.explain1_body: Ibintu bihuzwa n'izina, hanyuma n'ubutumwa hash, hanyuma n'ubusabane, uburyo bumwe bwa gatatu git ikoresha mu guhindura amazina y'amafaili. Umukora wohereza Mesh.001 usoma nk'ihindura, ntabwo nk'ihindura.
diff.explain2_body: Amakuru y'ibice ahuzwa ku gipimo cya 1e-4, bityo umuvuduko w'ihindura cyangwa urugendo rwa Draco ntibiremerwa mu gihe ihindura nyayo iboneka.
diff.explain2_title: Icyihanganira ku mwanda, gikomeye ku ihindura
diff.explain3_body: nta, gukosora, guciriritse, kinini, guhindura. Guhindura bisobanura ikintu umukoresha ashingiraho ku izina cyabuze: ikibaho, umuyoboro, mesh. Ibi ni ibibazo bituma ibintu byiza bidahinduka.
diff.explain4_body: Iyi paji, glb-diff CLI, na API y'ubuntu byose bikora @three-ws/glb-diff, bityo umwanzuro muri CI ntushobora guhangana n'ibyo ubona hano.
diff.hero_sub: Checksum ivuga ko amadosiye abiri atandukanye. Ntishobora kumenya itandukaniro hagati yo gukuramo neza no gukuramo rig itakaje ingingo eshatu z'intoki, kandi imwe muri izo niyo ifata avatar yawe ku ishusho. Shyira .glb ku mpande zombi maze ubone impinduka: geometry, ibikoresho, textures, skeletons, na clips, hamwe no guhindura no kwimura byamenyekanye nk'uko git ibikora.
diff.hero_title: Ni iki cyahindutse hagati y'izi moderi ebyiri?
diff.meta_desc: Shyira amadosiye abiri .glb urebe neza impinduka zose: geometry, ibikoresho, textures, skeletons, na animation clips, hamwe no kumenya guhindura no kwimura mu buryo bwa git n'uburemere ushobora gushyiraho ku kubaka. Bikorwa mu rubuga rwawe, nta kintu na kimwe cyoherejwe.
diff.og_desc: Imodeli ebyiri zinjira, impinduka imwe isohoka: ikintu cyahindutse, ikintu cyahinduwe izina, izihe ngingo zagiye, kandi niba hari ikintu cyose cyahindutse hasi.
