docs_freshness.every_doc_names_the_files_npm_scripts: Buri nyandiko ivuga ku mafayili, scripts za npm, na API routes bireba. Ibi bituma buri paji ibarwa: iyihuze n'inkomoko ivuga, hanyuma ubaze git niba iyo nkuru yarakozwe nyuma y'uko inyandiko yanditswe cyangwa yagenzuwe bwa nyuma. Kode yagiye ihinduka kuva icyo gihe ni kode paji itigeze isuzumwa. Gusoma paji no kuyisanga ikiri nziza nabyo birabarwa: icyo gupima cyandikwa nk'isuzuma, bityo akazi nyako ntikagomba gukorwa mu buryo bw'ibihimbano.
docs_freshness.meta_description: Ni izihe nyandiko za three.ws zigasobanura kode itangwa. Buri nyandiko ihuzwa n'ama fayili y'inkomoko ivuga, kandi git igena niba iyo nkuru yarahindutse nyuma y'uko inyandiko yanditswe.
docs_freshness.meta_og_description: Guhinduka kw'inyandiko, gupimwa. Buri nyandiko ihuzwa na kode ivuga; git igena niba iyo kode yarahindutse nyuma y'uko inyandiko yanditswe bwa nyuma.
docs_freshness.meta_twitter_description: Ese iyi nyandiko iracyasobanura kode? Buri nyandiko igabanyijwe ku mafayili y'inkomoko ivuga, kandi iyi dashboard ikurikirana guhinduka kugira ngo paji zishaje zishakishwe mbere.

docs_walk_analytics.anonymous_walkers_count_too_signed_in_wa: Abagenzi batamenyekanye nabo barabarwa. Abagenzi binjiye babarirwa kuri konti zabo; abandi bose bahuzwa n'indangamuntu itazwi ihindagurika, bityo urutonde n'ibiteranyo byawe bikomeza kubarimo.
docs_walk_analytics.beyond_automatic_metrics_fire_your_own_e: Uretse ibipimo byikora, tangiza ibyabaye byawe kugira ngo upime iby'ingenzi — kwiyandikisha, kugura, gukina. Kuva ku rupapuro rukoresha walk runtime:
docs_walk_analytics.each_event_posts_immediately_events_are_: Buri kintu kibaye gihita cyoherezwa (ibyabaye ni bike, bitandukanye n'ibipimo byegeranyijwe) kandi kigahuzwa na avatar n'umugenzi umwe nk'igihe cyose cyo gukoresha. Dashboard yerekana umubare w'ibyabaye byose n'igipimo cyabyo cya conversion ugereranije n'igihe cyo gukoresha.
docs_walk_analytics.edit_this_page_on_github: ✎ Hindura iyi page kuri GitHub
docs_walk_analytics.every_avatar_you_own_has_a_private: Buri avatar ufite ifite dashboard yayo ya analytics yihariye kuri three.ws/walk-analytics — ibihe byo gukoresha, intera, igihe, aho yagenze, n'ibyabaye bya conversion watangije ubwawe. Imibare yose ikomoka ku bikorwa nyabyo byo kugenda; nta na kimwe cyapimwe cyangwa ngo kigereranywe.
docs_walk_analytics.meta_description: Igenzura rya analytics ry'ibyo wakoresheje muri Walk: ibihe byo gukoresha, igihe gisanzwe cyamaze, intera yagenzwe, aho byakoreshejwe bidasanzwe, urutonde rw'igihe rwa buri munsi, abakira benshi, n'ibikorwa byo guhindura byashyizweho n'uwabikoze bikoresheje ThreeWalkAvatar.track.
docs_walk_analytics.metres_walked_summed_from_per_frame_move: Metero zagenzwe, zibarwa ziteranyijwe kuva ku rugendo rwa buri frame.
docs_walk_analytics.no_third_party_tracking_metrics_flow_onl: Nta gukurikirana gukorwa n'abandi. Ibipimo bijya gusa muri three.ws ingest; nta mutanga wa analytics wo hanze uri muri sisitemu.
docs_walk_analytics.owner_only_the_dashboard_api_requires_a: Nyiracyo gusa. API ya dashboard isaba kwinjira (session) (cyangwa bearer token ifite uburenganzira bwa avatars:read) kandi ikagenzura ko uri nyir'avatar — abandi bahabwa 403.
docs_walk_analytics.per_day_sessions_distance_and_duration_g: Ibihe byo gukoresha, intera, n'igihe cya buri munsi — ibyanya byuzuzwa zeru kugira ngo igishushanyo kibe gikomeza.
docs_walk_analytics.sessions_counted_across_the_selected_win: Ibihe byo gukoresha byabaruwe mu gihe cyatoranijwe.
docs_walk_analytics.the_embed_host_which_site_the_avatar: Umukira w'ibyakoreshejwe (urubuga avatar yagenzemo) ikomoka kuri server kuva kuri header ya Origin/Referer y'icyifuzo — ntabwo yizerwa kuva mu mubiri w'icyifuzo. "Aho byakoreshejwe bidasanzwe" byawe bigaragaza aho avatar yakoreye.
docs_walk_analytics.the_ingest_accepts_this_batch_all_fields: Ingest yakira iyi batch (ibice byose ni optional keretse bibaye ngombwa):
docs_walk_analytics.the_runtime_unlocks_a_fixed_set_of: Runtime ifungura ibyagezweho bihamye, bibikwa rimwe kuri buri kimwe:
docs_walk_analytics.the_top_10_embed_hosts_by_session: Abakira 10 ba mbere b'ibyakoreshejwe hashingiwe ku mubare w'ibihe byo gukoresha.
docs_walk_analytics.the_walk_runtime_accumulates_two_running: Runtime ya Walk ikusanya imibare ibiri ikomeza — intera y'ubugari n'igihe cy'igihe cyo gukoresha — kandi ikohereza batch ntoya kuri POST /api/walk/metrics hafi buri masegonda 60, hamwe no rimwe iyo ipaji ihishwe binyuze kuri navigator.sendBeacon. Batch imwe ihinduka umurongo umwe wa rollup wa buri munsi, bityo isaha yo kugenda ni imirongo mike, ntabwo ari ibihumbi.
docs_walk_analytics.total_walk_time_total_sessions: Igihe cyose cyo kugenda ÷ ibihe byo gukoresha byose.
docs_walk_analytics.your_conversion_events_with_a_count_and: Ibikorwa byawe byo guhindura bifite umubare n'igipimo cyo guhindura (ibikorwa ÷ ibihe byo gukoresha).

docs_walk_chrome_extension.everything_stays_on_your_device_except_t: Byose biguma ku gikoresho cyawe uretse ibyifuzo bya text-to-speech, byoherezwa kuri three.ws kugira ngo bikore amajwi. Amategeko y'urubuga rwawe n'ibyo ukunda bibikwa muri Chrome's synced storage.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.keep_the_avatar_in_sync_as_you: Guma avatar iri mu buryo bumwe uko unyura mu rubuga, gusuzuma amategeko y'urubuga rwawe, no kugeza impinduka z'amasetingi ako kanya kuri tabu zashyizwemo.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.light_dark_or_auto_samples_the_page: Umucyo, Umunyenga, cyangwa Auto (ifata ibara ry'inyuma rya paji).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.meta_description: Iyongeragerezo rya Chrome rya three.ws Walk Avatar: rigendana na avatar yawe kuri buri rubuga, ugashyiraho uko igaragara n'amategeko kuri buri rubuga, kandi rugasoma amapaji hejuru hakoreshejwe text-to-speech. Uko urishyira, uburenganzira, n'imiterere.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.meta_title: Iyongeragerezo rya Chrome — Inyandiko za Walk — three.ws
docs_walk_chrome_extension.mounts_your_avatar_on_any_site_the: Ishyira avatar yawe kuri buri rubuga. Avatar ni ya iframe itagaragara ya /walk-embed, ishyirwa muri tab irimo gukoreshwa iyo uyifunguye.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.narration_on_off_off_by_default: Gusoma hejuru gufunguye/gufunze (bifunze mu buryo busanzwe).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.persist_your_chosen_avatar_walk_speed_po: Ifata avatar wahisemo, umuvuduko wo kugenda, aho iherereye, amategeko y'urubuga, n'imiterere yo gusoma hejuru (bihuzwa n'ibikoresho byawe bya Chrome).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.picked_from_the_three_ws_tts_voice: Yahiswemo mu rutonde rw'amajwi ya TTS ya three.ws.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.read_the_current_tab_s_hostname_to: Soma hostname ya tab irimo gukoreshwa kugira ngo yandike "Koresha kuri uru rubuga" kandi ihererekanye gufungura/gufunga kwawe kuri iyo tab.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.reads_pages_aloud_optional_with_narratio: Isoma amapaji hejuru (bihitamo). Iyo gusoma hejuru gufunguye, ibona ingingo nyamukuru, ikurikirana ibigaragara, kandi ikavuga ibice bigaragara ikoresheje text-to-speech.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.requires_chrome_109_or_newer_manifest_v3: Bisaba Chrome 109 cyangwa iyisumbuye (Manifest V3). Kugira ngo upfunyike zip yiteguye gushyirwa kuri store, koresha npm run build:extension:prod, bigatanga dist/extension-<version>.zip.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.respects_your_rules_per_site_enabling_pl: Yubahiriza amategeko yawe. Gufungura kuri buri rubuga hamwe na allowlist/blocklist, kandi ntabwo yishyiramo ubwayo — ikora gusa aho wayisabye.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.small_medium_large_or_custom_width_heigh: Ntoya, Hagati, Nini, cyangwa ubugari × uburebure bwihariye.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_is_built_from_this_reposit: Iyongeragerezo ryubatswe kuri iyi repository kandi ryashyizwemo ridapfunyitse. (Ryateguwe kuri Chrome Web Store; ntirirashyirwa ahagaragara, bityo rishyiremo mu buryo bwa developer.)
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_requests_the_minimum_it_ne: Iyongeragerezo risaba ibikenewe byibuze kandi rijyamo gusa iyo umukoresha abisabye neza.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_three_ws_walk_avatar_extension_v1: Iyongeragerezo rya three.ws Walk Avatar (v1.0.0) rishyira avatar ya 3D igenda kuri buri rubuga usura. Rigendana nawe kandi rishobora gusoma ibice by'urupapuro hejuru — umugenzi wawe mu gushakisha. Rikora gusa kuri tab wafunguye neza.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.walk_speed_a_slider_from_0_5: Umuvuduko wo kugenda — akanyerezo kuva kuri 0.5× kugeza 2.0×.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.with_narration_on_the_extension_parses_t: Iyo kuvuga byacanzwe, extension isesengura ingingo nyamukuru y'urubuga (ikoresheje Readability extractor yayo), ikuramo imitwe, interuro, ibintu byo ku rutonde, n'imvugo zishyizwe mu migongo, ikanareba igice kiri kugaragara. Iyo igice kimwe kibaye cyo kwibandwaho, gisaba amajwi yo kuvuga kuri serivisi ya three.ws yo guhindura inyandiko ijwi, kikayacuranga, mu gihe ibwira avatar kugaragaza agapfundikiye k'amagambo no guhindura imyifatire yo gutegereza. Uhora ijwi, ushobora gucecekesha uri hagati mu gusoma, kandi kuvuga kubahiriza prefers-reduced-motion. Abanditsi bashobora kugaragaza ibice bakoresheje data-walk-narrate (cyangwa bakabireka bakoresheje data-walk-narrate="skip").

docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_a_three_ws_site: Uburyo bwa Companion ni ikintu cya three.ws-site. Kugira ngo ushyire avatar igenda ku rubuga rwawe, koresha JavaScript SDK ifite tag imwe; kugira ngo avatar yawe igende kuri buri rubuga rwose usura, shyiramo Chrome extension.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_platform_integrati: Uburyo bwa Companion ni ihuriro rya platform na SDK ya walk ishobora gutangazwa. Imiyoboro ya three.ws ishyiramo script ya companion gusa iyo companion yashyizweho — urupapuro rutayicanye ntiruyishyurira. Mu by'ukuri, itwara manifest y'amashusho ya avatar yateguwe mbere na moteri imwe yo kugaragaza ikoreshwa n'urupapuro rwa walk na embeds.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_site_wide_walking: Uburyo bwa Companion ni avatar igenda ku rubuga rwose rwa three.ws. Buyicane maze avatar yawe ive ku rupapuro, igende kuri ecran, ikugereho uko ugenda uhindura amapaji — irimo n'impinduka z'amapaji zimenya kugenda.
docs_walk_companion_mode.detaches_and_roams_your_avatar_leaves_th: Irava ku rubuga ikazenguruka. Avatar yawe iva ku buryo urupapuro rumeze ikaba umuntu wa 3D wigenga ushobora kureba agenda.
docs_walk_companion_mode.edit_this_page_on_github: ✎ Hindura uru rupapuro kuri GitHub
docs_walk_companion_mode.follows_you_between_pages_when_you_navig: Igukurikira hagati y'amapaji. Iyo uhinduye urupapuro, companion irakomeza — kandi impinduka z'amapaji zimenya kugenda zihindura uko usimbuka kugira ngo bijyane n'aho ugiye.
docs_walk_companion_mode.meta_description: Uburyo bwa Companion: avatar ya three.ws ikwirakwira urubuga rwose, iva ku rupapuro, ikazenguruka, ikagukurikira hagati y'amapaji — irimo impinduka z'amapaji zimenya kugenda no gusezera / gusuhuza.
docs_walk_companion_mode.meta_title: Uburyo bwa Companion — Inyandiko za Walk — three.ws
docs_walk_companion_mode.nav_button_the_walk_control_in_the: Akabuto ka Nav — akabuto ka Walk kari hejuru mu miyoboro gacana cyangwa kagacana companion. Ibyo wahisemo biribukwa buri gihe usuye.
docs_walk_companion_mode.picks_an_avatar_the_picker_includes_a: Hitamo avatar. Uburyo bwo guhitamo burimo umurongo wa "kora iyawe" ujya muri avatar studio.
docs_walk_companion_mode.programmatically_the_companion_instance_: Mu buryo bwa porogaramu — urugero rwa companion ruboneka kuri window.__walkCompanion iyo rwamaze gucanwa (ubu ni uburyo imiyoboro ikoresha).
docs_walk_companion_mode.query_parameter_append_to_any_three_ws: Parametre y'ibibazo — ongeraho ?walk=1 kuri URL iyo ari yo yose ya three.ws kugira ngo biyihate gukora, cyangwa ?walk=0 kugira ngo biyihate guhagarara.
docs_walk_companion_mode.the_companion_and_its_page_transitions_r: Umugenzi n'impinduka z'amapaji ye byubahiriza prefers-reduced-motion. Avatar igenda ni umutako; uburyo bwose bwo kugenda n'ibiriho bikomeza gukoreshwa neza umugenzi adahari, ibyo bikaba ari byo biba bisanzwe kugeza igihe ubishakiye.
docs_walk_companion_mode.waves_goodbye_and_hello_on_a_link: Gusezera no gusuhuza. Iyo ukanze kuri link, avatar ikora ikimenyetso cyo gusezera kandi igashyiraho ikimenyetso kimwe ipaji y'aho igana isoma kugira ngo nayo isuhuze iyo imaze gupakira.

docs_walk_embed_api.avatar_animation_clips_finished_loading_: Avatar + amashusho y'imikino byarangiye gupakira. Yongeye koherezwa nk'igisubizo kuri walk:ping.

docs_walk_embed_api.everything_inbound_is_validated_numbers_: Buri kintu cyose kiza kiragenzurwa. Imibare irafungwa, imirongo ifite imipaka y'uburebure, enums ziragenzurwa, na config.bg igarukira ku mabara afite umutekano. Itegeko ribi ritanga walk:error, ntabwo ritera ikosa.

economy_lab.read_fresh_on_load_nothing_on_this_label: Soma ibishya mu gihe cyo gupakira. Nta kintu kuri iyi paji kiri mu mwanya.
economy_lab.shorter_runway_spends_faster_today_and_l: Runway ngufi ikoresha vuba uyu munsi ikagabanya ibiri imbere.
economy_lab.slide_right_to_simulate_a_deposit_left: Kora iburyo kugirango ushimule ikiguzi, ibumoso kugirango ushimule ikuramo.
economy_lab.the_governor_recomputes_from_the_live_ba: Umuyobozi asubiramo ku mafaranga ariho kuri buri ihuriro, bityo gukoresha bigabanya ingengo y'imari yemera ikiguzi gikurikira. Iyi feedback ihurira kuri gukoresha / (ikiguzi × (iminsi + 1)) ku munsi. Ku rugero rwa runway rw'iminsi itatu, urukuta rutanga kimwe cya kane cya SOL ishobora gukoreshwa ku munsi, si kimwe cya gatatu: igipimo cya 25% hagati y'icyifuzo cyateguwe n'ukuri, kandi impamvu “iminsi itatu ya runway” na “ihuriro byahagaritswe uyu munsi” si ukutavuguruzanya.
economy_lab.the_governor_s_budget_is_one_equation: Ingengo y'imari y'umuyobozi ni equation imwe ifite ibice bitatu byigenga, bityo guhagarara buri gihe bifite ibisubizo bitatu bishoboka. Tanga umuvuduko ushaka kandi buri lever isubizwa neza, harimo n'izo zitashobora gukora.
economy_lab.the_last_24_hours_of_real_settle: Amasaha 24 ashize y'ibisubizo by'ukuri, ugereranije n'icyo uyu mwirondoro utekereza kuri icyo gihe. Ikigero hagati yabo ni ikosa mu mwirondoro cyangwa impamvu umwirondoro utazi, kandi kimwe cyose gifite agaciro ko gukurikirana.
economy_lab.the_only_knob_that_does_not_depend: Icyo gashami kimwe kitagendera ku mafaranga.
economy_lab.the_simulation_imports_and_from_the_same: Iyi simulation yinjiza walletDailyFeeBudgetLamports() na assessWalletFeeBudget() iva muri wallet-fee-governor.js, module imwe umuyobozi uriho akoresha kuri buri ihuriro. Hindura umuyobozi kandi iyi paji ihinduka nayo. Umwirondoro w'ibindi byakwirakwira; uyu ntushobora.
economy_lab.watch_for_the_utc_midnight_reset: Reba ku ihinduka rya UTC mu ijoro.

embed-doctor.hero_p: Ikimenyetso cyawe <agent-3d> kiri ku ipaji kandi nta kintu kigaragara. Console iratari, imiterere isa neza, kandi nta kosa ryo gushakisha. Ibice byombi bigenzurwa kimwe, bityo <three-d> ikimenyetso kuva ku mwanya wa v1 (harimo ikimenyetso gitegetswe) ni ikintu cyakirwa hano kimwe na <agent-3d>.

event.card_world_p: Umujyi wa 3D wateguwe uhereye ku mafaranga ubwawo, ufite isaha y’ukuri y’umunsi/nijoro buri wese yemera. Genda, ugende, kandi urebe abandi bose bari muri iyo.

event.foot: Isi iri kuri /play kandi irafunguye yaba hari igikorwa cyangwa ntikiriho. Kora avatar mbere kuri /create, reba ibyo ubukungu bwo mu isi bwishyura kuri /play/economy, kandi urebe byose byoherejwe vuba kuri changelog.

evm_wallet.grind_a_real_ethereum_evm_wallet_whose: Shakisha wallet nyayo ya Ethereum / EVM ifite aderesi itangira cyangwa irangira n'inyuguti wahisemo — ku mukozi wawe, ububiko, cyangwa ahantu hose aderesi ya 0x yoroshye kwibukwa ifite agaciro. Ibisubizo ni keypair isanzwe ya secp256k1 ushobora kwinjiza muri MetaMask, ethers, viem cyangwa Rabby. Ikora yose muri browser yawe. Private key ntabwo yoherezwa ahantu na hamwe.
evm_wallet.hex_characters_only_0_9_a_f: Inyuguti za Hex gusa (0–9, a–f). Buri nyuguti yiyongereye irushya inshuro 16. Inyuguti zivanzemo (urugero BeeF) zihura na EIP-55 checksum — zigaragara neza, zirushya inshuro ~2 kuri buri nyuguti.
evm_wallet.meta_description: Shakisha aderesi ya wallet ya Ethereum / EVM yihariye ifite umugabane w'imbere cyangwa uw'inyuma wahisemo. Ni keypair nyayo ya secp256k1 — ishobora kwinjizwa muri MetaMask, ethers, viem. Ikora yose muri browser yawe; private key ntabwo isohoka mu gikoresho cyawe.
evm_wallet.meta_og_description: Shakisha aderesi ya wallet ya Ethereum / EVM yihariye muri browser yawe. Ni keypair nyayo, ishobora kwinjizwa muri MetaMask. Keys ntabwo zisohoka mu gikoresho cyawe.
evm_wallet.meta_title: Gukora isakoshi yihariye ya EVM · three.ws
evm_wallet.meta_twitter_description: Shakisha aderesi ya wallet ya Ethereum / EVM yihariye muri browser yawe. Keys ntabwo zisohoka mu gikoresho cyawe.
evm_wallet.this_is_an_eoa_grinder_it_searches: Iki ni igikoresho cyo gushakisha EOA — gishakisha imfunguzo bwite mu buryo bweruye, bityo ukaba nyir'ubusobanuro buvuyemo. (CREATE2 ni igikoresho gisa nacyo cyo gushakisha ubusobanuro bwa smart-contract bwihariye, aho ushakisha "salt" aho kuba urufunguzo.) Imfunguzo ziremaremwa na CSPRNG ya mushakisha yawe, buri gihuye kigashakishwa bundi bushya kikanagenzurwa mbere y'uko kigaragazwa, kandi ibyoherejwe hepfo ni "keystore" yashyizwemo urufunguzo mu buryo busanzwe.

examples.meta_desc: Ibyitegererezo bishobora gukorwa mu nzira enye: shyira avatar ya 3D, kora no gupima imiterere ya 3D ku API y’ubuntu ya text-to-3D, shingira umukozi wose nk’amadosiye, kandi usome ku x402 amasezerano y’ishyurwa abakozi bakorana. Buri snippet ikora ku paji ikora ku APIs z’ukuri.
examples.more_p: Uretse snippets ziri mu idosiye imwe hejuru, ububiko butanga imishinga y’icyitegererezo yuzuye n’ishusho y’icyitegererezo iruhande rwa buri SDK n’ipaki yashyizwe ahagaragara: abakozi bateguwe mu buryo bwose nk’amadosiye, ibipaki by’ubumenyi bishobora gushyirwa hamwe, n’icyandiko gishobora kuyobora MCP n’ahantu h’ishyurwa kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku mpera. Urutonde rwakozwe no gusuzuma ububiko, bityo ntirushobora kwamamaza icyitegererezo cyakuwemo cyangwa kwibagirwa kimwe cyongereweho. Buri karita yerekana amadosiye ikubiyemo n’itegeko riyikoresha.
examples.og_desc: Ibyitegererezo bishobora gukorwa ku avatars za 3D, gukora imiterere, abakozi bateguwe nk’amadosiye, n’ubukungu bw’abakozi. Bikoreshwa hano, bigakopororwa ahantu hose.
examples.page_title: Ibyitegererezo: byose umukozi wa 3D AI ashobora gukora · three.ws
examples.share_title: Ibyitegererezo: byose umukozi wa 3D AI ashobora gukora · three.ws
examples.sub_label2: inzira: gushyira mu bikorwa umubiri wa 3D, gukora no gupima imiterere ubwabo, gusobanura umukozi nk'inyandiko, no gusoma ubukungu bushobora kwishyurwa n'imashini abo bakozi bacuruza. Buri kimwe ni inyandiko ya HTML yuzuye ikoresha bundle ya CDN y'ibikorwa kandi ikora kuri APIs z'ibikorwa. Kanda Run kandi kode nyayo yerekanywe izakora mu ishusho kuri iyi paji ikora ku makuru y'ukuri; kanda Copy uyishyire muri paji ya HTML iyo ari yo yose ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose. Shakisha izina cyangwa ikimenyetso kugira ngo ubone kimwe. Inyigisho z'ibanze ziri mu tutorials, ibiryo bya 3D API biri mu cookbook, n'impapuro z'ikora mu demos.

exit-lab.honesty_h: Ibyo ibi bishobora n'ibyo bitashobora kukubwira
exit-lab.meta_desc: Subira mu bucuruzi bw'ukuri bw'ikipe munsi y'indi politiki yo gusohoka. Hindura stop-loss, trailing stop, take-initials ladder na moon-bag floor, urebe ibyo ikipe yari gukora ku SOL yari imaze gukoresha. Imyanya y'ukuri, imfill z'ukuri ku murongo, nta makuru y'ibihimbano.
exit-lab.reasons_sub: Buri bucuruzi bwafunzwe bushingiye ku tegeko rimwe ryakoze. Politiki ifata inyungu yayo binyuze ku tegeko rimwe ni politiki ishingiye ku gitekerezo kimwe.
exit-lab.share_desc: Subira mu bucuruzi bw'ukuri bw'ikipe munsi y'indi politiki yo gusohoka urebe ibyo SOL yari imaze gukoresha byari gutanga.
exit-lab.sub: Ikipande cyamaze gukoresha uyu SOL. Ibi bisubiramo buri mwanya w'ukuri wafunzwe binyuze ku kode yo gusohoka nyayo umukozi w'ukuri akora, hamwe n'amategeko yahinduwe uko ushaka, kandi bigaragaza ibyo ubucuruzi bimwe byari gutanga. Nta kintu hano cyahimbwe: buri mwanya, igipimo n'igiciro cya nyuma ni igipimo cyanditswe ku mwanya wateje amafaranga y'ukuri kandi byakiriwe ku murongo.
exit-lab.sweep_sub: Subira mu nyandiko zose ku buryo bwose ku murongo no gushyira mu murongo ibisubizo. Ibi ni ugushakisha nyakuri ku bucuruzi bwamaze kuba, si igitekerezo: bigaragaza ibyo ikipe y'ibyakorewe byari gutanga, ari byo bintu gusa aya makuru ashobora kuvuga mu kuri.
exit-lab.title: Sohoka mu Lab
exit-lab.trades_sub: Imyanya aho iyi politiki ihinduka cyane ugereranije n'ibyo ikipe yakoze. Buri murongo uhuza kugura no kugurisha kuri Solscan.

fact_check.meta_description: Gusuzuma ukuri bifite inkomoko n'ibimenyetso bya cryptographic bigenzurika. Gushakisha ako kanya + imyanzuro ya LLM, igereranyo ry'ukuri ryasohotse, n'uburyo bwo kugenzura ubuntu buri munsi — gerageza kugenzura nyako hano.
fact_check.meta_og_description: Tanga ikirego, ubone umwanzuro ufite inkomoko n'ikimenyetso cya SHA-256 — bishyigikiwe n'igereranyo ry'ukuri rya rubanda, rigenzurika. Kugenzura 3 ku buntu ku munsi kuri IP imwe, hanyuma $0.10 USDC binyuze kuri x402.
fact_check.meta_twitter_description: Gusuzuma ukuri bifite inkomoko n'ibimenyetso bya cryptographic — igereranyo ry'ukuri ryasohotse, rigenzurika hamwe n'agashushondanga ko kugenzura ubuntu ako kanya. Kugenzura 3 ku buntu ku munsi kuri IP imwe, hanyuma $0.10 USDC binyuze kuri x402.

fact_checker.how_demanding_the_verdict_should_be_low: Uko umwanzuro ugomba kuba uhamye: Buke yemera ibimenyetso bidahagije, Gihamye isaba ibimenyetso bikomeye.
fact_checker.meta_description: Wishyura kuri buri igenzura. Ibisubizo bifite inkomoko. Ikimenyetso cyashyizweho umukono. Ikoresha gushakisha ako kanya kuri internet + isesengura rya LLM kuri Base na Solana USDC.
fact_checker.meta_og_description: Tanga ikirego icyo ari cyo cyose. Ubône umwanzuro ufite inkomoko mu masegonda. $0.10–$1.00 kuri buri igenzura. USDC. Base + Solana.

fade.honesty_1: Icyanditswe cy'ikibaho kigena gusa amafaranga y'ibyo umusaruro uzi. Umutsinzi ni amafaranga yageze ku AMM cyangwa yageze ku 3x cyangwa birenzeho.
fade.honesty_2: Amahirwe ari hejuru yabaruwe mu cyitegererezo: itsinda ryubatswe ku mafaranga yanditswe mu gice cya mbere cy'amateka, hanyuma rigakorwa ku mafaranga itashoboraga kubona.
fade.honesty_3: Amafaranga abara rimwe gusa igihe nibura abaguzi bayo batanu babonetse. Munsi yaho ikibaho kivuga ibyo ahubwo ntikibeshye.
fade.honesty_4: Ibi ni isesengura ry'amahirwe ku isoko rihanganye, ntibikaba igitekerezo, kandi ntibikaba inama. Amafaranga asobanutse ashobora kugera ku zero.
fade.honesty_5: Amafaranga three.ws ashyigikira ni $THREE. Amafaranga yose kuri iki kibaho ni ibyo ikigega cy'ukuri cyaduhaye.
fade.honesty_h: Ibyo ibi ari byo n'ibyo bitari byo
fade.meta_desc: Ikinyuranyo cya Smart Money Radar. Buri pump.fun amafaranga akurikiranywe hakurikijwe uko igice cyayo cyo kugura kiva mu mabanki afite amateka yagenwe kandi nta mutsinzi muri yo, hamwe n'amahirwe yabaruwe, atari mu cyitegererezo, inyuma y'ibyo byemezo.
fade.og_desc: Bimwe mu mabanki yaguze amafaranga menshi y'ibiceri ariko ntibigeze biba neza. Iyo bahurira ku itangiriro, iryo tangiriro ritsinda 1.8% by'igihe ku gipimo cya 22%. Dore aho bahagaze ubu.

fade.share_title: Fade Radar: amabanki atari yo · three.ws
fade.sub: Smart Money Radar ibaza uwuhe muntu w'icyubahiro ugura igiceri. Ibi bibaza ikibazo gikomeye: ni angahe ku ruhande rw'igura rutigeze ruba neza. Ikimenyetso cy'inyuma hano ni banki igaragazwa n'igishushanyo cyarebye igura nibura ibiceri bitanu ibyavuyemo ubu bamenyekanye, nta watsinze muri byo. Si bake, kandi iyo bahurira ku itangiriro rishya, iryo tangiriro riba ritaragera ahantu. Nta kintu kuri iyi paji kiri mu gihe gito: ku murongo w'ubufatanye, uburyo bwonyine bwo gucuruza fade ni ukutagura.

fade.twitter_desc: Icyerekezo cy'inyuma cya Smart Money Radar: ni ibiceri bingahe amabanki yagaragaye ko atatsinze arimo kugura ubu, n'amahirwe yagenwe inyuma y'icyemezo.

features.for_creators_who_want_a_personal_avatar: Ku: baremyi bashaka avatar yabo bwite nta guha akazi umuhanzi wa 3D.
features.for_crypto_enthusiasts_who_want_a_more: Ku: bakunda crypto bashaka uburyo bugaragara bwo gukurikirana isoko.
features.for_developers_and_creators_who_want_a: Ku: bateza imbere n'abaremyi bashaka AI iganira ifite isura igaragara neza.
features.for_enterprise_teams_evaluating_ibm_wats: Ku: makipe y'ibigo binini asuzuma IBM watsonx, cyangwa abateza imbere bashaka kureba ibyo models za Granite zishobora gukora mu bidukikije bya 3D bikorana.
features.for_site_owners_who_want_a_3d: Ku: bafite imbuga bashaka umufasha wa AI wa 3D ku rubuga rwabo nta gukora ku kodingi ya backend.
features.free_to_start_no_credit_card_required: Gutangira ni ubuntu. Nta karita yo kwishyura ikenewe.
features.get_updates_on_new_features_agent_toolin: Bona amakuru mashya ku biranga bishya, ibikoresho bya agent, n'impinduka za protocole.
features.give_your_agent_a_community_token_in: Ha agent yawe token y'umuryango mu byiciro bike — shyiraho izina n'ishusho, kandi ihita itangira gukorana ku isoko rya bonding-curve rya pump.fun umuntu wese ashobora gucururizaho.
features.list_your_agent_s_skills_for_others: Andika ubuhanga bwa agent yawe kugira ngo abandi babugure. Buri guhamagara kwishyurwa muri USDC (idolari rya digital rya $1) binyuze mu kwishyura buri guhamagara — ubwishyu bujya ako kanya mu gikapu cyawe.
features.make_avatars_build_ai_agents_and_put: Kora avatar, ubake agent za AI, kandi uzishyire ahantu hose. Gutangira ni ubuntu, nta gikapu gikenewe.
features.meta_description: Buri kintu cya three.ws cyose hamwe: rema avatar za 3D, shyira abagenzi ku rubuga urwo arirwo rwose, shaka isi z'ibiceri, kandi winjize ukoresheje ubuhanga bwo kwishyura kuri buri guhamagara.
features.meta_og_description: Rema avatar za 3D, shyira abagenzi ahantu hose, shaka isi z'ibiceri, kandi winjize ukoresheje ubuhanga bwo kwishyura kuri buri guhamagara.
features.meta_twitter_description: Rema avatar za 3D, shyira abagenzi ahantu hose, shaka isi z'ibiceri, kandi winjize ukoresheje ubuhanga bwo kwishyura kuri buri guhamagara.
features.no_crypto_needed_everything_in_this_sect: Nta crypto ikenewe. Buri kintu muri iki gice gikora ukoresheje imeyili gusa — nta kofi, nta bimenyetso, nta blockchain. Iyandikishe utangire mu minota mike.
features.one_home_for_everything_you_have_made: Ahantu hamwe ho kubika ibyo wakoze byose — hindura imyitwarire ya buri mugenzi, uhindure animasiyo zayo, ukope kode zo gushyiramo, kandi urebe ibiganiro biza ako kanya.
features.one_transaction_on_solana_gives_your_age: Kugurisha kumwe kuri Solana guha umugenzi wawe indangamuntu ihoraho, ishobora kugenzurwa — umutungo wa Metaplex Core ushobora kuboneka kandi ukizewe na buri mukiriya wa A2A cyangwa MCP.
features.pick_a_goal_start_in_five_minutes: Hitamo intego. Tangira mu minota itanu.
features.pick_an_avatar_configure_size_and_style: Hitamo avatar, uhindure ingano n'imiterere, hanyuma ukope akamenyetso kamwe ka script. Kagishyire muri Notion, Ghost, WordPress, Framer — ahantu hose.
features.pick_any_animation_below_your_avatar_swi: Hitamo animasiyo iyo ari yo yose hepfo. Avatar yawe ihinduka ako kanya — nta kongera gupakurura urupapuro, nta kwinjiza. Ibi bikora kuri buri gikoresho, muri buri gushyiramo.
features.put_agents_on_chain_charge_for_what: Shyira abagenzi kuri chain, wishyurire ibyo bakora, kandi ushyireho token. Bifite imbaraga, ariko ntibisabwa na rimwe.
features.reads_live_market_prices_on_chain: Soma ibiciro by'isoko by'ako kanya kuri chain.
features.start_free_add_crypto_only_if_you:
Tangira ubuntu.
Ongeramo crypto gusa niba ubishaka.
features.take_one_photo_and_get_back_a: Fata ifoto imwe kandi ubonereho avatar ya 3D yuzuye mu masegonda agera kuri 60.
features.the_latest_features_each_linked_to_the: Ibiranga bishya n'ibyatangijwe vuba, buri kimwe gifitanye isano n'urupapuro rw'ako kanya. Urutonde rwihererekanya ubwarwo buri gihe habayeho gusohora.
features.the_web_component_lazy_loads_renders_on: Icyiciro cya web <agent-3d> cyikora buhoro, kigaragara kuri buri gikoresho, kandi gihuzwa na AI stack yawe isanzwe binyuze muri MCP cyangwa A2A. Nta framework. Nta build step.
features.the_whole_product_making_avatars_buildin: Igicuruzwa cyose — gukora avatars, kubaka AI agents, kubishyira ahantu hose — bikora gusa ukoresheje imeri. Ibiranga on-chain biri hepfo ni ibyongeweho ushobora kuzakoresha nyuma.
features.these_features_use_crypto_to_switch_them: Ibi biranga bikoresha crypto. Kugira ngo ubikoreshe, uzaba ukeneye wallet n'amafaranga make ya USDC cyangwa SOL. Nubireka rwose, igicuruzwa cy'ibanze cyavuzwe haruguru kiracyakora neza.
features.walk_your_avatar_through_3d_worlds_tied: Gendana avatar yawe mu isi za 3D zihujwe n'ibiciro bya crypto bihari. Ubutaka buhinduka bitewe n'isoko — buri si ni ubutaka bwa token itandukanye.
features.watch_two_ai_agents_oracle_and_nova: Reba AI agents ebyiri — ORACLE na NOVA — ziganira, zikoresha ubuhanga bwazo, kandi zikishyurana on-chain byikora. Nta bantu babigizemo uruhare.
features.why_it_s_better_agents_in_the: Impamvu ari byiza: Agents mu isi zishyurana on-chain mu gihe nyacyo — ushobora kureba x402 micropayment transactions zibera imbonankubone uko ugenda.
features.why_it_s_better_any_llm_works: Impamvu ari byiza: LLM yose ikora binyuze muri MCP cyangwa A2A — Claude, GPT, Gemini, cyangwa iyawe bwite. Nta vendor lock-in.
features.why_it_s_better_every_avatar_and: Impamvu ari byiza: Buri avatar na agent ukora bigaragara hano byikora — nta kintu cyo guhuza, login imwe kuri byose.
features.why_it_s_better_it_s_a: Impamvu ari byiza: Ni itangizwa nyaryo rifite ubucuruzi bukorwa ako kanya kuva ku isegonda rya mbere — wowe utanga amakuru, twebwe tugakora ibya on-chain.
features.why_it_s_better_no_app_install: Impamvu ari byiza: Nta gushyiramo app — ikorera muri browser ifite physics nyayo (Rapier) n'ubutaka nyabwo, atari ahantu hataringaniye.
features.why_it_s_better_no_sdk_required: Impamvu ari byiza: Nta SDK ikenewe ku ruhande rw'umukoresha — tag imwe, urupapuro urwo arirwo rwose, nta build step.
features.why_it_s_better_outputs_are_glb: Impamvu ari byiza: Ibisohoka byiteguye GLB — bishyire muri viewer ako kanya, ubishyireho, cyangwa ubishyiremo nta gihindura.
features.why_it_s_better_pay_per_call: Impamvu ari byiza: Kwishyura kuri buri guhamagara bivuze ko nta subscriptions zo gucunga — abaguzi bishyura ibyo bakoresheje gusa, nawe ukishyurwa kuri buri guhamagara.
features.why_it_s_better_real_on_chain: Impamvu ari byiza: Kwishyurana nyako on-chain binyuze muri pay-per-call (micropayments) — buri transaction irashobora kugenzurwa, ntabwo ari simulation.
features.why_it_s_better_sub_cent_fees: Impamvu ari byiza: Amafaranga make cyane. Ufite imfunguzo. Ikarita ya agent ni URL ya JSON rusange — nta kintu gifungiye kuri uru rubuga.
features.why_it_s_better_the_rig_is: Impamvu ari byiza: Rig yiteguye animation — ushobora kuyishyira muri viewer ako kanya ugahita ukoresha animation iyo ari yo yose.
features.why_it_s_better_these_are_real: Impamvu ari byiza: Ibi ni Granite API calls nyazo — zitari mocked — buri cyemezo gihujwe na Solana transaction nk'inyandiko idahinduka.
features.why_it_s_better_three_ar_methods: Impamvu ari byiza: Uburyo butatu bwa AR mu buto bumwe — iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, na WebXR. Ibukwiye ikora yonyine. Agent iguma ikora muri WebXR, bityo ibiganiro na animations bikora muri AR.

features_agent_exchange.built_on_the_open_x402_http_payment: Yubatswe kuri standard y'ubwishyu ya HTTP ya x402 ifunguye — umukiriya uwo ari we wese wa HTTP ushyigikira 402 / kwemeza ubwishyu ashobora kuba umuguzi cyangwa umucuruzi muri ubu bukungu.
features_agent_exchange.every_transaction_appears_in_the_live_fe: Buri gikorwa cyose kigaragara muri pane y'amakuru y'ako kanya hamwe na hash ya tx Solana, umubare muri USDC, n'uko byemejwe. Ushobora kugenzura buri gikorwa cyose kuri Solana Explorer wenyine.
features_agent_exchange.meta_description: Reba aba-agent ba AI babiri bafite avatars za 3D baganira kandi bakishyurana ubwenge bwa crypto bakoresheje micropayments za x402 kuri Solana. Buri gikorwa cyose cyemezwa kuri blockchain — ako kanya.

features_agent_exchange.neither_agent_is_simulated_both_hold_sol: Nta agent n'imwe yigana. Zombi zifite wallets za Solana zifite USDC nyayo. Buri bwishyu bwose ni igikorwa cyemejwe kuri blockchain — ntabwo ari ikigereranyo cyangwa inyandiko mu gitabo.
features_agent_exchange.nova_s_endpoint_responds_with_a_402: Endpoint ya NOVA isubiza 402 Payment Required n'igiciro cyagenwe. Wallet ya ORACLE yemeza ubwishyu, isinya igikorwa cya Solana, kandi ikongera gusaba — NOVA igenzura iyishyurwa kuri blockchain kandi igasubiza amakuru.
features_agent_exchange.open_the_agent_exchange_and_see_every: Fungura Agent Exchange kandi urebe buri gikorwa cyose kuri blockchain kiba mu gihe nyacyo.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_are_two_ai_agents: ORACLE na NOVA ni aba-agent ba AI babiri bafite avatars za 3D na wallets za Solana nyazo. Bagura kandi bakagurisha ubwenge bwa crypto hagati yabo bigenga banyuze kuri micropayments za x402 — buri gikorwa cyose cyemezwa kuri blockchain, kigaragara mu gihe nyacyo.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_have_distinct_3d_avatars: ORACLE na NOVA zifite avatars za 3D zitandukanye, amajwi, n'indangamuntu kuri blockchain — uzibona nk'ibigo biganira, atari nka API calls zidafite isura.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_decides_it_needs_crypto_market_da: ORACLE ifata icyemezo ko ikeneye amakuru y'isoko rya crypto. Ivumbura NOVA nk'utanga amakuru kuri kataloge ya serivisi ya x402 kandi igasaba API yishyuwe — guhamagara kwa HTTP bisanzwe bifite umutwe w'iyemeza ry'ubwishyu.
features_agent_exchange.the_three_ws_agent_sdk_implements_the: SDK ya agent ya three.ws ishyira mu bikorwa inzira yuzuye ya x402 ako kanya. Agent iyo ari yo yose wubaka ishobora guhamagara ubumenyi bwishyuwe kandi ikinjiza amafaranga mu kugaragaza ubumenyi bwayo — ibikorwa remezo bimwe na bimwe ORACLE na NOVA zikoresha.

features_ar.add_the_attribute_to_your_tag_the: Ongeraho ikiranga ar kuri tag yawe ya <agent-3d>. Akabuto ka AR kagaragara ubwako ku bikoresho bigendanwa bishyigikiwe. Nta kindi kikenewe.
features_ar.android_chrome_launches_google_s_scene_v: Android Chrome itangiza Scene Viewer ya Google binyuze muri ARCore. Dosye za GLB zipakira ako kanya — nta guhindura bikenewe. Amashusho yimuka arakina. Nta kiganiro.
features_ar.desktop_shows_a_qr_code_scan_it: Desktop yerekana kode ya QR. Yisikane na telefoni yawe maze uburambe bwa AR buhita bufunguka — nta ntambwe z'inyongera, nta porogaramu y'inyongera.

Nta porogaramu. Nta gukuramo.

features_ar.on_any_desktop_browser_the_ar_tab: Kuri buri mushakisha wa mudasobwa, tab ya AR yerekana QR code aho kuba buto yo gutangiza. Sikana ukoresheje telefoni yawe maze uburambe bwa AR bufunguke — modero irimo, nta gushakisha kwa kabiri gukenewe.
features_ar.open_any_avatar_or_forge_model_on: Fungura avatar iyo ari yo yose cyangwa modero ya Forge kuri three.ws, uhindure kuri tab ya AR, maze ukande 'Shyira mu mwanya wawe'.

features_ar.place_a_forged_3d_product_on_a: Shyira igicuruzwa cya 3D cyakozwe ku igorofa nyayo mbere yo kwiyemeza kugishyira mu bikorwa. Reba ubunini nyabwo n'imikorere mu mwanya wawe nyirizina.
features_ar.place_characters_props_and_scenes_in_rea: Shyira abantu, ibikoresho, n'amashusho mu bidukikije nyabyo mu gukora ibikubiyemo, kwamamaza, cyangwa uburambe bw'imikoranire.
features_ar.see_exactly_how_large_a_model_is: Reba neza ubunini bwa modero ku gipimo nyacyo cy'isi mbere yo kwiyemeza gucapa muri 3D, gukora igishushanyo mbonera, cyangwa gutangira umusaruro.
features_ar.tap_place_in_your_space_the_model: Kanda Shyira mu mwanya wawe. Modero igaragara yashinze imizi kuri ubwo buso ku gipimo nyacyo cy'isi. Yizenguruke. Koresha intoki ebyiri kugira ngo uhindure ubunini.
features_ar.the_camera_scans_for_flat_surfaces_floor: Kamera ishaka ubuso butambitse — hasi, ku meza, ku ntebe. Akamenyetso kagaragara iyo ubuso butambitse bubonetse kandi bwiteguye gushyirwaho.
features_ar.the_most_powerful_method_the_page_itself: Uburyo bukomeye cyane. Ikarita ubwayo ihinduka uburyo bwo kureba AR — umukozi aguma ari muzima rwose. Amashusho, ibiganiro by'ijwi, ubuhanga, n'ibikoresho byose bikora muri AR. Umukozi akurikirana kamera ya XR nk'umutwe wawe.
features_ar.three_ar_methods_one_button: Uburyo butatu bwa AR. Buto imwe.
features_ar.three_ws_selects_the_right_method_automa: three.ws ihitamo uburyo bukwiye ubwayo — wowe ntuhitamo na rimwe. Buri kimwe gifite ibyiza n'ibibi bitandukanye bitewe n'ibyo igikoresho n'umushakisha bishyigikira.
features_ar.your_ai_agent_with_its_3d_body: Umukozi wawe wa AI — ufite umubiri wa 3D n'imiterere izima — uhagaze mu cyumba kimwe nawe. Muganirize muri AR, ubone ibisubizo nyabyo.

features_deploy.because_the_identity_is_an_nft_it: Kubera ko indangamuntu ari NFT, ishobora kwimurwa cyangwa kugurishwa. Ufite NFT ni we ugenzura imyigaragambyo y'umukozi kuri blockchain kandi akusanya amafaranga y'ubuhanga bwayo.
features_deploy.click_deploy_the_ui_previews_the_transac: Kanda 'Kohereza'. UI yerekana mbere ibikorwa n'amakuru y'inyongera mbere yo gusinya. Metaplex Core ikora NFT kandi ikandika ibyerekeranye na ERC-8004 — izina, ubuhanga, URI ya avatar, endpoint — byose kuri blockchain.
features_deploy.every_agent_minted_through_three_ws_carr: Buri agenti wose wacurishijwe binyuze muri three.ws uba ufite ikimenyetso cya "3ws" cy'icuruzwa — ikimenyetso cyemeza inkomoko yacyo, kigihuza n'uru rubuga.
features_deploy.fill_in_your_agent_s_name_description: Shyira izina rya agenti yawe, ibisobanuro, tags z'ubuhanga, n'ishusho mu gice cya Deploy UI. Hujuriza GLB ya 3D ushaka ko icuruzwa kuri blockchain — yaba yaravuye muri Forge, yakanzwe, cyangwa yinjijwe.
features_deploy.from_agent_to_on_chain_identity: Kuva kuri agenti kugera ku ndangamuntu kuri blockchain
features_deploy.meta_description: Andika agenti yawe ya AI kuri Solana binyuze muri ERC-8004 na Metaplex Core. Curuza ishusho yayo ya 3D nka NFT kuri blockchain, fungira metadata, kandi uyigire ishobora kuboneka n'undi agenti uwo ari we wese — iteka ryose.
features_deploy.meta_og_description: Curuzuza agenti yawe kuri Solana. Indangamuntu kuri blockchain, ishobora kuboneka n'ubwo bwoko bwose bwa wallet cyangwa agenti.

features_deploy.on_chain_attestations_accumulate_on_the_: Ibyemezo bya blockchain bikusanyirizwa kuri NFT imwe — kwemeza ubuhanga, ubwinshi bw'ikoreshwa, n'ibimenyetso by'indangamuntu byemejwe bigira uruhare mu nyandiko ihoraho.
features_deploy.other_agents_resolve_your_identity_from_: Abandi bagenti bamenya indangamuntu yawe binyuze mu makuru ya blockchain kandi bakoresha ubuhanga bwawe nta kigo cyo hagati kibigenzura — itumanaho rya agenti-ku-agenti ridakeneye uruhushya kandi ridashobora guhagarikwa.
features_deploy.permanent_verifiable_discoverable_on_sol: Ihoraho, ishobora kwemezwa, ishobora kuboneka — kuri mainnet ya Solana mu gihe gito.
features_deploy.register_your_ai_agent_on_solana_via: Andika agenti yawe ya AI kuri Solana binyuze ku rwego rwa ERC-8004. Metaplex Core icuruza ishusho yayo ya 3D na metadata nka NFT kuri blockchain — ifunze, ishobora kwemezwa, kandi ishobora kuboneka n'ubwo bwoko bwose bwa wallet cyangwa undi agenti, iteka ryose.
features_deploy.your_agent_appears_instantly_in_the_erc: Agenti yawe ihita igaragara mu gitabo cya ERC-8004 kuri blockchain kuri /discover kandi ikabona endpoint ya /.well-known/agent-card.json. Undi agenti uwo ari we wese ashobora kuyibona no kuyihamagara akoresheje inyandiko ya blockchain.

features_forge.all_forge_generations_feed_the_three_ws: Ibikorwa byose bya forge bigaburira uruganda rw'imyitozo rwa three.ws — bigatuma ubuziranenge bwa model bwiyongera ku muremyi wese uko igihe gihita.
features_forge.attach_the_glb_to_any_ai_agent: Hujuriza GLB kuri agenti ya AI iyo ari yo yose kuri three.ws kugira ngo agenti ibone umubiri wa 3D wihariye aho kuba ishusho isanzwe.
features_forge.describe_what_you_want_a_ceramic_coffee: Sobanura icyo ushaka — "igikombe cya kawa cy'ibumba gifite ibara ry'ubururu," "inkota y'icyuma yaguyeho ingese," cyangwa ikindi cyose. Saba neza ibijyanye n'ibikoresho n'imiterere kugira ngo ubone ibyiza.
features_forge.each_generated_model_gets_a_permanent_ur: Buri model yaremwe ibona URL ihoraho ushobora gusangiza abandi — yifungura muri browser iyo ari yo yose nta plugins cyangwa apps zikenewe.
features_forge.every_generated_model_opens_in_webxr_ar: Buri model yaremwe yifungura muri WebXR AR mode ukoresheje gukanda rimwe — ishyire ku meza yawe nyayo cyangwa hasi maze uyizenguruke.
features_forge.flux_renders_a_detailed_texture_image_fr: Flux itanga ishusho irambuye ifite texture ikomoka ku nyandiko yawe. TRELLIS ihindura iyo shusho ikaba 3D mesh yuzuye ifite texture za UV-mapped, byose bikorwa mu buryo bumwe.
features_forge.forge_runs_flux_image_generation_and_tre: Forge ikoresha Flux mu kurema amashusho na TRELLIS mu kongera kubaka 3D bikurikirana. Sobanura ikintu icyo aricyo cyose maze ubonane GLB ifite texture ushobora kuzengurukisha muri AR, kuyishyira ahantu hose, cyangwa kuyihuza n'umukozi wawe wa AI.

feedback.meta_description: Ibyo abasura bavuze ku mufasha w'igice, byashyizwe mu murongo umwe ku kibazo, byakurikiranwe n'ubukana, kandi bifite inzira, kubaka, n'ibibazo by'ibikoresho byafashwe igihe byabaye.
feedback.what_visitors_told_the_corner_companion_: Ibyo abasura bavuze ku mufasha w'igice. Umurongo umwe ku kibazo cyihariye, ikirangantego cyose, buri kimwe gifite inzira, kubaka byabayeho, n'ibibazo by'ibikoresho umubare w'ibikoresho byafashwe icyo gihe. Aho ikiganiro cyanditswe, raporo ikusanyirizwa mu igerageza rya Playwright riba ritsindwa kugeza ikibazo gikemuwe. Nta kintu hano gihindura igicuruzwa ku giti cyacyo: ni urutonde umuntu asoma kandi akagira icyo akora.

fees.fees_are_the_total_amount_users_pay: Amafaranga y'imirimo ni amafaranga yose abakoresha bishyura kugira ngo bakoreshe porotokole. Inyungu ni igice porotokole ubwayo igumana nyuma yo kwishyura abatanga ibicuruzwa n'abatanga ubwishyu.

fits.empty_body: Nta fit z'ubukire zigurishijwe kugeza ubu. Gura imwe muri Play kandi uzaba uri ku isonga ry'ikibaho cy'ubukire mu gihe umuhanzi w'isi y'igiceri abona igice cye, cyangwa ukore igice gishya muri Wardrobe.
fits.fineprint: Buri mubare hano usomwa mu rutonde rw'ibicuruzwa byemejwe, ntibikozwe mu buryo bw'ibipimo: umurongo ubaho gusa nyuma y'uko USDC kwishyurwa byemejwe. "Umubare w'ibicuruzwa byrecent" ushyira hamwe igihe cy'ibicuruzwa iki kibaho gitanga, si igihe cyose. Amafaranga y'abahanzi ajya ku banki yemejwe hashingiwe ku byanditswe by'itangiriro ry'igiceri, bityo uburyo bwo kugabanya ntibushobora guhindura andi mafaranga y'igiceri. Reba ikibaho cy'ibyangombwa ku ruhande rw'umuguzi rw'urubuga.
fits.lookup_p: Shyiramo aderesi y'ibikoresho by'umuhanzi Solana kugirango ubone amafaranga y'ibikoresho byemejwe: amafaranga y'igihe cyose na 30, yishyuwe ugereranije n'ayari mu gihe, n'ibisobanuro ku bikoresho n'isi y'igiceri. Amakuru rusange, nta konti ikenewe.
fits.meta_desc: Ubukungu bw'ibikoresho by'ubukire: ibikoresho by'ubukire bihenze cyane bateguwe hakurikijwe uburenganzira bw'ibikoresho, abakusanya beza babikora, abahanzi babona amafaranga mu USDC, n'ibicuruzwa byose byemejwe uko bigenda. Reba amafaranga y'ibikoresho by'umuhanzi, ubuntu kandi nta konti ikenewe.
fits.og_desc: Ibikoresho bihenze cyane, abakusanya beza, amafaranga y'abahanzi mu buryo bw'ukuri USDC, n'ikigega cy'ibicuruzwa byose byemejwe. Buri mubare usomwa mu rutonde rw'ibicuruzwa byemejwe.
fits.rarest_note: Bateguwe hakurikijwe uko amabanki make abifite
fits.sub: Ibikoresho by'ubukire bigurwa mu buryo bw'ukuri USDC, kandi buri igurishwa igabanya amafaranga n'umuhanzi w'isi y'igiceri fit ibarizwamo. Iyi ni iyo rutonde: ibikoresho bihenze cyane, abakusanya babikora, abahanzi babona amafaranga, n'ibicuruzwa byose uko bigenda. Bwear mu Play; kora ibyawe mu Wardrobe.

fits.twitter_desc: Ibikoresho bihenze cyane, abakusanya beza, n'amafaranga y'abahanzi yemejwe mu buryo bw'ukuri USDC, biva mu rutonde rw'ibikoresho.

forge.model_failed_to_load_often_a_brief: Model yananiwe gupakira — akenshi biterwa n'ikibazo gito cya internet ku dosiye. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa ukoreshe akabuto ko gukuramo kari hepfo kugira ngo uyibike ako kanya.
forge.multi_engine_pipeline_engines_marked_fre: Uburyo bwa pipeline ikoresha moteri nyinshi. Moteri zanditseho UBUNTU zikora nta funguro: Kurema kwakiriwe na NVIDIA hamwe n'abakozi bacu ba GPU twishyizemo (TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D, TripoSG). Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Stability, na Replicate bikora ku funguro rya API ryawe bwite. Ibisubizo byiza: ikintu kimwe cyasobanuwe neza gifite ibikoresho n'umurongo w'urumuri. Uburyo bw'amafoto bwakira amashusho agera kuri 6 kugira ngo hongere huremwe amashusho menshi. Ubu buryo bwa pipeline buraboneka ku bagize MCP kuri /api/mcp-3d.
forge.no_3d_engine_is_reachable_on_this: Nta moteri ya 3D ishobora kugerwaho kuri iyi deployment. Shyiraho kimwe muri NVIDIA_API_KEY cyangwa HF_TOKEN ku nzira z'ubuntu, cyangwa REPLICATE_API_TOKEN kuri pipeline ya flux → TRELLIS — Forge ikoresha icyo cyashyizweho nta mpinduka zindi.
forge.one_click_geometric_filters_restyle_this: Ibyungurura bya geometrike bikorwa rimwe gusa. Hindura imiterere ya iyi model ikaba voxels, amatafari, urushundura rweruye, cyangwa low-poly — ibara ry'umwimerere rihererekanywa aho uburyo bubyemera.

forge_nim.one_clear_subject_plain_background_the_s: Ikintu kimwe gisobanutse, inyuma yoroshye. NIM yicumbikiye yongera kubaka GLB ifite imiterere mu ntambwe imwe — hanyuma uyizengurutse, uyirebe muri AR, cyangwa uyikure hano.
forge_nim.subtitle: Tanga ifoto, ohereza rimwe kuri /v1/infer, hanyuma GLB ifite texture igaruke ako kanya nk’inyandiko ya base64: irerekanwa hano, ishobora gukurwaho, yiteguye AR. Nta gusubiramo, nta kubika by’igihe kirekire.
forge_nim.unconfigured_body: Uru rupapuro ruyobora TRELLIS NIM wiyobora, kandi nta endpoint ihujwe n’iyi deployment. Shyira URL nyamukuru ya konte yawe ya nvcr.io/nim/microsoft/trellis hano kugirango wongere uyubake, cyangwa shyiraho NIM_TRELLIS_URL kuri deployment kugirango ihuzwe na bose.

forge_studio.model_failed_to_load_often_a_brief: Ikigereranyo cyarananiranye kuregerwa — akenshi biterwa n'ikibazo gito cya interineti kuri dosiye. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa ukoreshe akabuto ko gukuramo kari hepfo kugira ngo ukibike ako kanya.
forge_studio.multi_engine_pipeline_free_uses_nvidia_h: Pipeline ikoresha moteri nyinshi — Ubuntu ikoresha ibyaremwe na NVIDIA; Fast, Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Stability, na Replicate bisaba API key. Ibyiza byavuyemo: ikintu kimwe gisobanuwe neza gifite ibikoresho n'urumuri. Uburyo bw'amafoto bwemera kureba inshuro 4 kugira ngo hongere hubakwe ibintu bitandukanye. Iyo pipeline imwe iraboneka ku bagenzuzi binyuze kuri MCP kuri /api/mcp-3d.
forge_studio.no_3d_engine_is_reachable_on_this: Nta moteri ya 3D ishobora kugerwaho kuri iyi deployment. Shyiraho imwe muri NVIDIA_API_KEY cyangwa HF_TOKEN ku nzira z'ubuntu, cyangwa REPLICATE_API_TOKEN kuri pipeline ya flux → TRELLIS — Forge ifata icyashyizweho nta mpinduka zindi.
forge_studio.one_click_geometric_filters_restyle_this: Ibyungurura bya geometrike bikorwa rimwe gusa. Hindura imiterere y'aka kantu ukagira voxels, amatafari, urushundura rufunguye, cyangwa low-poly — ibara ry'umwimerere rihererekanywa aho uburyo bubyemera.
forge_studio.only_avatars_creatures_can_be_given_a: Avatars n'ibiremwa gusa ni byo bishobora guhabwa ubwonko bikaba agents — ibindi byose bibikwa nk'ikintu cya 3D.

forge_studio.open_this_model_in_scene_com_title: Fungura aka kantu muri Scene Composer kugira ngo ugashyire kuri avatar cyangwa ukashyire muri scene.
forge_studio.optional_guidance_for_reconstruction: Amabwiriza atari ngombwa yo kongera kubaka.
forge_studio.re_run_this_exact_prompt_at_title: Ongera ukoreshe iyi prompt nyine ku rwego rw'ubuziranenge rwo hejuru.
forge_studio.refine_current_model_instead: Ahubwo, ongera utunganye aka kantu kariho.
forge_studio.retopologize_to_a_poly_budge_title: Retopologize kugira ngo uhuze na poly budget kandi ubikuremo GLB + FBX yiteguye gukoreshwa na engine.

forge_studio.text_3d_two_ways_forge_a_textured: Inyandiko → 3D, mu buryo bubiri. Forge ikintu gifite texture, cyangwa usobanure umuntu hanyuma ubone avatar ifite rigging.
forge_studio.type_what_you_want_a_character_a: Andika icyo ushaka — umuntu, ikiremwa, uburyo. Dutegura ishingiro risukuye, tukongera tukarikora muri 3D, kandi tukongeraho igikanka kugira ngo gishobore kugenda.
forge_studio.view_this_model_in_ar_place_title: Reba aka kantu muri AR — kagashyire mu cyumba cyawe.

forged.every_asset_here_was_purchased_by_one: Buri kintu kiri hano cyaguzwe na imwe muri agents zigenga za platform ikoresheje USDC nyayo binyuze kuri protocol yo kwishyura ya x402: agent yishyuye Forge, Forge yaremye icyo kintu, kandi kwishyurana byarangiriye kuri Solana. Nta gutoranya, nta mocks: iyi ni ubukungu bwa agent bwubaka library rusange y'ibintu, buri kintu cyishyuwe kikaba kimwe mu byakozwe.

gestures.apply_signin: Injira kugirango ubike ibi ku agent
gestures.atlas_desc: Buri clip iri mu makuru, ifashwe ku keyframes yayo kandi igashyirwa ku murongo hashingiwe ku buryo ikora n'uburemere bw'iyo mbaraga hejuru y'igice cy'umubiri. Imyitwarire yoroheje y'igice cy'umubiri ikusanywa mu gice cyo hejuru ibumoso; imbyino zose zifite imbaraga n'ibikorwa byihuta biri mu gice cyo hasi iburyo. Ibara ni agace kayobora imigendekere. Kanda ahantu na hamwe kugirango uyikine, cyangwa uyigerageze mu mwanya wahisemo.
gestures.cta_sonar: Kina ibi mu ntoki, nta kamera
gestures.footnote: Slots, hints na clips bifatanye mu buryo bw'imashini: tests/animation-slots.test.js isuzuma buri hint yanditswe munsi ya src/ kandi igahagarika kubaka niba imwe igaragara ku mwanya cyangwa ku clip itari mu public/animations/manifest.json. Icyerekezo cyuzuye cy'abakora porogaramu ni docs/animations, kandi inzira ni Animate your agent.
gestures.hero_lede: Agent ntikora ku mafaili y'ibikorwa. Iha izina slot, kandi urubuga rugakemura uwo mwanya mu clip nyakuri. Ubumenyi buha izina umwanya mu buryo butaziguye, binyuze mu hint. Uru rupapuro ni ururimi rwose: icyo buri mwanya ukina, ubumenyi buhita butangira, n'uburyo bwo gushyira umwanya ku clip iyo ari yo yose mu makuru.
gestures.hints_desc: Ubumenyi buhamagara hint igihe butangiye. Hint ikemura mu mwanya, umwanya ukemura mu clip, kandi avatar ikayikina. Buri murongo munsi y'iyi ni wo waturutse ku bisobanuro by'ubumenyi byoherejwe.
gestures.layers_desc: Imashini y'ibikorwa by'ugukora igumana urutonde rwa kabiri, rwiyemeje rw'imyitwarire hamwe n'igice kuri buri myitwarire: imyitwarire y'igice cyo hejuru ikora ku ngendo, bityo avatar ikaba ishobora gukina cyangwa kugorora mu gihe ikomeza kugenda; imyitwarire yose ifata umubiri wose kandi ikabuza imigendekere kugeza irangiye.
gestures.meta_desc: Buri myitwarire agent three.wsishobora gukina: ururimi rw'ibice, clip buri mwanya ukemura, ubumenyi butangira, n'ububiko bwo guhindura umwanya uwo ari wo wose ku agent yawe.
gestures.og_desc: Ururimi rw'imyitwarire y'agent: slots 19, clip buri ikina, ubumenyi butangira, n'ububiko bwo guhindura mu gihe nyacyo.
gestures.override_lede: Shyira slot ku clip iyo ari yo yose mu makuru, hanyuma ubike byihuse ku agent ufite.
gestures.sig_title: Icyo iyi clip ikora mu by'ukuri
gestures.similar_lede: Clips hafi mu mwanya w'ibikorwa byapimye, ntabwo ku izina.
gestures.slots_desc: Amazina akomeye agent ishobora guhindura. Umwanya udafite guhindura ukemura ku clip yerekanywe ku ikarita yayo.
gestures.stage_empty_body: Hitamo umwanya uwo ari wo wose kugirango uyikine ku avatar iriho. Nta 3D izakora kugeza ubwo ubikoze.

gestures.stage_error_title: Iyi clip ntiyahuye na avatar yo kwerekana.
gestures.tw_desc: Imyanya 19 y'ibimenyetso, yerekanywe mu gihe nyacyo, hamwe n'ubuhanga butera buri kimwe.

globe.about_p1: Imirongo 11 y'amakuru afunguye ku isi imwe, ikomeza kuvugururwa. Intambara, imiterere y'ingabo n'ibihano byanditswe mu isoko y'ibikorwa bya GDELT hakoreshejwe kode ya CAMEO kandi bigakomeza mu gihe gito ku three.ws, bityo kugenzura igihe ni ukuri aho kuba gusa isura. Ibikorwa karemano bituruka ku isoko y'ibikorwa by'ibiza ya USGS na NASA EONET, ibihe bibi bituruka ku GDACS, igihombo cy'itumanaho gitangwa na porogaramu ya IODA ya Georgia Tech, n'ihungabana ry'ubukungu bitangwa n'ibipimo by'Ikigega Mpuzamahanga. Ibigo by'ingabo, ahantu h'ibinyabutabire n'ahantu h'ibihombo by'inyanja ni ibipimo by'ubutaka, kandi urwego rw'ibihombo rwiyipima ku isoko ririho aho kuba ruhagaze.
globe.about_p2: Buri murongo uvuga igihe nyacyo waciyemo kandi buri gice gihuza n'ahantu hacyo. Nta byangombwa bisabwa kugira ngo usome ibyo byose. Icyo gikorwa cyose ni guhamagara rimwe: /api/globe/intel, byanditswe mu inyandiko y'isi.
globe.canvas_aria: Isi ya 3D ikora y'ibikorwa by'isi mu gihe nyacyo
globe.hint: Kurambura kugira ngo usubire inyuma, kanda kugira ngo ugaragaze, kanda ku gice icyo ari cyo cyose kugira ngo ugisome. Kanda <kbd>F</kbd> kugira ngo ugabanye, <kbd>Space</kbd> kugira ngo uhagarike guhindagurika.
globe.meta_desc: Isi ya 3D ikora y'ibiri kuba ku Isi ubu: intambara, imiterere y'ingabo, ibihano, ibikorwa karemano, ibihe bibi, ibihombo by'itumanaho n'ihungabana ry'ubukungu, byakwirakwijwe ku bigo by'ingabo, ahantu h'ibinyabutabire n'ahantu h'ibihombo by'inyanja.
globe.share_aria: Kopi link kuri iyi view nyayo
globe.share_desc: Imirongo 11 ikora ku isi imwe ya 3D: intambara, imiterere y'ingabo, ibihano, ibikorwa karemano, ibihe, ibihombo, ihungabana ry'ubukungu, ibigo, ahantu h'ibinyabutabire n'ibihombo.

guards.hero_p: Iyi codebase ntifite CI. Icyo iyikingira ni seti y'ibipimo bito, byihuta byinjijwe mu nzira nta muntu ushobora kwirengagiza: prebuild, umuryango, deploy build, na git pre-push hook. Buri mutekano uri hasi hano ubaho kuko ikintu kimwe cyaracitse. Soma inyandiko yose cyangwa inyigisho yo kuyandika.
guards.meta_desc: Buri mutekano w'imashini ukingira three.ws codebase, n'icyiciro buri umwe ukoreramo. Iyi repository ntifite CI, bityo ukuri gukurikizwa n'ibipimo byihuta byinjijwe mu prebuild, umuryango, deploy build, na git pre-push hook.
guards.more_p: Umutekano utinjijwe mu nzira idashobora kwirengagizwa ntukingira na kimwe, kandi umutekano nta muntu wigeze awuhamya ntukingira na kimwe. Andika umupima, uhe umwandiko wa npm, uwandike muri data/guards.json hamwe n'ikosa ugomba kwanga, kandi uhuze mu cyiciro. npm run audit:guards ikubwira niba urutonde n'imirongo bitumvikana; npm run prove:guards ikora buri mutekano ku ikosa ryavuzwe kandi ikakubwira niba ukiri gukora.
guards.og_desc: Nta CI, ku mpamvu. Buri gipimo gikingira iyi codebase, icyo gikingira, n'icyiciro gikoreramo.

holo.hero_sub: Ikimenyetso cya holographic foil, cyerekana mu gihe nyacyo. Umurongo wo gukata, foil iridescent, umucyo uyisubiza, n'igice cy'ikibuno byose biteranywa mu browser yawe: nta mashusho, nta mafaili y'ibimenyetso. Komeza uyihindure uko wakwihindura ikintu nyacyo, cyangwa andika ubutumwa bwawe kandi ubukate mu kimenyetso cyacyo.
holo.how_body: Ikimenyetso cyakoreshejwe, cyakwirakwijwe, cyakwirakwijwe n'ikibaho uko umukata yongeramo umupaka, kandi cyakurikiranwe mu mirongo ya vektori hamwe n'ibisate, ibinogo birimo. Foil ni ibikoresho bifatika bifite iridescence y'igice gito, kandi igice cyo gukuramo ni igice cy'ikibaho cy'ibice, bityo umucyo ku gice cy'ikibuno ni nyacyo.
holo.meta_desc: Ikimenyetso cya holographic foil mu gihe nyacyo cyerekana mu browser yawe. Komeza uyihindure uko wakwihindura, kuramo igice, hindura foils, kata ubutumwa ubwo ari bwo bwose mu kimenyetso, kandi download frame nka PNG. Byose ni ibikurikira, nta mutungo.

home.your_agent_remembers_every_visitor_acros: Agent yawe yibuka buri musura ku bikoresho bitandukanye no mu bihe bitandukanye. Ihuze n'aho ubika amakuru yawe bwite cyangwa ukoreshe ububiko bwa vector bwayo.

home_connect.auth_failed_body: Tokens ni imwe buri murongo kandi byoroshye gukuramo ku kopesha. Reba imwe nshya mu {{path}}, kandi shiraho urutonde rwose.
home_connect.bad_url_body: Koresha URL yose ya https ya Home Assistant yawe.
home_connect.cancelled_body: Nta nzu yashyizwe hamwe nta token yabaye. Gerageza none igihe ushobora.
home_connect.card_sub: Buri kintu gikora ku gice cyawe bwite. Ibyo tubika, n’ibyo tutabika, birasobanurwa hasi mbere yo kwihuza.
home_connect.disconnected_body: Ikarita y’uruhushya twari dufite yarasibwe. Siba kandi ikarita muri Home Assistant niba ushaka ko ivaho ku mpande zombi, kuri {{path}}.
home_connect.insecure_body: Iyi modoka isohoka ku https, kandi browser ntizakoresha ubuhamya butandukanye bw'icyuma. Koresha adiresi ya https ya inzu yawe.
home_connect.insecure_short: Adiresi ya http ntiyashoboka kubonekera kuri iyi modoka.
home_connect.label_hint: Ibyerekeye mu agent na mu log y'ibikorwa. "Inzu", "Ibiro", cyangwa icyo cyawe.
home_connect.landed_anyway_body: Wahagaritse igihe kiri kirekura, ariko inzu yawe yari yarishyushye, kuko yashyizwe hamwe. Yandike hasi igihe ntibyo wabaye.
home_connect.need_url_body: Ni URL ya https ukoresha kugera mu nzu yawe hanze.
home_connect.need_url_title: Ongera adiresi ya Home Assistant yawe.
home_connect.not_yours_body_none: Ibyo byashobora kuba byasenyutse, cyangwa ubuzima bushobora kuba bwa konti yindi. Ntibyo ufite amazu yashyizweho gushika ubu.
home_connect.not_yours_body_some: Ibyo byashobora kuba byasenyutse, cyangwa ubuzima bushobora kuba bwa konti yindi. Amazu yawe yose ari hasi.
home_connect.not_yours_title: Ayo mazu ntawo ari ku konti yuwe
home_connect.private_host_action: Shyiraho umuzo wabaye gusa ku mbuga hwaniro yanje
home_connect.private_host_body: three.ws gukora ku buzima bw'ibanze, kuko ntibishobora kugera kuri adirese igomba kuba gusa mu nzu yawe. Hari buryo mbiri by'ukuri byo kugaragaza.
home_connect.private_host_bullet_1: Shyiraho adirese yawe ya https y'iburyo bwo gushyiraho. Home Assistant Cloud ikupa, n'umuhanga wawe w'ikibazo cy'iburyo bwo gushyiraho. Ibyo bigenda ubu, n'igitangaza cyo ufite gushika ubu.
home_connect.private_host_bullet_2: Cyangwa ube uwo mu nzu yanyuma agera kuri three.ws ahandi, n'ikibanza cyo hasi. Integirasi nke cyane mu Home Assistant, nta poti yashyizweho, nta token ya Home Assistant ibikijwe hano.
home_connect.private_host_short: {{host}} ari gusa ku mbuga hwaniro yawe.
home_connect.private_host_title: {{host}} ni adirese ku mbuga hwaniro yawe.
home_connect.quota_bullet_1: Senyura umuzo utagira ubuzima uwo ugomba kugira ngo uwo ubuzima ugira ubuzima.
home_connect.quota_bullet_2: Cyangwa kugera ku gahunda agira amazu menshi.
home_connect.quota_title: Iyi konti yafashije ibice byayo by'amazu
home_connect.quota_title_unknown: Igihunda cyawe kigize ibice byayo by'amazu.
home_connect.signed_out_point_1: Umwuga wawe ugasoma ibyumba byose, amasoko, ibirwanisho n'ibisobanuro byose igice cyawe gishyiraho.
home_connect.signed_out_point_2: Ugira icyo washinze n'ibikorwa wabakoze, zita.
home_connect.signed_out_point_3: Gukomeza, kufunga n'igikorwa kidasanzwe ntakibazo. Gukomeza, kugira n'igikorwa kidasanzwe bigomba.
home_connect.signed_out_sub: Amazu yawe araronderwa na konti yawe ya three.ws, kuko igitangaza gishyiraho inzu yawe gikijwe mu buryo bw'ibanga kandi ntikibaho mu browser.
home_connect.step_mcp: Gukurikirana seva ya Model Context Protocol
home_connect.token_help_note: Token ikijwe imbere y'uko ibikijwe kandi ntakibazo gitangwa inyuma kuri iyi peji. Guciba mu Home Assistant gikomeza ubuzima bwawe gusa, icyo dufite.
home_connect.token_hint: Yatangajwe kuri three.ws rimwe, ikijwe mu buryo bw'ibanga, ntakibazo gitangwa inyuma kuri iyi peji cyangwa ibikijwe mu browser.
home_connect.token_step_1: Fungura Home Assistant yawe kanda izina ryawe hejuru y'ibara ry'iburyo.
home_connect.token_step_3: Sukura kuri Long-lived access tokens kandi utegereze Create token.
home_connect.token_step_4: Ibizwa "three.ws" kandi ukopera token. Home Assistant irishyura rimwe.
home_connect.unreachable_bullet_1: Niba adirese ni yo, kuraba niba inzu iri hano kandi ishobora kugerwa kuva hanze ya mbuga hwaniro yawe.
home_connect.unreachable_bullet_2: Niba ishobora kugerwa gusa mu nzu, three.ws ntishobora kuyigerera. Add-on igira ubuzima bw'ibanze kuva mu mbuga hwaniro yawe ni inzira yo.
home_connect.url_hint: URL ya https ushobora kuyishyira kuva hanze y'inzu: Home Assistant Cloud, cyangwa umuhanga wawe w'ikibazo cy'iburyo bwo gushyiraho.
home_connect.verifying_sub: Ibyo bigenda ku gice cyawe gusa. Bigomba amafaranga abiri cyangwa gatatu.

home_floorplan.canvas_aria: Ikarita y’inzu. Imbeba y’inyuguti yimura icyumba cyatoranijwe, plus na minus bigabanya cyangwa byongera ubunini bwacyo.
home_floorplan.conflict_body: Babikijije igice {{version}} aho wari ukora. Nta kintu kica: hitamo icyo ukeneye kugira.
home_floorplan.empty_body: Ibigo byawe bya 3D birikoresha urwego rw'ibanze. Andika igisagara munsi ya kugira ngo ubanze ibyo byose.
home_floorplan.filed_body: Byanditswe mu Home Assistant yawe, kandi byabonetse mu dashboards na voice assistant yawe.
home_floorplan.first_room_body: Nta kintu mu nzu iyi kiri mu nzu. Banza uyo wa mbere kandi igahunda iratangira hano.
home_floorplan.name_required: Andika izina ry'inzu, nk'iyo mu cucine.
home_floorplan.no_areas_body: Home Assistant nta mazi yahawe iyo nyumba. Banza inzo munsi, kandi sogera ibikorwa byawe mu nzu: byo ni byandikwa mu Home Assistant yawe, si hano gusa.
home_floorplan.no_areas_title: Nta kintu kidosiyemwo mu nzu gushika ubu
home_floorplan.readonly: Ushobora kubona uru rwego rw'ibanze. Gukoranya birikeneye umukuru w'icyo gikorwa cyangwa admin.
home_floorplan.reset_body: Inzu zikurikira urwego rw'ibanze ku nzu yose gushika ubanze urwego rw'ibanze rwongere.
home_floorplan.room_aria_orphan: {{room}}, {{w}} na {{d}} metero, ntikiri mu nzu iyi
home_floorplan.room_made_body: Yakozwe mu Home Assistant yawe, kandi ushobora gudosiyera ibikorwa mu nzu hano kandi ukoresha iryo hano.
home_floorplan.room_made_title: {{room}} ni inzu mu nzu yawe ubu
home_floorplan.saved_body: Ibigo byawe bya 3D birakurikira uru rwego ubu.
home_floorplan.took_theirs_body: Ibyo wakoze ntabibitswe. Banza ongera ukabika ongera ukibaza.
home_floorplan.tray_empty: Inzu zose mu nzu iyi ziri ku rwego rw'ibanze.
home_floorplan.tray_hint: Sogera kimwe ku nzu. Gikora gidosiyera mu Home Assistant yawe, kandi gishobora kuboneka mu dashboards na voice assistant yawe.
home_floorplan.tray_hint_readonly: Gudosiyera igikorwa mu nzu bikeneye umukuru w'icyo gikorwa cyangwa admin.
home_floorplan.unreadable_body: {{reason}} Ibigo bya 3D birikoresha mwanya wabo w'ibanze. Gukora no gubika bigasubiza igahunda yabitswe.

home_join.lede: Hari umuntu waguhawe uburenganzira bwo kwinjira mu nzu yahujwe na three.ws. Mbere yo kwemera, uru rupapuro rurakubwira inzu ari yo, ibyo ushobora gukora, n’ibyo utazashobora gukora. Uru rukurikirane rukora rimwe gusa.
home_join.meta_description: Emeza ubutumire bwo kwinjira mu nzu y’umuntu yahujwe. Uru rukurikirane rurakubwira inzu ari yo n’ibyo ushobora gukora mbere yo kwinjira, kandi rukora rimwe gusa.
home_join.meta_og_description: Ubutumire bwo kwinjira mu rugo: inzu ari yo, ibyo ushobora gukora, n’ibyo utazashobora gukora.
home_join.meta_title: Injira mu nzu · Emeza ubutumire bwo mu rugo · three.ws
home_join.meta_twitter_description: Ubutumire bwo kwinjira mu rugo: inzu ari yo, ibyo ushobora gukora, n’ibyo utazashobora gukora.
home_join.noscript_body: Kwemera ubutumire bisoma konti yawe, rero uru rupapuro rukenera JavaScript. Ubutumire ubwabwo ntibuhindutse kandi buracyakora: shyira JavaScript ku murongo hanyuma usubiremo ifunguro.
home_join.title: Watumwe mu rugo

home_manage.disconnect_body_1: Icyo token twifite gishusho gishyushwa noneha kandi umuhanga wawe ugaruka atagira ubuhisho bwose kuri iyo nzu. Ibishingwe byawe byose n'urugendo rw'ibyakozwe birasigaye kugira ngo ushobore gusoma ibyagenze.
home_manage.disconnect_body_2: Ibi bitasiba token mu Home Assistant. Usibe hano kandi ukibaza ukibaza kugira ngo kibe wose ku bice bye.
home_manage.grants_empty_body: Burunduke, burwo kuryohereza n'ubwo kwica ibikomere byose biramira n'ibibaza. Ukiraba umwe, ubuhura hano kandi ufite gukirungikira.
home_manage.grants_summary: Iyo umuco wanyu ashobora gukuraho nta kibazo cyaba.
home_manage.health_failed_body: Ongera ufungure urupapuro kugira ngo ugerageze noneho.
home_manage.health_failed_title: Ntibyagenze kureba iki gituma bitari byo.
home_manage.health_summary: Kwiboneka, icyo umuco wanyu yakoze hano, n'iki gishobora kuba gikenewe n'abo.
home_manage.log_empty_body: Umuco wanyu ugihe wagize umuriro uva canke agasigaye akavuga nta yo kwiruka umuryango, ubuhura hano n'iki cyabaye.
home_manage.log_end: Iyo ni byose byahise twiteze kuri uyu muzu.
home_manage.log_summary: Byose umuco wanyu yakoze, n'ibyo yagize nta yo.
home_manage.mcp_off_body: Ongera Model Context Protocol Server integration mu Home Assistant, kuri Settings, Devices and services, kugira ngo umuco wanyu ufite ibikoresho byo gushaka ubyakoze. Byose birakora neza nta kintu gikeneye.
home_manage.mcp_off_title: Ibiranga: fungura Model Context Protocol server.
home_manage.mcp_on_body: Umuco wanyu ushobora gukoresha ibikoresho byo gushaka wabonye mu Home Assistant, n'ibyemezo byawe byo kubona.
home_manage.mcp_on_title: Model Context Protocol server yashyizwe hamwe ({{tools}} ibikoresho).
home_manage.only_this_house: Inzu zose zishyizwe hamwe zishura neza, kandi uyu muzu umeze nk'umwawe wese ahari ico twiteze.
home_manage.panel_failed_body: Gerageza kugifungura noneho mu gihe kirekire.
home_manage.platform_body: three.ws ufite ikibazo cyo kugera mu nzu zishyizwe hamwe ubu. Nta kintu mu nzu yanyu gikeneye gusubira inyuma n'access token yawe iri neza. Turi kumwe n'iyo, n'urugo rwawe ruzasubira inyuma rwenyine.
home_manage.platform_title: Iyo ni ibyo twiteze, si urugo rwawe.
home_manage.retries_paused: three.ws yahagaritse ibyo yagerageza iminota yagiye kandi izagerageza noneho rwenyine.
home_manage.status_auth: Home Assistant yarushije token yashyizwe. Shyira hamwe noneho n'ishya.
home_manage.status_down_never: Ntibishura ubu. Icyo twabonye kigize kiri hasi.
home_manage.status_down_seen: Ntibishura ubu. Byashyushye {{ago}}, n'ico ni cyo twabonye kiri hasi.
home_manage.sub: Umuco wanyu ashobora gusoma byose hano. Nta kintu gikurikira, gikurikira canke gishyiraho ibikomere gishobora gukomeza nta kibazo, ntibyo wabaye wabaye byemeje hasi.

home_plan.lede: Icyo gahunda yawe ikubiyemo, ibyo ukoresha, n’igihe isubiraho. Buri rugero ruri hano niba uri hafi yarwo cyangwa utari hafi, kuko urugero ugeraho gusa igihe rukubuza gukora ni urugero nta wigeze akwereka. Gufunga umuryango, gufunga garage cyangwa valve no gushyira alarme ntibihagarikwa n’urugero, ku buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose bwa gahunda.
home_plan.meta_description: Icyo gahunda yawe ya three.ws ikubiyemo ku mazu ahujwe: amazu, imyanya y’abatuye, ecran ziriho, iminota y’amajwi n’ibihe by’abakozi, hamwe n’ibyo wakoresheje n’igihe isubiraho. Gufunga, gufunga garage no gushyira alarme ntibihagarikwa na gahunda.
home_plan.meta_og_description: Icyo gahunda yawe ikubiyemo ku mazu ahujwe, ibyo wakoresheje, n’igihe isubiraho. Ibikorwa by’umutekano ntibihagarikwa na gahunda.
home_plan.meta_title: Gahunda y’urugo · Ibyo amazu yawe akoresha n’igihe isubiraho · three.ws
home_plan.meta_twitter_description: Icyo gahunda yawe ikubiyemo ku mazu ahujwe, ibyo wakoresheje, n’igihe isubiraho. Ibikorwa by’umutekano ntibihagarikwa na gahunda.
home_plan.noscript_body: Uru rupapuro rusoma uko ukoresha ubu uhereye kuri konti yawe, bityo rukenera JavaScript. Imipaka yawe n’amazu yawe ntibihinduka, kandi buri gikorwa cy’umutekano kirakora: gahunda ntiziguhagarika gufunga.
home_plan.title: Urwego rw'uwa

home_satellite.lede: Home Assistant yoranya ibikomeye: ijambo ry'ibyaza, ububazi bw'ikico, intungo, ijibuza, n'ibikoresho bimwe mu nyumba. Icyo ntisyigikira ni umubiri. Hunika satellite three.ws n'icyo pipeline uko ushaka kikoresha, bikajya umubiri, lip-synced ku igikocho cyayo, kuri satiri yoroshye mu nyumba. Fukisha aya page n'umusindi wawe uko yari atangira.
home_satellite.meta_description: Reka uhindure pipeline y'igikocho ya Home Assistant ku three.ws agent, bikajya ishusho, expression, lip sync n'umubiri. Home Assistant yoranya ijambo ry'ibyaza, ububazi bw'ikico n'ijibuza; three.ws ni ishusho.
home_satellite.meta_og_description: Umusindi wa Home Assistant w'igikocho ni umwanditsi n'iringanwa ya LED. Wanige ishusho, lip sync n'umuburi uri kugera ku wawe.
home_satellite.meta_title: Satellite y'igikocho · Wanige umusindi wa Home Assistant ishusho · three.ws
home_satellite.meta_twitter_description: Umusindi wa Home Assistant w'igikocho ni umwanditsi n'iringanwa ya LED. Wanige ishusho, lip sync n'umuburi uri kugera ku wawe.
home_satellite.noscript_body: Aya page ifunganya umsession y'igikocho kirenze kandi ikagufasha avatar ya 3D, kandi ikakenerewe JavaScript. Satellite yange iyo ntisyigikira: ikora mu buryo bwa Home Assistant kuri network yako, iyo kaba ikora cyangwa se ntibikora.
home_satellite.noscript_guide: Raba urugero rw'installation mu magambo menshi.
home_satellite.title: Umusindi wawe w'igikocho uko ari uko. Wanige ishusho.

home_scene.empty_body: Home Assistant yishuye, ariko nta bikoresho byo byabaye. Ongeza integration mu Home Assistant (Settings, Devices and services), kandi iyi scene izakwibuka vuba nk'uko gikoresho cyambere gihereye. Nta kindi gukora hano.

home_scene.err_auth_title: Injira kugira ngo ubone inzu iyi

hood_desk.every_number_on_this_desk_is_read: Umubare wese uri kuri iki meza usomwa mu buryo buhoraho kuva kuri Robinhood Chain (4663): ibibanza n'amateka kuva kuri RPC ya chain na Blockscout indexer, Stock Token NAV kuva ku byinjijwe na Chainlink ku murandasi, ibiciro by'ifaranga kuva mu gishoro kinini cya Uniswap. Stock Tokens ni ibikoresho by'ubukode byatanzwe na Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Ltd kandi ntibishobora gutangwa, kugurishwa, cyangwa gutangwa ku bantu bo muri Amerika; ameza agaragaza ibyo kandi ntigahindura itegeko mu kintu na kimwe. Nta kintu hano ari inama y'ishoramari.
hood_desk.meta_description: Ameza y'ubucuruzi buhoraho ku murandasi ya Robinhood Chain (4663): agaciro k'igitabo, amateka y'ibibanza, urutonde rw'ibikorwa ku murandasi, imyanya igenerwa ku giciro cya Chainlink NAV na Uniswap, urwego rwa NAV, imiyoboro y'abandi, n'ibihinduka bya memecoin. Amakuru nyakuri ku murandasi, nta kiyi ya API, nta signature.
hood_desk.meta_og_description: Shyira aderesi ya Robinhood Chain iyo ari yo yose kandi ubone igitabo cyayo cyose: amateka y'ibibanza, urutonde rw'ibikorwa, imyanya igenerwa ku giciro, urwego rwa NAV n'imiyoboro y'abandi.

hood_desk.meta_title: Hood Desk · iguriro ryo gucuruza riri ku murongo wa Robinhood Chain · three.ws
hood_desk.meta_twitter_description: Iguriro ryo gucuruza riri ku murongo wa Robinhood Chain: igitabo, tape, imyanya, NAV premium ridge.
hood_desk.read_only_any_robinhood_chain_address_ca: Gusoma gusa. Adresi yose ya Robinhood Chain irashobora gukoreshwa; nta kintu cyemejwe kandi nta murongo ukeneye.

hood_portfolios.constituents_weights_schedule_the_origin: Ibice, ibiro, gahunda, igitekerezo cy'ibanze n'ishusho y'ikirere byanditswe kandi byemejwe. Hash ijya ku murongo; inyandiko ifite aderesi y'ibikubiye. Ntibishobora guhinduka, bityo ibyo wagurishije ntibishobora guhinduka munsi yawe.
hood_portfolios.deliver_every_constituent_to_mint_receiv: Ohereza buri gice kugira ngo ugure, wakire buri gice kugira ngo usubize. Ikigega ntigicuriza ikintu na kimwe kugira ngo umuntu yinjire cyangwa asohoke, bityo ntigikoresha igihombo kandi ntigikeneye umubare w'ibiciro kugira ngo gikore.
hood_portfolios.elsewhere_refining_an_index_with_a_follo: Ahandi, kunoza urutonde hamwe n'igitekerezo gikurikira bihindura urutonde ufite. Fata imwe muri 18 zero-dependency @three-ws/* SDKs — forge, ijwi, amazina, ubwenge, izina ryiza, x402 — kugira ngo uhamagare API zitaziguye muri code. ibm_hello.three_ws_is_a_platform_for_3d: three.ws ni urubuga rwa AI agents za 3D. Ubusobanura imiterere y'umuntu mu magambo asanzwe ukabona avatar ifite texture, yakorewe rigging, igenda, ifata imyanya, kandi ibaho mu isi za 3D zisangiwe — ikora muri browser iyo ari yo yose, nta gushyiraho software. Buri agent ishobora kugira indangamuntu kuri blockchain, kugira wallet, no kwishyura cyangwa kwishyuza akazi mu gihe nyacyo.
ibm_hello.three_ws_turns_a_sentence_into_a: three.ws ihindura interuro ikayigira 3D agent yakorewe rigging, ikayiha indangamuntu n'ububiko kuri blockchain, ikayiha ubushobozi bwo kwinjiza no gukoresha amafaranga mu gihe nyacyo binyuze kuri x402, kandi igatekereza kuri byose hamwe na IBM Granite kuri watsonx.ai. Demo ziri hepfo ni ibice bigize imashini — iyi ni imashini yose.

ibm_hello.what_three_ws_is_what_ibm_brings: Icyo three.ws ari cyo, icyo IBM izana, n'uburyo ibice bya 3D, AI, na on-chain bihuza.
ibm_hello.x402_revives_the_dormant_http_402_paymen: x402 izura HTTP 402 Payment Required yari yarazimye, ikayigira uburyo nyabwo bwo kwishyura. Uhamagara endpoint nk'ibisanzwe; niba yishyuwe, seriveri igusubiza 402 ikubwira igiciro nyacyo, umutungo, n'aho wohereza. Ikarita yawe isinya uburenganzira budasaba gazi, ukongera ukohereza ukoresheje X-PAYMENT header, maze ihamagara igakemuka kuri on-chain — byose mu rugendo rumwe, nta konti cyangwa API key.
ibm_hello.yes_the_paid_demos_move_real_funds: Yego. Demo zishyuwe zikoresha amafaranga nyayo avuye mu ikarita yawe — USDC, cyangwa $THREE kuri Solana — kandi zigakemuka kuri Base cyangwa Solana mainnet. Nta kigana cyangwa ikigero; igiciro ubona gisomwa ako kanya kuri 402 response ya seriveri, kandi ubona inyemezabuguzi ya on-chain.
ibm_hello.you_can_pay_every_x402_demo_on: Ushobora kwishyura buri demo ya x402 iri kuri iyi paji muri $THREE, cyangwa ukayireba kuri pump.fun.
ibm_hello.you_ll_get_back_price_24_hour: Uzahabwa igiciro, impinduka mu masaha 24, market cap, liquidity, volume y'amasaha 24, n'ikimenyetso gifite impamvu ngufi — byose biturutse kuri DexScreener. Bikemuka muri USDC cyangwa $THREE kuri Solana (USDC kuri Base); ikiguzi cya network gitangwa na facilitator.
ibm_hello.you_ll_need_the_phantom_wallet_on: Uzakeneye ikarita ya Phantom kuri Solana — ifite igiciro cya model muri USDC, cyangwa ikingana nayo muri $THREE, kuri Solana mainnet. Ibi bikoresha amafaranga nyayo — igiciro cyerekanwe hejuru — avuye mu ikarita yawe; ikarita igufasha guhitamo USDC cyangwa $THREE. Kwishyura ubwabyo ni umukono udasaba gazi: ikiguzi cya network gitangwa na x402 facilitator, bityo ntikiyongera ku kiguzi cyawe. Generation itangira kwishyura byemejwe kandi bifata hafi umunota. Nta karita? Forge imwe ku buntu hepfo — nta karita, nta key, nta kwishyura.
ibm_hello.you_sign_a_gasless_usdc_authorization_re: Usinya uburenganzira bwa USDC budasaba gazi, ukongera ukohereza ukoresheje X-PAYMENT header, maze ihamagara igakemuka kuri on-chain — amakuru yawe akagaruka.

inspect.lede: Ibi bikora ku ubuziranenge nyabwo three.ws bukoreshwa ku byinjira mu bubiko bwayo ku bintu byose .glb uhawe. Module imwe, ibipimo bimwe, icyemezo kimwe. Bikorwa mu buryo bwuzuye muri browser yawe: nta kintu na kimwe cyoherejwe, kandi igisubizo kiraboneka ako kanya.
inspect.meta_desc: Kora ku buzuzi nyabwo three.ws bukoreshwa ku bubiko bwayo ku bintu byose .glb, muri browser yawe. Nta kintu na kimwe cyoherejwe. Igisubizo cyihariye ku mabwiriza hamwe n'igikemura ku byabuze.
inspect.note_gate_p: Urupapuro rukoresha module imwe na cron ishyiraho, bityo amabwiriza hano ntashobora guhinduka ugereranyije n'amabwiriza mu bikorwa. Soma inyandiko yose ya gate ku rwego rw'icyerekezo rukora nyuma y'uru.
inspect.note_strict_p: Umukora wihitiyemo gukora mesh itarimo ubuziranenge, kandi ashobora kongera kuyikora. Umushyitsi ureba mu bubiko ntiyahisemo na kimwe: buri kintu ni urubuga rwiyemeje. Blob imwe yahiye ku iduka itanga icyizere kinini kuruta icumi zatumijwe zose zishobora gutakaza ikiguzi.
inspect.note_structure_p: Izi checks zigereranya niba model ikoze neza ku buryo bwo kuyitangaza: ubunini, ibiro, texture, imipaka, guteranya. Niba isa neza, bigenwa ku buryo butandukanye n'icyerekezo ku nzira y'ububiko.

integrity.agent_wallets_on_three_ws_are_custodial: Amakonti y'abakozi kuri three.ws aracungwa — dufite imfunguzo kandi dusinya mu izina ryawe. Bityo rero, gucunga tubigira bishobora kwemezwa, ntabwo ari isezerano gusa. Buri masaha make dufata ifoto y'uko buri konti ihagaze kuri blockchain, tukubaka Merkle tree, maze tugashyira umuzi kuri Solana. Hasi hari umuzi uheruka n'ibikorwa byawo by'ishingiro — byigenzure kuri blockchain ubwawe. Ufite konti? Emeza uburenganzira bwawe bwo kwinjizwamo →

irl_privacy.lets_you_place_an_agent_at_a: Bigufasha gushyira umugenzi ahantu nyaho no kumenya abari hafi yawe. Duhagarika gusa ibiri mu ntera ya metero nkeya uvuye aho uri ubu — ntabwo tureba ahantu hagari — kandi aho uherereye ntabwo bigera ku bandi bakoresha.
irl_privacy.meta_description: Kuri three.ws IRL, umugenzi washyizweho aba ari ibanga bitewe n'aho aherereye: agaragara gusa ku bantu bahagaze mu ntera ya metero nkeya uvuye aho ari — ntabwo agaragara ku ikarita, urutonde, cyangwa mu gitabo cy'abantu bose. Dore neza ibyo bisangizwa, ibyo bidashyirwa ahagaragara, n'uko kamera yawe, imigendekere, n'aho uherereye bikoreshwa.

irl_privacy.your_agents_are_private_by_location: Abakozi bawe ni ibanga bitewe n'aho biherereye.

launch_week.267_8k_impressions_25_3k_engagements_9: Ibigaragaye 267.8K. Ibikorwa 25.3K. Igipimo cy'ibikorwa 9.4%. Abasuye umwirondoro 5.1K. launch_week.a_real_time_3d_agent_runtime_on: Uburyo bwa 3D agent runtime ikora ako kanya kuri Three.js + glTF. Chat y'abafatanyabikorwa benshi (Claude, GPT, Groq, OpenRouter) ifite amarangamutima ashingiye ku byiyumvo. Kwinjiza wallet ya Solana kavukire. Ubumenyi bwo gucuruza bwa Pump.fun nk'ibikoresho bya agent. SDK yose ya pump-fun-agent-payments yarasobanuwe — Anchor IDL, PDAs, gusoma ibyabaye, x402 layer — ubu ni source ishobora guhindurwa. Solana vanity grinder. Pump.fun umufatanyemikono mu kurema ibiceri. Live pump.fun feed.
launch_week.anthropic_claude_openai_gpt_groq_openrou: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Groq, OpenRouter — byose biri inyuma y'urubuga rumwe rwa chat rufite streaming ikora ako kanya binyuze muri Server-Sent Events. Agent isoma ibyiyumvo by'abakoresha ikabyitwaramo ifite amarangamutima + animation. Gahamagara imikorere, gukoresha ibikoresho bya MCP, artifacts. 100% open source.
launch_week.april_29_2026_nichxbt_posted_three_ws: Mata 29, 2026. @nichxbt yashyizeho three.ws — urubuga rufunguye rw'abakozi ba AI ba 3D bavuga, bibuka, bafite amavaleti, kandi bakora minting kuri blockchain. ibyo abantu 135,000 barebye mu masaha 24 ya mbere. Uwo munsi nyine: npm package yashyizweho, yashyizwe kuri MCP Registry ya Anthropic, yashyizwe kuri x402scan nka endpoint yishyurwa, ubushobozi bwa Pump.fun bwo gucuruza bw'umwimerere bwashyizweho, Solana vanity address generator yashyizweho, demo y'umukozi wa voice + X Spaces.
launch_week.asymmetric_posture_is_a_signal_following: Kutangana mu myifatire ni ikimenyetso. Dukurikira 11. Dukurikirwa na 3,675. Imibare iravuga ko: turi abashyira ahagaragara ibintu, ntabwo turi uruganda rwo gukurikira abandi. Abadukurikira bemejwe (359, ~10%) bakunze kuba abakoresha bafite ubushobozi buhanitse — ni bo tsinda nyine ryishyura, rikoresha mu kubaka, kandi rigatambutsa ibyo tuzashyira ahagaragara ubutaha.

Kwiyandikisha ku bintu bya WebSocket — kwishyurwa → animation yo kwishimira; kugura bigatangira → agent igahita yitwara; kubikuza → byandikwa kuri timeline y'indangamuntu.
