launch_week.three_live_paid_endpoints_solana_token_t: Endpoints eshatu zikora zishyurwa: /api/x402/mint-to-mesh (token ya Solana → avatar ya 3D ifite insanganyamatsiko, $0.01 USDC), /api/x402/model-check (validator glTF yishyurwa), /api/insights/revenue-vision (ingamba za agent zikoresha Claude, $0.001 USDC). Zishobora kwivumbura ubwazo kuri /.well-known/x402.json. Umufasha wa CDP ukoresha ES256 JWT auth. Amayungurura menshi: Base (eip155:8453), Arbitrum (eip155:42161), Solana.
launch_week.three_live_x402_paid_endpoints_mint_to: Endpoints eshatu zikora x402 zishyurwa — mint-to-mesh, model-check, revenue-vision — zishobora kwivumbura ubwazo kuri /.well-known/x402.json. SDKs ebyiri zasohowe kuri npm: @three-ws/sdk na @three-ws/agent-payments v3.1. Indangamuntu ya ERC-8004 kuri chain. Delegations zifite urugero za ERC-7710. Ibyemezo bya Solana ku bwoko butandatu bw'ibikorwa.
launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Selfies eshatu (ibumoso, hagati, iburyo), kwongera kubaka isura mu buryo bwinshi bufashijwe na GPU, n'avatar yateguwe, ishobora gukoreshwa, yashyizweho nka token ya ERC-8004 mu minota itageze kuri mirongo itandatu. Uburyo bwo gufata amashusho bwibanze kuri mobile, bufite ubugenzuzi bw'ubuziranenge mu gihe nyacyo.
launch_week.three_ws: three.ws
launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws yateguwe mu bice bine bihanahana amakuru, hamwe na backend na package y'amasezerano. Buri gice kirakora kuri three.ws kandi kizasohoka nk'igice cya repo ifunguye. Dore urutonde.
launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws yashyizweho nka io.github.nirholas/three.ws kuri registry.modelcontextprotocol.io kandi irashobora kuboneka binyuze muri PulseMCP's curated directory. Umuhuzabikorwa uwo ari wo wose uzi MCP (harimo na Claude Desktop) ushobora guhuza no kuyobora avatars binyuze kuri JSON-RPC.
launch_week.tts_x_spaces_websocket_events: TTS · X Spaces · Ibirori bya WebSocket
launch_week.we_built_the_platform_that_gives_it: Twubatse urubuga ruyitanga. Mu cyumweru kimwe: urwego rwuzuye rwa 3D AI agent — umurebanyi, uburyo bwo gukora, indangamuntu kuri blockchain, ubwishyu, kwinjiza, n'isoko — hamwe na npm SDKs ebyiri, x402 endpoints eshatu zikora, ubufatanye na Google Cloud na Alibaba Cloud, kugaragara kuri Coinbase, Bybit, Jupiter, na CoinGecko, umwanya muri W3C, n'umuryango w'abubatsi 1,010. Iyi ni inyemezabuguzi.
launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Gukora ishusho ya WebGL 2.0 ifite inkunga yuzuye ya glTF 2.0 / GLB: gukanda geometry ya Draco, gukanda texture ya KTX2, kongera ubushobozi bwa Meshopt, amakarita y'ibidukikije ya HDR, ibikoresho bya PBR, animation y'uruhu, morph targets, na kamera zishyizwemo. Kwemeza bikorwa ku rwego rwa buri murongo binyuze muri Khronos gltf-validator. Lip-sync analyser ituma iminwa ihinduka bitewe n'ijwi rya agent mu gihe nyacyo. Gufata selfie + AvatarTurn integration bitanga avatars zishobora gukinishwa zivuye kuri kamera ya telefone. Gupakira ukurura ukarekura, OrbitControls ifite auto-rotation ishobora guhindurwa, na dat.GUI y'igihe nyacyo yo guhindura ako kanya.
launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Umurebanyi wa WebGL, LLM agent runtime, amasezerano y'indangamuntu ya ERC-8004, seriveri ya OAuth 2.1, MCP endpoint, n'igice cya web <agent-3d> — byose wasomye hejuru. Bikora kuri three.ws uyu munsi.
launch_week.weekend_doesn_t_sleep_the_biggest_single: Weekend ntabwo isinzira. Umunsi umwe munini (Gicurasi 5) wari ku Cyumweru. Ibyanditswe binini (Solana Hackathon, ibyarebwe 42K, 621 RTs) byasohotse ku wa Gatandatu. Crypto X iba maso igihe amakipe menshi y'ubucuruzi asinziriye. Kohereza ku mpera z'icyumweru.

Ikosa (bug), kubura kwa serivisi, ikibazo cy'umurongo (network), ihindurwa rya chain, ikosa rya RPC, cyangwa kunanirwa kwa serivisi y'undi muntu bishobora gutuma ibikorwa binanirwa, bikaba bitunguranye, cyangwa bikavamo igihombo cy'amafaranga.

monitor.foot: Buri mubare uri kuri uyu murongo ni amakuru y'urubuga: flot ikurikirana ibikorwa by'abakozi byanditswe mu buryo nyabwo, imiyoboro y'amafaranga yemejwe ku bikorwa byakozwe ku murongo hamwe n'ibimenyetso bya Solscan, kandi abakozi basoma urutonde rw'ibikorwa byemejwe x402 hire ledger. Nta kintu na kimwe cyakozwe mu buryo bw'ikigereranyo. Ibyo wamenya birambuye: ibikoresho by'ubuzima, umuvuduko w'amafaranga, ikibaho cy'amafaranga, imimerere.
monitor.meta_desc: Dashboard y'ubuyobozi ku three.ws flot y'abakozi ba 3D AI: ibikorwa by'abakozi bigenzura, umuvuduko w'amafaranga ku murongo, abakozi ku bakozi, gutangiza n'ubuzima bw'urubuga, byose ku ishusho imwe.
monitor.share_desc: Dashboard y'ubuyobozi ku itsinda rya three.ws 3D AI agents: ibikorwa by'ubu, umuyoboro w'amafaranga, abakozi b'agent ku agent n'ubuzima bwa platform.
monitor.spot_desc_default: Kanda kuri agent iyo ari yo yose mu itsinda kugirango utangire avatar yayo ya 3D.

motion.a_motion_is_a_handful_of_beats: Imyitwarire ni ibitotsi bike: aho umubiri uri mu gihe kimwe, igihe bifata kugera aho, n'igihe bimara. Iyo uhuye ikintu, buri gitotsi kigaragara hano kandi ushobora kugikurikirana.
motion.an_arm_is_not_two_bones_on: Ikiganza si amagufa abiri ku gice cy'ibikoresho. Umugongo ugera ku ntego y'ahantu hihishe, ifite santimetero icumi kugeza cumi n'itanu z'uburebure kandi byinshi mu byerekana uburebure bigaragara nk'uko umubiri wose ugerageza aho kuruta ikiganza gusa.
motion.ankles_are_placed_in_world_space_against: Amaguru ashyirwa mu mwanya w'isi ku butaka. Hip ziba zifite ubwisanzure bwo kugwa, kwiyegereza no guhindukira, kandi amaguru akayakira binyuze mu kinyuranyo cy'imikoranire, ari na yo mpamvu kugwa hano bisa n'uko ari kugwa.
motion.describe_a_movement_in_plain_language_kn: Sobanura imyitwarire mu rurimi rworoshye. Imyitwarire izwi igisubizo vuba; ikindi cyose cyandikwa n'icyitegererezo cy'ururimi mu buryo bumwe na bumwe.
motion.every_other_way_to_get_a_new: Uburyo bwose bwo kubona animation nshya bukeneye amakuru udafite: icyiciro cyo gufata, ishyirahamwe ry'ibipimo byemewe, cyangwa icyitegererezo cy'ikwirakwiza cyatozwemo. Ibi bisaba interuro, kuko umubiri w'umuntu ni ikibazo cy'imikoranire cyakemuwe igihe umuntu yandika aho ugomba kuba n'igihe.
motion.is_the_same_compiler_this_page_runs: npm i @three-ws/motion ni yo compiler imwe iyi paji ikoresha, nta bindi bisabwa na renderer. Soma inyandiko cyangwa ukande API byihuse.
motion.meta_description: Sobanura imyitwarire mu rurimi rworoshye kandi urebe avatar ya 3D ikora. Nta gufata imyitwarire, nta bipimo by'ibikoresho: umusubirizo w'imikoranire usoma Icyiciro cy'Imyitwarire kandi ukabyara clip nyayo ushobora kugenda, guhindura igitotsi ku gitotsi, no kohereza nka GLB.
motion.meta_og_description: Andika interuro, ubone animation nyayo y'umubiri wose. Nta mocap, nta bipimo by'ibikoresho, nta kanda.
motion.meta_title: Icyumba cy'Imyitwarire · Andika interuro, ubone animation · three.ws
motion.meta_twitter_description: Andika interuro, ubone animation nyayo y'umubiri wose. Nta mocap, nta bipimo by'ibikoresho, nta kanda.
motion.no_motion_capture_no_model_weights_nothi: Nta gufata imyitwarire, nta bipimo by'ibikoresho, nta kanda. Sobanura imyitwarire kandi umusubirizo w'imikoranire ukora ku mpinduka z'ibice ku gice: ibirenge ku butaka, ibiro hejuru yabyo, ibitugu bikora ibyo ibitugu bikora. Genda, hindura igitotsi icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi ohereza clip ikina ku ruganda urwo ari rwo rwose.
motion.nothing_is_moving_yet: Nta kintu kiri kwimuka kugeza ubu
motion.nothing_to_export_yet: nta kintu cyo kohereza kugeza ubu
motion.reverse_any_two_of_these_and_the: Subiza ebyiri muri izi, igisubizo kiba giteye ubwoba mu buryo budashobora gukosorwa nyuma. Sola amaboko mbere y'igituza, buri gikorwa kiba aho igituza cyari.
motion.root_where_the_hips_are_which_everything:
umugogo aho ibibero biri, byose munsi yaho biterwa na
guha icyerekezo cy'umubiri, bityo ibice bigakemurwa mu ishusho yahinduwe
igituza guhindukira, guhindagurika no kwikubita, bigabanywa mu murongo w'inyuma
amaguru ibirenge byashyizwe mu mwanya w'isi, bityo kugabanya ibibero bigahindura amavi
gukora ibibero byimurwa kugeza ibiro bigeze ku birenge
amaboko ibiganza byashyizwe ku mizinga ikora ku gituza cyahinduwe
ibiganza bigaragara, nyuma y'ukuboko niho bikwiriye
amaso ya nyuma, bityo kureba biba bifitanye isano n'igituza cyarangiyeho
motion.send_any_motion_to_the_animation_studio: Ohereza igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose muri Studio y'Animasi kugira ngo ugenzureho, hanyuma ubike ku rubuga rwawe, ubigaragaze ku rubuga, cyangwa ubigurishe.
motion.the_centre_of_mass_is_a_mass: Ikigo cy'ibiro ni igiteranyo cy'ibiro ku bice bitwara ibiro by'umubiri, kandi ibibero bigenda kugeza bigeze ku birenge bifite ibiro. Fata ikirenge kimwe umubiri ugahindukira ku kindi ku giti cye.
motion.the_clip_plays_on_any_humanoid_rig: Icyiciro kirakina ku gikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose cy'umuntu binyuze muri embed imwe na retargeter, ishyira amazina y'ibihimba bya Mixamo, Avaturn, VRM, Unreal na Daz ku iseti imwe y'ibihimbano.
motion.the_intermediate_format_is_anatomy_and_t: Igenamigambi rihoraho ni imiterere n'igihe: imimerere: "gukubita", amaboko.buryo.buri: "ikibuno", amaso: "ku rundi ruhande". Nta mazina y'ibihimba, nta quaternions. Ibi nibyo bituma biba byandikwa n'icyitegererezo cy'ururimi, bigasomwa mu itandukaniro, kandi bigahindurwa n'intoki mu isanduku hejuru.
motion.the_same_score_compiles_to_the_same: Icyo cyerekezo kimwe gihuza ku cyiciro kimwe, byte kuri byte, iteka. Ibi nibyo bituma igikorwa kiba cyanditswe ku mpera, kigasuzumwa mu isuzuma, kandi kikabikwa mu igerageza ryo gusubira inyuma.
motion.type_a_movement_above_or_pick_one: Andika igikorwa hejuru, cyangwa uhitemo kimwe mu byerekana.
motion.weight_time_and_flow_pick_the_easing: Ibiro, igihe n'uburyo bitoranya umuvuduko w'ihinduka, bigakora urugendo, kandi bigashyiraho uko igice cyihuta mbere yo kuguma. Ibi nibyo bituma imiterere itatu imwe isomwa nk'igihinduka, guhanahana, cyangwa guha icyubahiro.

motion_swap.a_server_worker_tracks_your_body_pose: Seriveri ikurikirana imiterere y'umubiri wawe muri buri shusho, ikayishyira ku gishushanyo mbonera cy'umubiri cy'urubuga. Iyi ni yo moteri ihindura imiterere y'imigendekere ya avatar zose ziri hano. Inagutandukanya ikagushyira mu gishushanyo cy'igifuniko (mask).
motion_swap.any_rigged_humanoid_glb_works_one_you: GLB iyo ari yo yose yateguwe neza irakora — iyo wakoreye, wafashe muri selfie, cyangwa yateguwe kuva kuri mesh.
motion_swap.meta_description: Shyiramo videwo yawe maze uyisubirane avatar yawe ya 3D ikora imigendekere yawe aho kuba wowe. Gukurikirana imiterere, guhisha umuntu, no guhindura avatar — byegeranyijwe kandi byoherejwe muri browser yawe.
motion_swap.meta_og_description: Ntugaragare muri kamera ariko ntuvaneho videwo. Avatar yawe ikora imigendekere yawe, igaragara buri frame hejuru yawe.
motion_swap.meta_og_title: Motion Swap — Simbuza isura yawe muri videwo na Avatar yawe · three.ws
motion_swap.meta_title: Motion Swap — Simbuza isura yawe muri videwo na Avatar yawe · three.ws
motion_swap.meta_twitter_description: Ntugaragare muri kamera ariko ntuvaneho videwo. Avatar yawe ikora imigendekere yawe, igaragara buri frame hejuru yawe.
motion_swap.meta_twitter_title: Motion Swap — Simbuza isura yawe muri videwo na Avatar yawe · three.ws
motion_swap.mp4_mov_or_webm_up_to_256: MP4, MOV, cyangwa WebM kugeza kuri 256 MB. Amasegonda 90 ya mbere ni yo atunganywa. Umubiri wose uri muri frame ni wo ufatwa neza.
motion_swap.the_source_video_is_processed_transientl: Videwo y'umwimerere itunganywa by'agateganyo kandi amakuru y'imiterere ntabwo arimo amashusho — agace k'imigendekere ni ukuzunguruka kw'amagufwa gusa.
motion_swap.tracking_your_pose_frame_by_frame_and: Gukurikirana imiterere yawe buri frame no kuguhisha. Agace k'amasegonda 30 gafata iminota igera kuri ibiri.
motion_swap.upload_a_video_of_yourself_a_house: Shyiramo videwo yawe — urugendo rw'inzu, kwerekana ibicuruzwa, cyangwa ikiganiro kigufi — maze uyisubirane avatar yawe ya 3D ikora imigendekere yawe neza aho kuba wowe. Gukurikirana imiterere bikorwa kuri seriveri; uguma uri pixelated munsi ya avatar. Kwegeranya no kohereza bibera hano muri browser yawe.
motion_swap.video_motion_capture_body_swap: Gufata imigendekere muri videwo · guhindura umubiri
motion_swap.your_browser_then_plays_the_original_foo: Browser yawe noneho ikina amashusho y'umwimerere, ikugira pixelated munsi y'igifuniko, kandi igashyira avatar hejuru yawe buri frame, ihuye n'aho uri n'ingano yawe. Kohereza bifata ibyegeranyijwe hamwe n'amajwi y'umwimerere.
motion_swap.your_video_your_avatar_not_your_face: Videwo yawe. Avatar yawe. Ntabwo ari isura yawe.

Buri tagi ya <agent-3d> ishyira hanze umukozi ufite indangamuntu ya NFT ya Solana (Metaplex Core), ububiko bwa ERC-8004 kuri EVM, umubiri wa 3D w'umwimerere wa mushinga-mbere muri WebGL biciye kuri three.js, ubwonko bwa LLM bukomoka kuri Claude, n'ubwishyu bw'umwimerere bwa x402 / HTTP 402 muri USDC kuri Base, BSC, na Solana.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_apache_2_0_from: three.ws ni Apache 2.0 kuva hejuru kugeza hasi — ureba, ikora, amasezerano y'indangamuntu, n'inyuma. Abakiriya ba AWS bashobora gusuzuma umurundo wose, kuwugabanyamo, no gukoresha iyabo bwite niba bashaka igenzura ryuzuye. Iyi soko kandi yamaze gutangira gukora kuri Alibaba Cloud Marketplace kandi yashyizwe muri BNB Chain Dappbay, Rejisitiri ya Model Context Protocol, na x402scan — AWS yiyunze ku ngamba zateguwe zo gukwirakwiza mu bicuruzwa byinshi by'ibicu.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_now_an_aws_partner: three.ws ubu ni Umufatanyabikorwa wa AWS. Iyi soko yanditswe mu nzira y'Ikoranabuhanga ya AWS Partner Network (APN) nk'Umufatanyabikorwa mu Ikoranabuhanga — izina ryemewe ku bagurisha software bigenga bakora ibicuruzwa ku bakiriya ba AWS.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_the_first_fully_on: three.ws ni isoko ya mbere yuzuye y'abakozi ba AI ba 3D bakora kuri blockchain muri AWS Partner Network. Buri tagi ya <agent-3d> iyi soko ikora ni umukinnyi wigenga Solana-wakozwe, ERC-8004-ufite ububiko, x402-wishyurwa — kandi uwo murundo ubu ni igice cy'uruganda rw'abafatanyabikorwa ba AWS.

Inzira iva kuri "dukoresha AWS" ijya kuri "turi Umufatanyabikorwa wa AWS" ni ugushyira mu buryo bwemewe imikoranire ya tekiniki yamaze amezi menshi ikora.

nvidia_index.generating_3d_used_to_require_a_workstat: Gukora 3D byasabaga workstation, uruhushya, n'ubuhanga wamaze imyaka myinshi wiga. Impamvu umushyitsi ashobora kwandika interuro kuri laptop y'ishuri akabona moderi nyayo, ifite texture, ishobora gukorerwa rigging ku buntu, si uko moderi imwe izwi yagize neza. Ahubwo ni abafasha bose bagize neza kandi babonetse ku buntu icyarimwe, benshi muri bo bakirwa na NVIDIA inyuma y'urufunguzo rumwe. Ubushobozi bwa GPU ni cyo kibazo gikomeye ku bijyanye n'umuvuduko n'uburyo birambuye, kandi ni cyo kibazo Inception ifasha koroshya.

Iyi page ni ikarita y'ukuri y'uburyo: bimodel byakiriwe na NVIDIA bikora iki, GPU zacu bwite dukoresha, n'ibyo twize tubishyira mu bikorwa.

Igishushanyo mbonera ushobora kuzenguruka, kugishyira mu buryo bwo kugikoresha (rig), kugihindura (animate), no kugishyira mu cyumba cyawe cyo kuriramo, ni igisubizo gitandukanye n'ifoto yacyo gusa. three.ws ibaho kugira ngo ubwo buryo bwo gusubiza buhinduke ibisanzwe: uburyo bwa protocole ifunguye, umuyoboro w'ubuntu, n'ikoranabuhanga rifunguye (open-source stack) munsi yabyose. openai_index.render_any_public_glb_from_several_angle: Shyiraho GLB yose y'umuryango ku nzira nyinshi n'usome geometrie yayo, kugira assistant ishobore kubona muderi mbere y'ikugira.
openai_index.six_generation_tools_a_collector_an_insp: Ibicuruzwa 6 byo kwakira, collector ikura muderi wafashe igihe kirekire gusa, inspector ishushanya muderi wose kugira assistant ishobore gukora ibibazo byayo, n'ibicuruzwa 3 bya persona bishyira assistant mu mibere iremera, ibibazo by'ururimi. Byose 11 biwacu, byose byafashijwe na operator.
openai_index.the_same_free_lane_as_a_rest: Uburyo bw'ubuntu bumwe n'ubuso bwa REST Actions bwa GPT yihariye ya "three.ws 3D Studio", bufite urugi rw'umutekano rw'imyaka 13+ n'ibisubizo bisukuye. Bikubiyemo gahunda zidafite ubufasha bw'umuyoboro.
openai_index.three_ws_has_been_named_an_openai: three.ws yagizwe Umufatanyabikorwa watoranyijwe wa OpenAI mu rwego rwa OpenAI Partner Network. Umuyoboro w'ubuntu wa 3D Studio wa platform uhindura interuro igishushanyo mbonera cya 3D gikora, gifite imiterere (textured), kigaragara mu kiganiro, hanyuma kikagishyira mu buryo bwo gukoreshwa (rigs), kikagihindura (animates), kandi kikagishyira mu cyumba cyawe muri AR. Nta rufunguzo, nta konti, nta kiguzi.
openai_index.three_ws_is_an_independent_member_of: three.ws ni umunyamuryango wigenga wa OpenAI Partner Network ku rwego rwa Select. Iyi paji isobanura ibicuruzwa bya three.ws byuzuzanya na platform za OpenAI; ntabwo ari igicuruzwa cya OpenAI kandi ntabwo ishyigikiwe na OpenAI uretse izina ry'umufatanyabikorwa ryerekanwe. OpenAI, ChatGPT, na ikirango cya OpenAI Partner Network ni ibirango bya OpenAI. Menya byinshi kuri uru ruyange kuri openai.com/business/partners.
openai_index.turn_a_generated_avatar_into_a_persisten: Hindura avatar yakozwe ikore umubiri uhoraho, ufite izina, ushobora kongera gukorwa ukoresheje id.
openai_index.what_we_ship_on_openai_surfaces: Ibyo dukora kuri platform za OpenAI.

oracle.meta_description: Oracle ihuriza hamwe abaguze, uko baguze, icyo ikiceri ari cyo, n'uko kigenda mu barura rimwe ry'ukuri ririho kuri buri itangizwa rya pump.fun — kandi bigatuma umukozi wawe wa AI wa 3D akora ku mikorere ifite icyizere kinini. Uko amakuru menshi tugenzura, niko ibarura ryose rirushaho kuba neza.
oracle.meta_og_description: Ibarura rimwe ry'ukuri kuri buri itangizwa rya pump.fun, ryahujwe n'amakuru yuzuye y'ibihamya bya wallet + ikiceri + imiterere. Urebe muri ako kanya. Ha umukozi wawe ubushobozi bwo kubikoraho.
oracle.meta_title: Oracle — imyanzuro y'ukuri yahujwe pump.fun · three.ws
oracle.meta_twitter_description: Ibarura rimwe ry'ukuri ririho kuri buri itangizwa, ryahujwe n'amakuru menshi kuri pump.fun. Ha umukozi wawe ubushobozi bwo kubikoraho.
oracle.oracle_agents_ranked_by_their_real_convi: Abakozi ba Oracle bashyizwe ku rwego hashingiwe ku mateka yabo y'imyanzuro y'ukuri — buri cyemezo cyose kigenzurwa n'ukuri nyako. Hagaragazwa gusa abakozi bafite ibyavuyemo byamenyekanye. Iyandikishe kugira ngo ukore nk'abakora neza kurusha abandi.
oracle.oracle_fuses_four_reads_on_every_pump: Oracle ihuriza hamwe amakuru ane kuri buri itangizwa rya pump.fun — uwagura (uburyo bwa wallet yizewe), uko igurwa (guhuriza hamwe vs. imiterere karemano), icyo ari cyo (inkomoko y'umuco), na uko igenda — mu barura rimwe ry'ukuri ryagaragara neza riri hagati ya 0 na 100. Uko ibiceri na wallets byinshi tugenzura, niko ibarura ryose rirushaho kuba neza. Hanyuma ha umukozi wawe wa 3D ubushobozi bwo gukora ku mikorere irenze urwego rwawe. Soma inyandiko ↗

Dupima ijanisha ry'intsinzi nyayo ku rwego, tukagaragaza urwego rw'icyizere rwa 95% kuri buri mubare, kandi tugashushanya uburyo bwo kugereranya kugira ngo ubone ko ibarura rishira ibiceri ku rwego hashingiwe ku mahirwe. Inyungu ibarwa gusa niba imyanzuro y'ukuri irusha kugura utazi — kandi turabigaragaza n'iyo bitabaye bityo.

oracle-lab.ladder_h: Ese buri rwego rwinjiza ibyo ruvuga
oracle-lab.ladder_sub: Icyiciro cy'amanota si igipimo: 86 ivuga amahirwe ya 45%, si 86%. Buri runganya ni isezerano rusange ku bijyanye n'ubwiyongere, bityo hano ni isezerano riri kumwe n'ibipimo, ku byatanzwe model itigeze ibona. Model ifite urwego rwo hejuru idahagarika ibyo ivuga iranga ku muryango w'ibikurikirana aho kwinjira ahubwo ikabuzwa.
oracle-lab.lede: Oracle ikurikirana buri pump.fun itangiriro mu masegonda mirongo itatu na atanu ya mbere kandi ikayigira amanota. Uru rupapuro ni imashini ikora amanota, si ishusho y'ibyo: buri bwoko bw'ibipimo hamwe n'umubare w'ibyatanzwe inyuma yabyo, ibyo koko byabaye kuri ibyo byatanzwe, umurongo w'ubwizerwe yakuye ku makuru itigeze ibona, n'amateka yose y'ibice byose yagerageje, harimo n'ibyo byanzwe.
oracle-lab.lede2: Ni urutonde rw'ibipimo, hafi 32KB. Kanda kugirango ushyireho kandi ushobora kongera gukora amanota yose twigeze dukora, offline, nta ki.
oracle-lab.meta_desc: Model y'icyizere ya Oracle, yashyizwe ahagaragara mu buryo bwuzuye: buri bwoko bw'ibipimo hamwe n'umubare w'icyitegererezo inyuma yabyo, umurongo w'ubwizerwe bwafashwe, amateka y'ibyo imashini yize n'igihe, n'umukora w'amanota ushobora kuyobora mu ntoki.
oracle-lab.og_desc: Buri bwoko, buri mubare w'icyitegererezo, buri version. Kanda kugirango ushyireho model kandi wongere gukora amanota yose offline.
oracle-lab.registry_sub: Model ivugurura buri masaha atandatu kandi ifata gusa niba irusha iyari isanzwe ku rutonde rw'ibipimo. Abakandida banze baragaragazwa hano, hamwe n'impamvu: urutonde rwerekana gusa abatsinze ni urutonde rw'ibikurikirana, si amateka.
oracle-lab.scorer_sub: Buri kontrol hasi itanga ibipimo nyakuri, mu rubuga rwawe. Nta kintu na kimwe gitangwa ahandi. Iyi ni imibare imwe ikora amanota ku live feed.
oracle-lab.scoring_h: Ni iki kiri gukora amanota ubu
oracle-lab.scoring_sub: Model nyakuri iyi platform ikoresha ubu, hamwe n'imibare yakuye ku byatanzwe byafashwe mu myitozo yayo.
oracle-lab.twitter_desc: Icyitegererezo cy'ukuri cy'Oracle: buri gice gifite ibiro hamwe n'umubare w'ibikorwa byanditse inyuma yacyo n'ibyo byabayeho, umurongo w'ukuri w'ubwizerwe ku rwego rwose, amateka y'ibihinduka byose harimo n'ibyo byanzwe, n'umukino w'ubushakashatsi ukora ibiro nyakuri mu rubuga rwawe. Bika kandi usubiremo ikigereranyo icyo ari cyo cyose utari kuri interineti.
oracle-lab.use_note: verify() niyo ikomeye. Tanga ibikorwa hamwe n'ibyavuyemo wakusanyije ubwawe kandi isubiramo AUC yacu, ikigereranyo cya Brier n'umurongo w'ukuri ku makuru yawe. Niba imibare yacu yasohotse itakiriho mu bipimo byigenga, ugomba kuba ushobora kubimenya ku ruhande rwacu.
oracle-lab.use_sub: Nta bindi bisabwa. Node, Deno, Bun, Abakozi, urubuga. Icyifuzo kimwe, hanyuma ni imibare y'aho hantu iteka.
oracle-lab.weights_sub: Umurongo umwe kuri buri gice. Log-odds ni ibyo gice kizana ku kigereranyo. Win, rug na run ni ibyo byabaye ku bikorwa biri muri cyo, kandi n ni umubare wabyo. Icyifuzo gifite n ntoya ni icyifuzo gito, kandi ushobora kubona icyo ari cyo n'iki.

oracle_docs.24_endpoints_json_sse_serving_the_feed: ~24 endpoints (JSON + SSE) zitanga amakuru, ibisobanuro by'ifaranga, ubumenyi bw'ububiko bw'amafaranga, kwiga ibyahise, imigezi, n'ahagenewe imiterere y'umukozi. Bibikwa mu buryo bw'agateganyo kuri CDN; bifite umuvuduko ntarengwa kuri buri IP.
oracle_docs.3d_graph_every_scored_coin_as_a: Igishushanyo mbonera cya 3D. Buri faranga ryahawe amanota rishushanywa nk'umubumbe, rihurijwe hamwe bitewe n'inkuru, ingano yaryo ikagenwa n'icyizere. (Imibumbe igaragarira kuri hardware ya GPU; iyi foto yerekana igice cy'iboneza.)
oracle_docs.72h_retention: score, tier, pillars, scored_at · kugumana mu masaha 72
oracle_docs.a_coin_s_conviction_time_series_sparklin: Urukurikirane rw'igihe rw'icyizere cy'ifaranga (amakuru ya sparkline) rugaragaza umuvuduko wo kuzamuka/kugabanuka/guhagarara.
oracle_docs.a_coin_s_live_buy_sell_tape: Amakuru y'igihe nyacyo y'ifaranga y'ubugure/ubugurishwe, buri bucuruzi buherekejwe n'imiterere y'ububiko bw'amafaranga bw'umucuruzi.
oracle_docs.a_conviction_score_is_a_probabilistic_cl: Amanota y'icyizere ni ikirego gishingiye ku bushoboka, kandi ikirego gishingiye ku bushoboka nta gaciro gifite keretse gishyizwe mu ngiro. Oracle ihuza buri cyemezo n'ukuri kwacyo kandi ikagaragaza ibyavuyemo kuri page — harimo n'igihe itandukaniro ari rito. Iki ni cyo gitandukanya icyitegererezo n'amarangamutima.
oracle_docs.a_dynamic_1200_630_opengraph_conviction_: Ikarita y'icyizere ya OpenGraph ya 1200×630 ihindagurika (SVG) yo gusangiza abandi ifaranga.
oracle_docs.a_hard_ceiling_on_the_final_score: Igisenge ntarengwa ku manota ya nyuma, gishyirwaho n'ikimenyetso gitukura gikomeye cy'imiterere cyangwa ubwoko, gikoreshwa mbere yo gukomanywa.
oracle_docs.a_high_score_is_the_weight_of: Amanota menshi ni uburemere bw'ibimenyetso biri kuri blockchain, ntabwo ari garanti. pump.fun irwanya kandi ifite umurizo munini — ibyinshi mu bitangizwa biratsindwa, ndetse n'uburyo bwateguwe neza bukunze gutsindwa. Soma urwego nk'amahirwe, ushyireho ingano ikwiye, kandi ntukigere utega icyo udashobora gutakaza.
oracle_docs.a_long_lived_node_process_running_three: Uburyo bwa Node bumara igihe kirekire bukoresha imizenguruko itatu yigenga — score (kugumana imyanzuro ishobora gukoreshwa), agent (gukora ku masaha yateguwe), na settle (gutanga amanota ku bisubizo) — buri kimwe cyihagararira ubwacyo kugira ngo inzira yoroheje idahagarike iyihuta.
oracle_docs.a_model_you_can_only_trust_when: Icyitegererezo ushobora kwizera gusa iyo kigushimagije ntacyo kimaze. Dore ibyo Oracle idashobora gukora, aho ishobora kwibeshya, n'uburyo yakomejwe.
oracle_docs.a_pump_fun_coin_that_completed_its: Igiceri cya pump.fun cyarangije umurongo wacyo wo guhuza — ikimenyetso nyamukuru cy'intsinzi.
oracle_docs.a_pure_side_effect_free_scoring_function: Imikorere yo gutanga amanota idafite ingaruka z'inyongera, yuzuye (convict()) hamwe n'urwego rwo gukusanya amakuru rurinda. Uhawe mint, itanga amanota, urwego, isesengura ry'inkingi, n'impamvu. Nta I/O mu gihe cyo gutanga amanota — ishobora kugeragezwa byuzuye.
oracle_docs.a_scored_coin_is_a_win_if: Igiceri cyahawe amanota ni intsinzi niba cyararangije, cyangwa cyaragize inshuro ≥2× za ATH kitagize ikibazo cyo gukorera uburiganya; igihombo niba cyarakorewe uburiganya cyangwa cyaragumye munsi ya 1.2×; kirahagaze hagati. Ingingo "kitagize ikibazo cyo gukorera uburiganya" irakomeye: ibitangizwa byinshi bisanzwe byiyongera inshuro 2× kuva bigitangira mbere yo gusenyuka, kandi kubara izo ntera nk'intsinzi byatuma pump-and-dumps byongera umubare ugomba kubigaragaza. Ibiceri byakemuwe gusa nibyo bibarirwa mu kigero cy'intsinzi — imyanya ifunguye irasohoka, kugira ngo umubare udashobora kwiyongera bitewe n'amabwiriza ataracibwa.
oracle_docs.a_single_long_lived_node_process_runs: Uburyo bumwe bwa Node bumara igihe kirekire bukoresha imizenguruko itatu yigenga, yihagararira ubwayo. Ntibihuriyeho ikindi uretse database, kugira ngo inzira yoroheje yo gutanga amanota idatinda igikorwa cya agent, kandi kwemeza kwahagaze ntikwigere guhagarika gutanga amanota.
oracle_docs.a_single_wallet_s_profile_recent_coins: Umwirondoro w'ikofi imwe + ibiceri biheruka, cyangwa urutonde rw'ibifi byiza.
oracle_docs.a_wallet_labelled_smart_money_kol_or: Ikofi yashyizweho ikimenyetso cy'amafaranga y'ubwenge/KOL cyangwa ifite amanota y'icyubahiro ≥70 — ifaranga ry'ubwoko bwiza.
oracle_docs.activity_floor_every_agent_action_live_t: Igikorwa cy'ibanze — buri gikorwa cya agent, mu buryo bwa live, ako kanya kiba.
oracle_docs.agents_leaderboard_ranked_by_outcome_gra: Urutonde rw'Abagenzi — rushyirwa ku rutonde hakurikijwe igipimo cy'intsinzi cyapimwe n'ibisubizo, nyuma y'uko abagenzi bagaragaje ubushobozi.
oracle_docs.alongside_the_score_the_engine_emits_bad: Hamwe n'amanota, moteri itanga ibimenyetso (urugero: smart-money, structure-flag, news, momentum, prime) kugira ngo byorohereze kureba vuba, ndetse n'urutonde rukurikira rw'impamvu — buri imwe yanditsweho inkingi yayitanze — kugira ngo amanota atazigera aba ibanga.
oracle_docs.an_agent_configured_to_act_on_conviction: Umugenzi wateguwe kugira ngo akore ku bwizere mu buryo bwikora, mu buryo bwo kugerageza cyangwa mu buryo bw'ukuri.
oracle_docs.anything_labelled_deep_dive_expands_into: Ikintu cyose cyanditsweho Deep dive kirambura imibare nyayo, imibare idahinduka, inzira za code, n'ibibazo bidasanzwe — urwego rw'umushakashatsi. Biba bifunze mu buryo busanzwe. Koresha Expand all hejuru kugira ngo usome byose icyarimwe.
oracle_docs.arm_your_agent_pick_an_agent_set: Tegura umugenzi wawe. Hitamo umugenzi, shyiraho urugero (Prime / Strong+ / Lean+), ingano y'umwanya n'imipaka, ibyo kuyungurura inkuru n'ubutumwa bwa Telegram bishobora guhitamo, hanyuma utegure mu buryo bwo kugerageza cyangwa ubw'ukuri. Ibyerekanwa mu buryo bw'ukuri bigaragaza neza amafaranga y'ikoranabuhanga yashobora kuzuza amategeko yawe ubu. three.ws/oracle/arm
oracle_docs.biggest_conviction_changes_over_a_window: Impinduka nini mu bwizere zihinduka mu gihe runaka — amafaranga y'ikoranabuhanga amanota yayo azamuka cyangwa agabanuka, hamwe n'impinduka ya delta n'urwego.
Impinduka nini mu bwizere mu gihe runaka (bizamuka / bigabanuka).
oracle_docs.brier_score_the_mean_squared_error_of: Amanota ya Brier: BS = (1/N) Σ (s_i/100 − y_i)², ikosa ry'impuzandengo y'ibipimo bya kare by'ikirego gishoboka; ishobora gucibwamo ubwizerwe − gukemura + kutizera.
oracle_docs.buyer_track_record_is_the_single_most: — amateka y'ibyo umuguzi yakoze ni cyo kimenyetso kimwe cyonyine cyerekana neza ibizaba.
oracle_docs.category_not_in_the_agent_s_allow: icyiciro kitari mu rutonde rw'ibyo umugenzi yemerewe (niba byashyizweho)
oracle_docs.category_priors_base_virality: Ibyiciro by'ibanze (ubukana bw'ibanze): news 70 · culture 66 · ai 64 · meme 60 · animal 56 · community 58 · celebrity 54 · political 52 · tech 50 · utility 46 · unknown 40.
oracle_docs.coins_are_bucketed_by_score_0_10: Amafaranga y'ikoranabuhanga ashyirwa mu byiciro hakurikijwe amanota (0–10, …, 90–100) kandi igipimo cy'intsinzi cyagezweho cya buri cyiciro kigereranwa n'amanota kivuga ko kizagira. Moteri yagereranijwe igumana ibyagezweho hafi y'ibivuzwe kandi ikazamuka buhoro buhoro.
oracle_docs.concretely_the_platform_splits_into_thre: Mu buryo bw'ukuri, urubuga rugabanyijemo ibice bitatu bikorana:
oracle_docs.conviction_for_up_to_20_mints_at: Icyizere kuri mints zigera kuri 20 icyarimwe.
oracle_docs.conviction_is_only_half_the_product_the: Icyizere ni kimwe cya kabiri cy'igicuruzwa gusa. Ikindi gice ni ugufasha agent ya 3D gukora kuri ibyo — yigenga, mu mbibi wagennye, yisuzuma ubwayo kuri buri kintu cyose cyavuyemo. Ibyo ni byo /oracle/arm igenzura.
oracle_docs.conviction_is_the_weighted_fusion_of_fou: Icyizere ni ihuriro ry'ibipimo bine byigenga byapimwe mu buryo bubarwa. Buri nkingi ihabwa amanota 0–100 ku giti cyayo, ku mpamvu zayo bwite, kandi igatanga umugabane uhoraho ku mubare wa nyuma.
oracle_docs.conviction_weighted_size_the_executor_th: Ingano ibarwa hashingiwe ku cyizere: size = base · (1 + clamp((score − min)/(100 − min), 0, 1)·0.5). Umwongerera nyuma ashyiraho igipimo ntarengwa: size = min(size, ORACLE_MAX_TRADE_SOL) — urugero rw'umurinzi rurenga ku igenamiterere ryose rya buri agent.

oracle_docs.the_question_what_is_this_coin_about: Ikibazo: iyi coin ivuga iki, kandi inkuru yayo irashobora gukomeza mu muco? oracle_docs.the_question_who_is_already_in_this: Ikibazo: ni ba nde basanzwe muri iyi coin, kandi amateka yabo ni ayahe? oracle_docs.the_scoring_is_a_pure_function_of: Amanota ni imikorere y'amakuru yegeranyijwe. Buri kintu gifite imiterere — kwinjiza, kubika, gushyira mu bikorwa, kwishyura — kiba hanze yacyo. Uwo mupaka niwo utuma imibare ishobora kugeragezwa, imyanzuro ikongera gukorwa, kandi moteri imwe igakoresha live feed, API, n'icyemezo cya agent ifite ibisubizo bimwe.

Ibyo biragaragara, ntibihishwe. Urupapuro rwubatswe kugira ngo rwerekane intege nke kimwe n'imbaraga, kuko ikizamini cy'inyuma wizeye gusa iyo kigushimishije atari ikizamini cy'inyuma.
oracle_docs.the_system_gets_sharper_the_more_it: Sisitemu irushaho kuba nyayo uko irushaho gukurikirana, binyuze ku biziga bibiri by'iterambere. Uruziga rw'iterambere rw'amakuru: buri kintu cyakemuwe kivugurura igishushanyo mbonera cy'icyubahiro cya wallet gitanga imbaraga inkingi ya WHO, bityo ibisobanuro bya "amafaranga y'ubwenge" birahora byongera kwibonerwa, ntibihabwa agaciro rimwe gusa. Uruziga rw'iterambere rwo kugereranya: buri kintu cyapimwe gituma ikizamini cy'inyuma kirushaho kuba gikomeye, bigaragaza neza aho amanota afite icyizere cyinshi cyangwa gike kugira ngo icyitegererezo gishobore kongera gupimwa hashingiwe ku kuri aho kuba ku bitekerezo.
oracle_docs.the_what_pillar_depends_on_a_language: Inkingi ya WHAT ishingiye ku cyitegererezo cy'ururimi n'amakuru; byombi bishobora gusoma nabi inkuru cyangwa kubura inkuru yihuse. Ni yo nkingi ifite agaciro gake kubera iyo mpamvu, kandi ihinduka icyiciro cy'ibanze gipima neza aho kugwa.
oracle_docs.the_what_pillar_is_the_only_place: Inkingi ya WHAT ni yo yonyine Oracle igera hanze y'ubwonko. Kugira ngo ishyire mu byiciro inkuru yo gutangiza, ikura inkuru z'ingenzi za crypto ziriho muri API y'amakuru rusange (ibitswe ~90s), ikazishyira mu butumwa bw'icyitegererezo cy'ururimi, ikasaba icyiciro, inkuru ngufi, igipimo cy'uko yakwirakwira, n'icyizere. Igiceri kiri mu nkuru z'ingenzi z'uyu munsi kiramenyekana nk'icyo kandi kigahabwa amanota menshi. Niba icyitegererezo kitabonetse, icyiciro cy'ibanze gipima neza amagambo y'ingenzi kirakoreshwa kugira ngo umwanzuro uhore utangwa.
oracle_docs.the_wins_gallery_resolved_calls_with_the: Urutonde rw'intsinzi — ibyemezo byakemuwe n'amanota yabyo yo kwinjira ugereranije n'ibyo byagezweho.
oracle_docs.the_worker_is_configured_entirely_by_env: Umukozi ategurwa rwose n'ibidukikije. Ibipimo byatoranyijwe (n'ibipimo bisanzwe): ORACLE_MODE=simulate, ORACLE_NETWORK=mainnet, ORACLE_SCORE_INTERVAL_MS=15000, ORACLE_AGENT_INTERVAL_MS=3000, ORACLE_SETTLE_INTERVAL_MS=60000, ORACLE_SCORE_BATCH=20, ORACLE_RESCORE_AFTER_SEC=180, ORACLE_MAX_TRADE_SOL=0.25 (igipimo ntarengwa cyo kugurisha), na ORACLE_GLOBAL_KILL=1 (ihagarika ibikorwa byose by'umukozi n'iby'ubwishingizi mu gihe amanota akomeje). Uburyo bwa Live busaba kandi ibanga rikoreshwa mu gusobanura wallets z'abakozi, kandi ntibushobora gutangira nta ryo.
oracle_docs.these_docs_are_written_in_two_layers: Aya mabwiriza yanditswe mu byiciro bibiri kugira ngo urupapuro rumwe rube rwiza ku muntu mushya ushaka kumenya n'umuhanga mu mibare ushaka uburyo bwuzuye.
oracle_docs.this_buy_would_exceed_the_24h_spend: ubu buguzi bwarenga igipimo ntarengwa cyo gukoresha mu masaha 24
oracle_docs.three_ways_in_depending_on_what_you: Uburyo butatu bwo kwinjira, bitewe n'ibyo ushaka kuri Oracle uyu munsi.
oracle_docs.transparency_over_magic_every_score_ship: Kugaragara neza kuruta amayobera. Buri nota ritangwa hamwe n'impamvu zaryo. Nta musaruro w'icyitegererezo udasobanutse usabwa kwizera — ushobora gusoma impamvu igiceri cyabonye amanota 82 cyangwa kikagera kuri 46.
oracle_docs.two_coins_can_both_score_70_for: Ibiceri bibiri bishobora kubona amanota 70 kubera impamvu zitandukanye rwose — kimwe kubera amateka meza ariko kidafite imbaraga nyinshi, ikindi kubera inkuru yakwirakwiriye cyane ariko ifite ishingiro ridakomeye. Icyiciro kikubwira imbaraga; impamvu zikubwira impamvu, kandi impamvu ni yo ushingiraho ugurisha.
oracle_docs.two_design_commitments_make_that_bet_hon: Ibyemezo bibiri by'igishushanyo bituma ubwo bucuruzi buba bwizewe:
oracle_docs.two_win_rates_are_published_deliberately: Hari ibipimo bibiri by'intsinzi bitangazwa, byatandukanyijwe ku bushake: igipimo cy'intsinzi y'ibyo byasabwe (ibiceri byemejwe na Oracle byahawe amanota ya Lean, Strong, cyangwa Prime — ibyiciro ikubwira gukoraho) n'igipimo fatizo cy'isoko (buri gikorwa cyatangijwe cyahawe amanota — icyo kugura byose utitayeho byatanga). Kugeza igihe ibyo byasabwe nyabyo byemejwe, igipimo cy'intsinzi y'ibyo byasabwe kigaragaza "nta byasabwe byemejwe na gato"; igipimo fatizo ntikigaragazwa na rimwe nk'ubuhanga bwa moteri.
oracle_docs.unlike_the_normal_approximation_the_wils: Bitandukanye n'igereranya risanzwe p ± z·√(p(1−p)/n), intera ya Wilson iguma muri [0,1], ntiyagabanuka ikagira ubugari bwa zeru kuri p=0 cyangwa p=1, kandi ikora neza ku n ntoya ibipimo bya mbere bishya bigira. Iyo ni itandukaniro hagati y'ukuri "ntiturabimenya" n'ikinyoma "0% ± 0%."
oracle_docs.walking_the_drawer_top_to_bottom_mirrors: Kugenda mu kabati uhereye hejuru ukamanuka hasi bigaragaza neza icyitegererezo:
oracle_docs.when_a_coin_launches_the_people_who: Iyo igiceri gitangijwe, abatsinda ni abasanzwe bazi ibintu udashobora kubona vuba bihagije: ama-wallet agura (kandi niba ayo ma-wallet afite amateka meza cyangwa amateka mabi y'ubujura), niba itangizwa ari risanzwe cyangwa ryateguwe, niba "umuryango" ari abantu 200 nyabo cyangwa ama-wallet 200 mashya yashyizwemo amafaranga, na niba inkuru ifite imbaraga mu muco. Iyo umuntu asomye igishushanyo, itandukaniro ry'amakuru riba ryaramaze kwishyura.
oracle_docs.when_a_coin_s_outcome_resolves_the: Iyo ibyavuye mu giceri byemejwe, uburyo bwo gukemura bugena buri gikorwa cyatangiye kuri cyo:
oracle_docs.who_and_how_together_carry_nearly_two: NDE na UKO hamwe bifite hafi bibiri bya gatatu by'uburemere kuko uwagura na uburyo itangizwa ryakozwe mu mucyo ni ibintu bibiri byizewe cyane bitandukanya abatsinda n'abajura. IKI na GUKORA biroroshye — bitandukanya ibingana kandi bigashimangira, ariko inkuru nziza cyangwa umunota wa mbere mwiza ntibishobora kurokora igiceri inkingi zikomeye zihamya.
oracle_docs.who_s_in_is_the_live_pedigree: Abari muri ni urutonde rw'inkomoko zizwi — buri wallet izwi, ikimenyetso cyayo, n'amateka yayo.
oracle_docs.why_this_score_is_the_array_each: “Impamvu y'aya manota” ni urutonde rwa reasons[], buri murongo wanditswe ku nkingi yawutangije. Urugero: "nta ma-wallet yizewe aramenyekana" (NDE), "imiterere y'itangizwa isukuye kandi ikwirakwira" (UKO), "inkuru ya meme, ikwirakwira 45/100" (IKI), "nta mbaraga zigaragara ziraboneka — hakiri kare" (GUKORA). Itangizwa rishya risukuye ariko ritarageragezwa — neza ni ukureba, ntabwo ari ukwirinda cyangwa kugura.
oracle_docs.wilson_1927_probable_inference_the_law_o: Wilson (1927), Probable inference, the law of succession, and statistical inference — intera y'amanota. Brier (1950), Verification of forecasts expressed in terms of probability. Platt (1999), ibyavuye mu mibare y'ibishoboka kuri SVMs (Platt scaling). Zadrozny & Elkan (2002), isotonic calibration. Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana (2005), Predicting good probabilities with supervised learning.
oracle_docs.wilson_interval_the_95_score_interval_on: Intera ya Wilson: intera y'amanota 95% ku gipimo cy'intsinzi cya buri cyiciro/bin (ibyavuye mu isesengura ryimbitse ry'ibimenyetso), ikosowe ku n ntoya kandi igarukira kuri [0,1].
oracle_docs.win_loss_isn_t_known_until_a: Intsinzi/igihombo ntibimenyekana kugeza igihe igiceri cyemejwe, bityo ikigeragezo cya mbere gihora kiza nyuma y'igihe cy'ubu. Idirishya rya vuba ni rito kandi imipaka y'icyizere yabyo iragutse — kandi urupapuro rugaragaza ubugari aho kubuhisha.
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_honest_error: Igipimo cy'intsinzi ku cyiciro, hamwe n'imipaka y'amakosa y'ukuri.
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_wilson_cis: Igipimo cy'intsinzi ku rwego hamwe na Wilson CIs, urwego rwo kugereranya, Brier, n'incamake y'inyungu. Aho kuyungurura: igihe, urwego, urusobe.
oracle_docs.win_the_coin_graduated_or_its_peak: Intsinzi — igiceri cyarangiye, cyangwa igipimo cyacyo cyageze kuri ≥2× ku giceri kitarahanantuka kandi kitarashyirwa munsi y'igice cy'ingano yinjira.
oracle_docs.with_no_signal_yet_it_returns_too: Nta kimenyetso kiraboneka, gisubiza "hakiri kare," bigatuma inkingi iguma hagati aho guhanga imbaraga zitariho.

partners.a_builder_focused_publishing_partnership: Ubufatanye mu gusohora ibitabo bwibanda ku bafite ubumenyi: ingingo z'ingenzi, amasomo, n'amabwiriza y'abashinzwe iterambere ku bantu bakoresha AI, byasohowe ku bafite ubumenyi bakoresha HackerNoon.
partners.agents_earn_and_spend_using_the_x402: Abakozi binjiza kandi bakoresha bakoresheje uburyo bwo kwishyura bwa x402. Abafatanyabikorwa bashobora kwinjiza amafaranga kuri API binyuze mu kwishyurana guto hagati y'abakozi.
partners.alibaba_cloud_extends_three_ws_into_apac: Alibaba Cloud yaguye three.ws mu masoko ya APAC hamwe no guhuza na Qwen model no gushyira seriveri za MCP mu karere. Abakozi ba three.ws bagera ku bantu bo ku isi bafite ubushobozi bwo gukora vuba hafi y'abakoresha muri Aziya.
partners.built_on_the_world_s_best_infrastructure:
Hubatswe ku bikoresho bya
byiza cyane ku isi.
partners.deployed_on_aws_infrastructure_with_mark: Yashyizwe ku bikorwa remezo bya AWS hamwe no kuboneka kuri Marketplace. Ibigo bishobora gutanga ubushobozi bwa three.ws agent biturutse kuri fagitire yabo ya AWS isanzwe, bishyigikira gushyiraho VPC no kugenzura uburyo bwo kwinjira bwahujwe na IAM.
partners.every_agent_gets_a_verifiable_on_chain: Buri agent ibona indangamuntu yemejwe kuri blockchain. Urubuga rwawe ruhinduka igice cy'ubukungu bwa agent budasaba uruhushya.
partners.google_cloud_powers_three_ws_inference_s: Google Cloud itanga imbaraga kuri three.ws inference, ububiko, no gutanga serivisi mu gihe nyacyo ku rwego rw'isi. Guhuza na Vertex AI bituma agents zikoresha models za Gemini hamwe n'indangamuntu ya three.ws n'uburyo bwo kwishyura.
partners.if_your_platform_powers_ai_cloud_or: Niba urubuga rwawe rutanga imbaraga kuri AI, cloud, cyangwa ibikoresho by'abashinzwe iterambere kandi ukaba ushaka kubishyira imbere ya agents ziri kubaka internet y'ejo hazaza, reka tuganire.
partners.meta_description: Urusobe rw'abafatanyabikorwa ba three.ws — AWS, IBM, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Intel, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Oracle, Quicknode. Urubuga rw'ibikoresho remezo bya cloud, AI, na blockchain rutanga imbaraga kuri 3D AI agents ku rwego rw'ibigo binini.
partners.meta_og_description: Urubuga rwa cloud na AI rutanga imbaraga kuri 3D AI agents ku rwego rw'ibigo binini.
partners.meta_twitter_description: Urubuga rwa cloud na AI rutanga imbaraga kuri 3D AI agents ku rwego rw'ibigo binini.
partners.reach_developers_and_enterprises_buildin: Gerageza kugera ku bashinzwe iterambere n'ibigo biri kubaka AI agents z'igihe kizaza mu masoko yose akomeye.
partners.ship_a_first_class_mcp_server_that: Ohereza seriveri ya MCP yo ku rwego rwo hejuru agents zishobora kuvumbura no guhamagara mu buryo bwa kimeza muri three.ws Forge na marketplace.
partners.three_ws_3d_agent_identity_and_x402: Indangamuntu ya three.ws 3D agent na x402 payment rails bihuza na IBM watsonx na IBM Granite. Agents zikoresha AI models z'ibigo mu gihe zikomeza indangamuntu kuri blockchain no gukora micropayments nyayo — byose biturutse kuri profile imwe ya agent.
partners.three_ws_is_a_member_of_nvidia: three.ws ni umunyamuryango wa NVIDIA Inception, gahunda ya NVIDIA yagenewe startups zikora ku mibare yihuse. Buri nzira ya 3D generation isanzwe ikorera kuri NVIDIA silicon: text to 3D, photo to avatar, auto-rigging, na motion capture, hamwe na NIM lane y'ubuntu itunganijwe inyuma ya forge.
partners.three_ws_is_a_member_of_the: three.ws ni umunyamuryango wa Quicknode Startup Program ifite inguzanyo z'ibikorwaremezo byemejwe. RPC endpoints za Quicknode zikwirakwira ku isi hose zongerera ubushobozi no kwizerwa mu kwinjira kuri chain inyuma ya agent wallets, kugenzura kwishyurana kwa x402, n'amakuru y'isoko ya Solana mu gihe nyacyo.
partners.three_ws_is_an_openai_select_partner: three.ws ni Umuhamya Wafashwe na OpenAI mu Ntwazangabo y'Abahamya ba OpenAI. Konekitiri y'Itangazamakuru ya 3D Studio ya three.ws ifite ubuhinzi bwite ku buhinzi bwa ChatGPT zina 11: kubika umudende w'andiko, avatar zifite imirizo, gukorera hamwe n'ubushobozi bwo guhindura, kubona umudende wose mu nkengero zibanyi, n'umubiri w'umuhanga ubuzima, byose biraboneka mu mibare y'ibiganiro.
partners.three_ws_runs_on_and_integrates_with: three.ws ikorana kandi ihuzwa na za platform zikomeye za cloud, AI, na hardware — bigaha buri agent ubushobozi bwa compute, indangamuntu, n'ubugari bwa enterprise.

pill.skeleton_intro: Umukino wageze mu buryo busanzwe bw'ibimenyetso byakozwe no gusuzumwa: igikapu kimwe cyafunzwe, nta magufa, nta mitsi, cyafashwe mu gihe cy'igikorwa, kandi gifite ubunini buhagije bwo gufata telefone. Umurongo wacu wihariye ushaka umutwe ku gahanga n'intoki ebyiri ndende, kandi igikapu gifite ibice bine nta na kimwe muri ibyo. Bityo cyabonye umurongo wacyo, kandi uwo murongo uri muri repo: scripts/rig-pill-mascot.py.
pill.skeleton_outro: Uwo mubare wa nyuma ni wo ufite agaciro nyuma y'iyi paji. Umubiri ukoresha amazina y'ibimenyetso by'ibanze, bityo igikapu ntigifite imipaka ku mashusho atandatu giturukamo: buri gikorwa ku rubuga kiragikurura, harimo n'ibyo utarakoze. Ibisobanuro birambuye biri muri the docs.
pill.stage_canvas_aria: Urubuga rwa 3D. Igikapu cya pump.fun cyakozwe, gishobora kugendwa.
pill.stage_help: Ikiranga igikapu cy'icyatsi n'umweru gifite isura y'umusatsi, intoki ebyiri zifite uburebure n'amaguru abiri y'uburebure, ahagaze ku rubuga rw'ikirere. Koresha W, A, S na D cyangwa imfunguzo z'ibumoso kugenda, Shift kugirango ugende vuba, Space kugirango ushuke, E kugirango ushimire no Q kugirango ubyine. Imirongo iri hasi ikina imirimo imwe.
pill.stat_retarget: ya three.ws urutonde rw'imipaka rujya kuri yo
pill.step1: Shaka intoki utabwiwe aho ziri. Voxelize umubiri, fata impinduka zayo, kandi umubiri ni byose biremereye kuruta intoki. Ibice bine birasohoka nk'ibisigaye.
pill.step2: Siga buri gice kigaruka mu mubiri. Inzira y'igiciro gito ikunda imbere ikurikira imiterere nyayo y'intoki aho kwibeshya ku murongo utambitse, niyo mpamvu ikirenge cyakiriwe gifite igufa cy'ikirenge cyakiriwe.
pill.step3: Gukora ibyo biri imbere, ntabwo ibyo hafi. Icyifuzo cyakozwe gishyira ikiganza kimwe ku ruhande rw'umutwe. Icyose gupima intera gita izo mpande ebyiri abaturanyi kandi gihuza, bityo ibiro byemezwa no kugenda buri vertex imbere ku murongo w'igice ikora. Mu mesh, icyo kiganza kiri intera y'ukuri kuva kuri icyo gice cy'ubwoya.
pill.step4: Gukora mu gihe cy'igikorwa, uhagarare. glTF ikomeza umwanya wo gukora no guhagarara, kandi umusubiramo wacu usubiramo imirimo y'igice nk'ikimenyetso ku mwanya wo guhagarara. Icyiciro cyo kugenda kigomba gutangirira ku maguru munsi y'ibihanga, bityo umwanya usanzwe uba wubatswe mu mibereho yoherejwe.
pill.step5: Gukora ku bipimo bifite. Imipaka itandatu, yanditswe ku gikapu gifite intoki zifite uburebure n'umutwe ahubwo yakuwe mu makuru y'abantu: idasanzwe, kugenda, kwihuta, gushimira, gusimbuka, kubyina.
pill.tw_desc: pump.fun yemejwe $THREE nk'iyacu byemewe. Bityo twakoze igikapu cyabo kandi tubiha amaguru. Genda mu rubuga rwawe.
pill.verify_p1: pump.fun kwemeza ikarita nk'iyemewe y'igikorwa inyuma yayo. Iyi ni imirongo hagati y'ukuri $THREE n'ibisubizo byitwa izina n'ikimenyetso cyayo, kandi niyo nzira yihuse cyane ku mugura kumenya itandukaniro mbere yo gukoresha ikintu.
pill.verify_p2: $THREE niyo karita imwe uru rubuga rwamamaza, kandi ibarizwa kuri FeMbDoX7R1Psc4GEcvJdsbNbZA3bfztcyDCatJVJpump. Icyapa ubu kigaragara hafi yayo ku urupapuro rwa token, gusoma ubuzima bwa pump.fun ku busabe bwose bw'ibipimo aho kuba byanditse, bityo ikimenyetso hano buri gihe kigaragaza ikintu kimwe n'ikimenyetso hariya. Ibindi byose byakozwe binyuze muri three.ws ni itangiriro ry'umukoresha, kandi buri kimwe cyabo kiri ku rutonde n'umwanditsi wacyo kuri Ibikorwa by'Agent.

pitch.the_brains_are_everywhere_the_bodies_are: Ubwonko buri ahantu hose. Imibiri ntabwo irubakwa. Turi ikipe yasohoye urwego rubiha umubiri — kandi turashaka kubigira ibisanzwe.
pitch.the_character_beside_this_text_is_render: Umuntu uri iruhande rw'iyi nyandiko yerekanywe mu mushakisha wawe kuva kuri dosiye ya 3D isanzwe — kimwe n'ibyo bishyirwa mu kantu kamwe kashyizwemo. Kagikurure. Kagizunguze. Ni ukuri.
pitch.the_default_way_any_ai_gets_a: Uburyo busanzwe AI iyo ari yo yose ibonamo umubiri.
pitch.the_embodiment_layer_is_the_connective_t: Urwego rw'umubiri ni umusego uhuza byose bitatu.
pitch.the_one_line_element_that_drops_a: Agace kamwe k'umurongo gashyira agent ivuga kuri urubuga urwo arirwo rwose.
pitch.the_product_is_the_marketing_every_integ: Ibicuruzwa ni byo kwamamaza. Buri huzu ni ikimenyetso cyamamaza, kandi buri mushinzwe iterambere udukoresha arushaho kudufata.
pitch.three_ws_is_the_connective_tissue_betwee: three.ws ni umusego uhuza model ya AI n'umubiri isi ishobora kubona no kuvugisha. Intambwe enye, nta bahanga.
pitch.three_ws_turns_any_ai_into_a: three.ws ihindura AI iyo ari yo yose ikayigira umuntu wa 3D ugaragara ako kanya — ifite isura, ijwi, n'imigendekere — ushobora gushyira kuri urubuga urwo arirwo rwose ukoresheje umurongo umwe w'ikodegisi.
pitch.turns_every_user_and_every_embed_into: Bihindura buri mukoresha na buri kintu cyashyizwemo uburyo bwo gukwirakwiza.
pitch.two_lines_of_html_drop_the_agent: Imirongo ibiri ya HTML ishyira agent kuri urubuga urwo arirwo rwose, ikiganiro cyangwa porogaramu.
pitch.we_didn_t_write_a_roadmap_to: Ntitwanditse inzira igana ku guha umubiri. Twarayishyize hanze, hanyuma dutangira kuyongerera agaciro.
pitch.we_sit_where_three_large_markets_converg: Turi aho amasoko atatu manini ahurira.
pitch.webgl_and_webgpu_put_console_grade_rende: WebGL na WebGPU bishyira rendering yo ku rwego rwa console ku rubuga rusanzwe. Nta kwishyira, nta duka rya porogaramu, nta plugin.
pitch.what_s_missing_is_the_layer_that: Ibihura ni urwego rubihuza — kandi rugahindura imiterere n'imico bikaba agent ifite umubiri ushobora gushyira ahantu hose.
pitch.while_the_category_is_still_being_named: Mu gihe icyiciro kigishakirwa izina, twarashyize hanze inzira yose — mu bikorwa, mu mushakisha, uyu munsi.

play_economy.meta_description: Igiciro cyose, igihembo n'umuryango mu bukungu bwa /play: icyo iduka ryishyura ku byo ubonye, icyo rucuruza, uko banki irinda amafaranga yawe mu rupfu, icyo $THREE boutique yishyura, n'urutonde rwose rw'ibiciro bifite amahirwe nyakuri. Soma mu meza amwe n'ayo server y'umukino ikoresha mu gucuruza.
play_economy.meta_og_description: Icyerekezo cyuzuye cy'ubukungu bwa /play: ibiciro by'udukino, amategeko ya banki, $THREE boutique, n'urutonde rwose rw'ibiciro bifite amahirwe nyakuri. Ntiwigeze wandikwa, soma mu meza y'umukino ubwayo.
play_economy.meta_twitter_description: Ibiciro by'udukino, amategeko ya banki, $THREE boutique, n'urutonde rwose rw'ibiciro bifite amahirwe nyakuri.
play_economy.nothing_below_is_transcribed_by_hand_the: Nta kintu kiri hasi cyanditswe n'intoki. Urupapuro rusoma ameza amwe n'ayo server y'umukino ikoresha mu gucuruza, bityo umubare uri hano niwo uzishyurwa.
play_economy.the_catalogs_gates_and_odds_on_this: Ibyegeranyo, imiryango n'amahirwe biri kuri uru rupapuro bitangwa na /api/play/economy, ibikura mu moduli z'umukino ubwayo aho kubivuga, bityo iki cyerekezo ntigishobora kuva ku byo server yishyura. Amafaranga ni umutungo w'umukino kandi ntashobora kuva mu isi; gusa boutique ifungura n'ibiziga byishyurwa nibyo bigera ku murongo, kandi byombi byemezwa ku murongo mbere y'uko ikintu cyose gitangwa. Urutonde rwihariye rwa USDC cosmetics rail ku mukino wihariye w'ikiremwa cyanditswe munsi ya Fits.
play_economy.the_open_world_runs_a_real_economy: Isi ifunguye ikora ubukungu nyakuri: umufuka ushobora gutakaza, banki iyirinda, iduka rishiraho ibiciro byose ku ruhande rwa server, boutique y'ibikoresho ishyira ku Solana, n'igikapu gifite amahirwe ashyizwe ahagaragara. Kugeza ubu, wagombaga kugenda ugera kuri buri NPC kugira ngo umenye ibyo byose. Ibi ni byose, ahantu hamwe.

play_solver.every_yield_rule_in_the_open_world: Itegeko ryose ry'inyungu mu isi ifunguye ni imikorere isobanutse y'urwego rwawe rw'ubuhanga n'ikibuga urimo, kandi buri guhinduka ifite umuvuduko wihariye server ishyiraho. Ibi bisobanuye ko amafaranga yitezwe, XP n'ibicuruzwa ku isaha atari ibintu ugomba gukurikirana no guhuza. Birashobora gukemurwa, neza, mu gikorwa kimwe.
play_solver.meta_description: Ubukungu bwa /play, bwakemuwe. Amafaranga yitezwe neza na XP ku isaha kuri buri giti, amabuye n'ikiyaga ku rwego rwose, igihe cyiza cyo gufata no guteka, igiciro nyakuri cy'igikapu, n'agaciro k'ubukangurambaga ku kill. Byakoreshejwe mu buryo bwihariye bw'ameza y'umukino, ntibigeze bipimwa.
play_solver.meta_og_description: Amafaranga yitezwe neza na XP ku isaha kuri buri node mu isi ku rwego rwose, yakemuwe mu buryo bwihariye bw'ameza y'umukino. Hindura urwego urebe uko isi yose igenda ihindura ibiciro.
play_solver.meta_twitter_description: Buri node mu isi ya /play, igiciro cyayo neza, ku rwego rwose. Uburyo bwihariye, ntibipimwa.
play_solver.served_by_which_imports_the_authoritativ: Iherezo rya /api/play/solver, ryinjiza imiyoboro y'imikino y'ukuri aho kuyisubiramo: imiyoboro y'inyungu iva muri items.js, imirongo iva muri activities.js, ibiciro biva muri shop.js n'ibipimo bya buri node biva muri world-features.js. Nta mubare uri kuri iyi paji wigeze ukurwaho, gufatwa cyangwa kwandikwa, bityo ntushobora kuva ku byo server ikora. Ibyifuzo by'icyitegererezo byanditswe hamwe n'ibisubizo byose kandi bigaragara hasi kuri iyi paji, kuko igipimo cyavuzwe kitari kumwe n'ibyifuzo byacyo ni ikinyoma. Amafaranga ni umutungo w'umukino udashobora kuva mu isi; gusa gufungura boutique no kwishyura spins ni byo byinjira mu murongo.
play_solver.so_we_solved_them_move_the_level: Nuko twabikemuye. Hindura urwego hasi maze isi yose isubiramo ibiciro: igiti cyose, amabuye yose, ikiyaga cyose, igikuriro, iduka n'ibikoko byose biri muri yo.

pocket.embed_p: Iframe imwe. Icarry agent ufite ubu, ikabika umubiri wayo wa 3D, ikanakora ku isoko ryose. Nta SDK, nta cyiciro cyo kubaka, nta API key.
pocket.hero_sub: Buri wese ari gushushanya portfolios mu consoles z'ibinyoma. Iyi ikora. Hari agent nyakuri wa 3D urimo kugenda imbere ya ecran, D-pad ikayiyobora, cartridges ni agents ziriho zose umuntu ku three.ws yubatswe, kandi umurongo umwe wa HTML ushyira byose ku rubuga rwawe.

pocket.rail_hint: Buri agent hano ni nyakuri kandi iraboneka. Shyiramo imwe, cyangwa ukande L / R ku gikoresho.

Impinduka za 24h zigaragaza igice cy'agaciro hamwe n'amateka y'ibiciro; igipimo cyagaragajwe, ntigihamye. Ibimenyetso bitagira igiciro bigumana ingano zabyo kandi ntibijyanwa mu mibare y'ibisubizo.

preflight.how_p1: Umukiriya ni igipaki. Ukurura, ukemeza, kandi ntukemere ko wishyura umucuruzi udashobora kurangiza, ugahindura ku murongo ukora igihe uboneka.
preflight.how_p2: Cyangwa uhereye ku terminal, aho ikode y'igisohoka ari yo gisubizo:
preflight.how_p3: Uburyo bw'itumanaho burakomeye kandi budafite imbogamizi: umucuruzi uwo ari we wese x402 ashobora kubitangaza kandi umukiriya uwo ari we wese ashobora kubyemeza. Soma inyandiko ku buryo, amategeko yo kwemeza, n'ukuntu ushobora gutanga icyemezo uhereye ku muryango wawe.
preflight.meta_desc: Reba niba umucuruzi x402 ashobora koko kwakira amafaranga yawe mbere yo kuyishyura. Iyi niyo ikurura inyandiko yemewe y'ubushobozi bw'umucuruzi ikayemeza hamwe n'ikimenyetso n'igihe cyayo mu rubuga rwawe.
preflight.share_desc: x402 igaragaza igiciro cy'ikintu. Preflight igaragaza niba umucuruzi ashobora koko gufata amafaranga yawe. Yanditswe, ifite igihe ntarengwa, yemejwe mu rubuga rwawe.
preflight.sub: x402 igaragaza ikintu giciro. Nta kintu ivuga ku bijyanye n'uko umucuruzi ashobora gukemura ibyo akurikirana, kandi itandukaniro ryishyurwa n'umuguzi: guhererekanya kwanditswe, blockhash yakoreshejwe, 502, kandi nta serivisi. Preflight irakemura. Andika ahantu hose hasi kandi iyi paji izakurura /.well-known/x402-preflight inyandiko yemewe ikayemeza ikimenyetso cya ed25519, igihe cyayo n'icyo ikubiyemo byose mu rubuga rwawe. Nta kintu dufata ku ijambo ryacu.

press_index.01use_the_files_as_they_are_no: 01Koresha amafayili uko ari. Nta guhindura ibara, gukurura, gukurura, guhindura, cyangwa kongera kubaka ikibaho mu bice. Icyiza cy'icyuma ni ikimenyetso.
press_index.02leave_clear_space_keep_at_least_half: 02Siga ahantu hazwi. Bika nibura igice cya kabiri cy'uburebure bw'ikibaho ku mpande zose. Nta kintu gikuraho, gihuza cyangwa gicumbikiye muri icyo gice.
press_index.03write_it_lowercase_the_name_is_three: 03Andika mu nyuguti ntoya. Izina ni three.ws mu nyandiko ikomeza, ntukandike "Three.ws", "THREE.WS", cyangwa "ThreeWS".
press_index.04do_not_lock_our_mark_to_another: 04Ntukandike ikimenyetso cyacu ku rindi logo utabanje kubaza. Igishushanyo cy'ikimenyetso gisangiye kigaragaza umubano ushobora kutabaho.
press_index.05editorial_use_is_granted_coverage_revi: 05Gukoresha mu itangazamakuru birahari. Ibyo gukurikirana, ibitekerezo, gahunda z'inama, n'ibikoresho by'abafatanyabikorwa ntibikeneye uruhushya. Gukoresha ikimenyetso nk'ikimenyetso cy'igicuruzwa cyawe, cyangwa mu buryo bugaragaza ko twemera igicuruzwa, birabujijwe.
press_index.a_platform_for_creating_animating_and_mo: Urubuga rwo gukora, guhindura, no gucuruza abakozi ba 3D AI.
press_index.agents_on_three_ws_are_economic_actors: Abakozi kuri three.ws ni abakinnyi b'ubukungu. Buri umwe ashobora kugira icyangombwa ku murongo kuri Solana, urubuga rw'ikibuga, akagira wallet n'izina rishobora gusomwa n'umuntu, kandi akishyura cyangwa akishyurwa n'abandi bakozi buri gihe ku isoko ry'API ku x402, igipimo cy'ubwishyu bwa HTTP 402. Ifaranga ry'urubuga, $THREE, riba kuri Solana.
press_index.approved_descriptions_at_four_lengths_co: Ibisobanuro byemewe ku mpande enye. Bika uko biri; byanditswe kugirango bikoreshwe.
press_index.assets_on_this_page_are_regenerated_from: Ibikoresho biri kuri iyi paji bikoreshwa biva mu isoko mu bubiko, bityo ibyo ukura ni ibihangano bihoraho. Niba ufite igihe gito kandi ukeneye iformat itari hano (EPS, ikibanza runaka, cyangwa ishusho ifite umwihariko), tubwire mu butumwa bw'imeri kandi bizagaruka ku munsi umwe.
press_index.checkable_claims_only_anything_not_liste: Ibyemezo bishobora kugenzurwa gusa. Ikintu cyose kitari hano, tubaze mbere yo gucapa.
press_index.distribution_is_the_point_a_finished_age: Gutanga ni ingenzi. Umukozi wuzuye ugezwa nka <agent-3d> igice cy'urubuga gishobora gushyirwa ku ipaji iyo ari yo yose, kandi buri gikoresho cyo gukora no gushushanya gishobora kugerwaho n'abafasha ba AI binyuze kuri MCP. three.ws ni Umufatanyabikorwa wa OpenAI Select, kandi umuhuza wacyo wa 3D Studio utanga ibikoresho 11 bitagira urufunguzo bya ChatGPT bigenera, gushushanya, kugenzura, no gushyira imiterere ya 3D mu AR, ikorwa mu buryo bwihariye mu biganiro. Ni umunyamuryango wa NVIDIA Inception.
press_index.download_the_whole_kit_zip_6_0: Kuramo ikibaho cyose ZIP, 6.0 MB. Ibimenyetso, ibishushanyo bya OpenAI, n'amategeko y'ikoreshwa nka README.
press_index.every_avatar_is_a_full_agent_not: Buri avatar ni umukozi wuzuye, si igishushanyo kidahinduka. Igihe cyo gukina gihuza umwihariko n'ubwonko bwa LLM bumva, buganira mu gihe nyacyo, bugakora ibimenyetso, bukibuka, kandi bukerekana amarangamutima binyuze mu maso n'imyitwarire y'icyitegererezo, mu gihe nyacyo mu rubuga nta kintu na kimwe gikeneye gushyirwa.

press_index.the_openai_partner_network_badge_inside_: Ikirango cy'Urubuga rw'Abafatanyabikorwa ba OpenAI kiri mu ikadi y'itangazo ni umutungo wa OpenAI, ukorwa uko byari bimeze. three.ws ni umunyamuryango wigenga w'uru rubuga ku rwego rwa Select: si igicuruzwa cya OpenAI, kandi ntikigamije gushyigikira OpenAI uretse ikirango cy'umufatanyabikorwa kigaragara. receipts.fineprint: / gushakisha · e ohereza CSV. Buri nyemezabuguzi ni ikimenyetso cyanditse (JWS) gituruka ku x402 Offer & Receipt extension; igikorwa cyo gukuramo JSON kirimo ikimenyetso kugira ngo umuntu wese abashe kugihamya ku rufunguzo rwa three.ws umucuruzi. Bamwe mu nyemezabuguzi ntibigaragaza on-chain tx hash ku mpamvu z'ubwirinzi. API inyuma y'iyi paji ni GET /api/x402/my-receipts, yanditswe mu API reference.
receipts.meta_desc: Buri x402 kwishyura wakoreye three.ws, ushobora kuyibona iteka. Hura na Solana cyangwa EVM wallet, andika ubutumwa bumwe, kandi subiza inyemezabuguzi zawe zemewe: ikirangantego, umuyoboro, settlement tx, n'ikimenyetso cyose nka JSON cyangwa CSV.
receipts.og_desc: Hura na wallet, andika ubutumwa bumwe, kandi ubone buri nyemezabuguzi yanditse x402 three.ws wigeze guhabwa: icyemezo cy'igura kuri buri API yishyuwe, ishobora koherezwa nka JSON cyangwa CSV.
receipts.search_placeholder: Sukura hakurikijwe ikirangantego, umuyoboro, cyangwa tx hash
receipts.signin_copy: Andika ubutumwa busobanutse bugaragaza aderesi yawe n'igihe. Ikimenyetso cyemeza gusoma inyemezabuguzi zawe gusa kandi nta kintu cyandi: nta guhererekanya, nta kwemeza, nta kiguzi. Igihe cyayo kirarangira nyuma y'iminota 5.
receipts.signin_h: Emeza urupapuro rwawe, ubone inyemezabwishyu zawe
receipts.signin_note: Ihuza na Phantom, Backpack, na Solflare kuri Solana, na MetaMask cyangwa indi wallet yinjijwe kuri EVM chains. Inyemezabwishyu zemejwe na three.ws munsi ya x402 Offer & Receipt extension, bityo abash third party bashobora kuzikurikirana battrustinga twe. Ntukigeze ukora itumanaho ryishyurwa? Tangira kuri x402 endpoint catalog.
receipts.sub: Buri itumanaho ryishyurwa x402 ukora kuri three.ws ritanga inyemezabwishyu yemejwe, kandi turagumana kopi ikomeye. Wabuze umutwe w'inyemezabwishyu y'ibanze? Huza wallet yawe, emera ubutumwa bumwe bwo gusoma, kandi usubize inyemezabwishyu zose zigeze kuri yo. Iyi ni igice cy'umukiriya mu gitabo: buri nyemezabwishyu hano ni ikintu waguze.
receipts.title: Inyemezabwishyu Vault
receipts.twitter_desc: Subiza inyemezabwishyu zose zemejwe x402 three.ws zigeze kuri wallet yawe. Ikimenyetso cy'igura, gishobora gusohorwa, gishobora kugenzurwa n'abashakashatsi.

reputation_market_index.back_an_agent_with_escrowed_sol_and: Shyigikira umukozi ufite SOL yateguwe kandi ubone inyungu ku byo yakoze. Inyungu ituruka ku mateka y'ibikorwa by'umukozi yanditswe, igabanywa buri munsi wa UTC hagati y'abantu bose bashyigikiye.
reputation_market_index.each_epoch_has_a_funded_budget_split: Buri gihembwe gifite ingengo y'imari yateguwe igabanyijwe na umugabane ×igihe ×ibipimo. Isoko ntirigomba kugira byinshi kurenza ibyo escrow ifite, kandi umugabane ntushobora gushyirwa mu kaga.
reputation_market_index.every_constant_below_lives_in_one_place: Buri kintu cyose kiri hasi kibaho ahantu hamwe kandi gikora kimwe mu rubuga rwawe no ku murongo, bityo ushobora kongera kubona inyungu ubwawe. Amasezerano yose: spec.
reputation_market_index.meta_description: Shyigikira kwizera ku mukozi kandi ubone inyungu ku mateka y'ibikorwa byayo yemejwe. Umugabane wateguwe, inyungu zituruka ku byemezo byanditswe ku murongo, withdraw igihe icyo aricyo cyose.
reputation_market_index.meta_og_description: Shyigikira kwizera ku mukozi kandi ubone inyungu ku mateka y'ibikorwa byayo yemejwe.
reputation_market_index.meta_twitter_description: Shyigikira kwizera ku mukozi kandi ubone inyungu ku mateka y'ibikorwa byayo yemejwe: umugabane wateguwe, inyungu zituruka ku byemezo byanditswe ku murongo, withdraw igihe icyo aricyo cyose.
reputation_market_index.positions_belong_to_the_wallet_that_sign: Aho umwanya uherereye ni mu wallet yasinye stake, bityo umuntu wese ashobora kuwureba. Inyungu zigaragazwa ku mwanya ufunguye zirategereje: zibarwa ku isoma ryose kandi zigakosorwa gusa igihe uvanamo.
reputation_market_index.ranked_by_net_principal_currently_escrow: Icyiciro gishingiye ku mugabane wose wateguwe ubu. Ibipimo by'igihe ni iby'inyungu z'uyu munsi zituruka ku kazi kemejwe k'umukozi n'ibibazo; byakozwe ni igipimo cy'ukwezi cy'inyungu abashoramari babonye, ntabwo ari igipimo cy'ibizaza.
reputation_market_index.three_ws: three.ws
reputation_market_index.weight_is_doubling_output_does_not_doubl: Ibipimo ni imikorere ×log2(1 + akazi). Gukuba umusaruro ntibikuba inyungu, bityo gushyira ibimenyetso by'ibiciro bidafite agaciro ntibikora ikintu.
reputation_market_index.where_quality_maps_the_1_5_feedback: ubuziranenge ×ubunyangamugayo, aho ubuziranenge buhuza urwego rw'ibitekerezo 1-5 ku 0-1 kandi ubunyangamugayo ni akazi / (akazi + 2 ×ibibazo). Nta gitekerezo kigaragara nk'ikinyuranyo, si ikibi.

restyle.every_ai_restyle_mints_a_real_durable: Buri guhindura imiterere hakoreshejwe AI bitanga GLB nyayo, iramba — ntibigera bisiba iyayibanjirije. 'Bika verisiyo' ibika impinduka zawe z'ubu zo gutunganya neza n'ibiteganyijwe mu buryo bumwe. Kanda kuri verisiyo kugira ngo uyisubize uko yari iri; iy'umwimerere ihora ari verisiyo ya 1.
restyle.meta_description: Hindura isura y'imodeli iyo ari yo yose ya 3D mu mushakisha: shyiraho ibiteganyijwe by'ibikoresho bya PBR (chrome, zahabu, ikirahure, igiti…), ureme ubwoko bw'amabara butandukanye bushingiye ku mbuto, uhindure imiterere hakoreshejwe AI ukurikije amabwiriza yanditse, kandi wohereze GLB yemejwe — mu buryo butangiza, hamwe n'amateka nyayo ya verisiyo.
restyle.meta_og_description: Shyiraho ibiteganyijwe by'ibikoresho bya PBR, uhindure imiterere hakoreshejwe AI ukurikije amabwiriza yanditse, n'ubwoko butandukanye bushingiye ku mbuto kuri GLB iyo ari yo yose, utunganye neza ibikoresho ako kanya, kandi wohereze imodeli yemejwe — mu buryo butangiza.
restyle.meta_twitter_description: Hindura isura y'imodeli iyo ari yo yose ya 3D mu mushakisha: shyiraho ibiteganyijwe by'ibikoresho bya PBR (chrome, zahabu, ikirahure, igiti…), uhindure imiterere ukurikije amabwiriza ya AI yanditse mu rurimi rusanzwe, ukwirakwize ubwoko bw'amabara butandukanye bushingiye ku mbuto nka verisiyo ziramba, utunganye neza ubukana bw'icyuma n'uburunguruke ako kanya, kandi wohereze GLB yemejwe — mu buryo butangiza, hamwe n'amateka nyayo ya verisiyo ishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
restyle.meta_twitter_title: Sitidiyo yo Guhindura Imiterere — ibiteganyijwe by'ibikoresho, guhindura imiterere hakoreshejwe AI n'ubwoko butandukanye · three.ws
restyle.re_skin_any_3d_model_in_your: Hindura isura ya buri kintu cya 3D mu mushakisha wanyu — shyiraho uburyo bw'ibanze bwa PBR, sobanura uko ubyifuza mu magambo asanzwe kugira ngo AI ibihindure, tangiza amabara y'ibanze atandukanye, hindura neza ubw'icyuma n'uburungurukira ako kanya, hanyuma wohereze GLB yemejwe. Umwimerere wanyu ntugira icyo uhindurwaho; Gusubiza inyuma biwugarura ako kanya.

rig-doctor.badge: Ikora mu buryo bwuzuye mu isura yawe
rig-doctor.drop_hint: cyangwa ukande kugirango uhitemo dosiye. Nta kintu cyoherejwe.
rig-doctor.drop_tip: Cyangwa ukande D uhereye ahantu hose ku rupapuro
rig-doctor.explain1_desc: Buri iklip mu three.ws library yanditswe ku murongo umwe w'ibanze: Hips, LeftForeArm, RightUpLeg, imiyoboro 52 muri rusange. Umurongo uvuga LeftForeArm ntukora na rig ivuga iyo joint lowerarm_l.
rig-doctor.explain2_desc: Nta makosa. GLB irakora, ibikoresho biragaragara, mixer irakora, kandi ikirangantego gihagaze mu mwanya wayo. Nta muntu uguhishurira impamvu, niyo mpamvu iyi paji ibaho kandi ikora mbere yo gushyira hanze aho kubikora nyuma.
rig-doctor.explain3_desc: Mixamo, Avaturn, Ready Player Me, Unreal, VRM, Daz, Rigify, Biped, HumanIK, Reallusion, MikuMikuDance, na MakeHuman bose bita ku ngingo zimwe mu buryo butandukanye. Canonicalizer imaze kumenya buri rurimi rwose, kandi ishobora guhindura dosiye yawe mu mwanya wayo.
rig-doctor.explain4_desc: Rig ntikunda guhomba burundu. Akenshi umubiri n'amaboko birahuza ariko amaguru ntahuze, bityo avatar ikagenda ku butaka ifite ibirenge byahagaze. Gukora amanota ku itsinda ry'ibice bitandukanye ni itandukaniro riri hagati ya "62% byuzuye" na "amaguru yawe ntazigenda".
rig-doctor.hero_sub: Ibyiciro by'animasi byita ku ngingo mu izina. Rig ifite ingingo zitwa Bip001 L UpperArm ikora neza, igaragaza neza, hanyuma igahagarara itarimo kugenda. Shyira .glb yawe kandi umenye mu gihe cy'igice cy'igice, mbere yo kuyishyira ahantu.
rig-doctor.meta_desc: Shyira .glb urebe mu gihe cy'igice niba izakora ku three.ws. Rig Doctor izahita iguhishurira imigenzo yawe y'ibice, igafata amanota ku itsinda ry'ibice byose, ikagukemurira amazina y'ibice atari mu rwego mu rubuga rwawe, hanyuma igasubiza dosiye ikosowe. Nta kintu na kimwe kirashyirwa hanze.
rig-doctor.next1_desc: Buri gikorwa rig yawe igomba guhura, cyerekanywe. Ibi nibyo ingingo 52 zikoreshwa.
rig-doctor.next2_desc: Shyiramo, hash, kandi wemeze manifest uhereye ku shell yawe cyangwa kuri CI.
rig-doctor.next3_desc: Ibyo buri mwanzuro bisobanura, urutonde rwuzuye rw'ingingo zemewe, n'ukuntu wakosora buri imwe.

Mu minota igera kuri imwe ubona ikigirwamana cya 3D cyawe cyateguwe gishobora gukoreshwa muri app, umukino, cyangwa stream iyo ari yo yose. Amafoto agabanywa ubunini muri browser yawe — nta na kimwe kibikwa kuri disk. Ugiye gusikana ikintu aho kwisikana? Image to 3D ihindura ifoto iyo ari yo yose ikigirwamana gifite texture.

scan.remove_sunglasses_masks_or_anything_cove: Kura amadarubindi, udupfukamunwa, cyangwa ikindi kintu cyose gitwikiriye isura yawe
scan.stylized_cleaner_cartoon_leaning_good_fo: Stylized Isukuye, yegereye amashusho y'ibitabo. Yiza kuri streaming + imikino.
scan.this_scan_works_in_any_three_ws: Iyi scan ikora muri app, umukino, cyangwa stream iyo ari yo yose ikoresha three.ws.
scan.this_usually_takes_1_2_minutes_keep: Ibi bisanzwe bifata iminota 1-2. Guma ufunguye iyi tab — tuzakumenyesha birangiye.

Buri gice kiba ikintu gifite izina mu byavuye hanze GLB. Igikoresho kimwe kiboneka ku bagenzi binyuze kuri MCP nka segment_model no kuri REST kuri /api/forge-segment.
segment.meta_description: Gucamo igishushanyo mbonera cya 3D mu bice bifite ibisobanuro, bishobora gutandukanywa — umutwe, igituza, amaguru n'amaboko; umubiri, amapine, ikirahure. Kanda ku gice kugira ngo ugishyire ukwacyo, uhindure uko kigaragara, kandi ugikureho ukwacyo nka GLB.
segment.meta_og_description: Hindura imiterere imwe mu bice bifite amazina, bishobora kugerwaho ushobora guhisha, guhindura ibara, gusimbuza, no kohereza buri kimwe ukwacyo.

segment.part_segmentation_needs_the_segment_work: Gukata ibice bisaba ko umukozi ukata aba yashyizweho. Iyo GCP_SEGMENT_URL na GCP_RECONSTRUCTION_KEY bimaze gushyirwaho, iyi paji ikoresha urwego rwose nta mpinduka zindi.
segment.paste_a_glb_obj_stl_ply_url: Shyiramo URL ya GLB/OBJ/STL/PLY. Studio y'Ibice iyitandukanya ku bishishwa bitandukanye n'imikunjo yinjira, ikayigabanyamo ibice byahawe amazina kandi bishobora guhindurirwa amabara — hanyuma ukande ku gice icyo aricyo cyose kugira ngo ugishyire ukwacyo, uhindure uko kigaragara, cyangwa ukohereze cyonyine.
segment.paste_a_public_mesh_url_above_and: Shyiramo URL y'umuyoboro rusange hejuru hanyuma ukande Kata. Waba warakoze icyitegererezo muri Forge? Ifungurire hano ukoresheje akabuto ka “Split into parts” ku musaruro, cyangwa ushyiremo link yayo ya GLB.
segment.something_went_wrong_try_a_simpler_mesh: Hari ikitagenda neza. Gerageza umuyoboro woroshye cyangwa ibice bike.

sign-mirror.camera_note: Hand tracking ikora mu buryo bw'imbere hifashishijwe MediaPipe. Funga tab, irahita igenda.
sign-mirror.chip: Gukora ku maboko · igipimo ku gikoresho cyawe
sign-mirror.course_copy: Ibyuma bifunze mbere, amaboko afunguye nyuma, hanyuma pairs zose umunyeshuri wese akora amakosa. Ibaruwa ihinduka icyatsi igihe uyifashe neza; intambwe yawe ibikwa kuri iki gikoresho. Ushobora kandi gukanda urufunguzo rw'ibarwa iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo uhite ujya kuri yo.
sign-mirror.footer_note: Iyi ni igice cyo kwitoza mu gikorwa cyo gusinya. Icyerekezo cy'ibarwa n'umubare byose biri kuri /asl-alphabet, amagambo yose n'ibisubizo byanditse mu kiganiro biri kuri /sign-language, kandi moteri inyuma y'izi paji eshatu yanditswe muri inyandiko z'ururimi rw'ibisigo kandi ikoherezwa nka @three-ws/sign-language package, ishobora gushyirwa muri clone kugeza igihe iyandikwa ryayo rizaba rigeze. Avatar, igishushanyo cy'icyerekezo, n'igipimo byose bisoma specification imwe y'amaboko, bityo ibyo bigishwa n'ibyo bipimwa ntibishobora gutandukana.
sign-mirror.hint_default: Fungura camera kugira ngo upimwe, cyangwa gusa ukore kopi y'igishushanyo.
sign-mirror.lede: Kureba inyuguti ni igice cyoroshye. Hano niho uyikora: avatar ikora inyuguti, camera yawe ireba ukuboko kwawe, kandi urupapuro rukora isuzuma ry'uburyo ukuboko kugaragara mu gihe nyacyo, intoki ku yindi. Niba uyikoresheje neza, inyuguti irakomeza. Niba uyikoresheje nabi, izavuga intoki. Nta kintu camera yawe ibona gishobora kuva muri iki gice.
sign-mirror.meta_desc: Menya inyuguti z'ikinyarwanda mu buryo bwo kuzikora, ntabwo gusa kuzikurikirana. Avatar ikora inyuguti, camera yawe ireba ukuboko kwawe, kandi urupapuro rukora isuzuma ry'uburyo ukuboko kugaragara mu gihe nyacyo kandi rugatanga izina ry'intoki itari ku murongo. Ibintu byose biguma ku gikoresho cyawe.
sign-mirror.page_title: Sign Mirror: kora inyuguti, ukore isuzuma mu gihe nyacyo · three.ws
sign-mirror.share_desc: Avatar ikora inyuguti y'ikinyarwanda, camera yawe ireba ukuboko kwawe, kandi urupapuro rukora isuzuma ry'uburyo ukuboko kugaragara mu gihe nyacyo. Nta videwo na imwe ibasha kuva ku gikoresho cyawe.
sign-mirror.share_title: Sign Mirror: kora inyuguti, ukore isuzuma mu gihe nyacyo · three.ws
sign-mirror.title: Icyerekezo kizwi ku nyuguti.
sign-mirror.video_aria: Camera yawe, ikozwe mu buryo bw'ikinyarwanda
sign-mirror.video_idle: Camera irafunze. Funga kugirango ukore isuzuma mu gihe nyacyo. Videwo, ibimenyetso by'intoki, n'ibipimo byose biguma muri iki gice: nta murongo wa interineti mu gikorwa cyo kwitoza. Cyangwa wihorere camera kandi ukore kopi y'igishushanyo cy'icyerekezo n'amaso.
sign-mirror.video_loading: Gukura umuyoboro w'intoki. Hafi ya 8 MB, rimwe kuri buri murongo. Ibi birabikwa nyuma y'ibi, kandi bizarangirira muri iki gice kuva ubwo.
sign-mirror.video_starting: Gutegereza camera. Emeza camera mu gitekerezo cyawe cya murandasi kandi isuzuma ritangira.

sign_language.a_signer_spells_names_and_loanwords_and: Umusinyi yandika amazina n'amagambo y'inguzanyo, maze agasinya ibindi byose. Aya magambo afite ibimenyetso nyabyo mu mvugo y'ishusho: ishusho y'ikiganza, ahantu ku mubiri, n'ingendo, ku kiganza kimwe cyangwa byombi. Hitamo kimwe kugira ngo ukirebe. Ibindi byose mu nteruro biracyandikwa n'intoki.
sign_language.all_26_asl_letter_handshapes_plus_the: Amashusho y'inyuguti zose 26 za ASL hamwe n'imibare 0-9, harimo J na Z zishushanyijeho n'inyuguti ebyiri zikurikiranye. Andika ijambo muri Animation Studio maze wohereze ikimenyetso nka GLB igenda, cyangwa ugisangize nk'umurongo.
sign_language.american_sign_language_live_in_3d: Ururimi rw'amarenga rw'Abanyamerika · mu buryo bwa 3D
sign_language.api_foot: Inyandiko zose: API y'ibimenyetso · /api/sign mu inyandiko z'API · inyuma y'aho ni /api/asl-recognition. Agent zishobora kuyishaka nk'ikoresho sign_text ku three.ws MCP server.
sign_language.api_lede: Ibyo byose biyandikwa mu browser. Compiler iri hejuru irikora ku server, kandi na app, agent cyangwa engine yose ishobora gushaka ibimenyetso byemewe kandi iboneka: animation clip ya three.js keyed ku isi y'umuntu, n'ikiganiro cyayo. Nta konti, nta key, nta SDK. Andika hano kandi urebe endpoint iri hejuru ikwishura.
sign_language.best_results_good_light_hand_in_frame: Ibisubizo byiza: urumuri ruhagije, ikiganza mu ifoto, inyuguti imwe icyarimwe. Imibare n'inyuguti zose za A-Z birashyigikiwe.
sign_language.click_start_fingerspell_a_word_at_your: Kanda tangira, andika ijambo n'intoki imbere ya kamera yawe, hanyuma uhagarare. Porogaramu yawe y'ubushakashatsi ihindura videwo mu bimenyetso by'intoki n'umubiri mu buryo bw'ibanze; gusa ibyo bihuza ni byo byoherezwa kugira ngo bimenyekane. Kwandika n'intoki ukoresheje kamera ntibitunganijwe neza (teganya inyuguti imwe cyangwa ebyiri zishobora kuba zitaribyo), bityo reba inyandiko mbere y'uko uyizera.
sign_language.fingerspell_into_your_webcam_and_the_ai: Sinyisha intoki kuri webcam yawe maze AI ibyandike mu magambo: ibimenyetso by'ingenzi bikurwa ku gikoresho cyawe, bityo amashusho ntabwo asohoka kuri mudasobwa yawe. Iyi demo iri hepfo ikoresha uwo mumenyi umwe.
sign_language.honest_scope_words_with_a_sign_are: Uko bikora neza: amagambo afite ikimenyetso arasinywa, ibindi byose bigasinywa intoki inyuguti ku yindi. Ibinyetso bishyirwa hamwe mu buryo bw'amagambo y'Icyongereza, ni ukuvuga Icyongereza gisinywe, atari grammaire ya ASL: ASL nyayo ihindura imiterere y'interuro, igahindura inshinga mu mwanya, kandi ikagaragaza grammaire mu maso. Amagambo ari hejuru ni intangiriro kandi ateganijwe kwiyongera. Soma ibisobanuro birambuye.
sign_language.it_signs_these_it_doesn_t_spell: Ibi birasinywa. Ntabwo byandikwa inyuguti ku yindi.
sign_language.meta_description: Avatari za three.ws zikoresha Ururimi rw'Amarenga rw'Abanyamerika. Sinyisha intoki ijambo cyangwa umubare uwo ari wo wose, ubone ibisubizo by'ibiganiro bisinywe, kandi usinyire AI ukoresheje webcam yawe: uruziga rwose, mu buryo bwa 3D.
sign_language.meta_og_description: Avatari zikoresha ASL. Sinyisha intoki ikintu cyose, ubone ibisubizo by'ibiganiro bisinywe, kandi usinyire ukoresheje webcam yawe, mu buryo bwa 3D.
sign_language.meta_twitter_description: Avatari zikoresha ASL: gusinyisha intoki, ibisubizo by'ibiganiro bisinywe, n'uburyo bwo gusinya ukoresheje webcam, mu buryo bwa 3D.
sign_language.the_same_signing_over_http: Iyo signing iri hejuru, kuri HTTP
sign_language.three_ws_avatars_fingerspell_any_word_or: Avatari za three.ws zisinyisha intoki ijambo cyangwa umubare uwo ari wo wose muri ASL, zigasinya buri gisubizo cy'ikiganiro, kandi zigasoma ibyo wasinye ukoresheje webcam. Ikiganiro cyose, mu mpande zombi, muri 3D ikorera muri browser.
sign_language.turn_on_sign_mode_in_the_agent: Koresha uburyo bwo gusinya mu kiganiro cya agent maze avatar isinye buri gisubizo: ibimenyetso by'urubuga aho bihari, ibindi bigasinywa intoki. Avatar iyo ari yo yose yashyizwemo ibibona binyuze kuri attribute imwe ya sign-language.

signal_detail.meta_description: Ibikubiye mu bimenyetso byishyurwa by'umucuruzi wemejwe — ubuhanga bwagaragaye, ibyagezweho byagaragaye, n'ibimenyetso bya on-chain kuri buri kimenyetso. Iyandikishe ukoresheje agent yawe kugira ngo ikore auto-mirror.
