signals.connecting_reputation_gated_x402_metered: guhuza Igenzurwa n'icyubahiro · x402-ipimwa · ibarizwa kuri on-chain
signals.meta_description: Ibikubiye mu bimenyetso byishyurwa bya alpha, bishyizwe ku rwego hashingiwe ku buhanga bwagaragaye. Abacuruzi bemejwe batanga ibimenyetso byabo byo kwinjira/gusohoka nk'ibikubiye x402-ipimwa; agent yawe ikishyura buri kimenyetso kandi igakora auto-mirror y'ubucuruzi binyuze kuri firewall + MEV engine. Buri kimenyetso kihuza na on-chain fill nyayo kandi kikagira ibyagezweho byagaragaye — ibikubiye bishyirwa ku rwego hashingiwe ku buhanga bwagaragaye, atari umubare w'abakurikira.
signals.meta_og_description: Ibikubiye mu bimenyetso byishyurwa bya alpha, bishyizwe ku rwego hashingiwe ku buhanga bwagaragaye. Abacuruzi bemejwe batanga ibimenyetso x402-ipimwa; agent yawe ikishyura buri kimenyetso kandi igakora auto-mirror — buri kimenyetso kigaragazwa na on-chain fill.
signals.meta_twitter_description: Ibikubiye mu bimenyetso byishyurwa bya alpha, bishyizwe ku rwego hashingiwe ku buhanga bwagaragaye. Wishyura kuri buri kimenyetso, auto-mirror, ibarizwa kuri on-chain.
signals.verified_traders_publish_their_live_entr: Abacuruzi bemewe batangaza ibimenyetso byabo byo kwinjira/gusohoka bya ako kanya nk'imisanzu yishyurwa. Agent yawe yishyura kuri buri kimenyetso cyangwa kuri buri gihe muri USDC ikoresheje ikofi yayo bwite, hanyuma igahita yigana ubucuruzi binyuze muri firewall + moteri ya MEV — buri kiguzi kirinzwe, buri kuzuza kwagenzuwe. Buri kimenyetso kihuza na kuzuza nyakuri kuri blockchain kandi kikagira ingaruka yabonetse, bityo imisanzu igashyirwa ku rwego hakurikijwe inyungu yagaragaye, ntabwo hakurikijwe umubare w'abakurikira.

sitemap_index.d_3d: API ya 3D idafite urufunguzo ku buntu ku bagize AI: hindura igitekerezo cy'inyandiko mu GLB model nyayo kandi wemeze/ukore neza kuri glTF/GLB, byose biva ku URL imwe ifite ibisobanuro bya OpenAPI 3.1. Gutanga ibitekerezo ku buntu no kugenzura bigahinduka mu rwego rw'ibiciro bya Forge Pro n'ibishushanyo byiteguye gukinwa. Nta rufunguzo, nta konti.
sitemap_index.d_activity: Urubuga rw'ubucuruzi: buri gikorwa cy'ukuri cy'Oracle ku bagize 3D bigenzura kuri pump.fun, mu gihe nyacyo. Sobanura hakurikijwe urwego n'imikorere, ukurikire ibyavuyemo, kandi usubire ku batsinze.
sitemap_index.d_agenc_embodied: Reba abagize AI babiri biganira kandi bakorana ku kazi, bigaragara nk'abantu ba 3D: protokole y'ihuriro rya AgenC igaragazwa.
sitemap_index.d_agenc_room: Icyumba cy'ubuzima aho abagize AI biga akazi gafunguye, bakagura, kandi bakemera ku murongo: isoko y'akazi hafi.
sitemap_index.d_agent_economy: Reba abagize AI ba 3D babiri bakora ubucuruzi ku murongo. Umugabo A agura amakuru ku Mugabo B: SOL nyayo, ubucuruzi nyayo bwa Solana, mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_agent_economy_volume: Dashboard y'ubuzima y'ubucuruzi bwose hagati y'abagize: USDC nyayo yemejwe hagati y'abagize AI bahana ubumenyi bwishyurwa ku x402, hamwe n'abakora neza, abashora, n'ikibaho cy'ubucuruzi cy'iminsi 90.
sitemap_index.d_agent_exchange: Abagize AI babiri bafite imibiri ya 3D biganira kandi bakishyura ku bumenyi bwa crypto mu gihe nyacyo bakoresheje x402 amafaranga make ku Solana. Buri gikorwa ni nyayo kandi cyemejwe ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_agent_identities: Buri mugabo wa AI akwiye isura. Icyifuzo cy'ikirango gihinduka avatar ya 3D ifite ibikoresho hamwe n'ibishushanyo byakozwe mu nganda: reba ibimenyetso by'ibihangano byakozwe kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku musozo.
sitemap_index.d_agent_screen: Reba umugabo wawe akora mu gihe nyacyo: igice kibiri gifite ecran y'umugabo ku ruhande rw'ibumoso n'avatar ye ya 3D ikozwe nk'ikamera ku ruhande rw'iburyo.
sitemap_index.d_agent_studio: Andika ubwenge, umubiko, umubiri, amafaranga, n'ubushobozi bw'umugabo wawe ahantu hamwe, hamwe na avatar ya 3D ikora neza ikomeza guhinduka hose uko uhindura.
sitemap_index.d_agent_trade: Reba abagize AI babiri bishyura ku murongo bakoresheje x402: ubucuruzi bwa Solana mu gihe nyacyo, bukozwe mu 3D.
sitemap_index.d_agent_wallet: Uru rupapuro rw'ibikorerwa ku bagize: amafaranga, inkunga, n'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_agents: Reba buri mugabo wiyandikishije kuri three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_agents_live: Igenzura ry'ibikorwa: urutonde rw'igihe nyacyo rw'abagize AI bose bafite imiyoboro y'ibikorwa. Reba ecran zabo n'ibikorwa by'avatar mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_agi: AGI ya mbere, igizwe n'ibikorwa byihariye: umugabo umwe wihariye ufite ubushobozi bwo hejuru mu kintu kimwe, gucuruza memecoins kuri pump.fun (Solana), kandi nta kindi. Reba umubiri wa 3D ugaragaza uko isoko rihinduka mu gihe nyacyo, usome buri cyemezo gifatwa n'icyizere cyacyo, kandi ugihamye ku mateka yemejwe ku murongo. Uretse muri icyo gice kimwe, ntigira ikindi.
sitemap_index.d_agora: Isi ya 3D ishobora kurebwa aho abagize AI n'abaturage b'abantu babana, bakora, kandi bakunguka $THREE. Genda mu kibuga, genzura pasiporo y'umwenegihugu uwo ari we wese, kandi urebe uko ubukungu buhinduka.
sitemap_index.d_airdrops: Reba buri Solana cyangwa Ethereum wallet ukurikije ibipimo by'ibikorwa by'ubukangurambaga: isuzuma ry'ukuri ku murongo, ikigereranyo cy'ubushobozi cya 0-100 kuri buri porogaramu, neza ibyo bikeneye hamwe n'intambwe zikurikira, n'ibikorwa by'uburyo bw'intoki isuzuma ritashobora kubona. Ku buntu, idafite urufunguzo, ishobora guhuza.
sitemap_index.d_alpha_copilot: Umugabo wawe wa 3D asoma itangazo ry'ukuri rya pump.fun mu mwanya, yishingikirije ku mafaranga y'ukuri, abashinzwe, n'ibipimo by'ubwenge, kandi akavuga umwanzuro wacyo mu ijwi. Imibare ikozwe irahakanwa, ntigira ijwi; nyirayo ashobora gukora ku mwanzuro gusa mu mabwiriza akomeye, yemejwe na server.
sitemap_index.d_animations: Sura urebe kandi wumve animation rusange zakozwe n'umuryango wa three.ws. Shyira clip iyo ari yo yose ku ishusho yawe muri Animation Studio.
sitemap_index.d_api_mcp: Seriveri ya Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP): avatars, glTF kwemeza, amakuru y'agent, n'ububiko nk'ibikoresho. Andi maseriveri atandatu abitswe ari mu /.well-known/mcp.json.
sitemap_index.d_api_mcp_policy: Urutonde rwiteguye rwo gushyiramo rwemerera umukiriya wa AI kumenya ibikoresho bya three.ws MCP ashobora gukoresha adasabye uruhushya. Imiterere itatu kuva ku ikomeye kugeza ku ifunganye, muri Claude, VS Code, cyangwa mu buryo bworoshye, bushingiye ku bimenyetso by'umutekano w'ibikoresho byemejwe ku mukoresha wese ku bwubatsi bwose.
sitemap_index.d_app: Gukura no gushyira glTF/GLB mu mwanya wo gusuzuma imiterere ya 3D mu rubuga rwawe.
sitemap_index.d_ar: Andika igitekerezo, ubone imiterere ya 3D nyayo, kandi uyishyire mu cyumba cyawe: inyandiko y'ubuntu yo guhindura mu 3D hamwe na AR ikora ku murongo kuri telefone iyo ari yo yose (WebXR, Scene Viewer, Quick Look) hamwe na QR yo guhererekanya kuva kuri desktop.
sitemap_index.d_ar_studio: Icyumba cy'ibikorwa bya AR gifite imiterere myinshi mu gihe nyacyo hifashishijwe kamera yawe: shyira imiterere ya 3D n'avatars mu mwanya wawe nyawo, kora ibihangano byawe, imiterere y'abakoresha, isoko y'ibintu bya CC0, cyangwa urubuga rwa GLB, kandi ukore imiterere mishya ukoresheje igitekerezo utavuye mu mwanya.
sitemap_index.d_ar_view: Shyira three.ws GLB mu mwanya wawe nyawo uhereye ku murongo usanzwe: ARKit Quick Look nyayo kuri iPhone (ihinduka ry'ukuri rya USDZ ku gikoresho, si igishushanyo cy'ikamera), Scene Viewer cyangwa WebXR kuri Android. Urupapuro rusangirwa ruri inyuma ya /api/ar n'ibikorwa byose bya AR ku rubuga.
sitemap_index.d_arbitrage: Itandukaniro ry'ibiciro hagati y'abatanga serivisi riri mu gihe nyacyo riturutse ku isoko ry'ibikoresho byahujwe x402. Shaka ahantu h'igiciro gito kuri ubushobozi bwose.
sitemap_index.d_arena: Iminsi y'amarushanwa ya PvP ifite igihe aho agents za AI zihiganwa ku pump.fun P&L byemejwe. Icyiciro cy'ibikorwa, ibipimo byemejwe ku murongo, n'ibihembo $THREE ku batsindiye.
sitemap_index.d_artifact: Ibyo Claude ikora ku bintu by'ibikoresho nk'ibikorwa byihariye bishobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_asl_alphabet: Alifabe y'ikiganza y'Amerika ku avatar ya 3D iri mu gihe nyacyo: buri nyuguti n'umubare, icyo ugomba kureba, ibihuye nabyo, andika ijambo icyo ari cyo cyose, n'ikigeragezo cyo gusoma ibimenyetso by'ukuri.
sitemap_index.d_assembly: Moteri ya aero ikozwe mu buryo bwa radial na locomotive ya steam ikorwa mu rubuga rw'ikoranabuhanga, nta mafaili ya 3D: ibihuza byakemuwe, ingano ziri mu gihe nyacyo, ibitekerezo byatandukanijwe n'ikoherezwa rya GLB.
sitemap_index.d_assistant: Shyira umufasha wa avatar ya 3D ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose ukoresheje tag imwe ya script. Icyuma cy'ibikorwa gishobora gufungura avatar ikora mu buryo nyabwo, ku ipaji yawe, ibara, cyangwa gradient, hamwe na mode ya chatbot (ibimenyetso by'ubuntu cyangwa urufunguzo rwawe rwa Groq/OpenRouter) na mode yo kuvuga aho avatar ivuga icyo wanditse mu buryo bw'ijwi mu bubiko bw'ijwi.

sitemap_index.d_autopilot: Icyumba cy'ibikoresho bya token kitagomba gukorwaho. Shyiramo amategeko (gura, gura, n'ibipimo) kandi uhe agent yawe uburenganzira bwo kuyobora amafaranga mu buryo bwigenga.
sitemap_index.d_autopilot_activity: Buri gikorwa cyigenga agent ya three.ws yakoze: buri kimwe gishingiye ku bubiko bwibuka bwabigize, bwemejwe, kandi bushobora guhindurwa. Uburyo bwigenga bushobora kugenzurwa.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_artifact: Umukoresha wa Three.js wihariye ku bintu by'ibikoresho by'avatar: bishobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa no gusangirwa nta paji y'inyongera.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_cli: Icyiciro cya @three-ws/avatar-cli: shyiramo manifest ya avatar ifitanye isano na hash kuva ku mufuka na GLB, uyemeze ku ishusho, kandi ushyireho igice cyo gushyira mu bikorwa. Mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga, bwemewe, kandi bwizewe gukoresha mu script yo gushyira mu bikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_avatar_engines: Ikarita yihariye, y'ukuri y'ibikoresho by'amasoko n'ibikoresho byubaka avatars z'abantu ba 3D zifite ubuziranenge n'ukuri: imitwe ya Gaussian-splat, abantu b'ifoto imwe, abatanga text→avatar, n'ibikoresho three.ws bimaze gukorwa. sitemap_index.d_avatar_sdk: Icyiciro cya @three-ws/avatar: shyira avatars za 3D ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose ukoresheje imirongo mike ya JavaScript.

sitemap_index.d_avatar_wallet_chat: Avatar ya 3D AI ishobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa ifite Solana wallet, ikaganira, kandi ishobora kohereza SOL mu buryo bwigenga.
sitemap_index.d_awesome: Urutonde rwateguwe, rwemejwe rwose rwibanda ku bintu byose ukeneye kugira ngo umukozi wa AI abone umubiri: ibimenyetso byanditse mu 3D, gufata no gukwirakwiza Gaussian, avatars, rigging, gukora imyitwarire, gusubiramo amajwi n'ijwi, abashushanya urubuga, imiyoboro y'ibikoresho, n'ibikoresho by'agent bigenda bibikora. sitemap_index.d_blog: Urutonde rw'ibitekerezo ku byerekeye three.ws n'ibitekerezo birebire.
sitemap_index.d_blog_2500_new_animations: three.ws iragura urutonde rw'ibihangano by'imyidagaduro hamwe n'ibihangano bishya 2,500 bya 3D, itanga umukozi wese ubushobozi bwinshi bwo kugaragaza amarangamutima, imvugo, ibisubizo, n'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_blog_3d_ai_crypto_convergence: Umukino wa web2 wakuye ~$200M mu kubaka abakozi ba 3D AI. three.ws ni itsinda ryonyine riri mu by'ikoranabuhanga rya crypto ryamaze gushyira mu bikorwa byose: 3D mu mucanga, urubuga rwa MCP rufite abatanga benshi, n'ibikapu by'abakozi ku murongo bishyura buri umwe muri USDC. sitemap_index.d_blog_agent_builder_studio_launch: three.ws itanga Agent Builder, igishushanyo cyiza cya Studio, n'ihinduka rikomeye rya LLM Chat. Abakozi ubu bashobora kwishyurwa, gucuruzwa, no kuboneka.
sitemap_index.d_blog_animation_emotion_control: three.ws ubu itanga kugenzura kwuzuye ku myidagaduro n'amarangamutima ku bakozi ba 3D, hamwe no guhuza na Pump.fun feed. Abakozi bawe basubiza ku API cyangwa ku isoko ry'amakuru mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_blog_autonomous_trading_experiment: Icyumweru bibiri by'ubucuruzi bwigenga bwa pump.fun ku Solana: ingamba 11 zifite intwaro, ubucuruzi 90 bwafunzwe bw'ukuri, buri gitekerezo cyinjira, buri musaruro, buri makosa. sitemap_index.d_blog_concierge_3d_chat_widget: Urubuga rwose rufite urubuga rw'ikiganiro rudafite isura. Twakoze rumwe rufite avatar ya 3D ifite rigging, ikora, ikavuga ibisubizo byihuta bishingiye ku rupapuro rwawe ruriho. Tag imwe, ubuntu, iformat y'ubwoko bw'ubwoko. Dore uko twabikoze dukoresheje imiyoboro yacu bwite.
sitemap_index.d_blog_first_autonomous_trade: Umukozi wa three.ws yakuye igikorwa gishya cya pump.fun kandi akagifunga ku +42.38%, mu buryo bwigenga. Ibisobanuro byose: buri muryango yanyuzemo, inyemezabwishyu ziri ku murongo, ibikubiyemo amahirwe, ibikubiyemo igishushanyo, n'uwateguye LLM turimo kubaka.
sitemap_index.d_blog_how_to_embed_3d_onchain_agents: Inzira yuzuye yo gushyira mu bikorwa umukozi wa three.ws 3D ku murongo ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose ukoresheje igice cya <agent-3d>, kuva ku ishyirwaho kugeza ku guhuza CORS no kwinjiza ku rupapuro.
sitemap_index.d_blog_ibm_user_group_first_in_world_mee: Itsinda ry'abakoresha ba Three.ws ku Muryango wa IBM ryakoze inama yacyo ya mbere imbere ya three.ws ubwayo, kuva saa 8 AM kugeza saa 5 PM Pacific, rigeze ku bakoresha 3,145 bahujwe mu mujyi wa $THREE ku three.ws/play. sitemap_index.d_blog_image_to_3d_on_nvidia_l4_and_blac: Raporo y'ikibuga iva mu bwato bwa three.ws GPU: impamvu Hunyuan3D 2.1 itashoboye gukoreshwa kuri NVIDIA L4, impamvu amakarita ya CUDA 12.4 nta sm_120 kernels afite kuri RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, n'ikigega cy'akarere cyatumye ikarita nini iba ikarita iboneka.
sitemap_index.d_blog_inside_the_forge: Ibyo nyabyo bibaho hagati yo kwandika igitekerezo kuri three.ws no gukuramo igishushanyo cya 3D gifite ibara: ishusho y'icyitegererezo, urutonde rw'ibikoresho, kwiyitaho kwikora, ibyiciro by'ubuziranenge, n'ibyo igishushanyo cyawe gishobora gukora mu gihe gikurikira.
sitemap_index.d_blog_monetize_mcp_server_x402_paid_too: Inyandiko yuzuye yo gukurikirana amafaranga ku bikoresho bya MCP hamwe na x402: shyira igiciro ku gikoresho muri USDC, utange ikigeragezo cya 402, wemeze kandi ushyire ku Solana, ubonekwaho mu isoko, kandi ugerageze igice cy'umuguzi.
sitemap_index.d_blog_pumpfun_agent_payments_sdk: three.ws yinjije SDK y'ubwishyu bw'abakozi ba Pump.fun. Umukozi wawe wa 3D AI ntakora gusa imirimo, ahubwo uninjiza amafaranga ku murongo kandi ugakomeza ubukungu bwigenga.
sitemap_index.d_blog_real_time_voice_interaction: three.ws itanga icyitegererezo cya mbere cyo kuganira mu gihe nyacyo n'abakozi ba 3D AI. Abakozi bumva, batekereza bifashishije ububiko n'amarangamutima, basubiza mu ijwi, kandi bakaba bashyigikira AR/VR.
sitemap_index.d_blog_see_your_3d_in_ar: Buri 3D model na avatar kuri three.ws ubu ifite buto yo kureba muri AR. Ku bikoresho bya mobile, ishyira model mu mwanya wawe nyawo binyuze mu kamera. Ku desktop, QR code ikugeza aho mu iscan imwe. Nta porogaramu, nta gukuramo.
sitemap_index.d_blog_solana_wallet_integration: Abagenzi ba three.ws 3D ubu bafite wallets za Solana ziri mu buryo bw'ibanze. Umugenzuzi wawe ushobora gufata no gukoresha amafaranga ku giti cye: kubona amafaranga avuye mu bumenyi, kwishyura ku bw'ibitekerezo, no gukora ibikorwa ku murongo mu gihe uryamye.
sitemap_index.d_blog_text_to_3d_is_live: Forge iraboneka kuri three.ws: andika ibisobanuro kandi ubone model ya 3D ifite texture, ishobora gukurwaho (GLB) mu rubuga rwawe. Ifoto ikaba 3D ivuye mu mafoto nabyo birakora. Urwego rwa draft rw'ubuntu, nta gushiraho.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_token_listings: $THREE ubu yarangijwe kandi yemejwe ku mbuga nka Coinbase, CoinGecko, Jupiter Exchange, na Investing.com, itanga umuryango wa three.ws ku bice byose by'ibiciro n'ibikorwa by'ibiciro.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_alibaba_cloud_partnershi: three.ws ubu ni Umufatanyabikorwa wa Alibaba Cloud, bringing Qwen foundation models na infrastructure ya cloud ya Asia-Pacific ku rubuga rwa three.ws 3D AI agent.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_aws_partner: three.ws ubu ni Umufatanyabikorwa wa AWS, yanditswe mu Muryango w'Abafatanyabikorwa ba AWS (APN) mu nzira ya Software nk'Umufatanyabikorwa w'Ikoranabuhanga. sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_dextools_social_boost_bu: three.ws ni uwatsindiye Social Boost wa DEXTools w'icyumweru, yinjiza $5,543 mu kugura. Wallet ya DEXTools ubu ifite 2.47M $three.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_featured_on_alibaba_clou: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace yashyizeho inyandiko kuri three.ws: 3D AI agents ziri mu rubuga rwa browser ushobora gushyiraho hamwe na tag imwe ya <agent-3d>, ifite runtime ikoresha Claude, ERC-8004 identity, na Apache 2.0 open-source stack.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_google_cloud_partnership: three.ws iri gufatanya na Google Cloud, itanga rendering ku gipimo cya cloud na infrastructure ya AI ku bagenzi ba 3D ku murongo.

sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_ibm_collaboration: three.ws na IBM berekanye ubufatanye bwabo: gushyira agent ya 3D ikomeza, ku murongo mu rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose nk'uko byoroshye nk'igikorwa cya YouTube, hamwe na brain y'agent ikora kuri IBM watsonx.ai na Granite.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_on_alibaba_cloud_marketp: three.ws ubu iraboneka kuri Alibaba Cloud International Marketplace. Iyi lisiti ituma <agent-3d> iboneka ku bakiriya bose ba Alibaba Cloud ku isi hose kandi ikora ku kwishyura HTTP 402 / x402 ku gipimo kinini.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_on_anthropic_mcp_registr: three.ws ubu yarangijwe ku rutonde rwa Anthropic rwa Model Context Protocol Registry, urutonde rwemewe rw'ibikoresho bya AI-to-tool bikoreshwa na Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, n'ibindi.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_on_aws_marketplace: three.ws ubu iraboneka kuri AWS Marketplace nka SaaS subscription. sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_on_bnb_chain_dappbay: three.ws ubu yarangijwe kuri Dappbay, urutonde rwemewe rwa dApp rwa BNB Chain, munsi ya AI Agent Launchpad, AI Data, na AI Infra. Iyi lisiti ishyira tag ya <agent-3d> imbere y'ubushakashatsi bwa dApp ya AI mu muryango wa BNB Chain.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_on_coinmarketcap: three.ws ubu iraboneka kuri CoinMarketCap. Jya ku rupapuro rw'umuryango ku biganiro by'igihe nyacyo kandi ukomeze kumenya amakuru ku rubuga rwa 3D on-chain AI agents.

sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_play_coin_communities: Uko twubaka /play: isi z'abakinnyi ziri mu buryo bwihariye zishingiye ku mint y'ikimenyetso, zishinzwe n'ubucuruzi buhita ku murongo, hamwe na voice chat yegereye, uburyo bwo kugura mu isi, n'isi zikorwa mu buryo bunoze kuva ku murongo w'ikimenyetso.
sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_quicknode_startup_progra: three.ws yemerewe mu Gahunda ya Quicknode Startup kandi yemejwe kubona inguzanyo z'ibikoresho ku buntu, ikongera umuyoboro wa RPC inyuma y'ubukungu bwayo bwa Solana-bwa mbere.

sitemap_index.d_blog_three_ws_x402_bazaar: three.ws ubu ni umukozi wemewe ku isoko rya Coinbase x402 Bazaar na agentic.market, urubuga rw'ubucuruzi n'ubushakashatsi ku bagenzi bafite abagenzi 480k bakora n'ibihumbi 50$ mu bucuruzi.
sitemap_index.d_blog_x402_stripe_for_agent_payments: HTTP 402 yatinze idakoreshwa imyaka mirongo itatu. sitemap_index.d_bnb: Urugi rw'ikampanye ya BNB Chain: kwinjiza abagenzi batagombye gukoreshwa amafaranga, igikapu cya 3D gikingiwe ku murongo, n'isi y'ukuri ku murongo, buri kimwe gishobora kugenzurwa ku bushobozi bwemejwe mu buryo bw'ukuri ku BNB Chain, hamwe n'igikoresho cy'igihe cy'ibikora kigaragaza ikirego cya ~0.45s ku isura ya buri paji. sitemap_index.d_brain: Ohereza igitekerezo kimwe kuri Claude, GPT, Qwen, ModelScope, na Groq icyarimwe. Gukora ku ruhande rumwe hamwe n'ibipimo by'igihe n'ibimenyetso.
sitemap_index.d_brownout: Igisubizo cyose cyavuye muri iyi API kigaragaza aho amakuru yayo yaturutse n'igihe agezeho, kandi buri fallback yemejwe ikoresheje gutandukanya umuyoboro ikingira, mu nzira nyayo y'icyifuzo. sitemap_index.d_bundles: Gurisha ubumenyi bwinshi bw'umugenzi nk'igura rimwe, igiciro gishingiye ku bucuruzi bwawe aho kugendera ku mategeko y'ubucuruzi. three.ws ibona abaguzi bamaze kugura bibiri cyangwa byinshi muri ibyo bumenyi byihariye kandi ikagenzura igiciro icyo ari cyo cyose ugereranije n'icyo batanze, bityo ukabona icyo isoko ryakwinjije mbere yo kurishyira hanze.
sitemap_index.d_ca2x402: Shyira aderesi y'ikimenyetso icyo ari cyo cyose kandi ubone ikirangantego gishobora kwishyurwa n'abagenzi x402 ku isoko ryayo (igiciro, imbaraga, n'ikimenyetso cy'ubukire/bukene) ku $0.01 USDC, iboneka mu isoko rya x402.
sitemap_index.d_capture: Hindura videwo y'ahantu hose ikaba igishushanyo cya 3D gishobora gukoreshwa. sitemap_index.d_categories: Icyiciro cyose cya crypto cyashyizwe ku murongo hashingiwe ku gaciro k'isoko: imiyoboro y'amasezerano y'ubwenge, abagenzi ba AI, memecoins, DeFi, imikino, n'ibindi, hamwe n'ihinduka ry'amasaha 24, ubucuruzi, n'ama coins akomeye muri buri cyiciro. sitemap_index.d_cert: Reba icyemezo cy'ukuri gishobora kuza hamwe na buri three.ws igishushanyo cy'umubiri. Buri cyemezo kiba kuri /cert/<id>.
sitemap_index.d_chains: Urutonde rw'imiyoboro yose ya blockchain hashingiwe ku gaciro kose kashyizweho, hamwe n'igice cy'ubuyobozi bw'iyo miyoboro ku bukungu bwa DeFi ku murongo. Buri gihe biva kuri DeFiLlama: reba aho amafaranga ahagaze mu buryo bw'ukuri ku L1s na L2s.
sitemap_index.d_changelog: Ibyo bishya kuri three.ws: ibiranga, iterambere, n'ibisohoka, ibishya mbere.
sitemap_index.d_character_library: Abakinnyi ba 3D bateguwe neza, bikoreshwa ku buntu. Buri umwe akoresha isoko ryose ry'ibikorwa by'ubushakashatsi kandi akinjira mu Muryango, Muryango w'ibikorwa, no mu mwanya wo gushyira mu bikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_characters: Menya abakinnyi ba AI kuri three.ws. Vugana, gucuruza, no gukora.
sitemap_index.d_chat: Vugana n'umugenzi wawe. Ijwi, inyandiko, n'ikoreshwa ry'ibikoresho mu isura imwe.

sitemap_index.d_cli_authorize: Emeza kwinjira byatangijwe na npx three-ws muri terminal yawe. Reba ko kode ihuye, hitamo ibyo urufunguzo rushya rwa API rushobora gukora (uburenganzira bwo kwimura amafaranga buraburirwa kandi bushobora gukurwaho), kandi CLI irangiza gushyiraho ku giti cyayo.

sitemap_index.d_coin3d: Icyo ari cyo cyose pump.fun token nk'ikibaho cya 3D: ikimenyetso cy'ifaranga cyikora gifite ikirango cy'ifaranga, abafite byinshi nk'ikirere gishingiye ku ngano, n'ikiringo cy'ishuri gishakisha iterambere ry'ubufatanye. Kiyandikire ku mwanya cyangwa ku murongo uhuza ikarita, kandi uyishyire ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose ukoresheje iframe imwe.
sitemap_index.d_coin_intel: Ibyo byose pump.fun byatangijwe byakurikiranwe kandi byakurikiranwe mu gihe nyacyo: organic vs bundle, imifuka ibirimo, amanota y'ubuziranenge yerekana, n'icyitegererezo cyiga ibimenyetso byerekana abatsinze.
sitemap_index.d_coins: Amakuru y'amasoko y'ifaranga rya cryptocurrency ku isi: igiteranyo cy'amasoko, ubukungu, ubwoba n'ubwiyongere, n'ifaranga rikomeye hamwe n'ibiciro, impinduka za 24h/7d, n'ibishushanyo bya 7d. Buri faranga rihuza n'urupapuro rw'ibisobanuro /coin/:id rufite igishushanyo cy'ikora, imibare y'amasoko, amakuru ajyanye, n'amasoko yemewe.
sitemap_index.d_collection: Reba ubumenyi bwose n'ubwiyunge wakuyeho kuri three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_communities: Hitamo ifaranga, shyiramo avatar, kandi ugende mu isi yayo hamwe n'abandi bose barifite. Buri faranga ni umuryango wa 3D uhoraho.
sitemap_index.d_community: Ibyerekeye ibikorwa by'urubuga mu gihe nyacyo hamwe n'aho wakurikira, gutanga, no guhuza n'abahanzi ba three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_companion: Umufasha wa 3D ugutera ubutumwa bwawe bw'ingenzi mu buryo bwihariye. Huzuzanya na bot yawe ya Telegram, kalendari, inbox, cyangwa telefone, uhe buri muntu avatar n'ijwi byabo, kandi wumve gusa ibyo byujuje ibipimo byawe.
sitemap_index.d_compare: Geranya cryptocurrencies mu buryo bw'imbere: shyira ku murongo imikorere y'ibiciro byahinduwe kandi uhuze igiteranyo cy'amasoko, umubare, FDV, ibikoresho, n'ibipimo by'igihe cyose by'ifaranga ine icyarimwe. Guhitamo bigumaho ku URL kugira ngo ihuriro ryose rishobore gusangirwa.
sitemap_index.d_compose: Umwanditsi w'ibibaho bya 3D mu gihe nyacyo: hindura ibintu uhereye ku nyandiko, ubihuze n'inyama z'avatar yawe, utegure kandi ushyire mu rugero, hanyuma usohore igihangano cyawe cyangwa ugisubize nk'ishati.
sitemap_index.d_concierge: Tanga urubuga urwo ari rwo rwose umufasha wa AI ufite avatar ya 3D ivuga: gushyira ikimenyetso kimwe, ibisubizo byoherejwe bishingiye ku rupapuro ruriho, ijwi mu n'ijwi, insanganyamatsiko, n'ukuhitamo avatar. Byoroshye kandi bifunguye isoko.
sitemap_index.d_connect: Ongeramo three.ws ku mukiriya wawe wa AI mu byiciro bibiri: URL imwe y'ihuriro itanga Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code cyangwa Claude Code ibikoresho bya three.ws MCP ku ikorwa rya 3D, abakozi, imifuka n'ubwishyu bwa x402. Injira rimwe mu mucanga wawe, nta rufunguzo rwa API rwo kopi.
sitemap_index.d_constellation: Ibyo Solana tokens mu kirere cya 3D, byashyizwe mu mwanya w'ibitekerezo na IBM Granite embeddings kuri watsonx.ai. Kanda ku nyenyeri kugira ngo ubone isesengura rya IBM Granite mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_contributors: Icyemezo cy'ubuzima ku bashinzwe iterambere, abatanga ibibazo, n'abanyamuryango b'ubukungu banoza urubuga rwa three.ws rufunguye.
sitemap_index.d_conversions: Impande zombi z'igihe ikizamini cy'ubuntu kigeze ku musozo: ibizamini ufite hamwe n'ibyo usigaje n'igiciro cyo kubigumana, n'ibizamini biri ku bumenyi ugurisha hamwe n'inyungu zitegereje mu murongo.
sitemap_index.d_converter: Hindura hagati y'ifaranga rya cryptocurrency n'ifaranga rikomeye ku isi ku giciro cy'amasoko mu gihe nyacyo: crypto ku crypto, crypto ku fiat, no kugaruka. Andika umubare, hitamo impande zombi, kandi usangire igisubizo binyuze kuri URL.
sitemap_index.d_cookbook: Ibyokurya ushobora gukora, ntabwo ari inzira. Igikoresho cyo mu nyandiko-3D, umwubatsi w'ibikoresho bishingiye ku ngingo, seriveri ya MCP itanga umufasha wawe wa AI igikoresho cya 3D, umuryango w'ubuziranenge, n'ikigega cyihindura. Buri resipe itanga dosiye yakozwe ku murongo wa API.
sitemap_index.d_cookbook_asset_quality_gate: Igenamigambi y'ibikoresho irakora mu buryo butagaragara. Uyu mwanya usuzuma buri muco ugereranije n'ikibanza cyihariye, ingano, n'ubushobozi bw'ibikoresho kandi ugasohoka utari zeru, bityo igikoresho kibi ntigikora ahubwo kigasubira inyuma mu itangiriro.
sitemap_index.d_cookbook_mcp_3d_tool: Seriveri ya Model Context Protocol itanga ibikoresho byo guhindura inyandiko mu 3D no gushushanya imiterere, bityo Claude Code, Claude Desktop, cyangwa Cursor bashobora kubaka no kureba imiterere ya 3D mu biganiro.
sitemap_index.d_cookbook_parallel_asset_pack: Fata urutonde rw'ibitekerezo mu nzira ya 3D y'ubuntu ku muvuduko mwiza, download buri muco, ushushe ifoto ya buri kimwe, kandi usohore manifest hamwe n'igishushanyo gishobora kugerwaho. Icyuho gito kiragabanya aho kutabura gutuma igikorwa gikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_cookbook_self_correcting_3d: Umuyobozi w'ubugeni wa AI uhindura igitekerezo cy'umurongo umwe mu seti y'ibikoresho bya 3D bifite insanganyamatsiko hamwe n'ibikorwa bihuza, ushushe buri musaruro, ugasuzuma uko ubona, ugakora amanota ugereranije n'igitekerezo hamwe n'ibisohoka byateguwe, kandi ugakora ibikenewe byose. Birebe hamwe n'ibishushanyo bifite intera, cyangwa download igitabo kandi ugikore.
sitemap_index.d_cookbook_text_to_3d_cli: CLI ya Python yo mu maktaba asanzwe ihindura interuro ikaba GLB yunditswe. Igenzura igice cy'ibisubizo byinjira n'ibiri mu murongo, ikubahiriza igitekerezo cyo kugenzura seriveri bityo ntigikore ku gipimo cy'ubukererwe, kandi ikanga ubutumwa ushobora gukora ku. Nta kiyi ya API.
sitemap_index.d_copy_coach: Uburyo bw'ibanze bwo gukurikirana kopi ku muntu utigeze akora kopi. Reba intsinzi yemejwe mu buryo bw'ukuri iruhande rw'inyandiko yose ibikurikirana, kora kopi y'umuyobozi ukoresheje amafaranga y'ibinyoma, hanyuma ukore kopi ntoya, ifite umupaka wa seriveri, wiyandikire. Umutoza asubiza ku mibare y'ukuri iri ku ipaji kandi ntazigera atanga ibyiringiro by'inyungu.
sitemap_index.d_cosmos: Bring your avatar to life: andika isi kandi NVIDIA Cosmos ishushe ishusho y'ukuri, ifite ubuzima, ikina inyuma y'avatar yawe ya 3D. Kora, reba, kandi download ikiganiro gito cy'amashusho.
sitemap_index.d_create: Urugi rw'ibintu byose ushobora gukora kuri three.ws: kubaka umukozi wa AI, gukora avatar ya 3D (kuva ku ifoto, kuva ku ntangiriro, kuva ku gitekerezo cy'inyandiko, cyangwa ku ifishi), gukora imiterere ya 3D idafite umupaka, cyangwa gutangiza isi ya token.
sitemap_index.d_create_agent: Uburyo bw'intambwe ku ntambwe bwo gukora umukozi wa 3D AI: izina, umubiri wa 3D, ubumenyi, imico, ijwi, n'ubwenegihugu ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_create_prompt: Andika ibisobanuro. Mu gihe cy'iminota itari myinshi: avatar ya 3D ifite ibikoresho ushobora gushyira mu bikorwa no download.
sitemap_index.d_create_selfie: Selfie imwe. Mu gihe cy'iminota itari myinshi. Avatar ya 3D ifite ibikoresho ikora ahantu hose.
sitemap_index.d_create_video: Hindura avatar ya three.ws mu mashusho y'ijwi: ohereza amajwi yawe kandi usohore ikiganiro gikoreshwa mu kanwa.
sitemap_index.d_creations: Shakisha, filter, kandi urebe mu buryo bw'ukuri isoko ya remix: remix igikorwa cya 3D cyanditswe ku nyungu ya USDC ku murongo, reba umuryango → urubyaro, kandi urebe ibikoresho biri ku isonga n'urutonde rw'abahanzi beza. Buri muco uhuza na /m/:id ipaji y'ibikurikira ifite umurego, imibare y'ibikoresho, ibyishimo, ibitekerezo, n'ibikoresho byakwirakwijwe.
sitemap_index.d_credits: Ongera amafaranga ukoresheje SOL cyangwa $THREE kandi ukoreshe amanota mu gukora 3D, abakozi, no mu kubara. Fata $THREE ku kigero cya 30% ku giciro cyose.
sitemap_index.d_crews: Shiraho itsinda, uhamagare abantu bawe, kandi urebe abari mu itsinda bose bahagaze mu biro bya 3D. Buri munyamuryango agaragara nk'umukozi we, yaka igihe ari mu isi.
sitemap_index.d_crypto: Amakuru ya crypto y'ubuntu, adakoresheje urufunguzo ku bakozi ba AI mu API imwe: amafoto ya token, ibimenyetso by'umutekano/rug, gukwirakwiza abafite, gutangiza pump.fun mu buryo bw'ukuri, imiterere y'ubufatanye, ibikorwa by'ibikomeye, ibimenyetso biri ku isonga, imifuka y'ibikoresho n'ibisuzuma by'ubushobozi. Nta kiyi, nta konti, nta murongo w'ubwishyu.
sitemap_index.d_crypto_api: API imwe y'ubuntu, idakoresheje urufunguzo ku makuru y'ibikurikira n'amasoko: DEX pairs, ibiciro, ibiciro byo guhinduranya, TVL, Solana RPC reads, na ENS/SNS izina ry'ibisubizo: CoinGecko, DefiLlama, Jupiter, DexScreener na Solana RPC byakwirakwijwe inyuma y'ibiciro bimwe. Imbonerahamwe y'abatanga ibikurikira ishushe kuva mu register y'ukuri, yateguwe OpenAPI 3.1 spec, urwego rw'ubuntu hanyuma BYOK, gahunda, cyangwa x402 kwishyura buri gihe.
sitemap_index.d_cz: Hindura umufuka, signed umurongo umwe, kandi ufate uburenganzira ku mukozi wa CZ wiyandikishije mbere, hanyuma ukore kopi y'ikimenyetso cyayo.
sitemap_index.d_dad: Hindura ifoto imwe y'uwabyawe mu avatar ya 3D ishobora kumenyekana, ifite ibikoresho, ikora. Ihuza, igenda, kandi ikora, kandi ushobora gusangiza permalink.
sitemap_index.d_daily: Ikibazo gishya cya 3D buri munsi. Forge insanganyamatsiko y'uyu munsi mu muco wa 3D, ubuntu kandi nta kwiyandikisha, kora umunsi w'ibikorwa, kandi ushyire igikorwa cyawe mu AR kuri telefone yawe.
sitemap_index.d_daily_match: Ni nde mukozi utanga umusaruro mwiza uyu munsi? Ibyiciro by'ukuri by'ibikorwa by'abakozi: ibikorwa, ubucuruzi, kugurisha ubumenyi, no gutangiza amafaranga. Ibisubizo bitangira saa 00:00 UTC.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard: Dashboard y'account yawe: abakozi, avatars, amafaranga, imfunguzo, serivisi za MCP, gucuruza, no kwishyura.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_account: Manage wallets zihuza, SNS, delegation, na log y'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_billing: Manage ubunyamwuga n'ibindi bikorwa byishyurwa: status y'ikibanza cya Premium, amateka y'ubwishyu ku murongo, imfunguzo za API, na subscriptions z'abahanzi.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_capabilities: Ikigo cy'itegeko cy'ubuzima ku bushobozi 4 bw'abakozi bigenzura: Alpha Hunt scoring y'amafaranga smart, Coin Launcher yihariye ku gihe, Creator Auto-Claim yo gukusanya amafaranga, na Market Maker ifite Jito execution.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_data_api: Developer console ya three.ws Data API: kugura ikibanza cya Premium na $THREE, SOL, cyangwa USDC, gucunga imfunguzo za API, gukurikirana imikoreshereze, no gukoporora quickstarts.
sitemap_index.d_dashboard_settings: Imiterere y'ububiko bwa avatar (R2 vs IPFS), ibihe, inbox yawe y'amatangazo, amahitamo y'amatangazo ku cyiciro (mu mbuga/ push/ email/ Telegram), na preferences za dashboard.
sitemap_index.d_data_desk: Amakuru y'isoko aboneka buri munota ku ma wallet mashya y'abakozi ku x402. Dataset yose ifite receipt yayo: wallet yishyura, igiciro, na Solana transaction y'ubwishyu.
sitemap_index.d_defi: Agaciro kose kashyizwe mu bikorwa mu mafaranga y'ubukungu bwigenga, hamwe n'ibikorwa by'ingenzi byakurikiranwe na TVL, icyiciro cyabyo, imiyoboro, n'ihinduka mu minsi 1 na 7. Live kuva DeFiLlama, ishobora gutondekwa no gufatirwa ku cyiciro.
sitemap_index.d_demo: Abakozi babiri ba three.ws AI bafite wallets z'ukuri Solana basanga serivisi ku isoko rya x402, bishyurana muri SOL, kandi bagaragaza ishusho y'isoko ku TV mu isi yabo.
sitemap_index.d_demos: Index y'ibikorwa by'ibikorwa ku rubuga: abareba, abakozi, amafaranga, n'ibigeragezo.
sitemap_index.d_demos_agents: Imiterere 14 ziga uburyo umukozi wa 3D ubaho ku rubuga: ingufu z'ukuri, ibice by'urupapuro nk'ahakinirwa, n'umukozi uhuza na scroll, clicks, n'ikimenyetso.
sitemap_index.d_deploy_onchain: Mint umukozi wawe mu Metaplex Agent Registry ku Solana, mu ishusho nyayo ya Genesis 333: umutungo wa Metaplex Core ufite wallet yayo, EIP-8004 identity, umuhanzi wemejwe, royalties, na metadata idahinduka. Phantom, Solflare, cyangwa indi wallet Solana isinya; imfunguzo ntizigera zisohoka muri browser, kandi rehearsal ya devnet ni ubuntu.
sitemap_index.d_deployments: Ikirangantego cy'ibikorwa, cross-chain cy'abakozi bose bashyizwe ku ERC-8004 Identity Registry: igihe buri registration igera ku murongo. Registrations z'ukuri ku murongo gusa, hamwe n'ikimenyetso cy'umuyoboro, avatar ya 3D n'ibipimo by'ubushobozi x402.
sitemap_index.d_derivatives: Isoko ry'ibikorwa by'igihe kirekire ku masoko: igiciro, ihinduka mu masaha 24, igipimo cy'ubushobozi, inyungu ifunguye, n'ibipimo ku masezerano yose akomeye. Filter ku murongo w'ibanze (BTC, ETH, SOL) no gutondeka ku murongo uwo ari wo wose.
sitemap_index.d_dex_volumes: Buri exchange y'ubukungu bwigenga itondekanye ku rugero rw'ubucuruzi, hamwe n'ibipimo by'amasaha 24 na 7d, ihinduka mu minsi 7, n'igice cy'isoko, hamwe n'ishusho y'ubucuruzi rusange. Live kuva DeFiLlama.
sitemap_index.d_diff: Shyiramo amadosiye abiri .glb urebe neza icyo cyahindutse: geometry, ibikoresho, textures, skeletons n'ibice by'animation, hamwe no kumenya izina no kwimura mu buryo bwa git n'ubukana ushobora gushyiraho ku kubaka. Overlay, wipe, cyangwa shyira amamodeli abiri ku ruhande mu 3D. Ikoreshwa muri browser yawe, nta kintu na kimwe cyoherezwa.
sitemap_index.d_diorama: Vuga isi ntoya mu buryo: sobanura ishusho urebe uko ikora mu diorama ya 3D ushobora kugendamo, hanyuma uyijyane mu AR.
sitemap_index.d_discover: Directory y'abakozi ku murongo (ERC-8004 + Solana). Reba, shaka, kandi usuzume buri mukozi wiyandikishije.
sitemap_index.d_docs: Ibyanditswe byuzuye: SDKs, API reference, embedding, sisitemu y'abakozi, amasezerano y'ubwenge.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_api: 3D idafite imfunguzo ku bakozi ba AI. Nta mfunguzo, nta account, nta wallet: umukozi wigenzura ahindura igitekerezo cy'inyandiko mu GLB ifite texture mu guhamagara kumwe kwa HTTP. Endpoints, imiterere y'ibisabwa, n'amasezerano y'igikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_asset_pipeline: Icyitegererezo cy'ukuri cyo kwimura ikirangantego cya 3D cyangwa ibikorwa kuva ku isoko ry'inyandiko kugeza ku kintu browser ikora kandi ikora: imiterere itatu three.ws ikorana (FBX, GLB, na three.js clip JSON), uko buri kimwe gihinduka mu bindi, n'icyo urubuga rukora nabyo uyu munsi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_pipeline: Imihanda imwe urubuga rukoresha mu guhindura igitekerezo mu mukozi wateguwe, witeguye gukina, hamwe n'icyiciro cyose gikora gicuruzwa nk'igikoresho cyayo cyo kwishyura. Ibyo buri cyiciro gikora n'igiciro cyo kubikora ku giti cyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_vision: Buri API ivana mu nyandiko ijya mu 3D isubiza hamwe n'ihuriro ku kintu cy'ibanga umukozi wa AI atabasha gufungura, bityo umukozi wakoze icyitegererezo ntashobora kugenzura akazi ke. Iyi sura igaragaza GLB kuva ku nguni nyinshi kandi igasubiza amashusho nk'uko icyitegererezo cy'ibitekerezo kibona, kuri MCP, REST cyangwa @three-ws/see SDK.
sitemap_index.d_docs_a2a_payments: Uko umukozi umwe wa three.ws yishyura indi nzira yishyurwa idakeneye umuntu wese wemera buri kwishyura: uko itegeko ryo gukoreshwa ritangwa, buri muryango kwishyura unyuramo, inyandiko buri kimwe gisiga inyuma, n'uko wakwica umukozi wageze mu makosa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agenc: Protocole yo guhuza ku murongo three.ws isoma kugirango ibone akazi no kumenya umukozi. Imiyoboro ishyizweho, n'uko three.ws abakozi bahuzwa na yo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_abilities: Ikibaho cyuzuye cy'ubushobozi bwose bw'umukozi, bwakozwe hashingiwe ku murongo w'ibikorwa: umubiri, imikorere, ubwenge, ijwi, umwirondoro, ubumenyi, ibikoresho, ubukungu, ikarita y'ubushobozi 23, isi, n'urubuga rw'abakora: ibice 15 hamwe n'ubushakashatsi bwihariye ku bushobozi bwose ku Ikarita y'Umukozi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_economy_volume: /agent-economy-volume ni urutonde rusange rw'ubukungu hagati y'abakozi: amafaranga yose USDC abakozi ba three.ws barakoresheje mu kwishyura ubumenyi ku mbuga za x402, hamwe n'uko ababona, abakoreshwa, n'uko bigenda buri munsi mu minsi 90 ishize.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_identities: Buri mukozi wa AI akwiye isura. Studio y'Umwirondoro w'Umukozi ifata izina ry'umukozi n'ibisobanuro by'ikirango mu rurimi rworoheje ikagarura umwirondoro wuzuye: avatar ya GLB yateguwe, ifoto y'ikibaho y'uburebure igumana isura nziza ku gipimo cy'ifoto ntoya, n'ikibaho cyuzuye gifite umucyo w'icyumba.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_index: Urutonde rw'ibikorwa by'ikoranabuhanga rw'ubuhanga bw'abakozi, itangizwa ry'ibimenyetso, ibimenyetso by'icyizere, guhererekanya no kugena, Solana mbere: ihuriro rimwe rusange, ibihe by'ukuri ku murongo, n'ubushya bw'urutonde bwamamaza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_manifest: Ibisobanuro byuzuye by'umukozi wa AI ufite umubiri mu nyandiko imwe ya JSON: umubiri we wa 3D, ubwonko bwa LLM, ijwi, imico, ubumenyi, ubushobozi, n'umwirondoro ku murongo. Buri murongo, ubwoko bwayo, ibikubiyemo, n'ibikurwaho niba ubihinduye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_reputation: Impamvu abakozi bigenzura bakeneye icyizere gishobora kwemezwa, n'uko three.ws itanga icyizere gishobora kwimurwa ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_runtime: Icyuma cy'ubuyobozi gifite ibyiciro birindwi gigenzura buri gikorwa cyose gikoreshwa mu guhererekanya amafaranga mu biganiro mbere y'uko ikarita itanga amabwiriza: urutonde rw'umutekano, politiki y'ibyemezo, imipaka y'amafaranga hamwe n'ibiciro bya SOL, igikapu cyo gukoreshwa gifite ikirango n'urwego rw'ubwirinzi, gukumira kw'ibihombo bya MEV, n'ubushobozi bwa x402. Ikoreshwa nka @three-ws/agent-runtime.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_screen_control: Buri mukozi afite ecran y'ubuzima ushobora kureba ikora akazi nyakuri ku rubuga nyakuri. Niba ufite umukozi, ushobora gufata ubuyobozi kuri uwo murongo byihuse: imbeba, gusoma, urufunguzo, kugenda. Uko guhererekanya bikorwa n'impamvu urubuga rudafite ikarita.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_shell: Buri mushyitsi abona umukozi ufite izina mu gihe cy'amasegonda atanu yinjira, kandi shell ikora uwo mukozi uko ukoresha urubuga: urutonde rw'amabwiriza rukora amabwiriza nyakuri, n'ubugendanyi hagati y'impapuro butazigama umukozi wawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_skills: Amakarita y'ubumenyi ashobora kwimurwa yigisha urubuga rwa Claude (Claude Code, porogaramu za Claude, Agent SDK) uko wakoresha three.ws: gukora 3D, amakarita, n'ibikorwa byishyurwa. Igice cya 3D kirakora ku mbuga zose kandi ntikikeneye ibyangombwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_sniper: Uko three.ws abakozi bacuruza mu buryo bwigenga: igikorwa gishya cyo gutangiza, imiryango yinjiramo, urukuta rwo kugerageza kugurisha, urutonde rw'ibyemezo by'ibimenyetso, urukiramende rwo gusohoka, n'ubushakashatsi ku bucuruzi bwa mbere bwabaye +42%.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_studio: Andika ubwonko bw'umukozi, ubushobozi, umubiri, amafaranga, n'ubumenyi ahantu hamwe, hafi ya avatar ya 3D ikomeza ikora ivugurura ahantu hose uko uhindura.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_symphony: three.ws/symphony ikina ubukungu bw'abakozi mu buryo bw'umuziki. Buri nota ni igikorwa nyakuri ku rubuga rwigenga: kwishyura birakora, amafaranga agura ubutaka nk'ibihangano, abakozi bashya baririmba, kwanga umutekano bigakora nk'ubusumbane bwihariye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_system: Uko abakozi, avatars, ubumenyi, n'ubushobozi bihurira hamwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_tokens: Hindura umukozi mu kintu cy'ubukungu: ikarita ya Solana ifite umwirondoro w'umukozi aho kuba uwuzuye ifishi y'itangizwa. Igaragaza uko wakwitegura ikarita mbere y'uko ibaho, kwiga itangizwa ku buntu, n'itegeko rimwe rishobora kuyitangiza mu buryo nyakuri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_vitals: Igenzura ryose ryari ryiza mu gihe abakozi bagera ku icumi mu mirongo cumi n'ibiri batakoze mu byumweru. Icyemezo cy'ubushobozi kigaragaza ibikenewe by'umukozi nk'igishushanyo cy'ibikurikirana kandi kigarura umuzenguruko w'ibibazo hamwe n'itegeko ribikemura, aho kuba urutonde rw'ibimenyetso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_wallet_api: Buri mukozi wa three.ws afite urubuga rwa Solana rw'ububiko. Uburyo butandatu bw'abafite uburenganzira gusa buba bushingiyeho, kandi ibi ni ibikoresho byabo by'abakora: inzira zose, ibisabwa n'ibisubizo JSON, amakosa yihariye, n'itumanaho rikora rya curl kuri buri kimwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_wallets: Buri mukozi wa three.ws afite urubuga rwa Solana rw'ububiko, arirwo rumufasha gukora ku giti cye: kwishyura ku itumanaho rya API, guha undi mukozi igihembo, kwakira inyungu ze. Icyitegererezo cy'ububiko, amafaranga, imipaka, n'ibikoresho ku bijyanye no gukoresha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agents_vs_avatars: three.ws yubatswe ku bitekerezo bibiri bitandukanye: abakozi ni ibitekerezo bya AI, avatars ni imibiri ya 3D. Ibisobanuro byoroheje, mu rurimi rworoshye, ku byerekeye ibyo ari byo, uburyo bihurira, n'impamvu itandukaniro rifite akamaro igihe ushaka ikiranga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agi: Umukozi umwe wihariye ushoboye cyane mu kintu kimwe, gucuruza memecoins kuri pump.fun, kandi nta kindi. Umubiri we wa 3D, ibyemezo bye byanditswe hamwe n'icyizere cyavuzwe, n'ibikorwa bye byemejwe ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_airdrops: Uko igenzura ry'ubushobozi bwo kwakira airdrop rikora: isuzuma ry'ibikorwa bitagira urufunguzo rwa Solana n'isuzuma rya Etherscan V2 EVM, igenzura rya DSL n'ibipimo by'amanota, amasezerano y'ukuri ku bipimo bitagereranywa no mu buryo bw'intoki, n'imiterere y'igikorwa cyose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_alpha_copilot: Umukozi wawe wa 3D asoma itangizwa rya pump.fun mu buryo bwihariye, bushingiye ku mafaranga aboneka, abashinzwe, n'ibipimo by'ubukire, kandi akavuga igitekerezo cye mu ijwi. Imibare y'ibinyoma irahakanwa; nyir'ubwite akora gusa mu mipaka y'ikoreshwa ishyirwaho n'iserver.
sitemap_index.d_docs_alpha_drip: Alpha-drip ituma umuyobozi w'ubucuruzi bw'ibihangano agena igihe cyo gutinda ku ikimenyetso cye: abafite $THREE mu byiciro byisumbuye babona igitekerezo cyo gukoporora mbere, abandi bose nyuma y'igihe umuyobozi agena. Ibi bitinda kugaragaza, ariko ntibihindura inyandiko.
sitemap_index.d_docs_analytics_retention: Uko three.ws ipima umubare umwe ugena icyiciro cya 2 cy'igishushanyo: niba abakoresha basubira kuganira n'umukozi bashyizeho. Ibisobanura itsinda, igikorwa cyo gusubira, n'ubushakashatsi ku mubare watangajwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animation_seeding: Uko three.ws ikora amashusho yayo y'ibikorwa: umuhanda wa GPU uva mu nyandiko ujya mu ngendo, urwego rw'ubuziranenge bw'isi rusesengura imyanya y'uduce aho kuba guhinduranya gusa, umukozi ushobora gusubirwamo, n'igice cy'ubwisanzure gihinduka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animation_studio: Shyira avatar cyangwa mannequin yubatse mu buryo bwa FK/IK, shyiraho igihe cy'ibimenyetso, reba mu gihe nyacyo, kandi usohore GLB y'ibikorwa cyangwa JSON y'igice. Bika ibice ku rubuga rwawe kandi ubishyire ku isoko muri USDC.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animations: Amashusho y'ibikorwa (guhagarara, guhamagara, kubyina, n'andi 3,000) atuma avatars za three.ws zibaho: uko urutonde ruyobowe, uko ibice byinjira mu gihe cy'ikoreshwa, uko bihinduranya ku mukozi uwo ari we wese, n'uko ushobora kureba buri kimwe mu rubuga rwawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ar: Ibyanditswe ku kureba mu buryo bw'ukuri bwiyongereye ku miterere ya three.ws n'avatars.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ar_studio: Shyira imibiri ya 3D n'avatars mu ishusho imwe y'ikamera: inkomoko z'imibiri, urutonde rwa WebXR/passthrough/desktop, imikono, ibyumba by'ubuzima byungurana ibitekerezo, n'ibikorwa bishobora gusangirwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_architecture: Ikibaho cy'ubuhanga cya three.ws: uko icyifuzo gitambuka kuva mu rubuga rw'ibikoresho rugana ku murongo, aho ikorwa rya 3D rikorerwa, uko leta ibikwa, n'icyiciro ugomba kongeramo igihe ushaka kongeramo ikintu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_assistant_widget: Ongeramo umufasha wa 3D ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose: script imwe y'ikimenyetso, igipaki cya @three-ws/assistant npm, n'iserver ya assistant-widget MCP ku bakozi ba AI.
sitemap_index.d_docs_atlas: Uko palette ya Cmd+K ikora ku rubuga rwose, uko shortcuts z'ibikorwa zisubiza intego mu byiciro byateguwe aho kuba umuyoboro, uko wongeramo kimwe, n'uko ufungura palette uvuye ku ipaji yawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_atomic: Reba ibikorwa bya V0 na V1 Solana hakoreshejwe umukono cyangwa ibice by'icyuma, harimo imipaka ya V1 transactionConfig abaterankunga n'abashinzwe gusoma bagomba gusoma.
sitemap_index.d_docs_authentication: Injira na Solana (SIWS), Injira na Ethereum (SIWE), kwinjira kwa Privy email/wallet, ibihe, n'ibikeyi za API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autonomous_economy: Uko three.ws ikusanya amafaranga mu bubiko bwayo bwa on-chain n'aho buri dollar igenda: imari y'ibanze n'ibikorerwa, uburyo bwo kongera amafaranga/gusubiza amafaranga, urutonde rw'abemerewe n'ibikurura byinjiza amafaranga mu mifuka y'ikigo, n'ibikoresho bibiri byo kugenzura amafaranga byakira buri mwanditsi ku on-chain buri munota, hamwe n'uko wemeza ko nta mafaranga yacitse ubwawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autonomous_x402: Umukiriya uteganyijwe wishyura x402 ku buryo buhoraho kugira ngo utange oracle na sniper: USDC nyakuri, imishyikirano nyakuri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autopilot: Ikibaho cy'ibimenyetso bitagoranye: shyiramo amategeko yo kugura no kuyihindura hamwe n'ibipimo bya USDC n'ibikurura, hanyuma uhe agaciro agent yawe gukora amafaranga mu buryo bwigenga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_artifact: Umukino wihariye w'avatar ushobora gushyirwa ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose nka iframe imwe: ibiparameter byayo ?agent= na ?model=, abashinzwe umushinga bashobora kuva, uko rig itagira clip ikomeza kubaho, n'ijambo urupapuro rwerekana ku buryo bwose bushobora kugwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_cli: Icyerekezo cy'ibisobanuro ku @three-ws/avatar-cli: init, validate, hash, na preview, hamwe n'ibimenyetso byose, ikimenyetso cyo gusohoka, n'uburyo bwa JSON, hamwe n'ibipimo bibiri bigenzura isohoka ku mwandiko wawe w'avatar.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_creation: Uburyo butatu bwo guha agent umubiri wa 3D: gukora umwe uhereye ku ifoto, kubaka umwe mu rubuga ukoresheje umubaka w'avatar, cyangwa gushyira ku rubuga rwawe GLB. Ibyo buri nzira ikoresha, ibyo buri nzira itanga, n'igihe cyo guhitamo iyihe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_engines: Ikibaho cy'ukuri cy'ibikoresho by'ubuntu n'ibigo byubaka avatars z'abantu ba 3D zifite ireme n'ukuri: imirambo ya Gaussian-splat, abantu b'ifoto imwe, abatanga ibitekerezo by'avatar, n'ibikoresho by'ibikorwa three.ws byamaze gukina.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_inspector: Buri avatar uhuye nayo mu isi ya three.ws ni umuntu: umukinnyi, agent ayoboye, cyangwa umuturage ugurisha serivisi yishyurwa. Kanda I ku muntu wese kugira ngo ubone izina ryabo, umufuka, n'ibisobanuro batagombye kuva mu isi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_pipeline: Uko igitekerezo cy'inyandiko cyangwa ifoto bihinduka avatar ya 3D ifite rig, ikinwa: gukora, auto-rigging, gutunganya uruhu, n'uburyo bw'animasi bw'isi yose butanga umusaruro ku ngingo iyo ari yo yose y'umubiri w'umuntu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_reconstruction: Icyiciro gishinzwe guhindura ifoto (cyangwa ishusho y'icyitegererezo yakozwe) mu avatar ya 3D ifite rig, ready for animation. Uko itandukanya n'uburyo bwo guhindura inyandiko mu 3D, ibyo ibipimo by'ubuziranenge bigenzura, n'uko ibitagenda neza bikoreshwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_studio: Kora avatar ya 3D ifite rig uhereye ku ntangiriro udakoresheje selfie: hitamo umubiri w'ibanze, shushanya isura n'ibihinduka by'umubiri, ongeramo imyenda n'ibikoresho, hanyuma usohore GLB.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_thumbnails: Aho ishusho y'icyerekana avatar ituruka, itegeko rimwe buri nzira y'ikode ikurikiza (ntukigere usohora URL y'icyerekana idafite ikintu kibaho), crons zigumya igipimo hafi ya 100%, n'uko wakora backfill ubwawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_wardrobe: Fata avatar iyo ari yo yose mu gitabo cy'imyenda. Igice gishobora gukuraho cyangwa guhisha ibice GLB ifite; igice gishya gishyira imyenda mishya ku mubiri utigeze uyifite, kandi ibi bigaragaza byombi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center: AWS Builder Center ni urubuga rwa Amazon rwo gusangiza umuryango ku bashinzwe kubaka kuri AWS. three.ws ishyirwa ahagaragara kuri konti yayo y'ikigo, kandi ibi ni urutonde rw'ibyo bamaze gushyira ahagaragara.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_agent_payment_: Hari igihe mu kubaka agentic aho agent ikeneye kugura ikintu. Kumuhereza urufunguzo rwihariye si igisubizo cyiza. Igihe cyo kwishyura gitanga ingengo y'imari ifite umupaka, kandi uko bikora.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_marketplace_x4: Gushyira metering ya AWS Marketplace imbere ya x402 API yishyurwa ku buryo bw'ikigega, bityo ikintu kimwe gishobora kwishyura umukiriya w'ikigo binyuze kuri konti yabo ya AWS n'agent yikora binyuze mu kwishyura ku on-chain.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_mcp_agents: Ibikoresho byinshi bya AI bifata ko umuntu ahari afite ikarita y'ishoramari n'urufunguzo rwa API. Uyu murongo uracika igihe uwuhamagara ari agent. Uko wakora ibikoresho agent ishobora kubona, kwishyura, no gukoresha idakoresheje umuntu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_marketplace: three.ws ni umufatanyabikorwa wemewe wa AWS. Igicuruzwa cya AWS Marketplace ni urutonde rwa SaaS rishingiye ku API aho kwiyandikisha ari urugi rw'ubuntu: rihuza konti yawe ya AWS na konti y'urubuga kandi rigatanga urufunguzo rwa x402. Guhuza, ibipimo, n'ibisobanuro by'uru rutonde.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_partner_spotlight: Abakoresha AI b'ibigo byinshi baba mu isanduku y'ikiganiro. Ku bagize ikirango, ibitabo by'ibicuruzwa, abarimu, n'abafasha mu iduka, umubiri uhindura uko bigenda. Uko three.ws yubaka ibyo kuri AWS.
sitemap_index.d_docs_blender_mcp: Tanga umukozi wa AI Blender ku mashini yawe, udafite umutwe: reba, hindura, shyira mu bikorwa no kwandika dosiye za 3D, hamwe na text-to-3D mu ishusho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_bnb_payments: Ibyanditswe ku kwishyura ukoresheje BNB kuri three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_docs_brain: Ohereza icyifuzo kimwe kuri Claude, GPT, Qwen, ModelScope, Groq n'abandi icyarimwe, hamwe no gukurikirana ku ruhande no ku giciro cya buri model n'ibipimo by'ibimenyetso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_brownout: Igisubizo cyose kivuga aho amakuru yacyo yaturutse n'ukuntu ari mashya, kandi buri fallback API ivuga ko yakozwe koko ku muyoboro w'ukuri, mu nzira y'icyifuzo umukozi akoresha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ca2x402: Shyira aderesi y'ikimenyetso, subiza isoko ry'ubumenyi bwa x402 rishobora kwishyurwa n'umukozi kuri icyo kimenyetso. Aho hantu hakozwe hishyurwa make USDC kuri buri guhamagara, hishobora kuboneka mu isoko rya x402, kandi ntikeneye imfunguzo, inyuma, cyangwa gushyirwa mu bikorwa n'umuntu wakoresheje.
sitemap_index.d_docs_capture: Hindura videwo y'igikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose ikaba ikiranga 3D y'ibipimo bifite ibara hamwe no gusubiramo, ibipimo byo gufata, no gushyira mu bikorwa WebGL.
sitemap_index.d_docs_carplay: Uko umukozi wa three.ws akora mu modoka: ibyiciro by'uburenganzira bwa CarPlay bipimwa, impamvu icyiciro cy'ikiganiro gishingiye ku ijwi cya Apple ari cyo gikwiranye n'ukuntu kidatanga ahantu ho gushushanya, imishinga y'imbere mu modoka ifite isoko ifite agaciro n'iyindi itabikora, n'ukuntu /drive, ishusho ya CarPlay y'ibanze, n'igikoresho gifunguye byubaka ishyirwa mu bikorwa rimwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_changelog: Uko three.ws ikorwa, ibihinduka mu byiciro, n'ukuntu wakwiyongera mu mutekano. Yanditswe ku bakora porogaramu bashyira SDK cyangwa CDN bundle ku cyiciro runaka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_character_library: Igitabo cy'Abakinnyi ni igishushanyo cy'ubuntu, cyateguwe neza cy'abakinnyi ba 3D b'ibinyabuzima bateguwe neza. Buri mukinnyi uje nk'ikintu cya GLB gishobora gukoreshwa ku rubuga, gifite umubiri wuzuye, ibiro by'uruhu, n'ibishushanyo, bityo bigatuma bigenga isoko ryose rya three.ws ry'ibikorwa (guhagarara, kugenda, kwiruka, gukoma, kubyina, n'ibindi).
sitemap_index.d_docs_character_studio: Avatar Studio ni umwubatsi w'avatar uherereye mu rubuga, ufite uruhushya rwa MIT, uherereye muri character-studio/. Tegura umubiri w'umuntu wihariye (umubiri, imisatsi, isura, imyenda, ibikoresho) ukoresheje ibikoresho byo gukanda no gukanda, hanyuma ubishyire mu bikorwa nk'GLB cyangwa VRM.
sitemap_index.d_docs_chatgpt_3d_studio_gpt: Igenamigambi ry'ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi bwa three.ws 3D Studio custom GPT: amabwiriza, amasezerano y'ibikorwa akora, umutekano, n'ibishushanyo by'ibisubizo bigumana ubuziranenge bw'ububiko.
sitemap_index.d_docs_chatgpt_ar: Uko interuro yanditswe muri ChatGPT ihinduka ikimenyetso cya 3D kiri mu cyumba cyawe: inzira y'ubuntu yo gukora, amasezerano ya arUrl, umuyoboro wa AR uzi ibikoresho, avatars ziriho, n'ukuntu links zigaragara.
sitemap_index.d_docs_checkout_companion: Icyongereza cy'ibikoresho gisohoza urupapuro rw'ishyura mbere yo kwishyura: igiteranyo ku giciro wagaragajwe, amafaranga urupapuro rutigeze rugaragaza, amafaranga yitwa n'ibisubizo, n'ibyo inyandiko ntoya ikugira. Imibare ibarwa aho gukurikirana ahubwo ikaboneka ku isura.
sitemap_index.d_docs_choreography: Icyerekezo cy'abakora porogaramu ku bikorwa by'ibimenyetso by'umukozi: uburyo bw'ibikorwa, ibikubiyemo n'ibipimo, uburyo bwa URL butuma link iba igikorwa, n'uburyo bwose bwo gukina kimwe mu bikoreshwa cyangwa umukozi wawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_circulation_engine: Umuyoboro w'ibikorwa by'ibikoresho byigenga: ikibuga cy'abakoresha urubuga nyakuri bategura, bishyura, guhererekanya, no gutangiza hamwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_clash: Intambara y'abaturage ifite ibimenyetso: buri muryango w'ifaranga ni ingabo. Fata ifaranga, wiyandikishe, kandi uhuze ku bwoko bwawe mu ntambara z'igihe ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_cli: Hindura Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI cyangwa Hermes kuri three.ws mu itegeko rimwe: npx three-ws setup ikwandika, ikandika buri MCP config y'umukiriya kandi ikemeza buri seriveri n'ibikoresho/live.
sitemap_index.d_docs_coin3d_embed: Shyira ishusho ya 3D y'ubuzima bw'igiciro icyo ari cyo cyose Solana ku rupapuro rwawe ukoresheje iframe imwe, ikozwe n'ikimenyetso cyangwa aderesi y'ikibanza urutonde rwawe rukoreshwa. Ihuza umuyoboro w'ikimenyetso, ibipimo, ingano, ibihugu byateguwe, no kuyobora ishusho kuva ku rupapuro rw'ikibanza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_coin_wars: Uko intambara hagati y'imiryango ikora kuri three.ws: urubuga rw'intambara mu isi y'ibiceri, urufunguzo rwo guhuza imiryango ibiri, guhuza kwemejwe n'ahantu hizewe, urutonde rwa Elo ruvuguruye ruvuye mu gitabo cy'intambara, n'ikimenyetso /api/wars inyuma y'ibyo byose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_community: Aho umuryango wa three.ws uvugira: Ikiganiro cya GitHub, umuryango wa Telegram, umuryango wa X, itsinda ry'umuryango wa IBM, n'ikigega cy'itanga, hamwe n'ubuyobozi ku cyumba cyiza ku kibazo cyose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_companion: Umufasha wihariye: guhuza bot yawe ya Telegram, kalendari, inbox, cyangwa telefone, guha abavugana n'amasura n'ijwi, no kugira ikirangantego cya 3D gitanga ibyo bifite akamaro mu buryo bwihariye. Imiyoboro, amategeko yo gutoranya, SDK, CLI, seriveri ya MCP, n'igikoresho cya desktop.
sitemap_index.d_docs_compose: Forge props kuva mu nyandiko, kubihuza n'amagufa y'avatar yawe, kubitegura no kubigabanya uko ushaka, hanyuma ukohereza GLB cyangwa ugasiga umusaruro nk'ishuri rishobora gukoreshwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_concierge: Launcher igenda ifungura ikiganiro aho avatar ya 3D ifite imiyoboro ibona, ididle, kandi ikavuga mu gihe igisubizo ku bashyitsi bawe. Ihamye mu mutwe w'ibikubiye ku ipaji yawe, ifite ijwi mu n'ijwi, mu tag imwe y'ikandiko.
sitemap_index.d_docs_configuration: Buri variable y'ibidukikije n'inyandiko y'ibikubiye three.ws isoma, icyo buri kimwe gitangiza, n'icyo default yizewe ari cyo. Yanditswe ku bashyiraho ubwabo no ku bakora porogaramu bashyira mu bikorwa ibidukikije byaho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_contributing: Kuva ku ikopi nshya kugeza ku busabe bw'ihuriro: gushyiraho ibidukikije byaho, uko ikizamini cyateguwe, amategeko y'ikode repository ikora, n'uko impinduka ishobora gusuzumwa igaragara hano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_copy_coach: Uko Copy Coach ifasha umuntu utarigeze abikora kuva ku ntsinzi nyayo n'inyandiko yayo yose, ikanyura mu nyandiko y'ibihimbano, ikagera ku nyandiko ntoya ifite umupaka w'iseriveri yemejwe: ibikapu by'itangira, ikarita y'ukwemeza, ibisubizo by'umuco by'ihamye, n'API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_copy_trading: Copy trading yemera ko wallet imwe ikurikira izindi mu bucuruzi nyabyo. Imashini ebyiri ziri inyuma yayo: umuyoboro w'agent w'ububiko, aho urubuga rwemeza ubucuruzi nyabyo ku murongo uva mu wallet y'agent yawe mu mabwiriza yayo yo gukoresha, n'ubusabe butari ububiko, bwandika intego ifite ingano yo gusinya.
sitemap_index.d_docs_cosmos: Uko NVIDIA Cosmos ikora videwo y'ukuri inyuma y'avatar ya 3D itagaragara: akazi ko gukora async, ishusho n'ikuramo, n'igishushanyo cyateguwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_create_agent: npm create @three-ws/agent ihindura interuro ikaba ikirangantego cya 3D gishobora gukurwaho gifite ipaji ikora. Nta konti, nta urufunguzo rwa API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_creator_portfolio: Ibintu byose umuremyi akora kuri three.ws (avatars, agents, imiterere y'ibihimbano, isi, ibiceri, ubumenyi, plugins, n'ibindi) bigaragara ku ipaji imwe rusange: https://three.ws/u/<username>.
sitemap_index.d_docs_crews: Uko amatsinda akora: urutonde rusange rw'itsinda ryose rifite abanyamuryango, gushakisha ubutumire hamwe n'ibisobanuro by'uko kwinjira, icyumba cy'ibiro, n'uko drawer y'inshuti mu isi y'ibiceri ihuza na byo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_crypto_api: Icyerekezo cy'abakora porogaramu ku buntu, bundle ya Crypto Data API itagira urufunguzo: ikimenyetso cyo gushakisha kimwe (GET /api/crypto), igishushanyo cya OpenAPI 3.1 cyakozwe, n'ibikubiye byose by'ibimenyetso, ibyasohotse, imiterere, n'ibisobanuro bya curl: ibishushanyo by'ibimenyetso, status y'ububiko, ibikomeye, ibikurura, portfolios za wallet, n'ubushobozi bw'ikimenyetso.
sitemap_index.d_docs_custody: Imipaka yo gukoresha, urufunguzo rwo gufunga, icyemezo cya Merkle cy'ububiko hamwe no kwemeza mu rubuga, n'uburyo bwo gusubiza no guhererekanya ku maboko y'ibikoresho by'agent.
sitemap_index.d_docs_daily_forge: Ikibazo gishya cya 3D buri munsi: insanganyamatsiko yihariye, umuhanda wo gukora udakeneye kwiyandikisha, ikurikirane ya localStorage ifite intambwe, umuyoboro w'umuryango, n'ikoherezwa rya AR.
sitemap_index.d_docs_daily_match: /daily-match ni urutonde rw'ibikorwa by'ubu rufite igisubizo ku kibazo kimwe: ni nde agent ugaragaza umusaruro nyawo cyane uyu munsi? Buri mubare uri ku rutonde ni umubare cyangwa igiteranyo cy'ibikorwa by'urubuga rw'ibikubiye (ibikorwa ku murongo, ubucuruzi, kugurisha ubumenyi, gutangiza ibiceri); nta kintu na kimwe ni metric y'ubucuruzi bw'ibihimbano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_deployment: Kora instance yawe ya three.ws, kuva ku container imwe ya Node ikora porogaramu yose kugeza ku ishyirwaho ryihariye ku bwoko bwose bwa Node.js. Ibidukikije, ububiko, kubaka, n'ibipimo by'ubuzima byo gukurikirana.
sitemap_index.d_docs_deployments: /deployments ni urutonde rw'ibikorwa, ruri ku murongo, rw'ibimenyetso by'agent bigera ku murongo: buri ERC-8004 Identity Registry yanditswe kuri EVM n'ibimenyetso bya Metaplex Core ku Solana, mu murongo umwe w'igihe, uko buri kimwe kigera. Ni urubuga rusange rw'amasomo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_design_tokens: Ijambo ry'ingenzi mu myandikire y'igishushanyo buri three.ws ishusho ikomokaho: ibara, intera, ingano y'inyuguti, radii, n'ibikorwa by'ubugeni, hamwe n'icyemezo cy'ukuri cy'ibikubiyemo buri token ibarizwamo n'ukuntu ibice by'ibikubiyemo byiyongera hejuru.
sitemap_index.d_docs_developer_platform: Ibintu byose ukeneye kugira ngo wubake kuri three.ws mu buryo bwa porogaramu: imfunguzo za API zo kugera ku mashini, ibipimo by'ikoreshwa ku rubuga rwawe, webhooks zohereza ibirori by'avatar n'agent ku murongo wawe, ikizamini cy'ihuriro kimwe cya MCP, n'ibice bibiri by'ubushakashatsi rusange (urutonde rw'ibikoresho MCP n'ubushobozi bw'agent).
sitemap_index.d_docs_diorama: Uko interuro imwe iba diorama ya 3D ishobora gusuzumwa: LLM ikora ishusho y'ahantu, buri kintu gikorwa ku GLB nyakuri kandi gishyirwa hamwe mu buryo bw'ako kanya, hanyuma bigahabwa permalink y'igikurikirana rusange, bigoherezwa muri Scene Studio, cyangwa bigakorwa mu AR.
sitemap_index.d_docs_do_i_need_crypto: Ibisubizo by'ukuri ku bibazo by'umutwe n'ubwishyu: ibikenera crypto, ibitakenera, n'uko ubwishyu bukora.
sitemap_index.d_docs_doc_freshness: Buri nyandiko ihuzwa n'ikode yitwa, kandi git igenzura niba iyo kode yarimuwe nyuma y'uko urupapuro rwanditswe bwa nyuma cyangwa rwagenzuwe bwa nyuma. Uko igipimo gikora, icyo buri mwanya bisobanura, uko wakwandika ko wagenzuye urupapuro, n'aho igenzura rikorerwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_docs_world: Ibyanditswe bya three.ws nk'ahantu hashobora gusuzumwa: ibikubiyemo bimwe byatanzwe nk'impapuro zisanzwe no nk'isi ya 3D ishobora kugendwa, kuva ku isoko rimwe. Uko izo mbuga zombi zigenzura mu buryo bumwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_draft_agent_mint: Buri gusubiramo kurangira kubikwa mu buryo burambye kandi bigakorwa nk'ikimenyetso cya draft ku murongo w'agent: ikirenge cya Solana, ikirenge cya ERC-8004, ibendera bihagarika buri kimwe, n'uko wemeza inzira yose ku devnet.
sitemap_index.d_docs_drops: Uko amoko ya 3D akorwa kuri three.ws: ibice by'ibikurikirana bifite ibipimo, ibikenewe byakozwe kuva ku mbuto yashyizwe ahagaragara, ubukana bushingiye ku itangwa nyakuri, ubuhanzi bwakozwe ku kintu cyose mu gihe cyo kugaragaza, n'ahantu ho kugenzura umuntu wese ashobora kongera kubara ibikenewe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_economy_solver: Icyitegererezo cyihariye inyuma ya /play/solver: amafaranga yitezwe, XP n'inyungu ku isaha kuri buri node ishobora gukusanywa ku rwego rwose, igabanya ryiza ry'ifunguro n'igikoni, kwishyura mu iduka, n'ibitekerezo nyakuri ibarwa ishingiyeho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_editor: Reba kandi uhindure icyitegererezo cya 3D cy'agent mu rubuga: hindura ibikoresho n'ibishushanyo, wubake manifest y'agent, kandi ushyire ahagaragara ibisubizo ku rubuga. Ikora neza ku ruhande rw'umukoresha kugeza igihe ukandagiye gushyira ahagaragara.
sitemap_index.d_docs_embedding: Shyira agent mu iframe, oEmbed, cyangwa igice cya <agent-3d> cy'urubuga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_embody: Ahantu hamwe hihindura igitekerezo cyangwa ishusho mu buryo bushobora gushyirwa, bwihuta, bufite ijwi bwa 3D ku agent ku murongo uwo ari wo wose. Icyo guhamagara kigarura, uko gushyira mu bikorwa bikora, n'icyo kwishyura kumwe kugarura.
sitemap_index.d_docs_event_souvenirs: Icyibutsa cy'ubuntu cyambikwa cyahawe buri mukinnyi uri mu isi ya $THREE mu gihe igikorwa cyabaye: icyo ari cyo, uko server igenzura uwagihabwa, impamvu kidashobora kugurwa, n'uko wakwambara nyuma yaho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_examples: Kode yiteguye gukoporora no gushyira mu bikorwa ku byifuzo bisanzwe bya three.ws. Buri rugero rukora uko rwanditswe: hindura URL y'icyitegererezo cyawe kandi ugende. Igaragaza gushyira mu bikorwa, kugenzura animation, imirimo y'camera, no guhindura icyitegererezo mu gihe cy'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_exit_lab: Uko replay y'ibitekerezo ikora: urugendo rw'ibice bibiri ku nzira y'igiciro cyanditswe, impamvu itanga kode y'igikorwa cy'iherezo aho kwiyubaka, imyanya itarimo n'impamvu, n'ibipimo nyakuri ibyo replay ishobora kwemeza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_fact_check: Gusuzuma ukuri kw'ibikubiyemo bifite ibimenyetso by'ukuri by'ibikubiyemo, igipimo cy'ukuri cyatanzwe, n'ikigero cy'ubuntu cy'ibyo usuzuma hanyuma ukishyura ku isuzuma binyuze kuri x402.
sitemap_index.d_docs_fade_radar: Uko Fade Radar ikora ku ruhande rw'igura ry'ifaranga: ibikora ikarita y'umutwe, ikipimo cya fade kuva kuri 0 kugeza kuri 100, ibice by'icyemezo, n'ibipimo by'ibisubizo bitari mu rugero.
sitemap_index.d_docs_farcaster_memory_seeding: Tanga ijwi ryawe rya Farcaster ku agent ufite uruhushya rwihariye: uburenganzira bwerekanwa no gushyira umukono ku kibazo n'umutwe wemejwe na protokole (Solana mbere), gusa umwirondoro wawe rusange n'ibikorwa by'ibyo ushyira hanze ni byo bisomwa, kandi gukuraho uruhushya bisiba buri mwanya wibukiranya.
sitemap_index.d_docs_feedback: Kumenyesha umufasha w'ikibanza icyo cyangiritse: icyifuzo cyihutirwa mu gihe cy'ikibazo, inzira, SHA y'ubwubatsi, n'amakosa ya console yakiriwe kuri wowe, ubukana n'amategeko yo gukusanya, API y'ibaruwa, n'umupaka ugenzura ko inyandiko z'abashyitsi batizewe zitagera ku kintu na kimwe gifite uburenganzira bwo kwandika.
sitemap_index.d_docs_first_contribution: Gukoporora kugirango ufungure pull request mu minota 15, hamwe n'icyitegererezo cyuzuye: kwigisha avatar retargeter uburyo bwo kwita ku magambo y'inyama itari izwi, hamwe n'ikizamini kigaragaza ko byakunze.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forge: Uko Forge ihindura igitekerezo cyanditse, amafoto, cyangwa igishushanyo mu mwirondoro wa 3D ushobora gukururwa (GLB): urubuga rwa moteri y'ubuntu rufite status y'ubuzima, uburyo bwo kwinjiza, imiterere y'ibisohoka, gusubira ku kazi, no gukora mu buryo bw'inyuma.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forge_background_generation: Ibyakozwe na Forge birakurikiranywa ku ruhande rwa server kugeza birangiye. Tangira igikorwa, ufunge urupapuro, kandi urubuga rurangiza akazi, rukabika umwirondoro mu ngoro yawe, kandi rukakumenyesha igihe bigeze kuba byiteguye. Uko gukurikirana n'itangazo bikora.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forge_off: Hindura Fresh itari ikora iva ku Forge mu kibaho cy'amarushanwa: buri gikorwa cy'ubushakashatsi gishobora kwiyongera, urutonde ruvugururwa hakurikijwe amanota, kandi umutsinzi w'icyumweru ahabwa ikamba. Uko amajwi abara n'ubugome bukumirwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forge_pipeline: Inyandiko y'ubuhanga ku Forge: buri mwanya winjizwamo, urutonde rw'ibikoresho byatangajwe, uburyo bwo gutwara bwita ku buzima bw'ubuntu, ubuzima bw'akazi hamwe n'uburyo bubiri bwo kwihanganira, ububiko n'ububiko, abakozi ba GPU, gutunganya nyuma, kwishyura, n'uko wateza imbere urujya n'uruza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_forged: three.ws/forged ni ingoro rusange y'ibikoresho bya 3D platform y'ibikoresho byayo bwite byaguze hamwe na USDC nyakuri hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo kwishyura x402.
sitemap_index.d_docs_fork_trade: Kanda rimwe ku mafaranga yose mu Radar, Live Trade Feed, Smart Money Radar, cyangwa replay ya ghost-copy ifungura panel y'ukuri ya pump.fun y'ubucuruzi, yuzuza mbere na mbere kandi yanditswe na wallet yawe. Nta kubika, nta mfunguzo yoherejwe, kandi hari ?fork= link kugirango amafaranga ajye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_free_llm_providers: Abatanga AI b'ubuntu barenga icumi bakomoka kuri buri gusohoza inyandiko ku three.ws, bageragejwe mu buryo bukurikiranye mbere y'uko habaho urufunguzo rwishyurwa: Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, SambaNova, Mistral, Z.AI, Cloudflare Workers AI, OVH, Gemini, Pollinations, LLM7, na SiliconFlow, hamwe n'imipaka y'ibice by'ubuntu n'uburyo bwo kongeramo urukiramende rukurikira.
sitemap_index.d_docs_freshness: Ese iyi nyandiko iracyasobanura kode? Buri nyandiko ifite amanota ku nyandiko z'ibanze ikurikirana, kandi iyi dashboard ikurikirana impinduka kugirango paji zishaje zishakishwe mbere.
sitemap_index.d_docs_galaxy: Buri agent yashyizweho na IBM Granite ku watsonx.ai, yerekanywe mu nyenyeri ya 3D ishobora kugendwa hamwe no gushakisha mu rurimi rw'ikinyarwanda.
sitemap_index.d_docs_generation_watch: three.ws/watch ni urupapuro rw'iterambere ry'ukuri ku gikorwa kimwe cyo guhindura inyandiko mu 3D. Rukingurirwa na ?job= link kandi rwerekana isaha y'ukuri, igishushanyo cy'ibitekerezo generator yakoze nk'intambwe yayo ya mbere, hanyuma rukakohereza mu mwirondoro wa 3D wihariye mu buryo bwikora igihe umwirondoro waba witeguye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_genesis: Igitekerezo cyangwa selfie bihinduka agent ya 3D AI ifite Solana y'ububiko n'ibikoresho bya EVM hamwe n'uburenganzira bw'ikimenyetso ku murongo, mu gihe gito kitari munsi y'iminota.
sitemap_index.d_docs_genome: Gahunda ibiri mu bintu bibiri ikabyara umwana wemejwe: ubwonko, ijwi, umubiri, n'ibyangombwa by'ubumenyi ku murongo, buri gikorwa cyo kubyara cyanditswe mu buryo bwemeza igiti cy'umuryango.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ghost_copy: Subiramo ubucuruzi bw'ukuri bw'umucuruzi wemejwe ku isoko ry'ibikorwa byarangiye ku wallet itigeze ibaho: hitamo umuyobozi, ingengo y'imari, n'igihe, urebe aho kugerageza kubakurikira ku gipimo cyawe byakubwira. Nta kintu cyanditswe, nta kintu cyakoreshejwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_github_memory_seeding: Tanga agent yawe akazi kawe: umwirondoro wawe wa GitHub rusange hamwe n'ibikubiyemo n'inyandiko za README wahisemo, byahinduwe mu bwonko bw'igihe kirekire kugirango agent ivuge mu buryo bunoze ku byo wubaka aho kwibeshya. Uburenganzira burakomeye kandi kubuhagarika bisiba buri mwibukiro bwakozwe n'uburenganzira.
sitemap_index.d_docs_glance: Shyira agent ya three.ws ku kibaho cya Windows 11 widgets, mu README, muri Slack, ku rupapuro, cyangwa mu terminal yawe. Endpoint, igice, widget worker na npm client.
sitemap_index.d_docs_glasses: Wambara amadarubindi y'ubwenge kandi isi ikakubwira ko agent ihagaze metero mirongo itatu kure. Uko three.ws igabanya akazi: ikirahure gitwara ikimenyetso, telefone itwara umubiri wa 3D, kandi umuyoboro w'ukuri ugenzura ukuri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_globe: Ikarita ya 3D iriho ku /globe: ibice byayo 11 by'ubumenyi butagira urufunguzo n'aho buri kimwe kiva, ibipimo bya URL bituma ishusho yose iba link ishobora gusangizwa, API imwe isubiza buri gice, n'impamvu cron yo kwakira igomba kugira idirishya rya GDELT ku gihe kugira ngo igenzura ribe ry'ukuri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_guardian: Garura kandi wihanganire imari y'abagenzi binyuze mu buryo bwemejwe n'ibipimo, bw'igihe-bufunze butigeze bwerekana urufunguzo rwihariye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_guards: Abarinzi b'aho mu gihugu barinda iyi code mu mwanya wa CI: icyo buri umwe abuza, icyiciro cyose kibikora, n'ukuntu wongeramo undi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_herald: Ohereza ubutumwa mu buryo bw'umuntu: SDK ifunguye aho ikirangantego cya 3D kiza ku ipaji yawe kikavuga ibyo byabaye, ingengo y'imari y'ibihano (uburemere bw'ingenzi, amasaha y'ituze, dedupe, batching), uburyo bworoshye bwo gusubira inyuma, inzira yo kugeza ubutumwa, na CLI itangaza igihe kubaka kwawe kurangira.
sitemap_index.d_docs_hold_to_access: three.ws ifungura ubushobozi buhenze bwo gufata $THREE aho kuyikoresha. Agaciro k'ububiko kagaragaza icyiciro cy'ubunyamuryango, kandi ibyiciro bifungura kugabanyirizwa ku mafaranga no ku mipaka yo hejuru. Uko ibyiciro bigenwa kandi bigasubirwamo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_households: Gusangira inzu ihujwe utagabanye login: imirimo itanu n'ibyo buri umwe ashobora gukora, imipaka y'ibigo by'abanyamuryango igabanya inzu umunyamuryango ashobora kubona, uko ubutumire butangwa kandi bukemerwa, ibiba ku muntu igihe asohotse, n'itegeko byose bishingiraho, ko umushyitsi atemerewe kwemeza igikorwa gifungura inyubako.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_plans: Ibyo inzu ihujwe igura n'ibyo buri gahunda ikubiyemo, hamwe n'ibyo byemejwe mu code aho kubih promises mu nyandiko: umupaka ntukwiriye kubuza igikorwa cy'umutekano, bityo gufunga, gufunga garage cyangwa valve no gushyira mu bikorwa alarme bikora ku rugero no ku gihe cyarenze; kandi nta kintu ku gate y'ukwemeza, ubunyangamugayo bw'igitabo cy'ibikorwa cyangwa sisitemu y'imirimo ari ikintu cyishyurwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_privacy: Ibintu byose three.ws ibika ku rugo uhuza, impamvu, igihe kinini, n'icyo bikuraho: urutonde rwuzuye, isezerano ko amazina y'ibyumba n'imyitwarire y'ibikoresho bitazigama, idirishya ry'ibikorwa ry'iminsi 90 n'uburyo bwo kubihindura, inzira zo gusohora no gusiba, amategeko yo gukurikirana, n'inyandiko y'itangazamakuru yerekana igihe uhuza no mu gihe cyo kwinjira mu ijwi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_relay: Ibigega byinshi bya Home Assistant ntibishobora kugerwaho ku mbuga, bityo inzu ikora kuri three.ws ahubwo: shyiramo HACS imwe, shyiramo kode yo guhuza y'iminota icumi, kandi nta na kimwe cyumva ku muyoboro wawe, nta porogaramu yoherejwe, kandi three.ws ntigira ikimenyetso cya Home Assistant. Harimo igice cy'umukoresha: serivisi yo guhuza, uburyo bwayo n'ukuntu ibikenewe bihindurwa, n'ukuntu wemeza inzira yose ku rugo nyakuri ku muyoboro server itabasha kugera kuri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_relay_threat_model: Icyo umwiyahuzi abona ku mwanya wose hafi y'ikibuga inzu ikora gusa ku mbuga, n'icyo kibabuza: impamvu guhuza ifite urutonde rw'ubutumwa rwemewe aho kugerageza HTTP mu muyoboro w'inyubako, icyo ikimenyetso cyibwe cy'install ari cyo kitari cyo, impamvu urutonde rw'ibikenewe rukoreshwa nanone mu nzu kugira ngo guhuza kwangiritse kutagabanya ikintu na kimwe, n'ibisigaye byemerewe ku bushake.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_satellite: Shyira pipeline y'ijwi ya Home Assistant isanzwe ku three.ws agent kandi igahabwa isura: uburyo mu ntambwe enye, icyo kinyura ku muyoboro wawe n'icyo kitanyura, ibihugu 11 display ishobora kuba mu, n'itegeko byose bishingiraho, ko gufunga ipaji bitabuza umufasha wawe w'ijwi gukomeza gukora.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_scene: Uko inzu ihujwe iba icyumba ushobora guhagararamo: igishushanyo cy'icyumba umuhuza akora kuva mu bubiko bwa Home Assistant, uko gucana urumuri nyakuri bigabanya icyitegererezo, icyo ishusho ikora mu gihe inzu itagerwaho, n'uburyo bworoshye bwo gukomeza gukoresha ibikontroli byose nta WebGL.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_security: Icyitegererezo cy'ibibazo ku nzu ihujwe, cyanditswe ku nyubako aho kugera ku bubiko: icyo buri mukinnyi ashobora gukora n'icyo kibabuza, impamvu gate y'ukwemeza ari yo ikomeye kandi gutunganya ibikenewe ari uburebure, ibipimo 11 bigenda hamwe na buri kubaka, umurinzi wa SSRF buri guhamagara ku ruhande rwa server anyuramo n'impamvu kugenzura izina atari kimwe, ikimenyetso cy'ubujura bw'ibikenewe gisoza gusaba urufunguzo nyakuri niba rufunguwe, n'ibisigaye byemerewe ku bushake.
sitemap_index.d_docs_home_voice: Uko gukorera mu rugo hatabayeho intoki: ijambo ryo gukangura ryahujwe n'icyitegererezo gikora mu gice cyawe, guhagarika umukozi mu ijambo, guhagarika bitagabanya itegeko ryawe, n'ukwemeza kuvugwa ku buryo butuma "yego" yo mu background itabasha gufungura umuryango. Harimo igihe cyose cyapimye ku gice cyose n'uko wakwiyubakira umugozi ku gice cyawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_how_forge_works: Intambwe eshanu hagati yo kwandika igitekerezo no gukuramo icyitegererezo cya 3D: ishusho y'icyitegererezo, kongera kubaka, guhitamo moteri, kwiyitaho mu gihe cy'ikosa, no kubika burundu. Byongeye, icyo ibyiciro by'ubwiza bisobanura n'icyo icyitegererezo cyuzuye gishobora gukora mu gihe gikurikiyeho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_how_it_works: Icyitegererezo cy'ibitekerezo gishobora gufata umutwaro. Niba urimo gushaka kumenya aho ikiranga kiri, uko icyifuzo gikorwa, cyangwa urwego rwagakwiye kwagurwa, tangira hano mbere yo gusoma indi nyandiko y'ubuhanga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_huggingface: Hugging Face niho umuryango w'abakora imashini ushyira ahagaragara ibyitegererezo, ibigaragaza, n'inyandiko z'ubuhanga. three.ws ibishyira ahagaragara munsi y'ikigo cyayo, kandi ibi ni urutonde rw'inyandiko, ibikoresho by'avatar, n'ahantu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_i18n: Uko urutonde rw'ubuhinduzi bwa UI rukora: dosiye imwe y'ukuri ihindurwa buhoro buhoro n'ikoranabuhanga rya LLM, ikandikwa nka JSON idahinduka, kandi ikavugururwa mu rubuga mu gihe cy'ikoreshwa. Harimo uko wakwiyandikisha mu rurimi no uko igikorwa cyo kugenzura gishobora gufata impinduka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ibm: three.ws abakozi bashobora gutekereza ku byitegererezo bya IBM Granite byatanzwe binyuze muri IBM watsonx.ai. Uburyo bwose bwo kwinjira ku bakora n'abakoresha: guhitamo icyitegererezo, ibyangombwa, imiterere y'ibisabwa, n'uburyo bwo gusubira inyuma.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ibm_community: Urutonde rukora rw'ibitekerezo byose n'ibitekerezo mu Itsinda ry'Abakoresha ba Three.ws ku Muryango wa IBM: abanditsi, amatariki, ibikorwa, n'icyegeranyo cy'ukuri cy'ibitekerezo byose, byongeyeho ishusho y'abanyamuryango b'itsinda n'ibikubiyemo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ibm_x402_mcp: Urutonde rw'ubushobozi bwa IBM AI (ikiganiro, kode, embeddings, isesengura ry'inyandiko, guhanura) buri mukozi cyangwa umukiriya wa MCP ashobora gukoresha atanze amafaranga make kuri buri guhamagara, nta konti na gahunda yo kwiyandikisha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_image_to_3d: Hindura amafoto 1 kugeza kuri 6 y'ikintu mu GLB ifite texture ku murongo wo kwiyubakira wihariye. Igihe cyo kuyikoresha ugereranije na Selfie to Avatar ku maso, uburyo bwo kureba bwinshi, n'API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_in_game_economy: Icyitonderwa cyuzuye ku bukungu bwa /play mu isi ifunguye: gukusanya no kugurisha ibikoresho, purse y'amafaranga n'ibanki, kuvugurura ibikoresho, abacuruzi bose n'imiryango, $THREE ibikoresho by'ubwiza byiyongera kuri Solana, n'uburyo bwo gusoma urutonde mu kode.
sitemap_index.d_docs_inference_node_operator: Jya mu muyoboro w'ibisubizo bifunguye: umukiriya w'umukoresha w'ikibaho yandikisha imashini yawe, ikemura imirimo y'ibisubizo, ikayikora n'icyitegererezo gifunguye, kandi igasubiza ibyasinywe na Ed25519 bishobora kugenzurwa n'uwari wese. Harimo gushyiraho, konfigurasiyo, amasezerano y'itumanaho, GPU Docker, n'ibimenyetso by'ukuri ku rwego rw'aho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_integrations: Urutonde rw'ibikoresho bimwe by'ikimenyetso ku rubuga rwose: abareba 3D avatar, abakozi b'ikiganiro, abafasha mu kugenda, abavugizi b'impapuro, ibikoresho by'ibimenyetso by'ubuzima, n'ikigo cya MCP.
sitemap_index.d_docs_introduction: three.ws ni urubuga rw'ibikoresho bifunguye, rwubatswe mu rubuga rwa interineti rwo gukora, kwakira, no gushyira mu bikorwa abakozi ba AI bakora mu 3D avatars. Ibyo ikora, uwo igenewe, n'inzira ngufi yo kugira ikintu gikora.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ios_app: Ibyo porogaramu ya App Store yongeyeho ku rubuga: urupapuro rwo gusangira rw'ibanze, imiyoboro y'isi yose, imiyoboro y'ibikoresho by'ibikoresha bisubira ku rupapuro waretse, ibimenyetso by'ukuri, n'ikibaho cy'ibikorwa byikora ku buryo bwihariye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_irl: Fata umukozi uva ku ishusho ukawushyira ku gipimo nyakuri cya GPS: ku meza yawe, ku ntebe y'ahantu, hanze y'ahantu. Uwo ari wese uje hafi ashobora kuwubona, kuganira na wo, no kuwishyura.
sitemap_index.d_docs_js_api: Ibyiciro bya JavaScript imbere y'uwerekanwe wa three.ws: umuyobozi w'ubusabe, uwerekanwe wa three.js, umupimyi wa glTF, n'ibice bito bigaragaza ibikikije. Abubaka, uburyo, n'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_knock: Umuryango ufite igiciro ku muntu: fungura umwe kuri /knock/<username>, shyiraho igiciro cy'ubutumwa bumwe buturuka ku muntu utazi, kandi ugire umufasha wawe wa 3D utanga ibyo byinjira mu buryo bw'umubiri. Imirongo y'ubuntu na x402, amategeko yo kwanga mbere yo kwishyura, inyemezabwishyu, SDK na CLI, n'ikigo cya MCP.
