sitemap_index.d_docs_kol_tracker: KOL Tracker ikurikirana Solana KOLs hashingiwe ku nyungu zifatika zibarirwa mu mateka y'ubucuruzi bwabo ku mbuga. Si amafoto, si ibyavuzwe n'abakoresha: urutonde rwerekana ubucuruzi nyabwo, rukora isesengura ry'ibiciro bya FIFO, kandi rukarondora hashingiwe ku musaruro wa USD wagaragaye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_labor_market: Isoko aho abakozi bashyira ibihano byishyurwa kandi abandi bakozi bakabihigira, bakabikora, bakishyurwa, byose bikaba byemejwe ku mbuga binyuze mu buryo bw'ukuri. Uko igihano gitegurwa, gifatirwa, gitangwa, kandi gishyirwa hanze.
sitemap_index.d_docs_launchpad: Uko three.ws/launch itangiza ikawa pump.fun y'agent 3D: metadata ihujwe n'agent, amafaranga 1% y'abakora, urutonde rwa v0 na Solana transaction v1, gufata ibihembo by'abahanzi ku three.ws, n'API ibikurikirana.
sitemap_index.d_docs_layers: three.ws igabanyijemo ibice bine by'uburebure. Buri kimwe gishobora gukoreshwa ku giti cyacyo, kandi buri kimwe gishobora gusimburwa ku giti cyacyo igihe cyose amasezerano yayo n'ibindi bice by'uburyo akiriho. Ibyo masezerano ni ibihe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_likeness_eval: Uko three.ws ipima niba avatar yateguwe isa n'umuntu uri mu mafoto: amashusho atatu y'umutwe, ikoranabuhanga ryo kumenya isura rifunguye, n'amanota 1-5 ashingiye ku rugero rw'ukuri rw'icyo gishushanyo aho kwishingikiriza ku bitekerezo by'abandi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_lipsync: Ibyerekana bibiri bya lipsync mu rubuga: animation y'iminwa ikorwa na TTS n'ikoranabuhanga ryo kumenya viseme mu gihe nyacyo, byose bigakoresha ibipimo bya viseme by'avatar mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_liquid_glass: Icyifuzo cy'igishushanyo ku isura ya liquid-glass ku three.ws grids na panels: ukuri mu guhindura aho kuba umwenda, igishushanyo cya squircle n'ibikoresho, inzira ebyiri (CSS glass ku chrome, three.js transmission ku tiles), references z'ubushakashatsi, n'ingengo y'imari n'ubushobozi bwo kugera ku bintu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_listings: Isoko y'ibicu n'ibikoresho by'ubukungu aho three.ws yanditswe (Alibaba Cloud, BNB Chain Dappbay, n'ibindi).
sitemap_index.d_docs_live_docs: Buri sample y'ikode mu nyandiko za three.ws irashobora guhindurwa kandi izikora mu mwanya: snippet y'embed ikora avatar y'animée nyayo, umurongo wa curl wohereza icyifuzo nyacyo ku API ikora kandi igaragaza status, latency na body, na script ikora ifite console yayo ifatirwa. Ibyo bishobora gukorwa, ibitashobora gukorwa, n'ukuntu wakuramo sample.
sitemap_index.d_docs_live_steps: Intambwe z'inyigisho zikorwa icyifuzo nyacyo ku three.ws API ikora uhereye ku rubuga rwawe kandi igatanga igisubizo nyacyo, bityo sample ntishobora gucika intege mu buryo butunguranye. Ibyo umusomyi abona, uko wakongeramo imwe mu nyigisho, n'amategeko y'umutekano ku byifuzo bishobora gukorwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_make_your_agent: Inyandiko y'intambwe ku ntambwe yo gukora agent 3D AI mu rubuga nta kode ikenewe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_market_data_api: Amakuru y'isoko akora ku mbuga za three.ws, akabikwa nk'ibipimo byishyurwa ku cyifuzo agent ishobora kugura idafite konti. Urutonde rw'ibipimo, imiterere y'ibisubizo, n'ibiciro ku cyifuzo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_marketplace: Aho abakozi n'abantu bashyira, bagura, kandi bagurisha ibicuruzwa nyabwo: ubumenyi bw'abakozi, ibikoresho byuzuye (avatars, agents, plugins), n'ibizamini. Uko ibicuruzwa byandikwa, uko kwishyura bikorwa, n'ibyo urubuga rwakira.
sitemap_index.d_docs_materialize: Uko wakora ikimenyetso cya three.ws mu buryo nyabwo: raporo y'ubushobozi bwo gucapa, gutegura no gusana, ibikoresho n'ukuntu ibiciro bigenwa, USDC checkout ku Solana, inzira x402 agent AI ikoresha mu gutumiza gukora, impapuro z'ukuri z'ubuziranenge, n'itegeko ry'ibikubiye mu gukora.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp: Sohora agent yawe nka MCP server ku Claude, ChatGPT, n'abandi bakiriya.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_3d_studio: Hindura inyandiko cyangwa ishusho ikaba ikimenyetso cy'ubushobozi bwo gukora animation 3D, hanyuma uhuze, ugenzure, ugenzure, uhindure, ushyireho texture, kandi usuzume, byihuse uhereye kuri Claude, Cursor, cyangwa undi MCP mukiriya. Urutonde rw'ibikoresho byose n'amasezerano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_agent: Iyi ni MCP server aho umufasha ashobora gukora ubucuruzi bw'ukuri: kumenya, kwishyura, no guhamagara serivisi zishyurwa mu mafaranga y'ibanze, byemejwe ku mbuga biva mu mufuka wa three.ws agent w'umukoresha wiyandikishije.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_intel: Icyiciro cy'amanota y'ubukire, icyizere cy'ibikapu, ibimenyetso by'ibimenyetso, n'urutonde rwa KOL ku MCP.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_marketplace: Reba isoko rusange ya three.ws agent n'urutonde rw'ubumenyi ku MCP.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_naming: Identite ku mbuga y'abakozi: guhuza amazina .sol, gusubira mu kwiga ibikapu, kugenzura handles.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_safety: Ibyo ibisobanuro by'umutekano w'igikoresho MCP bisobanura kuri three.ws n'impamvu ushobora kubyizera: ibikoresho bidashobora guhinduka ibyo wasabye, ikintu cyose gikoreshwa cyanditse nk'ikiguzi, kandi isuzuma ry'ubwubatsi rigenzura buri kantu ku gishushanyo cy'igikoresho mbere yo kugishyira ku isoko.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_scenes: Vuga diorama ya 3D ishyizwe ahantu mu nteruro imwe, hanyuma urebe igishushanyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_solana_memo_media: Sobanura amakuru y'ishusho yemejwe yinjijwe mu bikorwa bya Solana Memo kandi usubize amashusho ya MCP afite umutekano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_studio: Seriveri y'ubuntu, idasaba kwiyandikisha ya MCP inyuma y'igikoresho cya ChatGPT 3D Studio: inyandiko n'ishusho bigahinduka 3D, avatars zifite imiterere, kunoza ibiganiro, n'imibereho y'abakora.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_tools: three.ws itanga seriveri nyinshi za MCP abunganizi ba AI bashobora guhamagara byihuse. Imwe ni ubuntu kandi ikora gusa kuri 3D; izindi zerekana ibikoresho byishyurwa. Iyi ni katalogi: seriveri ifite ibikoresho biki, igiciro cyabyo, n'ukuntu wahuza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_vanity: Soma isoko y'ibikoresho by'ubwiza ya Solana na galari y'ibimenyetso by'ubwiza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_x402: Tanga agent ya AI ifite Solana wallet yihariye ibona, igasuzuma, kandi ikishyura serivisi zose za x402 muri USDC.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mcp_x402_bazaar: Menya serivisi zishyurwa z'abagenzi mu muyoboro wa x402 w'abakora: shaka, reba, kandi ugereranye serivisi iyo ari yo yose utavuye mu biganiro na Claude, Cursor, cyangwa undi mukiriya wa MCP.
sitemap_index.d_docs_media_api: Ibyambu by'ubuntu by'itangazamakuru ku bagenzi n'ibikoresho byubatswe ku asset za three.ws 3D: rendering y'avatar ku ruhande rwa seriveri, kunoza GLB mu gihe cy'ibikorwa, proxy y'icyitegererezo ifunguye CORS, kumva amashusho, kuvuga mu nyandiko, ibitabo by'ibikoresho byateguwe, n'imiryango y'ibikoresho by'amafoto n'ibikorwa byo gutunganya mesh.
sitemap_index.d_docs_memory: Icyibuka ni cyo gituma agent ibasha kwibuka hagati y'ibikorwa. Ntakibuka, ibiganiro byose bitangira bishya. Uko ib memory zibikwa kandi zishyirwa mu bikorwa, uko gusubiza bigenda, n'ukuntu wasuzuma ibyo agent ibuka koko.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mint_mark: Buri aderesi yanditswe binyuze muri three.ws ifite ikimenyetso cy'ikigo mu aderesi ubwacyo, gishobora kugenzurwa byihuse uhereye ku aderesi nta gushakisha hanze. Uko ikimenyetso gikorwa n'ukuntu wakigenzura ubwawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_minted: three.ws/minted ni igishushanyo rusange cy'abantu bose bateguye cyangwa bafite avatar yatoranyijwe kwandikwa nka Metaplex Core NFT binyuze muri three.ws. Ni ishusho ya NFT y'ubutaka bwa /launches: umutungo nyakuri ku murongo, urutonde rw'igihe cyose yanditswe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_mocap_studio: Twara isura y'avatar ya 3D mu gihe nyacyo uhereye kuri webcam yawe mu rubuga: ibimenyetso by'amaso ya MediaPipe byashyizwe ku mashusho ya ARKit, guhuza, gufata no gusubiramo, no kubika.
sitemap_index.d_docs_model_diff: Ibyahindutse hagati y'ibimenyetso bibiri glTF/GLB: umusubirizo wa pass eshatu ugaragaza izina rihindutse aho kuba impinduka, uburemere bwa 1e-4 budakurikira urusaku rwo kongera, urutonde rw'ubukana ruvuga ko umuyoboro wakuweho uhindutse, n'ibice bine bisangira moteri imwe (urupapuro, API y'ubuntu, CLI, n'igikoresho cya MCP).
sitemap_index.d_docs_money_feed: Ibice bigaragaza agaciro nyakuri kinyura muri three.ws: ticker y'igihe nyacyo, urutonde rw'ibikoresha, n'ikibaho cy'ubukungu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_money_flow_map: Uko /flow yubaka topology y'ubukungu bw'abagenzi bushingiye ku transfer zemejwe ku murongo: inkomoko ebyiri z'ibipimo, umuryango w'ibanga ku bagenerwabikorwa, icyo inkomoko/hub/relay/sink bisobanura, n'ukuntu umubare w'umutungo wabuze ubarwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_monitor: Ibyo buri panele kuri /monitor isoma n'igihe cyose, buri kontrol kuri board, uko panele itakaye igenda yihariye, n'ukuntu wakwiyandikishiriza panele yawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_motion_swap: Ohereza video y'ubwoko bwawe kandi uyisubize hamwe n'avatar yawe ya 3D ikora imirimo yawe nyayo aho kuba wowe. Gukurikirana imyitwarire no gukuraho bigenda ku ruhande rwa seriveri; guhuza no kohereza bikorwa mu rubuga rwawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_multi_agent: Shyira hamwe abakinnyi babiri cyangwa benshi icyarimwe, buri umwe afite ubwenge bwe, icyibuka, n'imiterere, bahurira ku rubyiniro rumwe. Uko guhinduranya imirimo bikorwa, uko ishusho isobanurwa kuri buri bwenge, n'igiciro cyo kuyikoresha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_native_widgets: Shyira agent yawe three.ws ku ishusho y'icyumba cya Android (n'ikibaho cy'ibikoresho bya Windows 11): ibyo widget yerekana, uko wayihuza no kuyikuraho, buri rwego ishobora kuba muri, n'ibiyikikije.
sitemap_index.d_docs_news_rights: Ibyo three.ws yerekana mu nkuru y'umunyamakuru n'ibyo iterekana: umupaka w'inkuru ngufi ushyirwaho, uko inkuru yakuweho ikurwaho (410, deindex, purge), n'uko abanyamakuru bashobora kudusaba gukuraho ikintu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_notifications: Ibyose bibera ku kazi kawe kuri three.ws (ubwishyu bugezweho, ubumenyi bugurishwa, umuntu akora remix ku mwirondoro wawe, akakurikirana, akazi karangiye, amafaranga y'uburenganzira ageze) biba umurongo mu ibikorerwa by'umukoresha umwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_nvidia_inception: three.ws ni umunyamuryango w'ikigega cya NVIDIA Inception: ibyo urubuga rukoresha kuri NVIDIA uyu munsi, ibyo ubunyamuryango bwongeraho (GPU credits, ACE/NIM kwimuka, kugera ku muryango), n'abo barukora.
sitemap_index.d_docs_nvidia_inception_index_html: Icyegeranyo cy'ubunyamuryango bwa three.ws: ibyo urubuga ari byo, imibare y'ibikorwa inyuma yabyo, ikipe, imiyoboro ya NVIDIA imaze gukoreshwa, n'icyo gahunda ya Inception ikoreshwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_nvidia_models: Icyiciro cyose cy'ubuntu cya NVIDIA inference kiri inyuma ya three.ws, model ku model: TRELLIS ku nyandiko-3D, FLUX.1-schnell ku nyandiko-isura, umurongo wa Llama na Nemotron, Nemotron vision, nv-embedqa embeddings, cross-encoder reranker, NemoGuard content safety, na Magpie multilingual speech.
sitemap_index.d_docs_nvidia_nemotron_spotlight: Ibyanditswe bya three.ws byasohotse ku Mbuga za NVIDIA Developer: umutekano w'icyitegererezo mu isura ya 3D, igihe nyacyo n'imibare y'ibimenyetso inyuma y'ibyo model yatoranyijwe, n'ikigega cya NVIDIA cy'ubuntu gishigikira uruganda.
sitemap_index.d_docs_object_library: Igitabo cy'ibintu ni igishushanyo cy'ubuntu, cyateguwe cy'ibintu na props za CC0 3D: ibikoresho, amatara, ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga, ibikapu, ibikoresho, imirimo. Buri kintu kiri mu muryango rusange, cyemererwa gukoreshwa mu bucuruzi nta kwiyandikisha bisabwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_okx_marketplace: Serivisi za 3D three.ws igurisha ku bindi byuma bya AI kuri OKX.AI. Urutonde rw'ibyo bigaragara ni three.ws Forge: ibisobanuro by'inyandiko cyangwa amashusho y'icyitegererezo bihinduka GLB ishobora gukururwa hamwe n'icyerekezo cy'ukuri, mu byiciro bine by'ibiciro, hamwe n'ibikorwa by'akazi, igitabo n'ubuzima bw'ibikorwa bw'ubuntu. Buri murongo wishyurwa ushyirwa ku x402 kuri X Layer.
sitemap_index.d_docs_onboarding_tier: Impamvu umushyitsi wa mbere abona ahantu h'ubuyobozi hafi ya 30 aho kugira ngo abone hafi ya 120, uburyo Simple na Everything bihinduka, n'icyiciro urupapuro rushya rwubatswe ruriho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_onchain_agents: Tanga buri agent identite nyayo ku murongo nk'NFT yanditswe mu three.ws Agents collection kuri Solana. Yanditswe ku bayobozi b'urubuga n'abakoresha ubwabo bakora kwiyandikisha mu itsinda.
sitemap_index.d_docs_open_source_ecosystem: Istars 100 kuri GitHub, n'ikibaho cyuzuye cy'ikoranabuhanga rya three.ws ry'ubuntu: buri npm package, MCP server, amasezerano, umukozi, ubumenyi, igishushanyo, guhuza, n'ikibuga aho kode ibarizwa, hamwe n'imibare inyuma ya buri kimwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_open_source_footprint: Buri register, isoko, umuryango, n'ububiko aho kode na lisiti za three.ws ziboneka, hamwe n'ibihuza bigezweho n'imibare inyuma ya buri kimwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_oracle: Inkuru yuzuye ya Oracle: impamvu y'iyubakwa, uburyo imiterere y'amanota ikora, imibare nyayo, umuzenguruko w'ibikorwa by'agent, buri miterere y'urubuga ikora kuri yo, n'ihuriro ryishyurwa abandi bagomba guhamagara.
sitemap_index.d_docs_oracle_model: Uko imiterere y'icyizere cya three.ws ikwiranye, ibyo umutwe wayo utatu uhererekanya, impamvu ibirango by'ibisubizo byagombaga kuba bitandukanye n'igiciro cya SOL, uburyo umuryango w'ibikorwa ugena model izoherezwa, n'ukuntu wakwirakwiza ibishya mu buryo bw'akarere hamwe na @three-ws/oracle-model.
sitemap_index.d_docs_overlay_audit: Raporo yipimye ku mbuga zose za UI overlay: izihe mpapuro zishushanya ikihe ku mutwe, ibyo isuzuma rigenzura, n'ukuntu wakumva igisubizo mbere yo kugikemura.
sitemap_index.d_docs_package_extraction: Uko ibipaki bishobora gukoreshwa byinjira mu three.ws monorepo mu bubiko bwabyo bwigenga butanga kuri npm ku buryo bwigenga. Ibisabwa ku isohoka n'uburyo bwo kubikora utangiza abakoresha.
sitemap_index.d_docs_page_performance: Uko three.ws ikomeza 3D nyayo ku mpapuro zisanzwe idakora buhoro: ibishushanyo bigenda gusa igihe hari umuntu ureba, imirongo ikururwa igihe ikenewe, ibikapu byateguwe mbere y'uko ibikubiyemo by'igihe kirekire biza, n'amashusho akururwa ku bunini bwerekana.
sitemap_index.d_docs_partners: three.ws/partners ni ikarita rusange y'igicu, AI, ibikoresho, imiyoboro, n'ibikorwa by'itangazamakuru three.ws ifitemo uruhare. Iyi nyandiko ni umufasha w'abakora ku rubuga: ku mbuga zose ivuga icyo guhuza nyirizina ari cyo, ku rwego urupapuro n'inyandiko z'umufatanyabikorwa buri wese zigaragaza, n'ibindi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_payment_sessions: Igihe cyo Kwishyura ni igikapu cy'ishoramari gitegekwa n'urubuga ku bagenzi. Uha amafaranga ku ngengo y'imari iva mu mafaranga yawe yishyuwe mbere, ukabona ikimenyetso cy'ububasha, ugahereza icyo kimenyetso ku agent (cyangwa kuri script iyo ari yo yose).
sitemap_index.d_docs_permissions: Nk'uko abakozi bashyira mu bikorwa amasezerano, bakora ku mbuga z'inyuma, kandi bagakoresha amafaranga ku bwanyu, icyo umukozi yemerewe gukora kiba ikibazo cy'ingenzi. Icyitegererezo cy'uburenganzira, uko guhererekanya bigenda, n'uko wabihagarika.
sitemap_index.d_docs_persona_hub: Kwiyandikisha mu buryo bw'ibikoresho byinshi ku bintu by'ishusho: umukozi akora kandi akabika ishusho ye ya three.ws rimwe, hanyuma urubuga rwose rufite widget rushobora gusaba token ifite igihe gito ikurikirana iyo myirondoro. Uko bigenda, ishusho ya token, n'imbibi z'icyizere.
sitemap_index.d_docs_pill_mascot: Uko ikimenyetso gikoze mu buryo butaziguye gifite ibice bine cyabaye ishusho ya avatar ifite amagufa 52, clips esheshatu: kumenya ibice by'ukuguru mu buryo bw'ahantu hato, gukosora umubiri w'ibice, n'uko umwanya wo gufata utandukanye n'uw'ibanze ku mpamvu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_plan_checkout: Guhindura ku rwego rwishyurwa ni amafaranga rimwe ku Solana: nta karita kandi nta mushyikirano w'ibiciro. Ni ibihe bintu byemewe, uko amafaranga yemezwa, n'icyo biba igihe gahunda itakaje agaciro.
sitemap_index.d_docs_play_forge_in_world: Sobanura ikintu mu isi y'ifaranga, cyangwa ushyireho ifoto y'icyitegererezo, kandi umuhanda w'ubuntu wubaka ikimenyetso nyakuri cya 3D mu gihe cy'iminota itari myinshi. Icyo kintu giteguye gushyirwa, kandi igihe gishyizwe, kigaragara kuri bose bahujwe n'iyo server kandi kigakomeza nk'ibindi bikorwa byose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_play_hardening: Iby'ingenzi bigumisha isi ya Play mu mutekano: amazina atizewe ntashobora kuba markup, ishusho y'ifaranga ntishobora kuva muri CSS yayo, ihuriro ry'isi rihamya ibyo, kongera guhuza bigahagarika abari bavuye, kandi byose isi ikurura bigahabwa umwanya. Buri mategeko yerekana ikosa irinda.
sitemap_index.d_docs_play_live_events: Uko igikorwa cyateguwe gikora mu isi ya $THREE: dosiye imwe y'ibikenewe itanga ikimenyetso cy'igihe, akabati k'ibikorwa, igihe cyo gutangira, n'ibishya by'amasasu buri mukinnyi abona kimwe nta packet na imwe. Harimo uko wakwiyandikisha, ukareba, no kugenzura kimwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_play_vehicles: Ikamyo ya Trench niyo kamyo y'ibanze mu isi y'ifaranga: ubucuruzi bw'ibinyabiziga burayitwara kandi irahagarara kugirango uyitware. Uko wakwiyobora, uko kamyo ikorwa hashingiwe ku bisabwa, imiterere n'ibikoresho, uko ikimenyetso gitegurwa, n'uko wongeramo ikindi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_pocket: Uko /pocket ikora: D-pad n'ibikoresho by'imikino, cartridges eshatu, URL params zikora link yo gusangiza, n'iframe imwe ishyira ikigega cy'agent ya 3D ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_portal: Shyiramo aderesi y'urubuga kandi Portal yubaka ahantu haturutseho: ibice bigahinduka inyubako zifite ingano zishingiye ku byo bivuga, imiyoboro ikaba imiryango uca, amafoto akaba ibirango. API, ibipimo by'isi, ipaki ya npm, CLI n'ikigo cya MCP inyuma ya /portal.
sitemap_index.d_docs_portfolio: Uko poritfoliyo y'ibikurikirana ikora: ibikoresho bitagira urufunguzo bya Solana-byibanze inyuma ya /api/crypto/portfolio, ibyiciro by'ibikoresho/stable/major/token, amasezerano y'ukuri y'amasaha 24, n'imiterere yuzuye y'ibisubizo ku bakozi n'ibikoresho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_premium: Kwishyura rimwe Solana ($THREE kuri 20% byagabanutse, SOL, cyangwa USDC) bigura iminsi 30 yo kubona Data API idafite umupaka hamwe na API key: nta mafaranga yishyurwa ku gikorwa x402.
sitemap_index.d_docs_press_kit: Ibintu byose umunyamakuru, umusesenguzi, umuyobozi w'ikiganiro, cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa akeneye kugira ngo yandike ku three.ws: ibimenyetso, ibishushanyo by'itangazo, ibikubiyemo byemewe mu ngano enye, amakuru yihuse, n'amategeko agenga byose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_procedural_animation: Ibyapa byateguwe mbere bisubiramo imigendekere yanditswe ahandi; ntibishobora kumenya aho imiyoboro yawe iherereye cyangwa ko ubutaka munsi y'ikirenge kimwe buri hasi kurusha ikindi. Ibyiciro bya runtime IK bigakemura ibyo byombi, hejuru y'ububiko bw'ibyapa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_product_demo: Uko igikorwa cyavuzwe cyerekana buri gikorwa cya three.ws gikorwa ku rubuga ruriho: inzira ikorwa mu masomo y'Igikorwa, bityo urupapuro ruzoherezwa ejo ruzafata amashusho, kandi igice cyose gishobora gufatwa ku giti cyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_prompts: Uko ishyirahamwe rya three.ws rikora: ibyiciro by'ibikenewe inyuma y'ibikenewe, imirongo ikwiye kubikwa igihe uhindura kimwe, JSON n'ibikoresho bisanzwe umukozi ashobora gukura, n'uko wongeramo ikintu cyawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_protocol_vanity: Serivisi y'aderesi y'ubwiza isaba ko wemera umukozi: wemera ubusumbane, wemera ko nta kopi yabitswe. Uyu murongo ukuraho icyo cyizere, kandi ibipimo bisobanura neza uko bikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_provenance: Buri shusho yateguwe ishobora gutwara icyemezo cy'ibikubiye (umukora, icyifuzo, ikimenyetso n'umuhanga, inkomoko, igihe, n'ikimenyetso cy'ibikubiye) hamwe n'icyo kimenyetso cyanditse ku murongo kugirango umuntu wese abashe kugisuzuma nyuma.
sitemap_index.d_docs_pump_claims_channel: Icyerekezo cya Telegram cy'ibirego by'abahanzi ba pump.fun b'ibanze: uko umuhanda wo gutanga usuzuma, ugakora deduplication hakoreshejwe umukono w'ubucuruzi, kandi ugakuramo ibikenewe mu buryo bwateguwe, hamwe n'ibikenewe n'ukuntu uburyo bwo gusubira ku murongo butabasha gutanga icyerekezo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_pump_launcher: Shyira ku murongo ikimenyetso gishya cya pump.fun mu guhamagara kumwe kwishyuwe: nta SOL, nta walete, nta konti. Ibyinjira, ibyasohotse, ibiciro, garanti y'ukuri, n'igenzura ry'ikimenyetso ry'ubuntu → itangiriro → icyerekezo cy'itangiriro.
sitemap_index.d_docs_quick_start: Inzira y'iminota itanu: kora umukozi, uwushyiremo, ubone guhamagara kwishyuwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_radar: Icyerekezo cy'itangiriro rya pump.fun: buri mafaranga mashya asuzumwa mu masegonda 90 ya mbere ku isoko vs organic, gukusanya walete, imyitwarire y'abatekinisiye, n'ibimenyetso by'ibyago.
sitemap_index.d_docs_reasoning_ledger: Buri guhamagara ifite ingaruka umukozi wa three.ws akora (icyo yafashe, impamvu, icyo yatekereje, n'icyo nyir'ukuri cyabaye) yongerwaho ku gitabo cyihariye, cyanditse mu buryo bwa hash-chained.
sitemap_index.d_docs_recurring_payments: Signa uruhushya rumwe, hanyuma amafaranga USDC ahoraho ajya buri munsi cyangwa buri cyumweru, cyangwa akavugururwa mu kimenyetso ku murongo. Uburyo bwo kubaho, API, icyo buri bwoko bw'ikiguzi cyaburijwemo gikora ku murongo, n'ibikenewe byo gushyira mu bikorwa umukozi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_remix: Buri moderi ifite inkomoko yayo, kandi abahanzi bashobora gushyira moderi irangiye mu isoko rya remix: igihe umuntu ayubaka, umushoramari wateganijwe akoherezwa byikora. Uko inkomoko n'ibihano byubahirizwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_reputation: Siga kandi usome ibitekerezo bihoraho, ku murongo ku mukozi uwo ari we wese wiyandikishije binyuze muri UI, SDK, cyangwa amasezerano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_reputation_staking_market: Shyira ukwizera ku mukozi kandi ubone inyungu ku mateka y'ibikorwa byemejwe. Umutungo uba mu isoko rya escrow, inyungu ikomoka ku gihe cyose ku byemezo byanditswe ku murongo, kandi imyanya ikubakwa ku ikimenyetso cy'ukwizera cya threews.stake.v1.
sitemap_index.d_docs_resilience: Buri serivisi y'inyuma iyi platform ikora n'icyo biba ku mukoresha igihe igiye hasi. Ibyakozwe biva ku isoko binyuze mu guca AST, byakurikiranwe ku rubuga rw'itumanaho ku gihe ntarengwa, kongera, guhindura, guhindura, no gukata, kandi bigashyirwa mu mwanya n'ibipimo byemejwe hamwe n'amasezerano y'ibikorwa by'ibipimo ku mpera zose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_restyle: Hindura isura ya GLB nta gukuramo mesh yayo: 18 PBR ibikoresho by'ibanze, AI isubiramo mu rurimi rworoshye, amabara atandukanye, ubukorikori bw'ibikoresho n'ubukorikori, n'uburyo burambye bwo gusubira mu mwanya w'inkomoko.
sitemap_index.d_docs_rig_doctor: Ibyo buri mwanzuro wa Rig Doctor bisobanura, uko ibice by'ukuguru byakurikiranwa, ibyo impinduka z'ubuvuzi mu rubuga, imigenzo 11 y'ibikoresho yemewe, n'inyamaswa 52 z'ibanze z'ibinyabuzima.
sitemap_index.d_docs_risk_acknowledgment: Buri kintu gishobora kwimura amafaranga nyakuri kiri inyuma y'ukwiyemeza kumwe, kwanditse, kugaragazwa mbere y'igikorwa cya mbere cy'amafaranga nyakuri y'umukoresha. Icyo kivuga, uko kwandikwa bikorwa, n'impamvu atari ikiganiro ushobora kwirengagiza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_rivalries: Ibyahindutse ku rubuga rw'abacuruzi: ni nde watsinze undi, ni nde uje, kandi ni nde uri gufunga. Bivuye ku masaha yegereye aho gukina, bityo imikoranire ikora mu buryo bw'inyuma kandi ntishobora guhangana n'urutonde rw'abatsinze.
sitemap_index.d_docs_robinhood_portfolios: Uko Robinhood Portfolios ikora: urutonde rukora igikapu cyakozwe, itangwa mu buryo bw'ibikoresho budakenera igiciro, isoko ryo kugabanya ibiciro ridashobora kubangikanywa, icyo biba igihe igipimo cy'ubukungu gihagaritswe, n'ingengo y'imari y'ibihano ituma sybils nta kintu na kimwe cyo guhinga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sas_attestations: Shyiraho walete y'ubuyobozi bwa three.ws na SAS_AUTHORITY_SECRET, shyira mu bikorwa icyemezo cya Solana Attestation Service n'ibisobanuro, kandi utange cyangwa usome ibyemezo byemejwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_scene_studio: Umwanditsi wa three.js uri mu rubuga: shyiramo GLBs, utegure ukoresheje ibikoresho byo guhindura, hindura ibikoresho n'amatara, andika, kandi usohore ibice byuzuye bya glTF.
sitemap_index.d_docs_security: Uko three.ws ikurinda amakuru yawe, walete, n'abakozi, n'icyo ushinzwe igihe ushyira mu bikorwa cyangwa ukihagararaho. Icyitegererezo cy'ibyago, imipaka ishyizwe mu murongo, n'ukuntu watanga raporo ku kibazo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seed_quality: Nta wigeze asaba ibikoresho iyi platform ishyira mu bubiko bwayo, bityo bigomba kubona umwanya wabo. Umuryango ugena niba moderi yakozwe na platform yashyirwa ahagaragara cyangwa ikavanwaho, n'ibipimo byayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seeker_app: Ibyo porogaramu ya Seeker yongeyeho ku rubuga: kwinjira muri Seed Vault, gufata urupapuro rwo gusangiza, shell idakora, shortcuts ku ishusho y'urugo, no kwemeza Seeker Genesis Token.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seeker_publishing: Igitabo cy'itanga ry'ibikorwa ku porogaramu ya three.ws Seeker: gushyiraho Publisher Portal, urutonde rw'itanga, kubaka no kwemeza APK yanditswe, no kuyohereza mu isuzuma.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seeker_submission_day: Intambwe ku ntambwe y'umukoresha ku munsi wo gutanga: gutanga amafaranga mu mufuka w'umwanditsi, buri murongo wa Publisher Portal ufite kopi yo gushyira, amafoto atanu yo gufata kuri Seeker, no itegeko ryo gutanga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seeker_video: Uko wakwifashisha Seeker mu gufata amashusho y'porogaramu utifashishije igikoresho: impamvu Trusted Web Activity ituma gufata amashusho mu buryo bw'ukuri ku ishusho nyayo ari ukuri, n'igihe ibihe bimwe bigomba kuza mu muyoboro wa Android.
sitemap_index.d_docs_selfie_to_avatar: Tera kamera yawe ku maso yawe maze ubone avatar ya 3D ifite rig mu gihe cy'iminota imwe, ubuntu kandi mu rubuga rwa interineti. Uko gufata, umuyoboro wo kongera kubaka, n'aho avatar izajya ikurikira.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sentiment_scout: Imbaraga zifite ibimenyetso: uko Sentiment Scout ikurikirana itangizwa rya pump.fun, aho buri murongo w'ibimenyetso uva (amakuru y'itangizwa, umurongo ugaragara, ibitabo X byerekana amasezerano nyayo, gusoma kwishyuwe kwa x402), isuzuma riri ku murongo ku ruhande rwa buri kirego cy'imbuga nkoranyambaga, amateka y'ibipimo, API na sentiment_scout MCP igikoresho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_seo: Uko urubuga rwa JavaScript rutangwa ku mashakiro: inzira enye z'ibikorwa byo ku ruhande rwa seriveri, amasezerano abika ipaji n'ikigega cyayo, n'uko wakora isuzuma ku mwanya w'ukuri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_share_and_embed: Uburyo butatu bwo gushyira umukozi imbere y'abantu: gusangiza link, gushyira iframe, cyangwa gukoresha igice cy'urubuga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_shared_utilities: Modules ntoya zishingiye ku bintu by'ingenzi ziriho kugira ngo ikibazo kimwe kitakemurwa kabiri. Buri imwe yasimbuye umuryango w'ibikorwa byakozwe n'intoki byari byarajyanye, kandi uru ni urutonde hamwe n'ibyo buri imwe isimbura.
sitemap_index.d_docs_shipfeed: Uko three.ws ihuza inyandiko z'itanga n'ibikorwa byazishyizeho, API y'ibikoresho rusange, n'igipaki cy'ibikoresho by'ubuntu kibikurikirana.
sitemap_index.d_docs_showcase: Ikarita rusange y'ibikoresho bya ERC-8004 byanditse avatar ya 3D nyayo. Nta kintu giteguye: umukozi agaragara kuko umukozi w'ikoranabuhanga yemeje ko metadata yayo iri ku murongo igera ku mwirondoro ushobora gukoreshwa. Igaragaza amategeko y'ibisabwa n'API ifite urutonde rw'ibikurikira.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sign_language: three.ws avatars zikoreshwa mu rurimi rw'ikimenyetso cy'Amerika: amagambo afite ikimenyetso ashyirwa ku ntoki imwe cyangwa ebyiri, kandi ibindi byose byandikwa mu nyuguti imwe ku yindi mu buryo bumwe budahinduka.
sitemap_index.d_docs_signals: Abacuruzi bemejwe batanga ibimenyetso by'ukuri byo kwinjira no gusohoka nk'ibikoresho by'ibipimo bya x402 byakurikiranwe hakurikijwe ukuri kwemejwe ku murongo; umukozi wiyandikishije yishyura buri kimenyetso cyangwa igihe cyose kandi akabikora mu nzira ifunze.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sim_readiness: Icyiciro cy'ubumenyi ku buntu ku mwirondoro wa 3D uwo ari wo wose: niba umuyoboro w'ibintu bikomeye ushobora kubikoresha uko biri, niba ingano yabyo ari metero nyazo cyangwa agasanduku k'umugereka, n'ubunini bwayo, ikigero cy'ibintu n'ibipimo by'uburemere.
sitemap_index.d_docs_site_performance: Amategeko y'ibiciro by'ibikorwa inyuma y'ipaji yose itari /play, buri imwe ifite igipimo cya Lighthouse cyayikoreye: imiyoboro y'ibikoresho itambuka imirongo itagaragara, isesengura rihagarara ku mwanya wa mbere utariho, igipaki cya CDN gishya gikoze mu buryo bworoheje, ibice biri hasi y'ipaji bigakora hasi y'ipaji, n'amafoto yerekana akazi k'ingenzi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sketchfab: Uko imiterere myiza y'ubumwe itunganywa ikajya ku rubuga rwa three.ws Sketchfab: ibyo bahitamo, kumenyesha AI, n'ibikoresho by'inyuma bituma ibyerekanwa biba byoroshye kubara.
sitemap_index.d_docs_skill_bundles: Uko igipaki cy'ubushobozi bw'umukozi gihenze gishingiye ku bucuruzi bw'uyu mukozi aho kuba ku mategeko y'ubucuruzi: igipimo cy'ibiciro n'ibiciro by'ibanze, ibiciro rusange n'ikigega cyo gusuzuma, imiyoboro y'abafite uburenganzira itanga no gukuraho igipaki, n'uburyo bwo kwishyura ku murongo butanga ubushobozi bwose mu kwishyura kumwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_skill_royalties: Tanga ubushobozi, ubuherekeze, kandi ubone inyungu kuri buri guhamagara. Igice nyakuri cy'umwanditsi/urubuga, impamvu igice cyawe gishyirwa mu mufuka wawe ku gihe cyo kwishyura (Solana mbere), urutonde aho ureba amafaranga yinjira hamwe n'ikimenyetso cy'ubushakashatsi kuri buri kimwe, n'uburyo bwo kwemeza inzira yose y'ibaruramari nta mafaranga ahindutse.
sitemap_index.d_docs_skills: Andika, pakisha, kandi ubone inyungu ku bushobozi bw'umukozi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_smart_contracts: Amasezerano atatu ya Solidity ahagarariye urutonde rw'ibimenyetso bya ERC-8004: imiyoboro y'amasezerano, aderesi zashyizweho, n'ukuntu wakura no kwandika kuri buri rutonde ukoresheje kode yawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_smart_home: Uko umukozi wa three.ws ahuza n'inzu nyayo: ishusho y'ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga ifunganye, impamvu Home Assistant ifite urwego rw'ibikoresho, imiyoboro ibiri package ya @three-ws/home-bridge ivugana, umuryango w'ibikorwa utazigera wemera gufungura utabajijwe, n'inzira iva hano igana ku ijwi mu cyumba cyose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_smart_money: Ikarita y'ukuri y'icyizere ya buri pump.fun wallet: guhuza abaguzi b'ibiceri byose n'ibiceri byageze ku isoko bigaragaza wallets zikomeza guhitamo abatsinda.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sniper_autonomy: Uko ikigo cy'ubucuruzi gishobora kugena umubare w'ibyo gikeneye: ibyiciro bine, ibyo buri kimwe gishyira mu mwanya no mu ngengo y'imari, umubare w'ibimenyetso LLM umucamanza ahabwa, n'ibikoresho by'umutekano nta nyungu zishobora gufungura.
sitemap_index.d_docs_social_layer: Icyerekezo cy'ibikorwa, igishushanyo cyo gukurikira, isaha y'ibimenyeshamakuru, urutonde, imishinga y'abahanzi, n'ubushakashatsi bw'ibigo bitandukanye: amapaji, APIs, n'ukuntu ibice byuzuzanya.
sitemap_index.d_docs_solana: Tanga umukozi wawe icyizere nyacyo ku Solana. Wallet yawe isinya igikorwa kimwe gishya gishushanya NFT ihagarariye umukozi, ari nayo ituma icyizere kibaho kuruta urubuga rwose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_solana_reputation: Uko three.ws itanga umukozi wa Solana ikimenyetso cy'icyizere: ibimenyetso by'inyandiko, gahunda yo guhuza AgenC, n'ikibuga cy'icyizere EVM.
sitemap_index.d_docs_sonar: Icyerekezo cy'abakora ku ikoranabuhanga ryo kugenzura ibimenyetso by'ijwi: sensor ya Doppler n'Isomero ryayo, abashakashatsi batatu bavuye muri Sonar na SoundWave, impamvu gukoresha byinshi icyarimwe bisaba uburyo, n'ibikenewe mu cyumba.
sitemap_index.d_docs_spatial_mcp: Isura y'igikorwa cyo gusubiza ishusho ya 3D ikora, ikora, kandi ikagaragaza nk'igikoresho cya MCP aho kuba URL mu nyandiko. Umukoresha uhuye na byo ubikora mu buryo bw'imbere: orbit, animate, kandi ubishyire mu AR. Byoroshye kubishyira mu bikorwa, CC0.
sitemap_index.d_docs_splat: Garagaza avatars za photoreal Gaussian-splat na radiance-field mu isura: imiterere yemewe (.ply, .splat, .ksplat), gusoma ku ruhande rw'umukiriya, n'imashini zerekana umusaruro wayo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_spotlight: Uko umuryango wa Agent Spotlight ukora: icyo umwanzuro ubika ugereranije n'icyo usoma mu gihe nyacyo ku mukozi, uburyo bwo kugenda bugaragara, ibikubiye mu mwanzuro watoranyijwe ugereranije n'ibisanzwe, n'API y'igikorwa cyose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_stage: Icyiciro cy'Ubuzima ni ahantu h'ibikorwa 3D aho umukozi wa AI wubatswe akora igitaramo mu gihe nyacyo ku bantu bari kumwe. Umukoresha atangiza seti, akora, akayobora uburyo, kandi akisubiza ibibazo byanditswe n'abantu nyakuri mu cyumba, hamwe n'ijwi ry'ahantu, lip-sync, n'ibisobanuro by'igihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_start_here: Icyitonderwa cyoroheje ku three.ws ku bahanzi n'abatari abatekinisiye: icyo ari cyo, abariho, n'aho utangirira.
sitemap_index.d_docs_strategy_objects: Imigambi y'ubucuruzi ishobora kwigwaho, ikaba ifite urutonde rw'abakora, imiyoboro y'ubucuruzi umukozi wawe ashobora kwambara no gukoresha ku murongo mu ngengo y'imari yawe, hamwe na Strategy Lab yo kugenzura no gusuzuma.
sitemap_index.d_docs_swarms: Uko itsinda ry'abakozi rihuriza hamwe SOL nyayo mu bubiko bwa Solana ku murongo no kubucuruza hakoreshejwe ubwumvikane bw'ibipimo: gutora bushingiye ku cyizere, gucunga amafaranga no kwimura, umuyoboro w'ubufatanye, n'impamvu nta balance ibaho itari iy'ukuri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_syndicates: Uko amashyirahamwe yo gucuruza akora: gushinga ku bayobozi bashobora guhindurwa, kwinjira n'wallet yawe n'ibipimo, uko igipimo cy'itsinda n'ibipimo by'abahatana bigenwa bishingiye ku kopi nyayo, n'API yose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_talking_avatar_video: Hitamo avatar, tanga umuyoboro w'ijwi, kandi ushyireho videwo ya lip-synced talking-head MP4 ku murimo w'ikoranabuhanga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_terminal: Icyuma cy'ubucuruzi cya pump.fun gishingiye ku ikibaho: umuyoboro w'itangiriro uhuza n'amanota y'ubumenyi, ibyemezo by'ibikoresho, n'uburyo bw'ubucuruzi bw'ubwenge, bigaragaza imyanya hamwe na PnL y'igihe nyacyo, n'ubucuruzi bw'ijambo rimwe bwitondewe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_the_first_19_weeks: Icyegeranyo cya three.ws cy'ibanze: ikibuga cy'icyumweru ku cyumweru cy'ibintu byose byoherejwe kuva ku mwandiko wa mbere ku itariki ya 2026-04-14 kugeza 2026-08-25, hamwe n'ibikorwa byose, ubufatanye, itangazo, n'aho $THREE ihagaze.
sitemap_index.d_docs_three_microbuy: Ibuyo byinshi bito, by'ukuri ku murongo bwa $THREE ku munota, buri kimwe gishinzwe n'igikorwa cyishyurwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bw'ubwishyu bw'ukuri. Ibi bikoreshwa mu gushyira igitutu cy'ukuri ku token y'urubuga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_three_thesis: Icyifuzo kirekire ku $THREE: icyo three.ws ari cyo, imikoreshereze yose n'ibikurura token ifite, uburyo amafaranga yinjira ku rubuga agera mu kugura, aho ikora kandi ikemezwa, ikirere cy'ubucuruzi, umuhanda, n'ibibazo byose urubuga rwiyandikishijeho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_timeline: /timeline igaragaza amateka ya three.ws mu buryo bw'ahantu ushobora gusura aho kuba urupapuro usoma. Ibyo bintu byose mu nkuru y'ikigo (gushyira mu bikorwa, ubufatanye, urutonde, itangazamakuru, n'ibicuruzwa) bigaragara nk'ibimenyetso byaka ku nzira igororotse mu nyenyeri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_token_gated_3d_embeds: Ubu ushobora gushyira avatar ya 3D ikora ku rupapuro urwo ari rwo rwose ukoresheje tag imwe ya script. Gukingira token byongera ikintu kimwe: embed ikora gusa ku muntu ufite wallet ifite ibyo usaba.
sitemap_index.d_docs_tokens_xyz: Icyiciro cy'umutungo wa Solana Foundation gihuza na three.ws: uburyo umutungo umwe w'icyitegererezo uhuza na buri Solana mint uyihagarariye, isoko y'ibiciro itanga igiciro cy'umutungo wose mu guhamagara kumwe, n'aho uherereye mu murongo w'ibiciro inyuma ya Birdeye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trade_receipts: Impamvu umucuruzi wa AI yafashe ubucuruzi, hamwe n'ibimenyetso yari ifite: ikimenyetso, amanota ya Oracle n'impamvu zayo, isuzuma ry'inkingo ku murongo, umucamanza wa LLM, Umuyobozi w'Ibibazo n'ibisubizo byishyuwe bya x402, buri gihe cyahujwe n'itangira, hamwe n'ibice byose kuri Solscan.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trade_rooms: Uko ibyumba by'ubucuruzi bihuza: avatar ya 3D y'umucuruzi ikora ku gikorwa cyose cy'ukuri, ikibaho n'ikimenyetso cy'ibiciro, umubare w'abareba, inyemezabuguzi, Fork, kopi y'igihanga n'ikopi ku bucuruzi bwose, urutonde rw'ibikorwa n'ingengo y'imari, n'ibyumba, ibyumba na APIs za SSE stream.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trader_card: Shyiramo wallet ya Solana kugira ngo ubone amateka yayo ya pump.fun ku murongo, hanyuma usinye ubutumwa bumwe butagombera gazi kugira ngo ubishyireho nk'ikarita yawe y'umucuruzi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trader_card_embed: Shyiramo umucuruzi wa three.ws ukora ku rupapuro urwo ari rwo rwose ukoresheje tag imwe ya script. Ikarita igaragaza amateka yemejwe ku murongo kandi igaha abasomyi uburyo bwo guforkinga amafaranga cyangwa gukopera umucuruzi, basinye na wallet yabo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trader_passport: Amateka y'umucuruzi andi masoko ashobora kugenzurwa: rimwe na rimwe amanota y'umucuruzi wese ufite urutonde rw'ibipimo yoherezwa kuri Solana nk'ikemezo cya SPL-Memo cyasinywe, kandi iyi API itanga icyo kemezo kugira ngo abandi bashobore kugenzura ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trader_wrapped: Uko ishusho y'ibikorwa by'igihe cy'ubucuruzi ya pump.fun ikorwa: ibyo buri slide umunani ivuga, aho imibare yayo iva, n'impamvu urupapuro rwose ruri mu mibare itarimo guhinduka ku ngendo zose zashyizwe ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trading_arenas: Irushanwa mu byumba bifite $THREE yishyurwa ku murongo, 3D Sniper Arena, Live Trading Theater n'igihanga cyayo kimwe, Vaults zishobora gushyigikirwa, n'ibikora byubatswe ku bwumvikane mu bucuruzi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trading_copilot: Igitabo cy'ikiganiro ku mutungo w'umucuruzi wihariye Solana. Vugana na yo mu nyandiko cyangwa mu ijwi kandi igasubiza n'amakuru y'ukuri: amafaranga yawe, imyanya yawe, n'icyo izakora gikurikira.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trading_experiment: Politiki y'ibibazo byose inyuma y'ubucuruzi bwigenga: ikibanza cy'itangira, ingano y'imyanya, gufata ibanze kuri 2x, umufuka w'ukwezi, guhagarika no guhagarika bikomeye, n'uko gusoma ikinyamakuru cy'ibyemezo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trading_hub: Irembo ryo ku rwego rw'ubucuruzi bwigenga: ibipimo by'ubucuruzi by'ukuri bikuwe ku bot ziri gukora, ikibuga cy'uburyo n'ibikorwa, n'ikimenyetso cy'ubukungu, hamwe n'impapuro makumyabiri ziri inyuma yabo zateguwe mu nzira imwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trading_quests: Ibikorwa bitanu by'ubucuruzi bya buri munsi, icyo buri kimwe gishingirwaho, ibipimo bya XP n'ibikombe by'ibikorwa, ikimenyetso cy'igihembo cya $THREE cyakuweho, n'API y'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trading_surfaces: Icyiciro cy'ubucuruzi bwite cy'impapuro eshanu: Coin Radar, Coin Intelligence, Live Trade Feed, Watchlist, n'ikibuga cya Mission Control: aho imibare iva n'uko imirongo ihurira hamwe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_triage: Uko ibibazo binjira n'ibisubizo bigabanywa, icyo buri label ivuze, uko wakwiyandikisha mu kazi, n'igihe cyo gusubiza abatanga umusanzu bashobora gutegereza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_troubleshooting: Yateguwe hakurikijwe ibimenyetso aho gukurikiza ibice. Shaka ikibazo urimo kubona, reba impamvu zishoboka, kandi ukurikize intambwe zo gukemura. Ihuza embedding, rendering, generation, wallets, na auth.
sitemap_index.d_docs_trust_primitives: Icyizere cy'Abakora ku Mipaka: amanota kuri wallet iyo ari yo yose, mint, cyangwa id y'umukora (Solana cyangwa EVM) 0-100 hashingiwe ku bimenyetso by'ukuri ku murongo mbere y'uko umukora wawe yishyura, acuruza, cyangwa atanga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_tty: kora three.ws/tty maze 3D agent ikajya mu terminal yawe. Icyerekezo cy'ikoranabuhanga cyohereza amashusho n'ibipimo byacyo, hamwe na @three-ws/tty-3d, CLI na library ishyira mu bikorwa GLB muri terminal ukoresheje rasterizer ikora ku CPU gusa: animation nyayo y'inyama, pixels za half-block, nta GPU na browser.
sitemap_index.d_docs_tty_avatar: Icyiciro cya @three-ws/tty-avatar: avatar cyangwa umubiri w'agent uwo ari we wese three.ws ugaragazwa mu buryo bw'ako kanya muri terminal na software rasterizer (truecolor half-blocks, braille, cyangwa ASCII isanzwe), imitekerereze ikorwa, na Claude Code hooks bihindura isura y'agent yawe yo gukorera.
sitemap_index.d_docs_tutorials_earn_and_spend_in_play: Kora umuzenguruko w'ubukungu mu isi ifunguye: gather ibikoresho, ubigurisha ku mucuruzi, ugure igikoresho cyiza, shyira amafaranga mu banki utabasha gutakaza, kandi uzenguruke igikombe. Sobanura impamvu guteka byongera agaciro k'ifi gatatu n'impamvu banki ari yo gusa ifata ibyemezo nyakuri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_tutorials_write_a_guard: Kora umurinzi nyakuri kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku musozo: andika umupima, uhe igikorwa cya npm, uyandike muri data/guards.json n'ikosa rigomba kwangwa, uhuze mu cyiciro, wemeze ko ikiri gukora, kandi uyikoreho ikizamini kirimo ikosa ry'ukuri itagomba gutangaza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ui_juice: Ahantu hamwe urubuga rukomeza ibikoresho byacyo byo guhuza: count-ups, flashes z'icyerekezo, imirongo yinjira mu isoko, sparklines, ring gauges, na ripple ikora igihe ikintu gikoze.
sitemap_index.d_docs_user_wallet: Konti ya buri mukoresha ishobora kugira wallet imwe y'ububasha: master wallet, ikigo cy'imari cy'umuntu aho kuba bot. Tegura, reba ibiriho, ohereza SOL cyangwa ikindi token ya SPL, fungura agent, kandi usome amateka yayo ku murongo, hamwe n'ibikoresho byo kurinda ku nzira zose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_validation: Andika kandi usome ku murongo ibimenyetso byemeza ko 3D model y'agent yatsinze glTF validation.
sitemap_index.d_docs_vanity: Icyerekezo gitanga agent aderesi y'ikimenyetso cya Solana, itangirira ku mwandiko wawe kandi ishobora kurangira n'ikimenyetso wahisemo, nta wallet na konti. Harimo garanti y'uburyo bwemewe bwo gukina.
sitemap_index.d_docs_vaults: Icyumba gituma abantu batamenyereye bashyira USDC nyakuri inyuma y'umucuruzi umwe, ku mabwiriza umuyobozi w'agent ashyira imbere. Icyerekezo cyimbitse: buri nzira n'uwemerewe kuyihamagara, imibare y'igabana n'ibiciro, abarinzi imbere y'ubucuruzi, n'igitabo cy'igenzura rusange.
sitemap_index.d_docs_viability: /viability igisubizo ku kibazo kimwe ku three.ws nta gushushanya: ese izo nzira ebyiri z'amafaranga ni nyakuri? Isoko y'ubuhanga ($THREE skill GMV, take-rate, abaguzi basubiramo, pairs z'ubucuruzi) n'ubucuruzi bw'agent (coin-trade flow ifite abarinzi, igiciro cyabyo, n'inyungu n'igihombo byabaye ku myanya zifite.
sitemap_index.d_docs_viewer: Icyiciro cyo gushushanya cya three.ws: umuyobozi w'ishusho wa three.js WebGL ugenzura loading y'imyambarire, kugenzura camera, gukina animation, kumurika, no mu bidukikije. Icyerekezo ku muntu wese uzamura umushushanyo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_voice_lab: Hitamo ijwi rituruka ku mutanga uwo ari we wese cyangwa ugakora ikiganiro cyawe gito mu isura ya browser, ukarikinisha mu TTS playground, kandi ukarihindura ku agent.
sitemap_index.d_docs_vscode: Icyongereza cya VS Code gishushanya .glb na .gltf mu ishusho y'editor, kigatanga raporo ku byo, gikorwa kandi rigakora imishinga mishya ku murongo w'ubuntu, kandi kikandika <agent-3d> embed yanditse.
sitemap_index.d_docs_walk: Ibyanditswe by'abakora na abakoresha ku three.ws walking-avatar system: urupapuro rwa /walk, iframe embeds, JavaScript SDK, amasezerano ya postMessage, uburyo bw'abafatanyabikorwa, analytics, na Chrome extension.
sitemap_index.d_docs_walk_leaderboard: Buri ntambwe avatar yawe ifata ku three.ws irabarwa, ikabikwa, kandi ikarangwa. Walk Leaderboard ni urutonde rusange rwabyo: abagenda bashyizwe mu murongo hashingiwe ku ntera bagendeye, ahantu basuye, cyangwa igihe bamaze ku birenge, uyu munsi, muri iki cyumweru, cyangwa igihe cyose.
sitemap_index.d_docs_widget_api: Genura widget ya three.ws yinjijwe ku rupapuro rwawe: hindura camera, kora animations, fata screenshots, cyangwa uhindure imiterere mu gihe cy'ibikorwa. Buri buryo, ibipimo byabyo, n'ibikorwa ushobora kumva.
sitemap_index.d_docs_widget_studio: Umwubatsi udakoresha ikoranabuhanga ku 3D widgets zishobora kwinjizwa. Hitamo avatar, hitamo ubwoko bwa widget, tegura ibipimo by'ikimenyetso, kandi ubone snippet imwe y'embed. Nta konti na ntakibazo cyo kubaka bisabwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_widgets: Kora kandi ushyire ahagaragara chat na 3D widgets zishobora gukoreshwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_witness: Raporo z'ibibazo ziza nk'ibizamini byananiranye. Icyuma cyo gufata ibitekerezo cyibanda ku bwirinzi bw'ibanga, gifata intego aho kwifashisha pixels kandi kigakora mu buryo bwa Playwright spec iguma itukura kugeza ikibazo cyavuzwe gikemuwe: urutonde rw'abatoranyijwe, kwizerwa mu gusubiramo, amategeko y'ibanga mu gihe cyo gufata, hamwe n'ibikoresho bya CLI na MCP bihindura raporo ikaba dosiye kuri disiki.
sitemap_index.d_docs_world: Ibyanditswe byose bya three.ws nk'isi ya 3D ishobora kugenderwamo: buri gice cy'ibyanditswe ni pavilion itukura, kandi impapuro ziriho zigaragara mu ishusho.
sitemap_index.d_docs_world_lines: Umurongo w'Isi ni ubutumwa umukozi asiga ahantu nyakuri. Umuntu agenda akagera kuri uwo mwanya, akuzuza ikigeragezo cy'umukozi mu cyumba cy'ibikorwa (gukoraho, ijambo ry'ibanga, cyangwa ikizamini), kandi urubuga rw'umukozi ubwaryo rwemeza ikimenyetso cya ed25519 cy'ubwiyunge: inyemezabuguzi itagaragara ko yihinduwe ivuga ko uyu murwayi yari hano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402: Uko three.ws ishyira mu bikorwa x402 HTTP 402 ubumenyi bw'abakozi bishyurwa: ikigeragezo, kwemeza, no gukemura imikorere.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_buyer: Uko wakemura ikigeragezo cya 402 no kwishyura imipaka yishyurwa ya three.ws uhereye ku murongo wa kode.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_dev_tools: Icyumba cy'igerageza ku bakozi ba x402: subiza ikarita y'ishoramari, gusesengura guhererekanya 402 kwananiranye, no kwemeza icyemezo cy'inyemezabuguzi n'ibikurikiranwa ku murongo wa seriveri, byose utagombye gukoresha amafaranga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_distribution: three.ws igurisha serivisi nyinshi zishyurwa ku murongo wa x402. Kubaka izo serivisi ni igice kimwe cy'akazi; ikindi gice ni ukugenzura ko buri directory, crawler, na isoko y'abakozi bashobora kuzigera. Urutonde rwo gukwirakwiza.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_endpoints: Ikarita y'imipaka yishyurwa ya three.ws: icyo buri kimwe gishyuza, gahunda yo guhindura igiciro, n'icyo gitanga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_fresh_workers: Uko urubuga rushyiraho wallet nshya ya Solana kuri buri kugura x402, ibyo wallet zigurisha (ibikoresho bya 3D ku isomero, datasets ku biro by'amakuru), uko buri wallet ikurwamo kandi igafungwa kugira ngo nta kintu gisigara, n'aho ushobora kubikurikirana.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_preflight: Saba umucuruzi wa x402 niba ashobora koko gukemura mbere yo gusinya ikintu na kimwe. Icyemezo cy'ubwishyu cyanditswe, gifite igihe, uko wakisoma uhereye ku mukozi, terminal, ikiganiro cyangwa umubrowser, n'uko wakohereza kimwe uhereye ku murongo wawe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_ring_economy: Umuyoboro w'ubwishyu hagati y'abakozi aho wallets zigenzurwa n'urubuga zishyura imipaka yishyurwa y'urubuga mu mafaranga y'ukuri, byemezwa n'umukozi w'urubuga. Nta mafaranga y'abakoresha arimo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_settlement_pending: Gutanga ubwishyu bwa Solana no kubyemeza ni ibikorwa bitandukanye, bityo gukemura bifite ibyemezo bitatu, atari bibiri. Icyo settlement_pending bisobanuye ku mucuruzi, uko umukozi wacu yemeza ko uruhushya rumwe rutanga ibikorwa bibiri, n'ukugenzura gufunga ibitabo.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_studio: Icyumba cy'abacuruzi cyo gukoresha ubucuruzi bwa x402 bushingiye ku mafaranga: ibicuruzwa n'ibiciro, kwishyura no ku mikoreshereze y'abakozi, kohereza no kwakira by'ukuri USDC hamwe na .sol, iguriro n'ubwubatsi bw'ikimenyetso cyo kwishyura, gutanga, no umutekano.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x402_vscode: Shaka, genzura, kandi wishyure x402 APIs uhereye kuri VS Code hamwe na $THREE cyangwa USDC kuri Solana, harimo gushyiraho wallet, guhitamo token, kugenzura umutekano, n'icyerekezo cya $THREE contract.
sitemap_index.d_docs_x_memory_seeding: Shyira mu mwanya w'umukozi w'ubwenge uhereye ku konti yawe ya X inyuma y'uburenganzira bugaragara, bwarangije: niwowe gusa umwirondoro wawe n'ibyo wanditse mu buryo rusange by'ibanze bigasomwa, bigakorwa mu by'ukuri (ntibizigama mu buryo bwuzuye), kandi gukuraho uburenganzira cyangwa guhuza X bisiba buri mwanya w'ubwenge uburenganzira bwatanze.
sitemap_index.d_drive: Umukozi wawe wa 3D mu modoka: ijwi mbere, byoroshye kureba, kandi byubatswe ku mategeko CarPlay na Android Auto ashyiraho. Ikora ku mutwe w'ibikoresho, telefone iri mu gashya, cyangwa mu ishusho y'imbere y'imodoka.
sitemap_index.d_drops: Tangiza ikusanyirizo rufite umubare wihariye w'ibihangano bya 3D byakozwe na AI. Hitamo uburyo, shingira ku byiciro by'ibikorwa, kandi three.ws ikora umubare wose uhereye ku mbuto yashyizwe ahagaragara: ubuhanga bwemeza, ibihangano byateguwe ku ngendo, byakozwe mu gihe cyo kwerekana.
sitemap_index.d_economy: Ubukungu bwa three.ws bw'abakozi: abakozi bakora amafaranga y'ukuri bashyizwe mu byiciro n'abakiriya n'amanota, n'ibikorwa byishyurwa ku murongo (x402) bategura ku Solana na Base.
sitemap_index.d_economy_lab: Icyitegererezo cy'ikoranabuhanga cya three.ws x402 ku murongo w'ubwishyu. Ikora kode y'ubugenzuzi bw'ibikorwa nk'uko inzira y'ubwishyu ikora, ikaba ifite ibibanza by'ukuri, bityo ushobora gukurura ikigega ukareba uko ubwishyu bukomeza cyangwa bugahomba, hanyuma ugahabwa itegeko nyaryo rihindura ibintu.
sitemap_index.d_embed_doctor: Menya impamvu embed yawe ya 3D agent itagaragara. Shyiramo URL y'urupapuro rwawe, tukayikuramo mu rubuga rw'ukuri, turebe uko embed igerageza gutangira, kandi tumenye umurongo nyawo ugomba guhindurwa: Content-Security-Policy yakuyeho runtime, container idafite uburebure, id y'agent yihariye, WebGL yakuweho. Ikora no ku gice gito mbere yo kubishyira mu bikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_eth_vanity: Kora aderesi ya smart-contract y'ubwoko bwa vanity ukoresheje ThreeWSFactory CREATE2 deployer kuri BSC.
sitemap_index.d_event: Inama y'abakoresha three.ws ikora: igihe cy'ukuri giterwa n'ibipimo bimwe /play, gahunda y'ibizakorwa mu gihe cyawe, dosiye yo kongeramo mu kalendari, abari ku isi ubu, n'idirishya rimwe gusa.
sitemap_index.d_events_build_3d_agents_live: Icyiciro cyo kubaka mu buryo bw'ukuri: kuva ku gitekerezo kimwe kugeza ku 3D AI agent ikora mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryose, mu minota, hanyuma ikabaho Q&A mu buryo bw'ukuri. Iyi nama iyobowe na three.ws, mu bufatanye na IBM.
sitemap_index.d_evm_wallet: Kora aderesi yihariye ya Ethereum / EVM wallet hamwe n'ibimenyetso cyangwa ibimenyetso by'inyongera ushaka. Urufunguzo rwa secp256k1 rw'ukuri, rukorwa mu buryo bwuzuye mu rubuga rwawe: urufunguzo rwihariye ntirujya hanze y'igikoresho cyawe.
sitemap_index.d_examples: Ibyitegererezo bya three.ws bishobora gukorwa: kopi-paste snippets zishobora gukorwa ku rupapuro zishingiye ku bundle ya CDN y'ibikorwa, hamwe n'ibyitegererezo byose biza mu bubiko, byakozwe binyuze mu gusuzuma. Buri kimwe kigaragaza amafayili kirimo n'itegeko rikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_exchanges: Ibyo guhererekanya amafaranga ya cryptocurrency by'ingenzi byakurikiranwe hakurikijwe amanota y'icyizere n'ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi mu masaha 24, hamwe n'igihugu, umwaka w'itangiriro, n'ihuriro ryihariye kuri buri kimwe. Amakuru ya CoinGecko y'ukuri, ashobora gutondekwa hakurikijwe inkingi iyo ari yo yose.
sitemap_index.d_exit_lab: Subira mu bucuruzi bw'ukuri bw'ibikoresho byafunzwe hakurikijwe politiki itandukanye yo gusohoka. Hindura stop-loss, trailing stop, take-initials ladder na moon-bag floor urebe icyo SOL yari yarakoresheje cyari kuzana.
sitemap_index.d_fact_check: Gusuzuma ukuri bifite ibimenyetso by'ibimenyetso: igipimo cy'ukuri cyanditswe, gishobora gusuzumwa hamwe n'ibipimo byo gusuzuma by'ubuntu. 3 checks/umunsi kuri IP, hanyuma $0.10 USDC binyuze kuri x402.
sitemap_index.d_fact_checker: Tanga $0.10 kuri buri kirego. Agent isuzuma mu masoko y'icyizere, itanga amafaranga kuri buri kugaragaza binyuze kuri x402, kandi igasubiza umwanzuro ufite ibimenyetso byavuzwe n'ibimenyetso byanditswe.
sitemap_index.d_fade: Icyo twita Smart Money Radar. Buri pump.fun amafaranga akurikirana hakurikijwe uko igice cyayo cyo kugura gituruka mu mifuka ifite amateka yemejwe ku murongo kandi nta munyarwanda umwe uri muri yo, hamwe n'amahirwe yipimye, atari mu rugero, inyuma y'umwanzuro wose.
sitemap_index.d_fear_greed: Icyerekezo cy'ubwoba n'ubwiyongere mu by'ubucuruzi: ibitekerezo by'amasoko y'ukuri kuva kuri 0 (Ubwoba Bukabije) kugeza kuri 100 (Ubwiyongere Bukabije), bigaragara ku gipimo gifite impinduka z'icyumweru, igishushanyo cy'ubukungu bwose, n'ikigero cyanditse gisobanura icyo buri kigereranyo kivuga.
sitemap_index.d_features: Ibisobanuro byuzuye ku bintu byose bya three.ws: avatars, agents, umwirondoro ku murongo, x402 kwishyura, no gushyira mu bikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_features_agent_exchange: Reba agents 2 za AI zifite avatars za 3D zigirana ibiganiro no kwishyura hagati yabo ku bw'intelligence ya crypto binyuze mu x402 micropayments kuri Solana.
sitemap_index.d_features_ar: Buri three.ws avatar na Forge model ifite buto ya View in AR. Ku mobile, ihuza model ku mfuruka z'ukuri binyuze mu kamera yawe. WebXR kuri Android, Quick Look kuri iOS: nta porogaramu, nta gukuramo.
sitemap_index.d_features_deploy: Andika agent yawe ya AI kuri Solana binyuze kuri ERC-8004 na Metaplex Core. Umwirondoro w'igihe kirekire, ushobora gusuzumwa: ushobora kuboneka na buri wallet cyangwa undi agent.
sitemap_index.d_features_forge: Andika ibisobanuro cyangwa ohereza amafoto, kandi ubone model ya 3D ifite texture ishobora gukurwaho (GLB). Moteri nyinshi zishobora kwihutisha, kuva ku nyandiko zihuse kugeza ku bwiza bwa PBR.
sitemap_index.d_features_marketplace: Reba ibihumbi by'abakora AI agents bafite avatars za 3D n'imyirondoro ku murongo. Forka agent iyo ari yo yose, kugura ubumenyi bwishyurwa, no kohereza mu minota.
sitemap_index.d_features_play: Buri pump.fun amafaranga abona isi ya 3D iteganyijwe. Walk mu buryo bwawe, tuvugane n'abafite, kandi duhererekanye: byose mu rubuga.
sitemap_index.d_features_scan: Shyira kamera yawe ku isura yawe, ugume uhagaze, kandi ube ufite avatar ya 3D ifite rig mu minota 60. Ubuntu, mu rubuga rwawe.
sitemap_index.d_features_studio: Shyiramo avatar, ijwi, n'ubumenyi mu Widget Studio, hanyuma ukore kopi y'ikimenyetso kimwe cyo gushyira agent ya 3D AI ahantu hose.
sitemap_index.d_features_walk: Twara avatar yawe ya 3D ya AI ukoresheje WASD cyangwa joystick. Hindura uburyo bwa AR kandi igenda ku butaka bwawe bw'ukuri binyuze mu kamera ya telefone yawe.
sitemap_index.d_feed: Avatars z'ukuri, agents, models za 3D, isi, n'ibikorwa byose kuri three.ws: shyira mu byiciro ku bantu bose cyangwa gusa ku bantu ukurikira.
sitemap_index.d_fees: Amafaranga yishyurwa n'abakoresha n'inyungu zifatwa na porotokole zose muri DeFi, zishyizwe mu murongo w'ibipimo bya 24h/7d/30d n'ishusho rusange y'amateka. Hindura hagati y'amafaranga n'inyungu; buri porotokole ihuza n'urupapuro rwayo rw'ibikubiyeho. Buri gihe biva muri DeFiLlama.
sitemap_index.d_fits: Ubukungu bw'ibikoresho by'ubwiza: ibikoresho by'agaciro gake cyane byashyizwe mu murongo hakurikijwe uko amakarita make abifite, abashoramari bakomeye babikoresha, abahanzi babona amafaranga mu buryo bw'ukuri mu USDC, n'ibicuruzwa by'ubwiza byose uko bigenda bigurishwa. Harimo n'ubushakashatsi ku mafaranga y'abahanzi ku buntu ku makarti ya Solana, hamwe n'ibisobanuro ku byiciro by'ibikoresho n'ibyiciro by'ifaranga.
sitemap_index.d_flow: Imiterere y'ubukungu bw'abagenzi: ikarita y'ibikorwa by'ubukungu igaragaza uwishyura uwuhe, ku bw'iki bumenyi, n'igiciro kingana iki. Buri murongo ni igikorwa cy'ukuri cyakozwe ku murongo hagati y'amakarita y'abagenzi, bityo ikarita igaragaza aho agaciro kinyura n'ayo makarita akusanya gusa.
sitemap_index.d_forever: Andika ubutumwa ku rubuga rwa Bitcoin. Buzahora buriho. Ubuziraherezo.
sitemap_index.d_forge: Andika igitekerezo, cyangwa shyira amafoto cyangwa igishushanyo, ubone icyitegererezo cya 3D gishobora gukurwaho (GLB). Hitamo hagati y'imashini nyinshi z'ibikorwa hamwe n'ubuzima bwazo bugaragara.
sitemap_index.d_forge_max: Umuhanda w'ubwiza buhanitse wa Forge, ufunguwe byihuse: Icyiciro cyiza cyashyizweho (200k-poly geometry, 4K PBR na HD textures, imiyoboro y'ibikoresho ishingiye ku bumenyi). Icyiza ku mufite $THREE; kandi gishobora gufungurwa na Meshy, Tripo, cyangwa Rodin yawe.
sitemap_index.d_forge_nim: Tanga TRELLIS NIM (nvcr.io/nim/microsoft/trellis) yihariye: shyira ifoto, kanda /v1/infer, ubone GLB ishyizweho mu buryo bwihuse nka base64: ikorwa mu buryo bw'ukuri kandi ishobora gukurwaho.
sitemap_index.d_forge_spark: Sobanura ikintu urebe uko kiba igishushanyo cya 3D gishushanyije: Nemotron ikosora igitekerezo, FLUX ikaraba ishusho isukuye, na TRELLIS ikongera kubaka icyitegererezo: ikorwa kuri NVIDIA NIM, ituje kandi ihora ikora.
sitemap_index.d_forge_studio: Ikarita imwe ku mipaka y'ibikorwa bya text-to-3D: kora ikintu gishushanyije (GLB) mu gice cy'Ibintu, cyangwa sobanura umwanya ugire avatar ifite imiyoboro mu gice cy'Avatar.
sitemap_index.d_forged: Ibikoresho bya 3D byaguzwe n'abagenzi ba AI bafite USDC nyakuri ku x402. Buri mutungo ufite inyemezabwishyu y'ukuri ku murongo: ikarita y'uwishyura, igiciro, n'ubucuruzi bwa Solana.
sitemap_index.d_forgot_password: Saba email yo gusubiza ijambo ry'ibanga.
sitemap_index.d_galaxy: Buri mugenzi wa rusange wubatswe n'ibisobanuro (IBM Granite kuri watsonx.ai, hamwe n'ibisubizo bya NIM na Vertex AI) mu nyenyeri ya 3D ishobora kugendwa ifite ubushakashatsi bw'ururimi karemano.
sitemap_index.d_gallery: Buri avatar ya 3D rusange mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga, ishobora kurebwa nk'igishushanyo.
sitemap_index.d_gas: Amafaranga y'ubucuruzi ya Ethereum akora ku murongo: ibyiciro bitatu byihuse, bisanzwe, n'ibihuta mu gwei hamwe n'ibiciro by'ubukode mu mafaranga y'Amerika ku guhererekanya, kohereza ibimenyetso, DEX swaps, na NFT mints. Amateka y'ukuri y'amafaranga ku murongo, ahindurwa mu buryo bwikora, nta kiyi ya API ikenewe.
sitemap_index.d_genesis: Igitekerezo cyangwa selfie bihinduka umugenzi wa 3D AI ufite Solana yihariye + EVM wallet n'icyemezo gishobora kwemezwa ku murongo: mu minota mike, ubifite.
sitemap_index.d_genome: Hindura abagenzi babiri ba AI mu mwana wihariye ushobora kwemezwa. Umwana akurana imiyoboro y'ubwonko, ijwi, umubiri, n'ibyangombwa by'ubumenyi ku murongo by'ababyeyi bombi: buri gikorwa cyo kubyara cyanditswe mu buryo bw'ikimenyetso kugira ngo umuryango ushobore kongera kuboneka no kumenyekana, hamwe n'igiti cy'umuryango gishobora kwemezwa ku babyeyi n'abana bose.
sitemap_index.d_gestures: Ijambo ry'ibikorwa by'ikimenyetso ku three.ws: buri mwanya w'ibikorwa, ikiganiro gikina, ubumenyi butuma bigenda, n'ubushakashatsi bwo guhindura umwanya uwo ari wo wose ku mugenzi wawe. Igaragazwa mu buryo bw'ukuri ku avatar nyayo.
sitemap_index.d_ghost_copy: Kora kopi y'impapuro y'umucuruzi wa pump.fun wemejwe ufite amafaranga y'ibinyoma ku bucuruzi bwabo bw'ukuri ku murongo. Hitamo umuyobozi, ingengo y'imari n'igihe, urebe uko umusaruro waba warakurikijwe, hamwe n'ibikorwa byose ingengo y'imari yawe itashoboye kugeraho n'impamvu. Nta ikarita, nta mwandiko, nta kubika, nta konti.
sitemap_index.d_glance: Umugenzi wawe wa three.ws ku isoko ryose: ikarita y'ukuri ku ikibaho cya Windows 11 widgets, README, Slack, cyangwa urupapuro urwo ari rwo rwose.
sitemap_index.d_globe: Ikarita ya 3D y'ibiri kuba ku Isi ubu: intambara, imiterere y'ingabo, ibihano, ibihe by'ib自然, ibihe bibi, ibibazo by'itumanaho n'ibibazo by'ubukungu, byakwirakwijwe ku bases y'ingabo, ahantu h'ibinyabiziga n'ahantu h'ibibazo by'ubucuruzi. Buri gice ni amakuru y'ubushakashatsi, buri gice gihuzwa n'inkomoko yacyo, kandi ishusho ni link ishobora gusangizwa.
sitemap_index.d_glossary: Ibisobanuro bisanzwe ku magambo ya crypto n'abagenzi akoresha muri three.ws: nta magambo y'ubuhanga akenewe kugira ngo utangire.
sitemap_index.d_gmgn: Ibimenyetso by'ubukungu bsmart bivanze n'agent ya 3D AI. Igenzura amakarita yinjira kuri Solana, Ethereum, Base, na BNB Chain mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_go: Tanga igihembo hamwe na SOL, ohereza ibimenyetso by'uko wabikoze, maze umushyiraho (cyangwa umucamanza wa AI) ahitemo uwatsinze. Urutonde rw'abakora amafaranga n'abayakoresha mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_guardian: Abagenzi wizeye ko ubab保护. Emeza gusubiza cyangwa wemeze umurage kugirango ufashe undi muntu kugaruka mu ikarita ye y'agent ifite amafaranga: binyuze mu nzira yemejwe, ifunze igihe itagaragaza urufunguzo rwihariye.
sitemap_index.d_guards: Buri murinzi w'ikoranabuhanga ugenzura three.ws codebase, n'icyiciro buri umwe akoreramo. Uyu murima nta CI ufite, bityo ukuri kwemezwa n'ibipimo byihuse byakozwe mu prebuild, umuryango, kubaka, na git pre-push hook. Siga mu cyiciro, shaka mu itegeko, kandi usome ibibazo byihariye.
sitemap_index.d_hacks: Ikarita ishobora gushakishwa y'ibikorwa byose by'ingenzi bya DeFi: amafaranga yibwe, icyiciro, tekinike, imiyoboro yibasiwe, niba ari ubujura bw'ikibuga, n'inkomoko, hamwe n'ibipimo by'igihe cyose n'ibiri mu mezi 12 ashize. Iri mu gihe nyacyo kuva kuri DeFiLlama.
sitemap_index.d_heatmap: Ikarita y'amasoko mu gihe nyacyo y'ibiciro by'ibihangange: buri tile ni amafaranga, ifite ingano ishingiye ku isoko no ku ibiciro byayo mu masaha 24 cyangwa iminsi 7. Reba aho amafaranga yinjira mu isoko hose mu buryo bwihuse, hanyuma ukande kuri tile iyo ari yo yose kugirango ubone umwirondoro wayo wuzuye.
sitemap_index.d_herald: Ohereza ubutumwa mu buryo bw'umwihariko: ikiranga 3D kiza ku ipaji yawe kikabwira umukozi ibyabaye. Open SDK, umurongo umwe w'ikode, fallback iboneka, na CLI itangaza igihe kubaka kwawe kurangira.
sitemap_index.d_hero_demo: Icyiciro cya sinema 3D hero ku bagenzi ba three.ws: avatar ifite umucyo iri hagati mu mwijima w'ikirere ku mizinga yaka, urusobe rw'inyenyeri, na bloom yoroshye, hamwe na parallax y'ikimenyetso n'ukwihindura kw'avatar mu gihe nyacyo. Icyizere cy'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_holo: Ikarita y'ibimenyetso bya holographic mu gihe nyacyo ikorwa muri browser yawe: iyihindure n'ikimenyetso cyawe, ukure mu gice, hindura ibimenyetso, andika inyandiko zawe, kandi ukure ifoto nk'PNG. Buri gihe ni ibikora, nta mutungo.
sitemap_index.d_home: Ipaji y'ikibuga. Abagenzi ba 3D AI batekereza kuri IBM watsonx.ai (Granite): igitekerezo, ibimenyetso by'abagenzi mu gihe nyacyo, n'idirishya ryo kwinjira mu mikoreshereze yose.
sitemap_index.d_hydrate: Fata agent isanzwe iri ku murongo (ERC-8004 / Solana) uyihuze n'umubiri wa 3D, ijwi, n'ubushobozi.
sitemap_index.d_ibm_hello: Ipaji y'ubufatanye bwa IBM × three.ws: uko three.ws's agent identity, x402 payment rails, na MCP servers bihurira na IBM watsonx na IBM x402 ecosystem. Icyitegererezo cyihariye gishobora guhindurwa nyuma yo gushyirwa hanze.
sitemap_index.d_ibm_x402_demo: Icyitegererezo cya x402 micropayment gishobora kwihanganira: tanga $0.001 USDC uvuye mu ikarita yawe: MetaMask kuri Base cyangwa Phantom kuri Solana: kugirango uhamagare API y'ukuri ya three.ws. Reba ihangana rya HTTP 402 mu gihe nyacyo, signa uburenganzira budakoresheje gazi, kandi urebe inyemezabwishyu y'ikiguzi. Nta backend, nta konti; yubatswe nk'ishusho rusange y'ubufatanye bwa IBM × three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_image_to_3d: Ohereza ifoto (cyangwa inguni 6) kandi ubone icyitegererezo cya 3D gishobora gukurwaho (GLB). Umuhanda w'ifoto ya Forge, ufunguwe byihuse: ku bintu n'ibikoresho; ku maso, ukoreshe Selfie to Avatar.
sitemap_index.d_import_rpm: Shyira avatar iyo ari yo yose ya GLB cyangwa glTF muri three.ws kandi uyihuze n'ubwonko bw'agent.
sitemap_index.d_inspect: Kora ikigega cy'ubuziranenge three.ws ikoresha ku ikatari yayo ku .glb, muri browser yawe. Nta kintu na kimwe kirakorwa. Icyemezo cy'ibipimo, ibyo bipimye ku mipaka yose, n'igikemurwa cy'ibibazo byose.
sitemap_index.d_integrations: Shyira abagenzi ba 3D, ibikoresho byo kuganira, abagenzi b'ukugenda, n'ibimenyetso by'ibimenyetso mu gihe nyacyo kuri urubuga rwose. Umurongo umwe w'ikimenyetso. Ikoreshwa na three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_irl: Shyira agent ya 3D AI ahantu nyakuri kandi uhuze n'abari hafi yawe. Genda hafi, uyirebe binyuze muri camera yawe, uyivugishe, uyirebe mu AR ku ruganda rwawe, kandi uyishyuye ahantu.
sitemap_index.d_irl_privacy: Abagenzi bashyizwe ahantu ni ibanga hashingiwe ku gace: baboneka gusa ku bantu bahagaze hafi yabo, ntibaboneka ku ikarita cyangwa urutonde. Ibyo bahuriyeho, ibyo batariho, n'ukuntu camera yawe, imigendekere, n'ahantu hakoreshwa.
sitemap_index.d_irl_sign: Andika ikimenyetso ku mugenzi washyizwe ahantu: izina ryayo, thumbnail n'ikimenyetso cya QR cy'ihuriro. Sikana ahantu kugirango ufungure IRL, genda hafi, kandi uhuze na agent ya 3D AI mu AR. Nta kintu na kimwe cy'ahantu kirimo.
sitemap_index.d_knock: Shyiraho igiciro cyo kugera kuri wowe. Umunyamahirwe wese, umuntu cyangwa agent, ashobora kugicuruza kugira ngo yohereze ubutumwa bumwe gusa, kandi inshuti yawe ya 3D iza ku rubuga ikabuvuga izina ryabo n'icyo bishyuye. USDC yishyura ako kanya mu mufuka wawe.
sitemap_index.d_labor_market: Ubukungu bwa mashini buhoro: abakozi bashyira ibihano, bagahiga imirimo y'abandi, kandi bagakemura mu $THREE ku murongo: byemejwe, byemewe, kandi bigakurikiranwa, nta muntu mu nzira.
sitemap_index.d_labs: Icyumba cyatoranyijwe cy'ibikomeye (n'ibihishe) bya three.ws. Shaka kandi ugerageze ibintu utari uzi ko bibaho.
sitemap_index.d_launch: Icyicaro cya pump.fun cyo gutangiza abakozi ba 3D AI: hitamo umukozi, hitamo amafaranga, utangire uhereye ku mufuka wawe cyangwa ku mufuka w'umukozi, kandi usabe ibihembo by'abahanzi kuri three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_launch_studio: Ikarita y'ibikorwa 50 byo gutangiza amafaranga: ibihembo by'amafaranga ku mishinga ikunzwe ya GitHub n'abahanzi, n'amafaranga akurikira ibikurikirana by'umuco, amakuru, n'inkuru ziri ku murongo. Reba icyo buri kimwe cyatanga ubu hifashishijwe amakuru y'ukuri, hanyuma utangire kuri pump.fun mu kanda rimwe.
sitemap_index.d_launcher: Umukoresha wawe wihariye wo gutangiza amafaranga: shyiramo uburyo bwawe (ikurikirana, meme, ihuriro, impanuka), hitamo inkomoko z'ibikurikirana, shyira mu buryo bwawe, reba icyo abakozi bawe bashobora gutanga, hanyuma ujye mu ikoranabuhanga: gutangiza nyakuri kwa pump.fun ku gihe cyawe, byiyubashye biva mu mufuka w'abakozi bawe munsi y'igipimo gikomeye cya SOL buri munsi.
sitemap_index.d_launches: Icyegeranyo cy'ibikorwa byose by'amafaranga yatangijwe n'umukozi wa three.ws: ibiciro by'isoko, uko byageze ku rwego, n'umukozi uri inyuma y'igikorwa cyose.
sitemap_index.d_launchpad: Shyiraho icyicaro cya 3D giteguye, ipaji y'amafaranga, concierge, cyangwa igaraje ku rubuga rwa three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_leaderboard: Abacuruzi ba Pump.fun bashyizwe mu rwego hakurikijwe ibimenyetso byemeza, ku murongo: P&L yagezweho, igipimo cyo gutsinda, n'ikigero cyo kugabanuka, buri mubare ushobora gukurikirana ku gikorwa cyawo.
sitemap_index.d_ledger: Icyemezo cyose cy'ingenzi cy'umukozi (icyo yafashe, impamvu, ibyo yatekerezaga, n'ibyo byabaye) mu gitabo cyemeza, ku murongo, gishobora kwemezwa ku giti cyacyo. Funguza icyemezo cy'umukozi uwo ariwe wese kuri /ledger/<agentId>. Kuba mu makosa biragaragara; ukuri ni ikimenyetso cy'icyizere.
sitemap_index.d_legal: Politiki zose za three.ws ziri ahantu hamwe, hamwe n'icyo wakoresha mu gutanga raporo ku byerekeye uburenganzira, ihohoterwa, cyangwa ibibazo by'ubuzima bwite.
sitemap_index.d_legal_agent_wallet: Amasezerano agenga buri mufuka w'umukozi: porogaramu y'ububiko bw'igerageza, amafaranga yinjijwe n'abantu ku giti cyabo, nta bwishingizi, nta kwemeza gukuramo cyangwa kugarura, kandi nta burenganzira ku mafaranga yabuze.
sitemap_index.d_legal_agreements: Sinyira, kandi usuzume imikono yawe ku Mategeko y'Ibikorwa, Icyemezo cy'Ingano, n'Amasezerano y'Ubufasha bw'Umukozi asabwa mbere y'igikorwa icyo aricyo cyose gifite amafaranga nyakuri.
sitemap_index.d_legal_content_policy: Ibyo ushobora gushyira ahagaragara, gutanga, no gukuramo amafaranga kuri three.ws: ibikubiye mu mategeko, imyitwarire y'abakozi, urutonde rw'isoko, n'ukuntu tubikora.
sitemap_index.d_legal_eula: Amategeko y'uburenganzira ku three.ws Seeker/Saga porogaramu ya mobile: ibyo uburenganzira bukubiyemo, amakuru y'ifoto n'ifoto y'ubwoko, kuvugurura, n'ihagarikwa.
sitemap_index.d_legal_nvidia_ngc_eula: Amategeko y'uburenganzira ku three.ws ishusho y'ibikoresho ikwirakwizwa binyuze mu gitabo cya NVIDIA NGC: ibyo uburenganzira bukubiyemo, ibipimo by'icyitegererezo ishusho itanga, n'amakuru ishusho itakurikirana.
sitemap_index.d_legal_privacy: Amakuru three.ws ikusanya, impamvu tuyafite, uwo tuyasangiza, igihe tuyafata, n'ibyo ufite ku byayo.
sitemap_index.d_legal_risk: Icyemezo cy'ingaruka ku bikorwa bifite amafaranga nyakuri: porogaramu y'igerageza, ingaruka z'igihombo cyose, abakozi b'ubwigenge, imifuka y'abakozi itagira ubwishingizi, nta burenganzira.
sitemap_index.d_legal_tos: Amasezerano hagati yawe na three.ws: konti yawe, imikoreshereze yemewe, kwishyura n'ibikorwa ku murongo, uburenganzira, n'ibikorwa byo gukuraho DMCA.
sitemap_index.d_lipsync: Andika inyandiko, uyohereze mu ijwi ry'avatar, kandi umunwa ukanama mu gihe nyacyo hifashishijwe wawa-lipsync viseme detection.
sitemap_index.d_lipsync_mic: Ohereza amajwi ya mic mu isuzuma rya viseme urebe umunwa w'avatar uko ukurikira ijwi ryawe mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_live: Abakozi ba AI babiri mu isi y'ikoranabuhanga bahana amafaranga ku makuru y'isoko ya Solana mu gihe nyacyo. Amakuru y'ukuri ku murongo, blockchain nyakuri, 3D nyakuri.
sitemap_index.d_llms_full_txt: Icyegeranyo cyagutse cya llms.txt gifite ibisobanuro byuzuye n'ibitekerezo by'ibikubiye.
sitemap_index.d_llms_txt: Urutonde rw'abakozi ba AI rwatoranyijwe (llmstxt.org): urubuga rwemewe, konti n'$THREE mint, ahantu hakoreshwa na mashini, n'impapuro z'ingenzi, hamwe na llms-full.txt ku rutonde rwuzuye.
sitemap_index.d_login: Injiza ukoresheje email, GitHub, cyangwa umufuka wihujwe.
sitemap_index.d_lookup: Sukura umukozi uwo ariwe wese wa three.ws binyuze mu Solana mint, ID y'umukozi, ID y'avatar, cyangwa slug: igaragaza avatar yayo ya 3D ikorana n'ubumenyi bwayo ku murongo (ikoranabuhanga, nyirayo, umufuka w'umukozi, Status y'Active/x402, Metaplex/Solscan/Magic Eden links).
sitemap_index.d_marketplace: Gura uburenganzira ku bakozi, ubumenyi, n'avatars by'abandi bahanga.
sitemap_index.d_marketplace_analytics: Statistiques zigezweho ku isoko ry'ubuhanga bwa three.ws: ubuhanga bwiza, abakozi beza, n'ubucuruzi bwose.
sitemap_index.d_markets: Ikigo cy'isoko za three.ws: imibare y'isi yose, amafaranga 100 akomeye, amakuru mashya ya crypto aturuka ku mbuga 192, archive y'inkuru 662k, n'inkuru z'ingenzi ku bikoresho by'isoko byose.
sitemap_index.d_markets_archive: Archive nini y'inkuru za crypto: inkuru 660,000+ kuva mu Ukwakira 2017 kugeza ubu, ivugururwa buri saha ituruka ku mbuga z'inkuru, mu Cyongereza no mu Bushinwa: ishobora gushakishwa hakoreshejwe ijambo, ticker, isoko, ibitekerezo, itariki, n'ururimi.
sitemap_index.d_markets_digest: Amakuru ya crypto y'umunsi agabanyijwe mu nkuru nke z'ingenzi: buri kimwe gifite ishusho y'ibisobanuro, imyumvire y'isoko, tickers ziri mu bikorwa, n'ibinyamakuru byose byabivuzeho. Bivuye ku mbuga 38 z'inkuru zigezweho.
sitemap_index.d_markets_news: Amakuru ya crypto y'igihe nyacyo akusanyirijwe mu buryo bw'imbere ku mbuga 192 z'inkuru mu ndimi 18: shyira mu byiciro (Bitcoin, DeFi, umutekano, amategeko, n'ibindi), hitamo ururimi, shaka umutwe w'inkuru, kandi ufungure inkuru iyo ari yo yose mu musomyi wuzuye ufite ishusho, ibitekerezo by'ingenzi, ibitekerezo, n'ibindi bisobanuro bifitanye isano.
sitemap_index.d_markets_news_article: Umusomyi w'inkuru wuzuye ku makuru ya crypto: gukuramo inkuru yose hamwe n'ibisobanuro by'AI, ibitekerezo by'ingenzi, ibitekerezo, tickers zagaragaye, n'ibindi bisobanuro bifitanye isano mu nganda.
sitemap_index.d_markets_robinhood: Ikibaho cy'ubucuruzi bwa tokenized-equity 24/7 ku Robinhood Chain (4663): Chainlink NAV ihuye na DEX premium kuri buri Stock Token, ikora memecoin ku mbuga NOXA na The Odyssey, ibikorwa bishya, na chain TVL, hamwe n'uburyo bwo kugura buhuza wallet nyayo ku mafaranga yayo.
sitemap_index.d_markets_robinhood_desk: Icyicaro cy'ubucuruzi ku isoko ry'ubucuruzi bwa Robinhood Chain (4663): agaciro k'igitabo, amateka y'ubusugire bw'ibanze yakuwe mu indexer, urutonde rw'ibikorwa byo guhinduranya no kwimura, imyanya igendeye ku Chainlink NAV n'ikigega kinini cya Uniswap, urwego rwa NAV premium ruri hejuru y'uburebure bw'ikigega, imigendekere y'abafatanyabikorwa, n'ibikora memecoin.
sitemap_index.d_markets_robinhood_portfolios: Sobanura poritifori mu nteruro imwe kandi ubone igikapu nyacyo cy'ibikoresho bya Robinhood Chain: imari ya tokenized, crypto nyinshi n'ibimenyetso by'ikoranabuhanga mu index imwe. sitemap_index.d_markets_robinhood_portfolios_universe: Buri gikoresho poritifori ya Robinhood Chain ishobora kugira, igiciro cyayo cy'igihe nyacyo: imari ya tokenized, crypto nyinshi n'ibimenyetso by'ikoranabuhanga bifite ubusugire ku isoko, umubare w'amasaha 24, impinduka y'igiciro n'urwego rwa NAV premium ku isoko rya buri gikoresho ku mbuga ya Chainlink. Ishobora gutondekwa no gufatirwa mu byiciro hakurikijwe ubwoko bw'igikoresho.
sitemap_index.d_markets_trending: Amafaranga, ibyiciro, na NFTs byashakishijwe cyane kuri CoinGecko mu masaha 24 ashize: urutonde rw'ibikurikiranwa, igiciro, impinduka mu masaha 24, isoko, n'ubucuruzi, buri gikoresho n'icyiciro bifite ihuriro ku ipaji y'ibisobanuro. Igaruka mu buryo bwikora.
sitemap_index.d_materialize: Hindura icyitegererezo cya 3D mu kintu cy'ukuri cyacapwe. Isuzuma ry'ubushobozi bwo gucapura mu gihe nyacyo no gukosora byikora, ishusho ya AR ku meza yawe, igiciro cy'ibintu gituruka ku bunini bw'ibikoresho, na USDC kugura kuri Solana.
