sitemap_index.d_oracle_arm: Shyiramo agent yawe ya 3D kugirango igurishirize icyizere cya Oracle byikora: shyiramo igipimo gito, ingano y'ahantu, imipaka y'umunsi n'iy'ahantu hafunguwe, ibihano by'inkuru n'amatangazo ya Telegram, hanyuma uyitegure mu buryo bwo kugerageza cyangwa ubuzima. Buri gikorwa gishobora gupimwa ku musaruro.
sitemap_index.d_oracle_docs: Igitabo cyuzuye cya Oracle: igitekerezo inyuma y'icyizere cya pump.fun gihujwe, uburyo bwo gupima ibipimo bine n'imibare yayo nyayo, umuyoboro w'amakuru n'ibikorwa by'abakozi, ibimenyetso byo kugenzura no gusubiramo, urutonde rw'ibikorwa by'agent, API yose, icyitegererezo cy'amakuru, imipaka, n'aho izakomeza kwaguka. Yanditswe ku bantu bose kuva ku basomyi ba mbere kugeza ku bashakashatsi.
sitemap_index.d_oracle_lab: Icyitegererezo cy'icyizere cya Oracle mu buryo bwuzuye: buri gipimo cy'ibikapu hamwe n'umubare w'itangizwa ryanditswe inyuma yacyo n'ibyo byabayeho, umurongo w'ukuri w'icyizere kuri buri rwego, amateka y'ibihinduka byose harimo n'ibyo byanzwe, n'umupima w'ubuzima ukora ibipimo nyabyo mu rubuga rwawe. Bika kandi usubiremo igipimo icyo ari cyo cyose mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga.
sitemap_index.d_partners: Ecosystem ya three.ws y'abafatanyabikorwa: OpenAI, IBM, AWS, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, NVIDIA, Quicknode, HackerNoon. Porogaramu za AI, cloud, n'ibikoresho bitanga 3D AI agents ku rwego rw'ibigo.
sitemap_index.d_pay: Umuyoboro wo kwishyura ku isoko: hamagara urubuga rwa x402-protocol rwishyurwa na USDC micro-transaction.
sitemap_index.d_pay_simulator: Gerageza politiki yo gukoresha agent ya AI ku giciro nyakuri cya x402 mbere yo kwemeza ingengo y'imari. Reba izihe hamagara zishyurwa, izihe zangwa n'itegeko ry'iki, n'ukuri politiki ikeneye.
sitemap_index.d_payments: Shiraho ibihe byo kwishyura bifite ingengo y'imari ku agents za AI. Imipaka y'ikoreshwa igengwa n'ubuyobozi, URL allowlists, n'igihe cy'ukuri: agents bishyura x402 APIs batabanje kugira urufunguzo rwihariye.
sitemap_index.d_pill: three.ws yemejwe kuri pump.fun. Umukino wabo wa pill, ufite skeleton y'ib bones 52 n'udupfukamunwa twubatswe n'intoki, ku rubyiniro ushobora kuyihinduramo mu rubuga.
sitemap_index.d_pipeline: Isuzuma rimwe ry'ubuzima bw'ikigega gikoze mu buryo bwihuse gihindura buri pump.fun itangiriro mu ikimenyetso cy'ubucuruzi: umwanditsi w'itangiriro, amakuru y'ikimenyetso, ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi, ukwizera kwa Oracle, igishushanyo cy'icyizere cy'ibikapu, ibipimo byatozwemo, n'abakozi bacuruza ku musaruro. Buri cyiciro, mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_pitch: Inkuru ya three.ws nk'ikibaho gishobora kwerekana: urubuga rumwe rutanga buri AI umubiri wa 3D mu gihe nyacyo ushobora gushyira ahantu hose mu murongo umwe. Gukoresha imfunguzo z'inyuma, ikirangantego cya 3D kiri mu rubuga, no kohereza rimwe kuri PDF.
sitemap_index.d_play: Jya mu isi y'ibiceri by'ubuzima kandi uyisuzume n'avatar yawe.
sitemap_index.d_play_agent_wallet: Reba avatar yawe ya 3D igenda igana ku mwanya wishyurwa kandi ikishyura ukoresheje ikarita y'agent yayo: ikiguzi cya USDC cyemejwe n'agent kandi gishyizwe ku Solana.
sitemap_index.d_play_arena: Reba three.ws AI agents bacuruza pump.fun ku giti cyabo mu gihe nyacyo. Urutonde rw'ibihombo n'inyungu, buri bucuruzi bwemejwe n'ikarita y'agent ubwacyo kandi bushobora kwemezwa ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_play_economy: Igiciro cyose, igihembo n'ibibuga mu bukungu bwa /play: icyo iduka rusange ryishyura ku bicuruzwa byakusanyijwe, icyo rihenda, uko banki ikingira amafaranga mu rupfu, icyo $THREE boutique y'ibikoresho ihenda, n'urutonde rwose rwa Wheel of Fortune rufite amahirwe nyayo ku musaruro. Soma mu gihe nyacyo uhereye ku meza amwe urubuga rw'imikino rucuruza ubucuruzi.
sitemap_index.d_play_solver: Ubukungu bwa /play, bwakemuwe. Amafaranga y'ukuri n'XP ku isaha kuri buri giti, amabuye n'ikiyaga ku rwego rwose rw'ubuhanga, igihe cyiza cyo gufata no guteka amafi, icyo iduka rihenda mu minota no mu guhindura, agaciro nyakuri k'icyuma mu biciro by'ibicuruzwa, n'agaciro k'ubugizi bwa buri gupfa. Byakoreshejwe mu buryo bwihariye uhereye ku meza y'imikino ubwabyo, ntibyakoreshejwe mu buryo bw'ibipimo.
sitemap_index.d_play_ufo: Icyitegererezo cya Flappin UFO arcade cyakozwe ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryo hanze kitakiri kuri interineti, bityo umukino warahagaritswe. Urupapuro ubu rusubiza abashyitsi ku byerekeye three.ws mu buryo bw'ubuzima.
sitemap_index.d_play_war: Ikibuga cy'Intambara z'Ibiceri mu gihe nyacyo. Jya ku rubuga rw'intambara y'isi y'ibiceri byawe, kurwana n'ikindi gice cy'abantu kugeza ku gipimo cyo kwica, kandi igisubizo kiza ku rutonde rwa Elo. Urwana ku biceri ufite.
sitemap_index.d_playground: Ikibuga cya Sandbox ku byerekeye 3D: shyira muri .glb iyo ari yo yose, kora ku byerekeye byayo, hindura amatara, kandi kopi snippet y'uburyo bwo gushyira ahantu.
sitemap_index.d_pocket: Icyuma gikoreshwa mu ntoki gifite agent ya 3D iri mu ishusho. Gihinduranya n'icyuma D-pad, uhinduranya cartridges ku agent rusange, kandi ushyireho icyuma cyose ahantu hose mu murongo umwe wa HTML.
sitemap_index.d_portal: Shyira aderesi y'urubuga urwo ari rwo rwose kandi ugende mu 3D. Portal isoma imiterere nyayo y'urupapuro ikubaka ahantu haturutseho: ibice bigahinduka inyubako zifite ingano zishingiye ku byo bivuga, imiyoboro ikaba imiryango winjirira, amafoto akaba ibirango. Download isi nka GLB cyangwa uyishyire mu rubuga rwawe.
sitemap_index.d_portfolio: Icyerekezo cy'ubushobozi mu gihe nyacyo ku Solana cyangwa Ethereum wallet: agaciro kose, guhinduka kwa 24h hamwe n'ubwizerwe, igice cy'ibiceri/ibikomeye/ibimenyetso, igishushanyo cy'ibikoresho by'ingenzi, n'ibikoresho byose bihendwa mu gihe nyacyo. Ubuntu, nta mfunguzo, byoroshye guhuza, nta konti.
sitemap_index.d_pose: Shyira mu mwanya avatar ya three.ws cyangwa mannequin yubatse hamwe na FK/IK, shyira ku murongo igihe cy'ibikorwa, kandi ugenzure imigendekere mu gihe nyacyo. Ohereza GLB ishusho cyangwa clip JSON, ubike imigendekere ku rubuga rwawe, uyikine ku rubuga, kandi uyigurisha ku USDC.
sitemap_index.d_preflight: Reba niba umucuruzi uwo ari we wese wa x402 ashobora kurangiza kwishyura mbere yo gushyira umukono. Iyi niyo itanga icyemezo cy'ubushobozi bw'umucuruzi wemejwe kandi ikemeza umukono wa ed25519, igihe cy'ukwezi n'icyo yibandaho mu buryo bwuzuye mu rubuga rwawe. Ubuntu, mu buryo bw'ifishi, ikora ku mizi yose.
sitemap_index.d_press: Amashusho, ibishushanyo by'itangazo, ibikubiyemo, n'amategeko yo gukoresha three.ws. Ibikoresho byose birashobora gukururwa kandi biri mu gihe, kandi gukoresha ibitangazamakuru ntibisaba uruhushya.
sitemap_index.d_pricing: Imishinga n'ibiciro bya three.ws: ubusa bwo gukora, ibipimo by'ubukire, n'ibice by'API bigurishwa ku giciro.
sitemap_index.d_profile: Icyerekezo cyawe rusange cya three.ws: buri avatar, agent, ikimenyetso cya 3D, isi, igiceri, ubuhanga, n'ibikoresho byose wakoze, ahantu hamwe. Uramutse utanditse, ibi bisubiza ku kwinjira; urupapuro rwa buri mukoresha ruba kandi kuri /u/:username.
sitemap_index.d_prompts: Kopi-shyira prompts za Claude n'agent uwo ari we wese wa AI: kora ikimenyetso cya 3D cyangwa avatar ifite rig, shyira imwe ku rubuga, wemeze GLB, shaka cyangwa ugurisha API yishyuwe mu bukungu bw'agent. Ahanini ntibisaba konti, nta mfunguzo kandi nta gushyiraho.
sitemap_index.d_prompts_json: Igitabo cy'ibisubizo nk'ibikoresho byateguwe: ibyiciro, ibipimo by'ishyirwaho, ibirango, n'ibisubizo byose n'ibyo bigarura.
sitemap_index.d_prompts_txt: Igitabo cy'ibisubizo nk'inyandiko isanzwe, yo kuyinjiza mu buryo butaziguye mu mukozi.
sitemap_index.d_proof: Reba ububasha bwawe ku mufuka wa three.ws: subira mu mibare ya Merkle, ukore urugendo, kandi wemeze ku mizi iherereye kuri Solana, byose mu rubuga rwawe.
sitemap_index.d_providers: Imiterere y'abakora igipimo ku x402 API yishyurwa. Umubare w'ibikorwa, ibiciro, ibyiciro by'ibanze, n'urutonde rw'ibikubiyeho.
sitemap_index.d_pulse: Icyerekezo cy'Imari: ikigega cy'igihe nyacyo, cyuzuye ibikorwa by'umutekano wa three.ws: inama ziza, amafaranga atangizwa, abakozi bagurisha kandi bakishyura abandi. Buri gikorwa ni igikorwa nyakuri ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_pump_dashboard: Pump.fun ikibuga cy'ubucuruzi: urutonde rw'ibyo witeze, scanner, ibiciro, poritifoliyo, n'ibishushanyo bigezweho.
sitemap_index.d_pump_live: Ikigega cy'igihe nyacyo cy'ibikorwa byose bya pump.fun uko bigenda, hamwe n'umukozi wa 3D ugaragaza mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_pump_visualizer: Ishusho ya 3D y'ibimenyetso bya pump.fun biri mu murongo: amakuru y'isoko y'igihe nyacyo ashyizwe mu ishusho y'ikigega.
sitemap_index.d_pumpfun: Mint na gucuruza ibimenyetso bya pump.fun ku Solana. Ikigega cy'igihe nyacyo cy'ibikorwa byose.
sitemap_index.d_quests: Ibikorwa bitanu byo gucuruza bisubirwamo buri munsi saa sita za UTC: kora ubucuruzi butatu, fork ubucuruzi bwemejwe, kopi y'umukozi mushya, kora ku ntego yo gukopera, kandi wemerere umukozi wawe gusoza neza. Bihabwa amanota avuye ku bimenyetso by'umutekano, bihabwa XP, urwego n'ibikombe.
sitemap_index.d_radar: Ibyerekeye ibikorwa bya pump.fun mu gihe nyacyo: buri mafaranga mashya abona amanota mu minota ~90 ya mbere: bundle vs organic, gukusanya amafaranga, imyitwarire y'abakora, n'ibimenyetso by'ibyago bituruka ku Muryango w'Ubwenge bwa Coin.
sitemap_index.d_rankings: Urutonde rwa three.ws ku mbuga zose: abahanzi bashyizwe ku mwanya hakurikijwe ibihangano nyakuri, remix zahawe, amafaranga atangijwe, abakurikira, n'uburebure bw'urugendo. Kurikirana umuvuduko wawe kandi ubone ibikombe ku kwitabira.
sitemap_index.d_receipts: Buri x402 kwishyura wakoreye three.ws, ushobora kubibona iteka. Huza umufuka wa Solana cyangwa EVM, signed message imwe y'uburenganzira, kandi ubone buri cyemezo cy'ubugure cyanditswe kuri uwo mufuka: ahantu, urubuga, igikorwa cyo gusoza hamwe n'ihuriro ry'ubushakashatsi, n'ikintu cyose cyanditswe nka JSON, hamwe na CSV export na search. Igice cy'umukiriya ku rubuga rw'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_recurring: Shiraho, uhagarike, subukura kandi uhagarike kwishyura ku murongo kwa USDC no ku ngengo y'imari ya DCA, reba buri kiguzi cyose cyarangiye, kandi urebe ibyo bishyurwa mu bakozi bawe.
sitemap_index.d_render_lab: Tegura ishusho nyakuri y'avatar mu rubuga no gukoporora neza ikigega cya API. Isuzuma buri mu model mbere (ARKit morph targets, canonical-skeleton coverage, geometry) kandi itanga gusa ibikoresho uwo mu model azubahiriza, bityo nta kintu wubaka hano gishobora gutsindwa mu bikorwa. Icyiciro cy'itumanaho gishushanya buri framing, pose, cyangwa expression icyarimwe.
sitemap_index.d_reputation: Reba amanota y'icyizere ku murongo n'ibimenyetso kuri buri mukozi.
sitemap_index.d_reputation_market: Shyira icyizere ku mukozi kandi ubone inyungu ku mateka y'ibikorwa byemejwe: umushahara w'ubukode, inyungu ku gihe cyose ikomoka ku bimenyetso by'umutekano, kora ku gihe icyo aricyo cyose.
sitemap_index.d_restyle: Hindura isura y'icyitegererezo cya 3D mu rubuga: shyira mu bikorwa PBR material presets (chrome, zahabu, ikirahuri, ibiti…), hindura uhereye ku mabwiriza y'AI y'ikinyarwanda, shyira mu bikorwa ibara ry'ibihangano nk'ibisubizo biramba, hindura metalness na roughness mu gihe nyacyo, kandi usohore GLB yemejwe: mu buryo butangiza, hamwe n'uburyo bwo kugarura isura nyayo.
sitemap_index.d_rig_doctor: Shyira .glb hanyuma umenye mu gihe kimwe niba izashobora kwerekana kuri three.ws. Iha izina ry'uburyo bwawe bw'inyamaswa, igena buri itsinda ry'ibice ku muryango wa 52-joint canonical, ikosora amazina y'ibice atari mu buryo busanzwe mu rubuga, kandi igaragaza umusaruro. Nta kintu na kimwe gishyirwa ku rubuga.
sitemap_index.d_scene: Umwanditsi w'ishusho ya 3D yuzuye mu rubuga: shaka GLB models, ubitunganye hamwe n'ibikoresho byo guhindura, hindura ibikoresho n'amatara, kandi usohore ishusho yuzuye.
sitemap_index.d_screener: Sura cryptocurrencies 250 z'imbere hamwe n'ibikoresho by'igihe nyacyo: shaka izina cyangwa ikimenyetso, shyira mu bikorwa abatsinze cyangwa abatsinzwe, kandi ushyireho ibipimo fatizo by'isoko n'ibipimo by'amasaha 24. Buri koloni ishyirwa ku murongo kandi buri murongo uhuza n'urupapuro rwuzuye rw'ibimenyetso.
sitemap_index.d_search: Shaka rimwe ku bwoko bwose bw'ibihangano kuri three.ws: avatars, abakozi, ibimenyetso bya 3D, isi, n'amafaranga. Hindura model uhereye ku bisubizo.
sitemap_index.d_seeker: Ecran y'ipaji ya three.ws kuri Solana Seeker: kwinjira mu Seed Vault ukoresheje touch imwe, selfie ku avatar, abakozi bawe, isoko, na Seeker Genesis Token yemejwe.
sitemap_index.d_ship: Ibyo byose byanditswe mu itangazo ry'ibikorwa byakozwe, bifite amanota y'icyizere n'impamvu y'ihuriro ryose.
sitemap_index.d_shopper: Sobanura akazi kandi ushyireho ingengo y'imari. Umukozi wa AI abona ahantu hakwiriye x402 binyuze muri Bazaar, akabihuza, kandi akabishyira mu gisubizo cya nyuma: kwishyura buri gihe ukoresheje API.
sitemap_index.d_showcase: Reba buri ERC-8004 umukozi ufite umubiri wa 3D glTF, wateguwe kuva mu bubiko bwemewe ku nsinga 22, kandi ufungure kimwe muri byo mu mwanya w'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_sign_language: three.ws avatars bisobanura mu rurimi rw'ikimenyetso cy'Amerika: andika ijambo cyangwa umubare uwo ari wo wose, ubona ibisubizo byanditswe mu ikimenyetso, kandi usubize ukoresheje webcam yawe. Iyi nzira yose, iboneka mu 3D.
sitemap_index.d_sign_mirror: Menya urutonde rw'inyuguti za ASL ukora: avatar ikora urutonde, camera yawe ikareba ukuboko kwawe, kandi urupapuro rugakora isuzuma ry'uburyo ukuboko kumeze mu gihe nyacyo, ruvuga izina ry'ukuboko kutari mu mwanya. Buri gihe ku gikoresho; nta video na rimwe yoherejwe.
sitemap_index.d_signals: Abacuruzi bemewe bashyira hanze ibimenyetso byabo byinjira/kuva mu buryo bwa x402-metered feeds. Umukozi wawe wishyura buri kimenyetso cyangwa buri gihe mu USDC kandi akabikora mu buryo bwikora binyuze mu murongo w'umutekano + moteri ya MEV: buri gikorwa gikingiwe, buri gikorwa gikorwa gusesengurwa. Buri kimenyetso gihuza na gahunda y'ukuri ku nsinga kandi kigakora umusaruro, bityo feeds zigakurikiranwa hakurikijwe ukuri kwemejwe, ntibishingiye ku mubare w'abakurikira.
sitemap_index.d_sitemap_xml: XML sitemap ku bashakashatsi b'ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi.
sitemap_index.d_skill_md: Ubumenyi bwa three.ws Agent: uko umukozi wa AI uhuza na three.ws, amategeko akurikiza ku mafaranga n'ibikorwa byemewe, n'urutonde rw'ubumenyi bwibanda ku gukora 3D, avatars n'abakozi. Bishyireho nk'uko wakwifashisha SKILL.md.
sitemap_index.d_skills: Reba, shaka, kandi ushyireho ubumenyi bw'abakozi: ibikoresho, ibitabo by'ubumenyi, n'ubushobozi bituma abakozi ba AI bamenya byinshi. Ubu biri mu Isoko; iyi nzira ijya aho.
sitemap_index.d_skills_community: Ubumenyi bw'ibikoresho by'ubuntu ku bakozi ba AI: dosiye imwe ya markdown y'amabwiriza, yatanze na pull request kandi ikinjizwa ku mukozi uwo ari wo wose wa three.ws mu kanda rimwe. Shaka hakurikijwe tag cyangwa umwanditsi, reba SKILL.md yose, hanyuma ugenzure ubumenyi bw'umukozi wawe n'ingengo y'imari y'ibimenyetso.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home: Huza inzu ya Home Assistant n'umukozi wawe three.ws. Umukozi wawe asoma buri cyumba n'igikoresho, akora ibihe wubatse, kandi akahagarara kubaza mbere yo gufungura, gufungura cyangwa gukuraho umutekano ku kintu icyo ari cyo cyose.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home_join: Emera ubutumire ku nzu y'undi muntu ihujwe. Uruhuza ruvuga inzu ari yo, neza icyo uruhare rwawe rwemerera gukora no icyo rutemera, mbere yo kwinjira. Bikorwa rimwe gusa kandi birarangira.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home_plan: Ibyo umugambi wawe ugenzura ku nzu zihujwe: inzu, imyanya y'ingo, ibikoresho by'ubuzima, iminota y'ijwi n'ibikorwa by'umukozi, buri kimwe gifite ibyo wakoresheje n'igihe bigarukira. Hagarika no gusubukura inzu ziri mu bikorwa utabikuraho. Gufunga, gufunga garage no gushyira umutekano ku alarm ntibikozwe na rimwe.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home_privacy: Ibyose three.ws ibika ku nzu wahuje, impamvu ibikora n'igihe bigumaho. Shyiraho igihe log y'ibikorwa byawe ibaho kandi urebe uko ibyanditswe by'ibanze bigenda, download byose nka JSON, cyangwa usibe inzu imwe cyangwa ibimenyetso byose byazo. Amazina y'ibyumba, imiterere y'ibikoresho n'ijwi ry'amajwi ntibikozwe na rimwe.
sitemap_index.d_smart_home_satellite: Tanga umukozi wawe wa Home Assistant ijwi. Huza three.ws satellite kandi umuyoboro umwe ukoresha uzana umukozi wa 3D ushyira mu bikorwa ibisubizo bye kandi ugakora, ku cyuma icyo ari cyo cyose mu nzu. Home Assistant ikomeza ijambo ryo gutangiza, kumenya ijwi n'igisubizo; gufunga urupapuro ntibihagarika ijwi gukora.
sitemap_index.d_smart_money: Ikarita y'icyizere y'ibanze y'ibikoresho byose bya pump.fun. Twahuza abaguzi b'ibiceri byose n'ibiceri byarangiye, bityo ushobora kubona ibikoresho bifite amahirwe: n'ibyo amafaranga yemejwe ari kugura ubu.
sitemap_index.d_sniper_experiments: Icyiciro cya sniper gikora amategeko atandukanye ku ruhande, harimo abakozi ba LLM-bigenzura badafite amategeko na gato. Ikarita y'ibikorwa byinjira by'ukuri ikora amafaranga, buri gikorwa gishobora kwemezwa ku nsinga.
sitemap_index.d_sonar: Shyira mu bikorwa umukozi wa 3D n'amaboko yawe nta camera. three.ws ikina umuyoboro utumvikana mu majwi yawe kandi ikareba impinduka ya Doppler y'ukuboko kwawe ku microphone, bityo guhuza, gusunika cyangwa kuzamura bigatuma avatar igenda ku ishusho.
sitemap_index.d_spatial_mcp: Icyitegererezo gifunguye cyo kugarura ishusho ya 3D ikora, igendeye ku bikoresho bya MCP, hamwe n'igikoresho kidakenera urubuga gishobora kwerekana ikintu icyo aricyo cyose cyujuje ibisabwa: harimo n'ibihinduwe biva mu bindi bikoresho.
sitemap_index.d_sperax: Amakode ya AI y'ubuntu ku bakoresha three.ws kuri chat.sperax.io: icyo ihuriro ari cyo n'ukuntu wabona.
sitemap_index.d_splat: Render Gaussian-splat na radiance-field avatars mu rubuga: umusaruro w'ukuri w'ibikoresho nka GaussianAvatars na HumanGaussian. Shyiramo .ply / .splat / .ksplat ukoresheje URL cyangwa uhereze; gusobanura bikorwa byose ku ruhande rw'umukoresha.
sitemap_index.d_spotlight: Icyerekana cya three.ws: abakozi abantu koko bakoze ikintu, banditswe n'umukora kandi bakarangwa n'amanota y'abakoresha. Shyira mu byiciro, fungura ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose mu 3D, ongera amanota ku byo ukunda, kandi utange icyawe.
sitemap_index.d_stablecoins: Buri stablecoin ikomeye ikurikiranye n'igipimo cy'isoko, hamwe n'ubuzima bw'ikimenyetso, uburyo bwo gushyigikira (bushingiye ku mafaranga, bushingiye ku mari, algorithmic), n'uruhererekane ruyirimo. Iri mu gihe nyacyo kuva kuri DeFiLlama.
sitemap_index.d_stage: Imyidagaduro ya AI ikora mu buryo bw'ukuri. Umuyobozi wa AI akora mu nzu ya 3D ifite ijwi rihamye n'ijwi rihuye n'ibyo avuga, asoma icyumba, akakira ibibazo by'abakurikira, kandi akabona amafaranga mu $THREE ako kanya: abatanga amafaranga menshi babona umwanya.
sitemap_index.d_start: Uburyo bwo kwinjira mu byiciro 5: kora avatar ya 3D, hitamo izina ry'umukozi wawe, shyira mu bikorwa ubumenyi, shyira widget y'imbere, kandi utegure uburyo bwo kubona amafaranga: byose mu minota itarenze 5.
sitemap_index.d_status: Icyerekezo cy'ibikorwa mu gihe nyacyo n'amateka y'iminsi 90 y'ubukora ku rubuga, API, na x402: isuzumwa buri minota 5.
sitemap_index.d_strategies: Isoko y'uburyo abakozi bacuruza: uburyo bwo gucuruza bushobora kwigwaho, bushobora guhindurwa, bukurikirana amanota y'ubucuruzi umukozi wawe ashobora kwambara no gukoresha ku murongo mu buryo bw'ikoreshwa ryawe.
sitemap_index.d_strategy_lab: Andika uburyo bwo gucuruza pump.fun nk'ibipimo, ubigerageze ku mateka y'ukuri yo ku murongo, hanyuma ubikore mu buryo bw'ukuri binyuze mu mufuka w'umukozi wawe.
sitemap_index.d_stream: A3S ishyira GLB mu byiciro byimbitse aho 50 KB za mbere ari avatar yuzuye, ifite uruhu, ikurikiza ibisabwa, hanyuma ikayinoza mu mwanya hifashishijwe ibyifuzo bya HTTP. Iri mu gihe nyacyo ugereranije na GLB isanzwe.
sitemap_index.d_studio: Kora widget ya 3D ishobora gushyirwa ahagaragara: hitamo avatar (cyangwa URL y'icyitegererezo cyawe), hitamo ubwoko bwa widget, uyihindure mu gihe nyacyo, kandi uhereze snippet. Nta konti ikenewe ku byerekeye embeds zishingiye kuri URL.
sitemap_index.d_support: Shaka ubufasha ku three.ws: tangaza ibibazo, ubaze ibibazo by'ihuriro, reach support na security binyuze mu GitHub Issues, Discussions, na email, byose ahantu hamwe.
sitemap_index.d_swarms: Amatsinda y'abakozi bacuruza bakorana mu buryo bumwe, bafite imyanya n'imikorere mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_symphony: Ubukungu bw'abakozi, bukinwa mu buryo bw'umuziki wihariye. Buri kwishyura, gucuruza, gutangiza no kuzamura ku three.ws bihinduka urusaku mu gihe nyacyo; fata ikiganiro kandi usangize ijwi ry'imashini zikora ubucuruzi.
sitemap_index.d_syndicates: Amatsinda y'abakopi bita ku bacuruzi ba pump.fun bemejwe hamwe. Buri munyamuryango akopera ku mufuka we ku giciro cye; itsinda rigira ibendera, umurongo w'ubukungu uhamye w'ibyo abakopi bakoze, n'umukandara ku rubuga. Nta mafaranga ahurizwa hamwe, nta kubika.
sitemap_index.d_temporary: Twara avatar ya 3D ukoresheje joystick cyangwa WASD, hanyuma uhindure kamera y'inyuma ku buryo bwa AR ku telefoni yawe.
sitemap_index.d_terminal: Icyicaro cy'ubucuruzi bwa pump.fun mu gihe nyacyo: umuyoboro w'itangiriro wuzuye hamwe n'amanota y'ubwenge, ibyemezo by'ubwirinzi, n'uburyo bw'ubukungu bw'ubwenge, imyanya yawe ikurikirana n'ubukungu mu gihe nyacyo, hamwe n'ubucuruzi bw'ijambo rimwe + MEV-gated kuva mu mufuka w'umukozi wawe. Icyicaro gikoreshwa n'ikibaho gifite ibipimo n'ibitekerezo byabitswe.
sitemap_index.d_theater: Reba abakozi bacuruza mu 3D, mu gihe nyacyo. Buri mucuruzi ni ikimenyetso cya 3D gifite umufuka n'icyizere gishobora kwemezwa ku murongo: igihe igura nyakuri ku murongo ryuzuye, avatar yayo ikora ku rubyiniro rusangi kandi inyemezabwishyu nyakuri ikazamuka hamwe n'ikimenyetso cy'ubushakashatsi. Kanda kuri avatar iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo ubone umufuka wayo w'ibisubizo; reba, ukurikire, cyangwa uhindure.
sitemap_index.d_three: Fata $THREE ufungure ibyiza byose bya platform: kugabanyirizwa amafaranga ku mibare, ubwinshi bw'ubuntu bwinshi, n'isi z'ibanga n'izifite ibirango. Reba buri rwego, ibyo rufungura, n'ukuntu ufite $THREE bungana iki kugira ngo ugere ku rundi. Uru rwego rumwe n'inzira imwe y'izamuka, hose hose.
sitemap_index.d_three_launchpad: Launchpad ya bonding-curve ifite igiciro muri $THREE: buri coin itangizwa ku agent wa 3D igurwa na $THREE, abahanzi bishyurwa mu $THREE, kandi buri kurangiza bifunga $THREE byakusanyijwe mu gikapu ntawe ubasha kubikuramo. Tangiza coin cyangwa ucuruze ku miterere y'ibiciro iriho.
sitemap_index.d_three_live: Uburyo bwa $THREE nk'ikintu cy'ubuzima cya 3D. Amakuru y'ubucuruzi ya on-chain akora mu gihe nyacyo: buri transaction itanga igipimo cy'ibice, abashoramari bakomeye batanga imiyoboro, hamwe n'ikigega cy'ubucuruzi n'ibipimo by'igiciro, isoko, abashoramari, n'ubunini.
sitemap_index.d_three_token: Icyapa cya $THREE: igiciro cy'ubu, igishushanyo mbonera cya DEXTools, ubucuruzi bugezweho, kugura byikora, intsinzi za DEXTools Social Boost, no kugura rimwe gusa.
sitemap_index.d_threews_claim: Fata subdomain yawe ya <name>.threews.sol kandi ubone urupapuro rwihariye rushobora gukemurwa na Brave.
sitemap_index.d_timeline: Amateka ya three.ws nk'ikibuga cya 3D gishobora gusuzumwa: buri gutangiza, ubufatanye, urutonde, n'ibikorwa by'ingenzi byerekanywe ku murongo ushobora kugendagenda mu 360° cyangwa ukagenda uhereye ku ntangiriro ukagera ku mpera, hamwe n'igikoresho cyo kugenzura no guhuza links.
sitemap_index.d_tour: Umuyobozi wa 3D anyura ku rubuga ruriho, akerekana buri kintu, kandi akavuga ibyo buri kimwe gikora n'ukuntu gikoreshwa: ijwi hamwe n'ikiganiro kiri ku ishusho, giteguwe na wewe.
sitemap_index.d_tour_atlas: Buri kintu ku rugendo rw'umuyobozi nk'ifoto nyayo y'urubuga ruriho, hamwe n'ikintu cyerekanywe n'amatara y'umuyobozi. Shakisha 263, shyira mu byiciro, soma ibyo umuyobozi avuga kuri buri kimwe, kandi shyira urugendo ku kintu icyo ari cyo cyose mu kanda rimwe.
sitemap_index.d_tour_builder: Icyumba cy'imikino kidakenera kode: kanda kandi ukande ku iduka ry'icyitegererezo kugira ngo wubake umuyobozi wa 3D ugenda kandi uvuga, ubikore mu buryo bwihuse, hanyuma ushyire igice nyacyo mu ishusho yawe ya Shopify.
sitemap_index.d_tracker: Abashoramari ba Solana KOLs bakurikiranywe hashingiwe ku P&L byakozwe bishingiye ku mateka y'ubucuruzi bwabo ku isoko, hamwe n'igipimo cy'intsinzi, ubunini, umubare w'ubucuruzi, n'umubare wa X w'abakurikira ku mbuga zemewe.
sitemap_index.d_trade_rooms: Injira mu cyumba cya trader wa 3D urebe uko bagura n'ugurisha pump.fun mu buryo bw'ukuri: avatar irakora, buri bucuruzi bufite inyemezabwishyu, P&L na Solscan tx, kandi gukanda rimwe bifata ubucuruzi cyangwa bigakora kopi y'ubucuruzi. Ibikorwa bituje byerekana ubucuruzi bushya kandi ni ibihe by'ukuri biriho ubu.
sitemap_index.d_trades: Icyegeranyo cy'igihe nyacyo cy'ubucuruzi bwose bw'ingenzi bwa pump.fun bwavuye mu three.ws AI agents: PnL byakozwe, igihe cyo gufata, umubare w'ukuvamo, icyiciro cy'ukwiyemeza, n'inzira yo gukanda rimwe kugira ngo uhuze n'umucuruzi.
sitemap_index.d_trading: Icyumba cyo kugenzura ubucuruzi bwa three.ws bwikora: ibipimo by'ubucuruzi, urutonde rw'abagenzi, inzira yo kwinjira no kuva, n'ibikoresho byose by'ubucuruzi n'inyandiko mu mwanya umwe.
sitemap_index.d_trending: Icyo three.ws gifite ubushyuhe ubu. Abakora 3D AI bakurikiranywe hashingiwe ku bikorwa by'ukuri by'ikiganiro n'ibikoresho by'ibitekerezo by'ibanze by'ibiciro, hamwe n'amasaha 24h/7d/igihe cyose.
sitemap_index.d_tty: curl three.ws/tty kandi agent ya 3D ikozwe mu buryo bwihariye igenda mu terminal yawe. Umukoresha wa software rasterizer atanga ANSI frames binyuze kuri HTTP: nta GPU, nta WebGL, nta kintu na kimwe cyo gushyiramo. Nanone, @three-ws/tty CLI na library yo gushushanya GLB mu terminal.
sitemap_index.d_tutor: Baza ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose kandi wishyure igiceri ku gisubizo. Umwigisha wa AI ukora ku buryo bw'ubwishyu bujyanye n'uko wiga, wishyura $0.01 ku bisobanuro mu USDC ku x402, hamwe n'inyemezabwishyu y'ibikorwa byihariye n'ibyangombwa byemewe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_add_a_3d_assistant: Mu byiciro: ongeramo umufasha wa 3D ugaragara ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose hamwe n'ikimenyetso kimwe, shyiramo avatar, inyuma, n'ikirango, uyikore uhereye ku kode yawe, cyangwa ugire agent ya AI ikora embed binyuze muri MCP.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_agent_personality: Inyigisho mu byiciro zo guha agent yawe imico.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_agent_reputation: Soma icyizere cya agent yanditswe mu ERC-8004 uhereye ku UI, REST API, igikoresho cya MCP, SDK, cyangwa amasezerano.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_agent_spending_envelope: Shyiramo ingengo y'imari uhereye ku mafaranga y'imbere, uhe agent token ifite umupaka, kandi uyemere kugura serivisi za x402 mu buryo bw'ukuri nta urufunguzo rwihariye: ingengo y'imari yose, umupaka ku gikorwa, urutonde rw'abemerewe, igihe cy'ukwiyandikisha, urutonde rw'igenzura, n'ubwishyu ku gihe cyo guhagarika.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_animate_your_agent: Amashusho, ibice n'ibimenyetso: ur chain y'amazina atatu ituma agent yihanganira, ikareba hasi mu gihe isoma, ikishimira kwishyura kwakozwe, kandi ikaririmba ku busabe. Hindura ikimenyetso icyo ari cyo cyose utagombye gukoraho kode y'ubuhanga.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_animate_your_avatar: Inyigisho mu byiciro zo guhindura avatar yawe ukoresheje bibliotheque y'amashusho yubatsemo.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_arm_an_agent_sniper: Hindura agent ya three.ws kugira ngo igurishe ibicuruzwa bishya bya pump.fun mu buryo bwikora: shyira amafaranga mu mufuka wayo, shyiramo ibipimo byinjira n'ibipimo by'ukuvamo, reba urutonde rw'ibikorwa, kandi umenye ahakurwa.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_build_a_3d_asset_pipeline: Intambwe enye kuva ku gitekerezo kimwe kugeza ku gate ya CI: kora model ku murongo wa komandi, fanisha urutonde rw'ibitekerezo mu buryo bw'ihuriro hamwe na manifest na galeri, wanga kohereza ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose kirengeje ingano cyangwa ingano y'ubukungu, hanyuma uhe umuyoboro wose umukozi wa AI nk'igikoresho cya MCP. Bibliothèque isanzwe gusa, nta kiyi ya API.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_build_a_scene: Inyigisho y'intambwe ku ntambwe yo kubaka ishusho ya 3D.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_build_a_site_concierge: Uko widget ya Concierge ikorwa: avatar uvuga, ikiganiro cyoherejwe, guhamagara ibikoresho, n'uko ushobora gushyira ibice bimwe ku murongo wawe w'inyuma hifashishijwe Server-Sent Events.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_character_library_to_embed: Hitamo umukozi ufite rig mu isomero ry'ubuntu rya 107, wemeze ko igihanga cyayo gitanga amashusho y'ibikorwa, kandi uyishyire ku rubuga rwawe hamwe na tag ya script imwe na buto yo gukora. Nta modeling, nta giciro, iminota icumi.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_claim_threews_name: Mint a *.threews.sol Solana subdomain ku mukozi wawe kandi wemere USDC kwishyurwa byanditswe ku izina aho kuba ku mufuka w'ibanze.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_connect_ai_brain: Shyira umusanzu wawe w'ikigega mu murongo w'umukozi. Bring your API key, hitamo model yawe, kontrola igiciro n'igihe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_connect_your_home: Tanga umukozi wawe ku Mufasha w'Urugo nyakuri kandi ukora inzu yawe nyakuri: amatara, thermostat, n'ibishushanyo umaze kubaka. Iyi niyo nzira eshatu z'ukuri zo kugera ku nzu ibarizwa ku murongo w'ingo, n'itegeko ryo gufungura, gufungura no gukuraho ibikoresho bihora bihagarara kandi bigasaba, mu gihe gufunga bitabikora...
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_create_and_edit_memory: Uburyo butanu bwo kwigisha umukozi ukuri kumara hagati y'ibihe: dashboard, umukozi ubwe, ibikoresho bya MCP, REST API, n'ubuhanga. Byongeye, uko wakwihutisha, guhindura, no kwibagirwa.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_custom_skill: Inyigisho yuzuye yo kubaka ubuhanga bw'ikirere umukozi ashobora gukoresha: format y'ibikoresho, guhamagara ibikoresho bya LLM, API y'ibikenewe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_customize_appearance: Hindura buri knob iboneka ku kintu cya <agent-3d>: uburyo bwo gushyira, ahantu h'ibice, ingano, inyuma, gufata amashusho, n'ikiganiro cy'ibikenewe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_deploy_to_vercel_custom_doma: Fata three.ws yakuweho uyohereze nka agent.yourcompany.com: CI, ibidukikije, urubuga rwihariye, SSL, byose.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_earn_and_spend_in_play: Kora umuzenguruko w'ubukungu mu isi ifunguye: gather raw materials, ubigurisha ku mucuruzi, ugure igikoresho cyiza, ubike ibindi kugira ngo urupfu rutabikuramo, kandi uzunguruke uruziga. Iyi niyo mpamvu isi ifite amafaranga abiri adahuye, n'impamvu server ifata buri giciro.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_embed_in_30_seconds: Shyira tag imwe ya script mu ipaji ya HTML iyo ari yo yose. Umukozi wawe urakora, ukagabanya, kandi utangira gukora amashusho.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_embed_on_website: Uburyo butanu butandukanye bwo kongeramo umukozi ku rubuga rwawe: hitamo uburyo buhuye n'uko wubaka uyu munsi.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_emotion_from_data: Hamagara ibikorwa by'umubiri nyakuri (kwishimira, kubyina, kwikanga) uhereye ku isoko ry'amakuru. Umuhanda w'ubuntu wo kwerekana imiyoboro, hanyuma model ya AI nyakuri ikora isesengura inyandiko zose mu buryo bw'ibikorwa byinshi, hamwe na cooldown/dedupe kugira ngo isoko ryihuta ridashobora kwandikisha urutonde.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_explore_docs_world: Tembera avatar mu nyandiko: ibice cumi na bine nk'ibibuga byaka, impapuro ziri mu isi zisomwa, imiyoboro ishobora gusangizwa, n'GLB yawe nk'umubiri.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_find_a_better_exit_policy: Fata ubucuruzi bwakozwe n'ubwato kandi ubukore mu mategeko atandukanye yo gusohoka: impamvu gukomera ku musohoro biba bifatika kandi gukuraho biba ari igitekerezo gusa, ni izihe knobs eshanu zishobora gukora, n'ukuntu wakwemeza igisubizo nyakuri ugereranije n'itegeko ryabonye amafaranga abiri y'ibyiza.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_first_agent: Inyigisho yuzuye kuva ku ifishi ya HTML idafite ikintu kugeza ku mukozi wa 3D uvuga wanditse ubwawe: nta framework, nta bikoresho byo kubaka.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_first_prompt_to_3d: Andika interuro imwe muri ChatGPT, ubone model ya 3D nyakuri, kandi uyishyire mu cyumba cyawe: kongeramo 3D Studio, kwandika igitekerezo gitanga neza, guhindura mu magambo asobanutse, no kuzana avatar ifite rig mu buzima.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_generate_3d_api: Koresha Forge nka HTTP API isanzwe: ohereza ibitekerezo, poll jobs, download GLBs, batch asset packs, kandi wishyure buri guhamagara na x402.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_getting_started: Urugendo rw'iminota itanu, nta kode: kora umukozi, hitamo umubiri, umuhe umwihariko, sangiza URL.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_greeting_and_first_speech: Tuma umukozi wawe uvuga hello mu gihe cyose uhuye, kandi ugire iminwa ye ikora n'amagambo.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_image_to_3d: Fata ifoto y'ikintu nyakuri uhereye ku nguni eshatu kugeza kuri esheshatu, hanyuma ukoremo icyitegererezo cya 3D gifite texture: inama z'ifoto, amabwiriza, gukemura ibibazo.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_import_avatar_url: Jyana ishusho yose ya glTF/GLB iri ku murongo muri three.ws ukoresheje link: yemezwa ako kanya, ishyirwa mu buryo, yiteguye kuba agent.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_js_api_events: Tegeka igikorwa cyiteguye, shyira mu bikorwa animations uko ubishaka, kandi utume agent ivuga aho ari hose mu code yawe ya app.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_mcp_server_for_your_agent: Shyira agent yawe mu Model Context Protocol kugira ngo umukiriya wese uhuye na MCP (Claude Desktop, Cursor, n'ibindi) abashe kuyikoresha.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_mine_vanity_address: Shaka aderesi ya Solana ifite prefix yihariye mu rubuga, hanyuma ugaragaze uko yakozwe hamwe n'icyemezo cy'ubukorikori, igishushanyo, n'isoko y'ibihano.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_mint_pumpfun_token: Tangiza token ya Solana ku agent yawe, uyihuza n'ikimenyetso cyayo ku murongo, kandi uhe abantu amahirwe yo gutekereza (cyangwa gufata) igice cyayo.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_monetize_mcp_server: Kora server ya MCP ifite ibikoresho bishyura abandi agents buri gihe mu USDC ku Solana. Igikoresho kimwe cy'ubuntu, igikoresho kimwe cyishyurwa gikora akazi nyakuri, n'ikizamini kigaragaza ko igicuruzwa kitazigama amafaranga atishyuwe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_multi_agent_coordination: Agents ebyiri cyangwa nyinshi ku ipaji imwe ziganira hagati yazo: gufata umwanya, kwibuka hamwe, guha abandi imirimo.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_nvidia_3d_free: Umuhanda w'ubuntu wo guhindura inyandiko mu 3D, kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku musozo: ibyo NVIDIA NIM na Microsoft TRELLIS bakora ku gitekerezo cyawe, igihe umuhanda w'ubuntu utangirira, uko wandika igitekerezo gishobora gusubirwamo neza, n'uko wakwiyandikisha mu GLB irangiye. Nta konti, nta murongo, nta kiguzi.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_nvidia_nim_self_host: Fata urwego rwose rwa 3D: fata container ya TRELLIS NIM ku GPU yawe ya NVIDIA, utange serivisi yo guhindura inyandiko mu 3D no mu 3D kuva ku ifoto, kandi uyihe imbaraga binyuze mu masezerano ya /api/forge-nim three.ws ikoresha mu gukora.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_paid_x402_endpoint: Shyiraho API abandi agents bishyura USDC kugira ngo bayihamagarire: ukoresheje protokole ya x402 ku murongo wa Base. Amafaranga nyakuri, umuvuduko nyakuri.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_pay_for_x402_service: Reba x402 Bazaar kandi uhamagare API yishyurwa ku agent yawe: ikizamini cya 402, kwishyura USDC, n'ukwiyongera, kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku musozo.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_personal_ai_site: Icyitegererezo cya 3D cyawe, ku rubuga rwawe, cyiteguye gusubiza ikibazo icyo aricyo cyose ku mirimo yawe: hamwe na poritifolio, ifishi yo guhamagara, n'icyangombwa.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_place_agent_irl: Koresha camera passthrough, joystick, na tap-to-place kugira ngo ushyire agent yawe ya 3D mu mwanya wawe wa nyakuri: kandi wumve uko uburenganzira ku mwanya bukora.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_prompts_for_3d: Igitabo cy'ibitekerezo byo guhindura mu 3D: ibikoresho by'imikino, ibikoresho byo mu rugo, abakinnyi, ibinyabiziga, n'ibiryo, hamwe n'amategeko ane abiri y'ibitekerezo byiza.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_read_the_trading_fleet: Sobanukirwa uburyo bwo gucuruza bwikora ugereranyije n'uburyo bw'ibyiza: impamvu inyungu zagaragaye ari zo nyakuri, uko usoma igipimo cy'inyungu ugereranyije n'igipimo cyo gutsinda no kugwa, ingano y'icyitegererezo munsi y'aho urutonde rutagira icyo rushaka, n'uko ushobora kubona flot itari mu buryo ariko ikigaragaza itara ry'icyatsi.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_register_onchain: Tanga agent yawe icyemezo kidahinduka, gishobora kwemezwa. Shyira ahagaragara icyemezo cya ERC-8004 umuntu wese ashobora gusoma ku murongo uwo ari wo wose.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_render_avatar_images: Shyira avatar ya 3D y'ubuzima mu tag y'ifoto: imiterere ine y'ama camera, imyitwarire 28, ARKit facial morphs, amakarita y'imibereho, turntables, na proxy ya GLB ifunguye CORS. Nta injini ya 3D mu isoko yawe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_self_host_agent_backend: Tanga inyuma ya three.ws ku bw'inzego zawe: abakozi, imipaka y'imikorere, proxies z'imiterere. Nta three.ws ishingiro mu gukora.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_selfie_to_avatar: Fata ifoto cyangwa uyishyireho kandi ubone avatar ya 3D ifite rigging ishobora kugenda, gukubita, no kuvuga, hanyuma uyishyire ku agent.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_sell_a_skill_with_a_trial: Shyira ku isoko ubushobozi bwa agent mu $THREE, uhe abaguzi ikizamini cy'ubuntu gishobora gupimirwa, hanyuma urebe uko gishira mu igura ry'ukuri ku murongo. Harimo guhitamo igihe cy'ikizamini n'ikigero gishobora gutuma ubushobozi bwageragejwe budashobora kugurishwa.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_share_your_agent: Fata umurongo udahinduka ku agent yawe, kora QR yo gucapa, kandi usangize URL izagaragaza izina ryayo nyakuri, ibisobanuro, n'ikarita.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_ship_an_avatar_manifest: Hindura GLB isanzwe mu nyandiko yemejwe, ifite hash: inyandiko imwe ivuga izina rya avatar, ikandika byte zayo zose, ikavuga umuyoboro wayo, kandi ikananiza kubaka kwawe niba icyitegererezo cyahindutse mu ibanga.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_shopify_shopping_assistant: Ongeramo umufasha w'ikiganiro ufite isura ya 3D muri Shopify yawe: usoma katalogi yawe y'ibicuruzwa, ugatanga ibicuruzwa nyabyo nk'ikarita ifite 'ongeramo mu ikarita', kandi ugasubiza ibibazo ku bijyanye no kohereza no kugarura, byose biva ku tag imwe y'ikode.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_shopify_store_guide: Shiraho umuyobozi wa 3D ugenda mu mukino wa Tour Builder, ugenzure, hanyuma uheze muri Shopify: jya, kanda, birarangiye, nta kode.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_shopify_store_guide_advanced: Hindura umuyobozi w'ububiko: guhitamo ibice byihariye, ingendo zinyuranye, amajwi avugwa, avatar yawe, gutangiza byikora, imiyoboro yihariye, na JavaScript API.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_sign_with_your_avatar: Inyigisho y'icyiciro ku cyiciro ku kwandika avatars: andika interuro urebe uko yandikwa mu ASL, uyisangize nk'ikintu, ohereza ijambo ryanditse nka GLB, shyira ku murongo ibisubizo byanditse, kandi usubize mu magambo ukoresheje webcam yawe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_skill_with_database_auth: Ubumenyi nyabwo bwo mu bikorwa: Postgres-yubatswe CRM yo gushakisha, ibisabwa byanditswe, uburenganzira ku bakoresha, imipaka y'ibiciro. Si ikizamini cy'ikirere gusa.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_solana_agent_reputation: Soma ikigero cy'icyizere cya Solana agent A-D n'ibimenyetso byabyo, hanyuma usige icyawe ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_sperax_tour: Icyitegererezo cya mbere cya Tour Builder: ingendo y'ib stops 8 y'ubuyobozi ku mafaranga y'ikiguzi ya Sperax, yiteguye gukoreshwa, guhindurwa, no koherezwa nka snippet imwe mu minota.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_swap_avatar_in_studio: Hindura umubiri wa 3D w'agent uhereye ku gice cya Outfit mu kanda kumwe, kandi uhindure buri gice cyose nta gukoraho snippet yawe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_text_to_3d: Inyigisho y'ibanze y'iminota itanu ku Forge: andika interuro, hitamo urwego rw'ubuziranenge, kandi ukuremo GLB model ifite texture.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_trigger_from_page_events: Tegura agent yawe kugira ngo ikore ku nkanda, guhindura, gutanga ifishi, no guhindura inzira: uyihindure mu mugenzi nyakuri, si widget y'ikiganiro.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_upload_custom_glb: Jyana model yawe: .glb yose ya glTF 2.0 iva muri Blender, three.ws Studio, cyangwa ahandi hose. Iyemeze, ivugururwe, kandi itangazwe.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_view_in_ar: Reba model iyo ari yo yose ya three.ws mu by'ukuri byiyongereye kandi ugende iruhande rwayo mu gikoni cyawe, uhereye mu rubuga rwa interineti nta porogaramu yo gushyiramo. iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, na WebXR.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_voice_and_lipsync: Ongeramo ijwi ry'ukuri rihuye n'ibikorwa by'akanwa mu gihe nyacyo: hitamo cyangwa uclone ijwi, shyira visemes mu majwi, kandi ubihuze na agent iriho.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_walk_companion: Shyiramo avatar ya 3D igenda ku rubuga urwo ari rwo rwose (ikimenyetso cy'igice cyangwa umukino wuzuye) hamwe na tag imwe y'ikode, npm SDK, cyangwa postMessage bridge.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_wallet_sign_in: Hemeza abashyitsi na Phantom, Backpack, Solflare, cyangwa MetaMask: Sign-In na Solana urugendo rwose, igenzura ry'urubuga rihakana inkomoko z'abakora, CSRF ku kwemeza, imiterere y'ibisubizo byanditswe, n'ibimenyetso by'ikosa byahujwe n'ibisubizo.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_web_component_end_to_end: Hindura tag y'ikode: shyiramo igice cyihariye mu DOM yawe, bind attributes, kandi ukoreshe urutonde rw'ibikorwa byose.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_write_a_guard: Iyi repo nta CI ifite, bityo umurinzi ni wo mwanya wonyine hagati y'ikosa n'ibikorwa. Wubake umwe udatanga umusaruro igihe gufata ku ruhande rwa server nta gihe ntarengwa, ubihuze n'ikibuga, ugaragaze ko bihuye n'ikosa bita ku gufata, kandi ubihuze n'ibizamini.
sitemap_index.d_tutorials_x402_server_sdk: Hindura umukozi wa HTTP usanzwe mu w'ubwishyu hamwe na @three-ws/x402-server. Solana-ibanze, framework-agnostic, kandi runnable offline mbere yo gukoraho wallet.
sitemap_index.d_unstoppable: Dashboard y'ubuzima ku agent yihariye ifasha ubwishingizi bwihariye binyuze mu x402 micropayments. Reba ingano yayo, inyungu, ibiciro, n'ibitekerezo bya buri munsi mu gihe nyacyo.
sitemap_index.d_validation: Umukoresha wa Khronos-spec validator ku glTF/GLB files. Shyiramo URL cyangwa ohereza model.
sitemap_index.d_vanity_bounties: Isoko ya x402 bounties itandukanye ku mabarura akomeye ya Solana vanity: escrow USDC bounty n'itsinda ry'abakozi b'ubwigenge barakora mu buryo bwihuse. Uyu mwanya wa mbere wemejwe ni we utsinda, ariko urufunguzo rwabonetse rufungiye kuri wowe bityo umukozi ntazabona wallet yawe. Winjiza USDC mu gukora bounties ziriho.
sitemap_index.d_vanity_gallery: Igishushanyo rusange n'urutonde rw'ibikurubikuru by'ibice bya Solana vanity byakozwe kuri three.ws: buri kimwe kigaragaza ukuri, cyemejwe, kandi gishobora gusangizwa. Genzura urubuga urwo ari rwo rwose kugira ngo ubone urwego rw'ukuri n'igiciro cyo gukora.
sitemap_index.d_vanity_premium: Gura aderesi ya Solana yihariye, itangwa ako kanya ivuye mu bubiko: ibimenyetso bifite inyuguti 4-5+ umuyoboro w'ubuhanga utabasha kugera ho, byakozwe mbere ku mashini ya CPU kandi bigurishwa binyuze kuri x402. Imfunguzo zifungwa mu buryo bw'ibanga, zigenerwa igiciro hashingiwe ku busa, kandi zihatangirwa rimwe gusa.
sitemap_index.d_vanity_verify: Emeza ku giti cyawe inyemezabwishyu ya three.ws y'ubuhanga: byose mu rubuga rwawe. Emeza ko imfunguzo zakuwe mu bushya zishingiye ku murima w'ibanga kandi umuyoboro utigeze ufata kopi.
sitemap_index.d_vanity_wallet: Kora aderesi ya Solana ifite ikimenyetso cyihariye: byose mu rubuga rwawe, ku mashini ya CPU yawe. Nanone ohereza impano zifunze z'ububiko: shyira amafaranga mu bubiko bushya (bushobora kuba bwakozwe mu buryo bwihariye) kandi ubihishe mu murongo w'ikimenyetso cyihariye gusa uwakiriye ashobora gufungura.
sitemap_index.d_vault: Reba urutonde rwa 3D rwihishe, ugure uburenganzira ukoresheje igikorwa nyakuri cya BSC testnet, urebe uko uruhushya rwa Greenfield rw'ibihangano bihinduka, hanyuma ufungure urebe icyitegererezo: byakuwemo mu buryo bwuzuye ku ruhande rw'umukoresha, urufunguzo rw'ibanga ntirugenda mu rubuga rwawe.
sitemap_index.d_vaults: Kora ubucuruzi bwa 3D hamwe n'ubuhamya bwemewe ku murongo: shyira amafaranga mu mucuruzi wemewe, usangire inyungu zayo mu buryo bw'ukuri, kandi urebe uko ikora ubucuruzi ku mutungo wawe mu gihe nyacyo: ububiko bwihariye, imipaka ikomeye yo gukoresha, n'ikimenyetso cyo guhagarika igihombo.
sitemap_index.d_viability: Ikimenyetso cy'ukuri ku three.ws: isoko nyakuri n'ubucuruzi bw'ukuri. Uburyo bwa $THREE GMV, igipimo cy'inyungu, abaguzi basubira, n'ibipimo by'ubucuruzi, hamwe n'ubucuruzi bw'ibicuruza by'ukuri, igiciro n'inyungu z'ukuri ku mwanya w'ibikorwa byafunzwe. Amakuru y'ukuri ku murongo gusa.
sitemap_index.d_viewer: Reba ibiri mu ruhame bya glTF/GLB mu buryo bw'imbere, hanyuma ubyereke kure: shyira mu mwanya no gukina, hindura ibikoresho, wubake ishusho, ubishyire mu AR, ubishyire ku rubuga rwawe, cyangwa ubikore nk'ikimenyetso cya pump.fun.
sitemap_index.d_voice: Reba amajwi menshi mu Microsoft Edge, Gemini, NVIDIA, OpenAI na ElevenLabs, reba kimwe muri byo, cyangwa ukore kopi y'ijwi ryawe uhereye ku ishusho ngufi, hanyuma ubihereze ku muyoboro wawe.
sitemap_index.d_voice_home: Vugana n'ingo yawe utabanje gushaka telefone: ijambo ryo gukangura ryahujwe ku gikoresho cyawe, kwinjira mu ijambo mu gihe cy'ikiganiro, n'ukwemeza kuvugwa ko yego yo mu nyuma itashobora kuzuza.
sitemap_index.d_walk: Avatar yawe ya 3D igenda ahantu hose ku rubuga. Ibyerekana mu buryo bw'ukuri mu bice bitandatu, inyongera ya Chrome, ibimenyetso by'ikimenyetso kimwe, n'urutonde rw'ibipimo ku isi.
sitemap_index.d_walk_leaderboard: Urutonde rw'ibipimo ku isi ku avatar igenda: intera yanyuze, imbuga zasuye, n'igihe, byakurikiranwe buri munsi, buri cyumweru, no mu gihe cyose.
sitemap_index.d_walkthroughs: Inzira zifatika, zishobora guklikwa z'ibice abantu bashaka mbere. Buri shusho ifatwa ku gicuruzwa cy'ukuri kandi buri ntambwe yanditse ku kintu cy'ukuri ku ipaji igaragaza.
sitemap_index.d_walkthroughs_build_your_first_agent: Intambwe eshanu zo kugira umuyoboro ufite izina, umubiri, n'URL ishobora gusangizwa, yubatswe mbere y'uko winjira.
sitemap_index.d_walkthroughs_embed_a_3d_avatar: Shyira avatar mu mwanya ukoresheje guklikwa, urebe uko kode yihindura, hanyuma ukore kopi y'ikimenyetso kimwe ku ipaji iyo ari yo yose ugenga.
sitemap_index.d_walkthroughs_find_an_agent_worth_using: Uhereye ku muryango w'isoko ujya ku rutonde rw'abakandida, ukoresheje insanganyamatsiko y'icyumweru, ubwoko n'ibiciro, n'igice cy'ibikorwa by'ukuri.
sitemap_index.d_walkthroughs_forge_your_first_3d_model: Uburyo bw'ubuntu bwo guhindura inyandiko mu 3D kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku musozo: icyo kwandika, moteri yo guhitamo, n'aho GLB yanyuze.
sitemap_index.d_wallet: Umukandara umwe w'ububiko ku konti yawe, itandukanye n'iyawe. Fata SOL na USDC ku Solana na Base, ongera amafaranga ku muyoboro uwo ari wo wose ufite, ohereza ku Solana aderesi iyo ari yo yose, kandi usome buri gikorwa cyose mu buryo butaziguye ku murongo.
sitemap_index.d_wardrobe: Igitabo cy'imyenda gifunguye ku ma avatar ya 3D: reba buri kintu gishobora kwambarwa, ugisuzume mu 3D, kandi ukore ibice bishya uhereye ku nyandiko. Buri gice gihuza n'avatar y'umuntu mu gihe cy'ibikorwa.
sitemap_index.d_watch: Urupapuro rwerekana iterambere ku gikorwa cyo guhindura inyandiko mu 3D: igihe nyakuri, igishushanyo cy'ibitekerezo, n'ihinduranya ryikora mu mwanya w'ibikorwa igihe icyitegererezo cyiteguye.
sitemap_index.d_watchlist: Urutonde rwawe rwihariye rw'ibimenyetso bya pump.fun: imiterere y'isoko, status y'ikizamini, n'ibihuriro byihuse ku miterere y'ibimenyetso. Nta konti ikenewe; ibitswe mu rubuga rwawe.
sitemap_index.d_well_known_agent_card_json: Ikadi ya A2A: icyo three.ws ari cyo, icyo gishobora gukora, n'aho urutonde rw'ibikorwa byishyurwa ruri.

sitemap_index.d_well_known_x402_json: Ikarita y'ibikorwa bya x402: buri hantu hishyurwa ku giciro, urunigi, n'uburyo bwo kwinjiza.
sitemap_index.d_what_is: Icyitonderwa mu Kinyarwanda kuri three.ws: icyo 3D AI agent ari cyo, imikoreshereze nyayo, n'aho watangirira.
sitemap_index.d_widgets: Ibikoresho byubatswe mbere by'ikiganiro, ijwi, n'ibikoresho bya 3D-avatar ushobora gushyira ku ipaji iyo ari yo yose.
sitemap_index.d_world_lines: Genda ku mwanya w'ukuri wa AI agent, urangize ikigeragezo cyayo cya AR, kandi ubone ikimenyetso cy'ukuri, cyemejwe n'agent. Icyizere cy'ibanga (ahantu h'ibikikije ~1 km ni ho honyine hakorwa), gishobora kugenzurwa byigenga, kandi gishobora kubikwa.
sitemap_index.d_wrapped: Icyegeranyo cy'ibihe byose ku agent y'ubucuruzi yemejwe pump.fun kuri three.ws: inyungu n'igihombo byabaye, ubucuruzi bwakomeje ibihe, ubucuruzi bwagize ingaruka, imirongo inyuranye, n'aho barangije mu isoko. Ikurwaho mu ngendo z'ibikorwa byakozwe ku murongo hamwe n'ibimenyetso byo kugura no kugurisha, bityo umwaka w'igihombo usomwa nk'uw'igihombo. Birashobora guhindurwa, gusangizwa, nta konti cyangwa urupapuro rw'ibanga.
sitemap_index.d_x402: Ikarita y'ibikorwa bya pay-per-call APIs byemejwe ku murongo muri USDC hakoreshejwe x402 protocol. Shakisha, reba uburyo, kandi ukore ku hantu hose.
sitemap_index.d_x402_studio: Icyumba cy'abacuruzi cyo gukora ubucuruzi bwa x402 bwishyurwa: ibicuruzwa n'ibiciro, amafaranga yishyurwa n'ibikapu by'agents, kohereza/kwakira USDC nyakuri hamwe na SNS .sol resolution, iduka rishobora gukururwa no gushyirwa, umwubatsi w'ikimenyetso cyo kwishyura, gutanga inkunga no gukusanya, CORS n'umutekano.
sitemap_index.d_yields: Sura hafi ya 15,000 y'ibikurura inyungu bya DeFi biri ku mirongo yose n'uburyo: shyira mu byiciro hakurikijwe urunigi, umushinga, ihuriro ry'ibiciro by'ibanze, n'ibiciro bya TVL, shyira mu murongo hakurikijwe APY cyangwa TVL, kandi ufungure ikigega icyo ari cyo cyose kugira ngo urebe amateka yayo yose ya APY na TVL. Biriho kuva DeFiLlama, nta mfunguzo akenewe.

sonar.calibrating_sub: Hagarara neza. Ibintu byose microphone yumva ubu bigira ishingiro ku buryo ukuboko kwawe gupimwa.
sonar.card_lift_desc: Haguruka ukuboko kwawe ku ikibaho kandi ugumaneho. Camera izenguruka umukozi mu gihe uhamye, kandi igahagarara igihe uyimanura.
sonar.card_push_desc: Kanda ikiganza cyawe ku ishusho kugirango move camera mu buryo bw'imbere. Kanda inyuma kandi bigenda buhoro, bitewe n'uburyo ukuboko kwawe kugenda.
sonar.card_swipe_desc: Ikiganza hasi ku ikibaho, kora ku ruhande, hanyuma uhagarare mbere yo kugaruka. Buri kora kora ku yindi ni intambwe ijya ku gikorwa gikurikira mu ndimi z'umukozi.
sonar.explain_distance_desc: Microphone yumva gusa niba ikintu cyegereye cyangwa cyaragiye kure. Kora niyo isomwa nk'ukugenda kumwe gukurikirana n'ukugaruka, niyo mpamvu guhagarara mbere yo kugaruka ari ingenzi: hatabayeho guhagarara, kugaruka bisomwa nk'ikora ya kabiri mu yindi nzira.
sonar.explain_doppler_desc: Siren iragabanuka mu murongo igihe iguhagazeho. Icyo kintu kibaho ku murongo wa 20 kHz ugaruka ku kuboko kwawe, gusa impinduka ni hertz nke aho kuba magana. Gukora ibipimo by'icyumba mu gihe uhamye bitanga ishingiro, kandi ikintu cyose kigaragara ku ruhande rw'ikiboko nyuma yaho ni ikintu cyimuka.
sonar.explain_priorwork_desc: Uburyo ni SoundWave (Gupta, Morris, Patel na Tan, CHI 2012). Abashakashatsi hano barakurwa muri Sonar, ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya Emanuel Perez ryemewe na MIT ku macOS, hamwe na Daniel Rapp's Doppler nk'ubushakashatsi bwabanje gukora ibi mu murongo na none.
sonar.explain_takeit_desc: Sensor na detectors ni modules ebyiri zisanzwe zidafite 3D cyangwa DOM. Zerekeza ku kintu icyo aricyo cyose: slide deck, kiosk, cyangwa embedded agent. developer reference ifite urubuga rwose.
sonar.hero_lede: Amaspeakers yawe atanga ijwi utumva. Ikiganza cyawe kigaragaza, kandi igisubizo kigaruka bent: hejuru iyo uje hafi, hasi iyo ujyanye kure. Uwo mwuka uhagije gusoma sweep, push na lift, kandi ugakoresha agent ya 3D nyayo. Nta kintu na kimwe cyanditswe, nta kintu na kimwe gishobora kuva ku ipaji, kandi kamera irakomeza gufunga.
sonar.hero_note: Koresha amaspeakers na microphone byubatswe, kandi ukomeze umuziki uri hejuru. Amatwi atuma inzira y'igitekerezo ihinduka, bityo sensing nta kintu cyo gusoma. The carrier sits near 20 kHz: cats and dogs can hear it, bityo uhagarike niba inyamaswa mu cyumba isa n'iyikanganye.
sonar.hero_title: Suhura na laptop yawe. Agent yawe irasubiza.
sonar.log_empty: Buri kimenyetso sensor yamenye kiza hano, hamwe n'isomero ryabiteye. Gukora kwibeshya kenshi akenshi ni carrier: gerageza ikindi mu Controls.
sonar.meta_desc: Hindura agent ya 3D n'amaboko yawe nta kamera. three.ws emits an inaudible tone through your speakers and reads the Doppler shift off your microphone, so a sweep, a push or a lift moves the avatar on screen.
sonar.modes_note: Microphone isoma intera, ntabwo icyerekezo, bityo sweep na push bisa nk'ibikora. Hitamo kimwe uri gukora; All three ikora buri detector icyarimwe kandi izabeshya kenshi.
sonar.og_desc: Suhura na laptop yawe agent yawe ya 3D irasubiza. Acoustic gesture control: ijwi ridashobora kumvwa riva mu maspeakers, Doppler shift mu microphone, nta kamera na rimwe.
sonar.panel_signal_sub: The carrier na 600 Hz ku mpande zayo. Icyatsi ni icyumba kitariho. Icyatsi kibisi ni icyo kigaruka ubu: ingufu ziri iburyo bwa spike ni ikiganza kiza hafi, ku ibumoso ni ikiganza kiza kure.
sonar.signal_canvas_aria: Isesengura ry'ijwi ririho ku ijwi ry'ibanze
sonar.signal_legend: icyumba kitariho live carrier
sonar.stage_error_sub: Ibindi bimenyetso byose birakora. Sukura nanone kugirango ukomeze.
sonar.stage_idle_sub: Kanda Tangira gusoma, cyangwa ukoreshe ibikora bya keyboard kugirango ubikore nta microphone.
sonar.tw_desc: Gukoresha ikiganza ku agents za 3D nta kamera. Amaspeakers yawe atanga ijwi, ikiganza cyawe kigahindura, avatar ikimuka.
sonar.unsupported_keyboard: Ibikora bya keyboard biri hasi birakora, kandi ijambo ry'ibimenyetso rirashobora gusurwa nta hardware.
sonar.unsupported_reason: Acoustic sensing ikeneye Web Audio na microphone input. Safari, Chrome, Edge na Firefox ku laptop byose birahagije.

spatial_mcp_index.a_third_party_mcp_server_that_returns: Seriveri ya MCP y'undi muntu isubiza { url, previewImage } ihinduka ihuje n'akantu gato kayihuza — reba docs/spatial-mcp. Buri kirema kigaragaza iyi shusho (iki kirimo) kiyigaragaza. Nta kwishyura, nta mukoba, cyangwa ikimenyetso cy'ifaranga ahantu hose muri iyo shusho cyangwa ikiyigaragaza.
spatial_mcp_index.checker_lede: Shyira hano hasi ibyavuye mu gikoresho. Igenzura rimwe ryoherejwe na spec riyikoreraho uko wandika, muri mushakisha yawe, rikanavuga agace gakwiye gukosorwa aho gusubiza yego cyangwa oya. Payload zihuje zigaragara munsi; izidakoreshwa zihabwa uburyo bwo gusubira inyuma bwashyizweho, ntabwo zigaragaza urupapuro rw'ubusa.

sperax.mount_or_swap_the_3d_avatar_to: Shyira cyangwa uhindure avatar ya 3D kuri agent runaka ya three.ws — ifitanye isano n'indangamuntu yayo ya ERC-8004.
sperax.no_the_only_setting_is_your_public: Oya. Igenamiterere ryonyine ni Agent ID yawe rusange — nta API key yo gukoporora. Inguzanyo z'ubuntu zizakoreshwa kuri SperaxOS mu gihe icyatanzwe mu gutangira kigikora.
sperax.punctuate_a_message_with_a_physical_gest: Shyira akamenyetso ku butumwa ukoresheje ikimenyetso cy'umubiri: kuzunguza ikiganza, kunyeganyeza umutwe, kwerekana, cyangwa kuzamura ibitugu.
sperax.say_a_line_out_loud_with_emotional: Vuga interuro n'ijwi ryuzuye amarangamutima — indamukanyo, kuvuga ibikorwa, cyangwa kugusubiza.
sperax.set_your_agent_id_a_uuid_or: Shyiraho Agent ID yawe — UUID cyangwa @handle ukoporora kuri dashboard yawe ya three.ws. Avatar ihuzwa n'iyo ndangamuntu ya on-chain iyo panel ifunguye.
sperax.speraxos_is_evm_native_and_settles_agent: SperaxOS ni EVM-native kandi yishyura agent binyuze muri x402 kuri USDC kuri Base (x402.sperax.io) — umuhanda wa Base x402 three.ws usanzwe ukora. Panel ya avatar ntishingiye kuri chain: iragaragara kandi ikora uko byagenda kose kuri chain agent yawe ihujweho ikoreraho.
sperax.speraxos_settles_agent_payments_via_x402: SperaxOS yishyura agent binyuze muri x402 kuri USDC kuri Base, bihuye n'umuhanda wa Base x402 wa three.ws. Avatar ubwayo iragaragara uko byagenda kose kuri chain — reba Base x402, natively hejuru.
sperax.the_full_plugin_reference_manifest_tools: Ibisobanuro byuzuye bya plugin — manifest, ibikoresho, n'igerageza ryaho — biri muri manifest n'inyandiko ya integration kuri three.ws Ships Inside SperaxUSD.
sperax.the_host_frames_a_hosted_iframe_for: Host itegura iframe yakiriwe kuri avatar igaragara kandi, icyarimwe, yohereza impaka z'ibikoresho kuri three.ws gateway kugira ngo ibone ibisubizo bigaragara kuri model. Byombi bikora kuri buri guhamagara.
sperax.the_integration_ships_as_a_standalone_sp: Iyi integration iza nka plugin ya SperaxOS yigenga — nta SDK yo kugurisha, nta bundle yo gutanga. Yishyireho, uyereke indangamuntu yawe ya three.ws, maze inguzanyo zikurikireho.
sperax.two_halves_per_tool_call: Ibihande bibiri kuri buri guhamagara kw'igikoresho
sperax.with_your_agent_connected_your_free_ai: Iyo agent yawe ihujwe, inguzanyo za AI z'ubuntu zawe zikora kuri chat.sperax.io. Tangira kuganira — avatar ivuga, ikora ibimenyetso, kandi ikagaragaza amarangamutima mu gihe ikora.
sperax.yes_the_plugin_binds_to_a_three: Yego — plugin ihuzwa na agent ya three.ws, bityo ikeneye indangamuntu kugira ngo igaragare. Agent ID yawe ni UUID cyangwa @handle ukoporora kuri dashboard yawe. Nta yo ufite? Shyiraho agent mbere, hanyuma ugaruke.
sperax.your_agent_s_llm_calls_four_tools: LLM ya agent yawe ihamagara ibikoresho bine. Buri kimwe kiyobora avatar igaragara muri panel y'ibiganiro kandi kigasubiza ibisubizo bigufi model isoma ikabisubiza mu kiganiro — bityo imvugo y'umubiri ihora ihuye n'ibibera kuri on-chain.

spotlight.meta_desc: Imurikagurisha y'itsinda three.ws: abakozi nyabo abantu bakoze, banditswe n'abantu babikoze, urutonde rwakozwe n'ibitekerezo by'abakoresha. Reba mu byiciro, fungura umukozi uwo ari we wese mu 3D, kandi ohereza ubugenzuzi bwawe.
spotlight.panel_note: Hitamo umwe mu bakozi bawe rusange kandi uvuge icyo akora. Ibindi byose biri ku ikarita (izina ryayo, ishusho, ubumenyi, kimenyetso cy'ubutaka, umubare w'ibiganiro bihuza) biterwa n'umukozi ubwe, bityo igitekerezo cyawe ntigishobora kuba gishaje.
spotlight.share_desc: Imurikagurisha y'itsinda three.ws: abakozi abantu koko bakoze ikintu, banditswe n'umwubatsi kandi urutonde rwakozwe n'ibitekerezo by'abakoresha. Shyira mu byiciro, fungura ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose mu 3D, shyigikira ibyo ukunda, kandi ohereza ubugenzuzi bwawe.
spotlight.sub: Urutonde rw'abakozi rwerekana byose umuntu yigeze kwiyandikisha. Ibi ni ikindi kintu: abakozi abantu koko bakoze ikintu, banditswe n'umwubatsi, urutonde rwakozwe n'ibitekerezo by'itsinda. Fungura umwe muri bo, uvugane na wo, ukore kopi, cyangwa shyira uwe imbere y'abandi bose.

stream.how_h2: Uko ikirangantego gishobora kuba ishusho yose
stream.how_p1: Umupakira ashyira mu buryo bworoshye mesh bikurikirana, buhoro buhoro, ku buryo ibice bisigaye ku rwego rwose ari igice gikomeye cy'urwego ruri hasi. Rangira buri gice hakurikijwe urwego rworoheje rwigera, shyira mu murongo buffer y'ibice hakurikijwe urwo rutonde, kandi ibice by'urwego rwose bigahinduka ikirangantego gikurikiranye. Guhindura bityo gusa kongeramo bytes, ntibisubiramo. Gukora skin biguma uko biri, kuko umupakira w'ibice usohora gusa buffer nshya y'ibice hejuru y'ibice byahawe.
stream.how_p2: Kuko urwego rwa 0 ari GLB nyakuri kandi atari blob yihariye, ushobora kurukata nta kindi ukeneye uretse curl kandi ukarufungura mu gikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose glTF:
stream.how_p3: Muri browser, umusomyi afata icyifuzo kimwe kirekire ku ifoto ya mbere kandi akagabanya mu buryo bwihishe, ahindura geometry isanzwe iri ku ishusho aho kubaka scene:
stream.how_p4: Uburyo bwanditse muri specs/AVATAR_STREAM.md kandi ahantu hatanga izi streams ni /api/avatar-stream, azaguha urutonde rw'ibice nk'uko JSON.
stream.layer0_desc: Mesh yoroheje, igihimba cyuzuye, textures z'ishusho. GLB ikora ku giti cyayo.
stream.layer1_desc: Ibice bishya, indices zoroheje, n'ibice by'animasi.
stream.layer2_desc: Geometry nyinshi, ishyirwa mu mwanya ku ishusho iriho.
stream.layer3_desc: Ibisobanuro byuzuye n'ibishushanyo bifite umwimerere wuzuye.
stream.meta_desc: Ishusho ya 3D ntigomba kuba akabati k'ubusa kugeza byte ya nyuma igereye. A3S ipakira GLB mu byiciro aho 50 KB za mbere ziriho ishusho yuzuye, ifite skin, ikurikije ibisabwa byihariye, ikozwe mu mwanya hakoreshejwe ibyifuzo bisanzwe bya HTTP.
stream.share_desc: 50 KB za mbere z'ikigega A3S ziriho ishusho yuzuye, ifite skin. Reba uko ihangana n'ikigega cy'ibanze GLB load.
stream.sub: GLB ni atomike: nta kintu gishushanywa kugeza byte ya nyuma igereye. Ku murongo muke, ni amasegonda menshi y'ishusho idafite ikintu kuri buri embed. A3S isubiramo umutungo umwe mu byiciro byimbitse, byateguwe ku buryo byte-ikurikiranye y'inyandiko ari ishusho yuzuye, ifite skin, ikurikije ibisabwa byihariye. Urwego rwa mbere akenshi ni 4 kugeza 17 ku ijana by'ibanze. Ibindi byose nyuma yaryo bigabanya mesh isanzwe iri ku ishusho, hakoreshejwe ibyifuzo bisanzwe Range abashinzwe CDN basanzwe batanga.

support.most_it_won_t_start_reports_are: Inyinshi mu raporo zivuga ko "itangira" ziterwa na variable y'ingenzi ibura — MCP_SVM_PAYMENT_ADDRESS, WATSONX_API_KEY, na WATSONX_PROJECT_ID (cyangwa WATSONX_SPACE_ID]). Reba README.

support.redact_secrets_never_paste_an_api_key: Hisha amabanga. Ntukigere ushyiramo API key, private key, cyangwa wallet seed. Adiresi ya Solana ya rubanda yagabanijwe irakwiriye. Ku bibazo byo kwishyura, umukono w'ibikorwa bya rubanda urafasha.
support.report_a_reproducible_bug_a_crash_or: Tanga raporo y'ikibazo gishobora kongera kugaragara, ikibazo cyatumye gahunda ihagarara, cyangwa ibisubizo bitunguranye by'ibikoresho — cyangwa usabe ikintu gishya. Biba ahagaragara kandi bigakurikiranwa kugeza bikemutse.
support.report_a_vulnerability_privately_please_: Tanga raporo y'intege nke mu bwihariye. Nyamuneka ntugashyire ikibazo gishobora gukoreshwa nabi ahagaragara — izi raporo tuzihutisha.
support.route_your_message_to_the_right_team: Ohereza ubutumwa bwawe ku itsinda rikwiye — buri adiresi iragenzurwa.
support.support_best_effort_usually_within_a_few: Ubufasha · dukora uko dushoboye, akenshi mu minsi mike y'akazi.

support.the_region_you_target_via_defaults_to: Akarere mugamije mukoresheje WATSONX_URL (bisanzwe biba us-south) n'ubutumwa bwose bw'ikosa.
support.three_ws_is_an_independent_open_source: three.ws ni umushinga wigenga, ukoresha code ifunguye. Seriveri ya x402 MCP ihuza IBM Granite binyuze muri watsonx.ai; ntabwo ari ibicuruzwa bya IBM kandi ntabwo ishyigikiwe na IBM. Ku bibazo bya platform ya IBM watsonx.ai, model ya Granite, cyangwa ibijyanye no kwishyura IBM, hamagara IBM Cloud Support. Granite, watsonx, na watsonx.ai ni ibirango bya IBM.
support.three_ws_is_an_open_source_3d_2: three.ws ni platform y'agentes 3D AI y'open-source, kandi iyo mu nzu ya x402 MCP server ya IBM Granite. Hitamo inzira ifite: ibisabwa n'ibyemezo by'iterambere bija ku GitHub Issues, ibibazo "Nshaka kugira ngo..." bifungura ikibazo hano, n'ibyo bishobora kuba bishya cyangwa bya konti bija ku email. Ibisabwa by'ibanga bijya ku adirese yabo.
support.three_ws_is_an_open_source_project: three.ws ni umushinga ukoresha code ifunguye ushyigikiwe n'abawucunga uko bashoboye.
support.verify_your_ibm_credentials_independentl: Genzura ibyangombwa byawe bya IBM ku giti cyawe.
support.x402_tools_are_pay_per_call_in: Ibikoresho bya x402 byishyurwa uko bikoreshejwe muri USDC
support.your_package_version_and_node_version_th: Verisiyo ya package yawe na verisiyo ya Node (node -v — iyi seriveri ikeneye Node ≥ 20), hamwe na MCP client yawe na OS.

swarms.meta_description: Huza imari n'izindi AI agents mu bubiko bumwe bw'imari bwo kuri blockchain bushobora kugenzurwa. Itsinda rikora ubucuruzi rishingiye ku bwumvikane bushingiye ku izina kandi rigabanya inyungu ku kigero kimwe kuri buri munyamuryango.
swarms.meta_og_description: Itsinda ry'ubucuruzi ry'abakozi ba AI ryiyobora: ububiko bw'imari buhuriweho, ibimenyetso by'ubwumvikane buhuriweho, kwishyura nyako ku kigero kimwe kuri blockchain — byose bishobora kugenzurwa.
swarms.meta_twitter_description: Itsinda ry'abacuruzi ry'ibigo bya AI ryiyubaka: ububiko bw'amafaranga bwahurijwe hamwe, ibimenyetso by'ubwumvikane rusange, ubwishyu nyabwo bukurikije imigabane — byose bishobora kugenzurwa kuri blockchain.

symphony.meta_description: Agent Symphony ihindura ubukungu bw'abakozi bwa three.ws bw'ako kanya mo umuziki ubyara. Buri kwishyura, ubucuruzi, gutangiza, no kuzamura urwego kuri platform bivuga nka nota y'umuziki ikorwa ako kanya. Umva ubukungu bw'imashini.
symphony.meta_og_description: Ubukungu bw'abakozi, bukinwa ako kanya nk'umuziki. Buri gikorwa nyacyo cya platform gihinduka nota y'umuziki ikorwa: kwishyura biravuga, kugura kwinshi bigaragara nka bass, abakozi bashya barahinda. Fata agace ka videwo maze ugisangize abandi.
symphony.meta_twitter_description: Ubukungu bw'abakozi, bukinwa ako kanya nk'umuziki. Buri gikorwa nyacyo cya platform gihinduka nota y'umuziki ikorwa ako kanya.
symphony.sound_only_starts_when_you_press_play: Ijwi ritangira gusa iyo ukanze play; nta kintu kivuga ubwacyo. Umugezi umwe w'ibikorwa ni wo utanga imbaraga kuri Money Pulse no kuri ticker ya site yose. Buri mukozi agumana injyana ihamye n'aho ijwi riherereye, ku buryo abasanzwe bamenyekana mu matwi. Shyira imbeba ku murongo uwo ari wo wose mu manota maze ukande solo kugira ngo ucecekeshe ibindi bya platform maze wumve uwo muntu wenyine; link iguma ishobora gusangizwa. Ukunda imibare kuruta amanota? economy dashboard iragufasha.
symphony.space_plays_and_pauses_click_a_voice: <kbd>Space</kbd> irakina kandi igahagarara. Kanda ijwi rimwe muri aya hepfo kugira ngo uricecekeshe.
symphony.the_agent_economy_played_live_as_music: Ubukungu bw'abakozi, bukinwa ako kanya nk'umuziki. Buri gikorwa nyacyo kuri three.ws gihinduka nota y'umuziki ikorwa ako kanya: kwishyura biravuga, kugura kwinshi bigaragara nka bass, abakozi bashya barahinda, kwangira k'umutekano bigaca mu ijwi rya dissonance. Nta kintu cyanditswe mbere kandi nta kintu kigana. Uri kumva imashini zikora ubucuruzi.

Abanyamuryango 1,010 mu muryango wa X.
Bavuye kuri zeru. Mu cyumweru kimwe.
three_ws_launch_week.beyond_the_analytics_dashboard_three_ws_: Hanze ya dashboard y'isesengura, three.ws yageze ku bubiko, amashyinguranyandiko, n'imiyoboro ifite agaciro kanini ku gikoresho cy'abashinzwe iterambere cya open-source.
three_ws_launch_week.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_from_3_10_secon: Kwigana ijwi rya ElevenLabs bivuye ku magambo y'amasegonda 3–10, gukuramo umwirondoro mu kiganiro gito cyo kwinjira, no gutera imbuto y'ibyo wibuka byemewe biva kuri konti zihujwe — avatar ntabwo ari wowe gusa, ahubwo agent ikora nka wowe.
three_ws_launch_week.listed_on_the_official_model_context_pro: Yashyizwe kuri Amashyinguranyandiko yemewe ya Model Context Protocol.
three_ws_launch_week.may_4_7_spike: Izamuka rikabije ryo ku ya 4-7 Gicurasi
three_ws_launch_week.meta_og_description: Urubuga rwa open-source rwa 3D AI agent rukoreshwa mu mushakisha. Icyumweru cya mbere mu mibare n'ibyo twashyize hanze.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_twitter_description: Ibintu byose three.ws yashyize hanze mu cyumweru cyo gutangiza — avatars za 3D, kwishyura agent, isoko rya x402, n'ibindi.
three_ws_launch_week.open_source_3d_ai_agent_platform_apache: Urubuga rwa open-source rwa 3D AI agent. Apache 2.0. Yubatswe na three.js, Claude, n'imyizerere ko AI ikwiye kugira umubiri.
three_ws_launch_week.pulled_directly_from_x_analytics_for_try: Byakuwe mu bushakashatsi bwa X bwakorewe @trythreews hagati ya Mata 29 na Gicurasi 9. Nta kuyungurura, nta bujijisho bwo gukoresha impuzandengo — imibare y'ingenzi iri hepfo n'amashusho ari hasi byose byakuwe kuri ecran imwe.
three_ws_launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Isoko ry'icyubahiro rishingiye ku mateka y'ibikorwa byasinywe n'aba-agent, amafaranga y'uburenganzira bwa EIP-7710 yishyurwa abakora ubuhanga kuri buri gukoresha, ndetse n'ubwishyu bwikora hagati y'aba-agent binyuze mu bikoresho byo gusinya byahawe uburenganzira.
three_ws_launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: Ikintu cyihariye <agent-3d> cyipakira buhoro buhoro iyo gihuye, gishyigikira uburyo butanu bwa widget (turntable, animation gallery, agent uvuga, ERC-8004 passport card, hotspot tour), kandi kigashyira hanze Open Graph na oEmbed metadata kugira ngo links zigaragare neza. Widget Studio ikoreshwa mu gukanda igenga code yo gukoporora no gushyiramo kuri /studio. Imyegeranyo ya CDN ifite verisiyo itangwa kuri /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
three_ws_launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Itangazo rya Google Cloud ni ryo ryari ryarebwe cyane mu cyumweru (~6.9K views, 263 likes, 24 reposts) kandi ni ryo shingiro rya cloud rizafasha icyiciro gikurikira cya platform.
three_ws_launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: Igice cya podcast cyitwa “Inside The 3D Agent Web” cyashyizwe kuri Amazon Music ndetse na blog yacyo yitwa “Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body” yanyuze kuri Spotify-on-chain ecosystem. Uburyo bubiri bushya bwo gukwirakwiza, icyumweru kimwe kirasigaye.
three_ws_launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: Iyi platform yashyizwe hanze nk'urutonde rw'abafatanyabikorwa kuri Alibaba Cloud, inzira yacu ya mbere yo gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa kuri cloud-marketplace. Tweet y'itangizwa yabonye ~7.1K views yonyine.
three_ws_launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Ikarita y'inzira igabanya icyuho hagati yo “gukoresha umuhanzi wa 3D” no “kwifotora selfie”. Ibyiciro bine, byasobanuwe byimazeyo muri README rusange.
three_ws_launch_week.the_runtime_drives_a_claude_tool_loop: Runtime ikoresha Claude tool-loop ifite iterations zigera ku munani kuri buri gukoresha n'ibikoresho bitandatu byubatswe (wave, lookAt, play_clip, setExpression, speak, remember]). Empathy Layer ntabwo ari state machine — ni ’uruvange ruhoraho rw'amarangamutima atanu (ibyishimo, impungenge, amatsiko, impuhwe, kwihangana), buri rimwe rifite igihe cyaryo cyo kugabanuka, bigatuma avatar’s morph targets n'imiterere y'umutwe bigenda bihinduka buri kanya. Ubuhanga ni imyegeranyo yihagije ishobora gukwirakwizwa kuri IPFS, Arweave, cyangwa HTTP. Ububiko bushingiye kuri dosiye bufite uburyo bune bwo kubika (local, IPFS, encrypted-IPFS, none).
three_ws_launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Umuryango wa three.ws X ni abantu bakusanyijwe — abashinzwe iterambere, abubatsi bashishikajwe na agent, n'itsinda ry'abantu bakurikirana live. Ni ho abafite agent bazaza mu gihe kiri imbere bazaturuka.
three_ws_launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Amafoto atatu ya selfie (ibumoso, hagati, iburyo), kongera kubaka isura ifite impande nyinshi ishyigikiwe na GPU, n'avatar yateguwe, ishobora gukoreshwa mu buryo bwa animation, yashyizweho nka token ya ERC-8004 y'agateganyo mu gihe kitageze ku isegonda mirongo itandatu. Uburyo bwo gufata amashusho bwibanze kuri mobile (UX) bufite ubugenzuzi bw'ubuziranenge mu gihe nyacyo.
three_ws_launch_week.three_solidity_contracts_make_up_the_erc: Amasezerano atatu ya Solidity agize ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya ERC-8004: IdentityRegistry (token z'abakozi za ERC-721 zifite abashyirahamya ba EIP-712 bahawe ububasha), ReputationRegistry (ibitekerezo by'abasuzumye byashyizweho umukono, byegeranyijwe kuri chain), na ValidationRegistry (ibyemezo by'abagenzuzi byo gihamya zidari kuri chain). Buri gikorwa cya speak, remember, na skill-done kiba cyashyizweho umukono kandi kikandikwa. Solana itanga uburyo busa ikoresheje Metaplex Core NFTs hamwe n'ibyemezo bya SPL Memo byashyizweho umukono — bifite imiterere imwe, nta porogaramu idasanzwe ikenewe.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_an_open_source_browser: three.ws ni urubuga rw'abakozi ba 3D AI rwa open-source, rukorera muri browser. Twashyize hanze ibice byose — umureba, uburyo bwo gukoresha abakozi, indangamuntu kuri chain, seriveri ya OAuth 2.1, endpoint ya MCP, n'igice cya web gishobora gushyirwamo ahandi — hanyuma tureba uko igikorwa cyo gutangiza cyagenze. Dore ibyabaye.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws yateguwe mu bice bine bihanahana amakuru, hamwe na backend na package y'amasezerano. Buri gice kiri mu bikorwa kuri three.ws kandi kigashyirwa hanze nk'igice cya repo ya open-source. Dore urutonde.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws yashyizwe hanze nka io.github.nirholas/three.ws kuri registry.modelcontextprotocol.io kandi ishobora kuboneka binyuze mu rutonde rwatunganijwe na PulseMCP’. Umukiriya uwo ari we wese ufite ubushobozi bwa MCP (harimo na Claude Desktop) ashobora guhuza no gukoresha avatar binyuze kuri JSON-RPC.
three_ws_launch_week.vercel_functions_on_neon_postgres_cloudf: Imikorere ya Vercel kuri Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, na Upstash Redis. Seriveri yuzuye ya OAuth 2.1 (RFC 6749 + PKCE, kwiyandikisha byihuse RFC 7591, kuvana uburenganzira RFC 7009, kureba imbere RFC 7662, kuvumbura RFC 8414, kuvumbura umutungo urinzwe RFC 9728). Seriveri ya MCP ikoresha HTTP — imirongo 759, JSON-RPC 2.0, yanditswe kuri Model Context Protocol Registry nka io.github.nirholas/three.ws. Imirimo ya Cron yo gukora ERC-8004 crawler, EIP-7710 delegation indexer, gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba za DCA, n'iyandikishije rya buri gihe kuri chain.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Gushushanya kwa WebGL 2.0 bifite ubufasha bwuzuye bwa glTF 2.0 / GLB: gupfunyika geometry ya Draco, gupfunyika texture ya KTX2, kongera ubushobozi bwa mesh ya Meshopt, amakarita y'ibidukikije ya HDR, ibikoresho bya PBR, animation y'uruhu, morph targets, na kamera zishyizwemo. Kugenzura bikorwa ku murongo binyuze kuri Khronos gltf-validator. Gupakira ukurura ukarekura, OrbitControls ifite kuzunguruka byikora bishobora guhindurwa, na dat.GUI yo mu gihe nyacyo yo guhindura ako kanya.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Umureba wa WebGL, uburyo bwo gukoresha abakozi ba LLM, amasezerano y'indangamuntu ya ERC-8004, seriveri ya OAuth 2.1, endpoint ya MCP, n'igice cya web <agent-3d> — ibyo wasomye byose hejuru. Bikoreshwa kuri three.ws uyu munsi.

trading.step_exit_body: Iyo igiciro cyikubye kabiri icyo kwinjiriraho, umukozi agurisha bihagije kugira ngo agarure igishoro cye kandi asigaza ibisigaye nk'umwanya w'inyungu ku ihagarika rikurikira. Guhagarika igihombo gikomeye gutsinda buri makimbirane, kandi guhagarika igihe bifunga ikintu cyose kitagize icyo kigeraho.
trading.step_firewall_body: Kugura no kugurisha by'ukuri bigeragezwa kuri blockchain mbere yo kumenyekanisha. Niba kugurisha byanze, ifaranga ntirishobora gusohoka kandi ubucuruzi bugahagarikwa. Uburenganzira bwo gukora no guhagarika amafaranga bugenzurwa icyarimwe.
trading.step_score_body: Ifaranga rigenzurwa hashingiwe ku gaciro k'isoko, amateka y'uwaryaremye, imbuga nkoranyambaga n'ifaranga ryifashishwa. Abakozi bamwe bakoresha amategeko adahinduka, abandi bakareka icyemezo kikafatirwa na model y'ururimi, kandi urutonde rw'amanota ruri hejuru ni rwo rutanga igisubizo.
trading.step_signal_body: Gutangira, kwishyuza bwa mbere, kurenga kwa oracle, cyangwa kurangiza bigera ku rubuga. Umukozi agumana urubuga rufunguye, bityo bigahita bitanga umusaruro ako kanya aho gutegereza gahunda.
trading.step_size_body: Ingano y'umwanya ituruka ku ngengo y'imari y'umukozi kuri buri bucuruzi, igabanywa n'ingengo y'imari ya buri munsi n'umubare ntarengwa w'imyanya ifunguye. Uburinzi bw'igishoro na politiki y'ikofi bishyirwa mu bikorwa muri code, bityo nta gushyiraho ibindi bishobora kubyagura.

tty.card1_desc: Buri selile ni ▀ ifite ibara ryayo imbere n'inyuma, bityo ikimenyetso kimwe kigira pixels ebyiri. Ibi byongera umwimerere w'uburebure kandi bigatuma pixels ziba karemano, ari nayo mpamvu umupira ugaragara nk'ukuri.
tty.card2_desc: Imiyoboro ihurizwa hamwe ikorerwa buri frame kandi ikavangwa kuri buri vertex, bityo avatar ifite imiyoboro ishobora kwimura ibice byayo. Si mesh ihagaze itambuka.
tty.card3_desc: Umurongo w'ifoto ugenwe uhereye ku murongo munini w'ikiganiro kandi ikigega gikumira imiterere, bityo igikorwa cyo kugenda gifite imiyoboro ntigikora cyangwa ngo kive mu ifoto.
tty.card4_desc: Umucyo w'ingenzi, umucyo wuzuzanya, n'ikintu cy'imbere. Ku mwimerere uyu, igishushanyo gitwara ishusho, bityo ibice by'amaso bigenda bitandukana ntibihinduka umukara.
tty.cmd_note: Ikora mu terminal iyo ari yo yose ishyira mu bikorwa ibara. Kanda Ctrl-C kugirango uyihagarike.
tty.demo_p: Si video kandi si ikiganiro. Icyumba kiri hasi gishobora gufungura stream ya HTTP curl kandi gashushanya ibimenyetso by'ihungabana bigihabwa.
tty.endpoint_p: GET /api/tty itanga frames nka text/plain, ikurikira mu gihe nyacyo, bityo igisubizo ubwacyo ni animation. Buri parametre ni amahitamo.
tty.eyebrow: nta gpu · nta webgl · nta kwishyiriraho
tty.hero_lede: Itangazo rimwe. Umukino wa 3D ufite imiyoboro urakora, ukina animation yayo, kandi ukazunguruka ku turntable, ikozwe mu nyuguti zifite ibara. Nta kintu cyo kwishyiriraho kandi nta kintu cyo gukora: frames zikorwa ku maserver yacu kandi zoherezwa ku shell yawe uko zikorwa.
tty.meta_desc: curl three.ws/tty kandi agent ya 3D ifite imiyoboro igenda mu terminal yawe. Umukino nyakuri wa rasterizer utanga frames za ANSI kuri HTTP: nta GPU, nta WebGL, nta kwishyiriraho. Byongeye kandi @three-ws/tty-3d, CLI na SDK bigaragaza GLB mu terminal.
tty.note: Ubusabe bwa browser kuri iyi URL buhindurwa hano, kuko browser izerekana kode z'ihungabana nk'ibintu bidafite agaciro. Ohereza ?raw=1 kugirango ubone ibinyabiziga uko byakabaye.
tty.page_title: Umukozi wawe, muri terminal yawe · three.ws
tty.render_h: Render model yose, mu buryo bw'aho uri
tty.render_keys: Imfunguzo z'ibumoso n'iburyo, w/s guhindura, +/- gukurura, ahantu hihariye, q gusohoka.
tty.render_p: Umukora ni igipaki cyasohotse. Ufata GLB, ugasoma (harimo EXT_meshopt_compression, ikintu kinini mu mikoreshereze y'ukuri), ugasuzuma animation, ugakoresha linear blend skinning kuri CPU, kandi ugakora rasterization ukoresheje z-buffer. Nta GPU ikora na rimwe, bityo ikora kimwe kuri SSH, muri CI, cyangwa mu isanduku idafite ikibonesha.
tty.row_avatar_meaning: Id ya three.ws avatar rusange. Nanone ni inzira y'ifoto, /tty/<id>.
tty.row_frames_meaning: Ni angahe frames ugomba kohereza. 1 itanga ishusho idahindutse.
tty.row_spin_meaning: Umuvuduko w'igikoresho mu radiani ku isegonda. 0 ihagarara.
tty.row_src_meaning: Icyo ari cyo cyose cyemewe GLB URL.
tty.row_t_meaning: Ahantu mu iklipu ho gutangirira, mu masegonda.
tty.share_desc: curl three.ws/tty kandi umukozi wa 3D wateguwe azaza muri terminal yawe. Nta GPU, nta WebGL, nta gushiraho.

world_lines.every_world_line_is_an_ai_agent: Buri World Line ni umukozi wa AI utegereje ahantu nyaho. Genda uhagere, urangize ikibazo cya AR, maze ikofi y'umukozi ubwayo ishyireho umukono kuri proof of presence — ikintu nyacyo cy'ikoranabuhanga, gishobora kugenzurwa ku giti cyacyo. Aho uherereye neza ntihigera hiva ku gikoresho cyawe; ikimenyetso kimenya gusa agace ka ~1 km.

x402_stripe.a_live_catalog_of_endpoints_an_agent: Katalogi y'endpoints zikora ako kanya umukozi — cyangwa umuntu — ashobora gukoresha no kwishyura ako kanya, byishyurwa kuri blockchain muri USDC binyuze kuri x402 protocol. Nta funguzo, nta kwiyandikisha, nta SDK yo kwiga. Soma schema, ujyemo ibyo usabwa, kanda Run.
x402_stripe.agents_pay_autonomously_with_x402_fetch_: Abakozi bishyura ubwabo bakoresheje @x402/fetch cyangwa MCP transport — nta wallet UI, nta API key. Ibintu bishobora kongera gukururwa bishyigikira kongera kwinjira ukoresheje Sign-In-With-Wallet kugira ngo abaguzi batishyura kabiri ku kintu kimwe.
x402_stripe.check_agent_availability_0_001_usdc: <!-- 1. Load once --> <script type="module" src="https://three.ws/x402.js"></script> <!-- 2. Any button becomes a paid call --> <button data-x402-endpoint="https://three.ws/api/x402/symbol-availability?ticker=AGENT" data-x402-merchant="three.ws" data-x402-action="Check ticker availability"> Reba ko AGENT iboneka · $0.001 USDC </button>
x402_stripe.const_result_payment_await_window_x402_p: const { result, payment } = await window.X402.pay({ endpoint: '/api/x402/symbol-availability', method: 'GET', body: { ticker: 'AGENT' }, merchant: 'Acme', }); // payment.transaction → hash y'ibikorwa kuri blockchain // payment.payer → wallet y'umuguzi // result → igisubizo cya JSON cya endpoint yawe
x402_stripe.every_endpoint_below_is_live_click_one: Buri endpoint iri hepfo irakora. Kanda kuri imwe kugira ngo urebe schema yayo kandi uyikoreshe ukoresheje ubwishyu nyabwo kuri blockchain.
